Abstract: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.

</details>


### [46] [Landmark-Free and Scale-Blind Multi-View Registration of Preoperative Liver Models to Intraoperative Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24218)
*Jiaming Feng,Gerardo Loza Galindo,Shahid Farid,Sharib Ali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SimCompose估计包含尺度在内的完整相似变换，并用几何选择器与Neo-Hookean非刚性细化实现无地标、无真值的多视图配准，成功率达77%。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目重建难以保证尺度，而刚性运动配准需要尺度作为输入；同时手术场景中缺乏真值对齐，配准失败的可靠检测十分困难。

Abstract: Augmented-reality guidance in laparoscopic liver resection requires aligning preoperative 3D liver models from CT/MRI with intraoperative surfaces. Monocular reconstruction in most cases cannot guarantee scale, albeit rigid-motion registration requires scale as an input. Our proposed framework ``SimCompose'' estimates the full similarity transformation $\Sim$, including scale, without relying on landmarks and applies the same transformation across multiple views with known relative geometry. However, reliable detection of registration failures remains challenging in surgical settings, where ground-truth alignment is generally unavailable. For this, we propose a geometry-based selector that evaluates candidate transformations without requiring ground truth. Large disagreement among these transformations is used to flag potentially unreliable registrations. Finally, we propose to use a non-rigid refinement based on a low-dimensional deformation model from Neo-Hookean simulations in the Simulation Open Framework Architecture (SOFA), without additional network training. SimCompose is trained exclusively on synthetic partial views. Its encoder processes point clouds normalised to a unit root-mean-square radius, without access to metric scale, and filters each view before multi-view fusion. Evaluation on unseen synthetic data (300 single-view pairs per run; 100 three-view registrations) shows that multi-view integration and candidate selection increase the success rate under stringent $\Sim$ accuracy criteria from 38.4% for a single-view, single-method configuration to 77%. Existing learning-based baselines do not satisfy these criteria even when provided with the exact scale. On five in-vivo patients with 92 keyframes, the rigid registration stage reduces surface error more than three-fold relative to learning-based baselines with external scale information.

</details>

*unsu Kim,Naeun Kim,Dongyoon Han,Seungryul Baek*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户希望用语言查询在可动画高斯avatar上做局部编辑与动作检视，但现有语言高斯splatting方法存在两类歧义：相邻部件与服装难以分离且常被间接指代（区域歧义），细粒度动作在RGB上高度相似（动作歧义）。

Method: HumanSkill-4D为免训练框架，跨avatar共享一个多模态大语言模型与几何算子。每个avatar构建语义记忆，将身体部位与服装类别关联到持久的高斯区域及外观描述；MLLM依据类别名与描述按外观、关系或功能选类别；动作层面维护驱动关节轨迹的运动记忆，MLLM将算子组合成程序以在轨迹上检验查询条件，从而实现动作区间匹配。

Abstract: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

</details>

Abstract: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity single-shot synthesis, yet practical storytelling creation requires multi-shot videos with both strong inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability. To achieve this, our framework combines a hierarchical attention mechanism for multi-level narrative consistency with 3D-aware layout guidance for precise, per-shot spatial control. ### [49] [Hierarchical and Query-Aware Visual Token Pruning for High-Resolution LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24102)
*Luther Wei,Ling Zou,Kang-Yang Huang,Yu-Syuan Xu,Wen-Huang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的分层视觉token剪枝框架，利用查询引导在LLM执行前剪枝，在25%保留率下保持98.0%性能并实现2.0倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率LVLM通过全局缩略图+多个局部裁剪保留细粒度视觉信息，产生数千视觉token，成为LLM推理瓶颈。现有剪枝方法多依赖与查询无关的视觉显著性；查询感知方法要么仅停留在粗粒度裁剪级，要么在视觉token已进入重型LLM层后才计算相关性，为时过晚。

Method: 免训练的分层token剪枝框架，在任何LLM块执行前引入查询引导。三层自上而下：①实例级——依据样本视觉复杂度动态缩放每个样本的视觉token保留率；②裁剪级——用句级跨模态相似性将样本预算分配到各局部裁剪；③token级——在共享空间利用投影后的视觉token与文本查询token嵌入度量细粒度对齐，并用文本去偏归一化得到高保真查询分数。最终将查询引导的预算与分数同局部、全局视觉显著性指标融合，选出关键视觉token。

Abstract: High-resolution Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) preserve critical, fine-grained visual details by encoding a global thumbnail alongside multiple local crops. However, the resulting thousands of vision tokens introduce severe computational bottlenecks during Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Existing token pruning methods rely primarily on query-agnostic visual saliency, while current query-aware approaches either operate at a coarse crop-level resolution or compute token relevance too late, after vision tokens have already entered the heavy LLM layers. To address this, we propose a training-free, hierarchical token pruning framework that utilizes query guidance prior to executing any LLM blocks. Our top-down hierarchy first operates at the instance-level, dynamically scaling the vision token retention ratio of each sample based on its visual complexity. Next, at the crop-level, we distribute this sample budget across local crops using sentence-level cross-modal similarity. Finally, at the token-level, we exploit projected vision tokens alongside textual query token embeddings in the shared space to measure fine-grained alignment, applying a text-debiasing normalization to produce high-fidelity query scores. These query-guided budgets and scores are fused with local and global visual saliency metrics to select the most critical vision tokens. Extensive experiments on LLaVA-NeXT-7B demonstrate that our plug-and-play framework retains 98.0% and 94.8% of unpruned performance at 25% and 10% vision token retention, respectively. </details>

*Xinyu Fang,Yuchi Wang,Weihao Yu,Rongyao Fang,Zhaohai Li,Zhixun Li,Tiancheng Gu,Xilin Wei,Yuhang Zang,Hongsheng Li,Dahua Lin,Guofeng Zhang,Shuai Bai,Zhibo Yang,Dayiheng Liu*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型已可充当自主智能体，通过代码或直接软件操作创建与编辑 3D 模型；实际工作流要求模型从多样参考中推断物体形状、材质、空间布局与光照，并严格遵循指令完成重建、修改或设计。然而现有基准对真实场景中此类开放式请求覆盖不足，缺乏对复杂 3D 交付物的严格评测手段。

Method: 构建 BlenderWorld 基准：223 个任务，覆盖 architecture、products、natural environments、scientific visualization 四大领域，输入模态包括文本、图像、视频和结构化规格。建立统一评测协议：将提交的 Blender 工程从多视角渲染，结合 2,651 条任务专属二元评分规则（binary rubrics）与整体视觉质量评分进行融合打分。对 13 个前沿模型开展基准测试。

Result: GPT-6-Astra 取得最高融合总分 79.9，Opus-5 为 73.0，GPT-5.6-Sol 为 67.7。分析表明当前模型虽能解析宽泛指令，但在 Blender 中的细粒度 3D 空间一致性与精确结构复现方面仍显著不足。

Conclusion: BlenderWorld 填补了真实 3D 创作任务评测的空白，揭示了"指令理解尚可、空间与结构精度不足"的关键瓶颈，为未来 3D-native agentics 研究指明了方向与提升空间。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation. In practical workflows, these models must infer object shapes, materials, spatial layouts, and lighting from diverse references while strictly following instructions to reconstruct, modify, or design 3D content. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of such open-ended requests across real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce BlenderWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating frontier models on realistic 3D creation tasks. BlenderWorld comprises 223 tasks spanning architecture, products, natural environments, and scientific visualization, driven by text, image, video, and structured specification inputs. To rigorously assess these complex deliverables, we establish a unified evaluation protocol: we render the submitted Blender projects from multiple viewpoints and evaluate them against 2,651 task-specific binary rubrics alongside holistic visual quality scores. Benchmarking thirteen frontier models reveals that GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest overall fused score of 79.9, followed by Opus-5 (73.0) and GPT-5.6-Sol (67.7). Ultimately, our findings reveal a critical bottleneck: while current models can parse broad instructions, they still profoundly struggle with fine-grained 3D spatial coherence and accurate structural reproduction in Blender, leaving substantial headroom for future 3D-native agentics.

</details>


### [51] [Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23982)
*Shenyi Li,Ziyang Zhang,Wen Wu,Ming Liu,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Time-JEPA 用低维、时间对齐的物理时间序列作为辅助监督，微调视频世界模型，使模型更好地保留物理状态的演化过程，在驾驶、机器人操作、人体运动等多域任务上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型通过预测缺失或未来内容来学习视觉环境的演化，但物理状态信息能为环境演化预测提供有用上下文。已有做法存在缺陷：嵌入领域特定的物理定律会复杂化多域训练；仅对单帧或帧对施加监督，则对物理状态随时间演化关注不足。

Method: 提出 Time-JEPA：以低维、时间对齐的物理时间序列作为辅助监督对视频世界模型进行微调。通过把视频表示与对应时间位置上的物理状态相连接，促使模型保留物理状态的演化方式；与仅用视频微调的对照组进行匹配比较，并在多个域及第二个视频骨干网络上验证方法可迁移性。

Result: 在自动驾驶、机器人操作、人体运动等多个域中，Time-JEPA 在条件分布偏移与状态变量分布偏移下，均在当前状态解码、多步未来状态预测和运动学重建三方面优于匹配的视频微调基线。多域联合训练在三项任务上均优于匹配的单域训练。外部评估显示时间序列监督提升了对物理异常的敏感性以及物理交互的表示能力（含未见场景），第二个视频骨干上的整体增益表明方法可推广到更多骨干。

Conclusion: 物理时间序列能帮助视频世界模型更好地理解物理世界，是一种无需引入领域特定物理定律、又能显式建模状态随时间演化的有效辅助监督信号。

Abstract: Video world models learn how visual environments evolve by predicting missing or future content. However, physical-state information can provide useful context for predicting how environments evolve. Prior work incorporates this information through different mechanisms: domain-specific physical laws can complicate multi-domain training, while supervision on individual frames or frame pairs gives limited attention to how physical state evolves over time. We introduce Time-JEPA, which fine-tunes a video world model using low-dimensional, temporally aligned physical time series as auxiliary supervision. Physical time series connect video representations with physical state at corresponding temporal positions, encouraging the model to preserve how physical state evolves. In multiple domains including autonomous driving, robot manipulation, and human motion, Time-JEPA improves current-state decoding, multi-horizon future-state prediction, and kinematic reconstruction over matched video-fine-tuned controls across both condition and state-variable distribution shifts. Multi-domain training provides aggregate gains over matched single-domain training in all three tasks. External evaluations further suggest that time-series supervision improves sensitivity to physical anomalies and the representation of physical interactions, including in unseen scenarios. Aggregate gains on a second video backbone indicate that the method can be applied to more backbones. These results suggest that physical time series help video world models better understand the physical world.

</details>


### [52] [IMPULSE: Push First, Then Predict in V-JEPA 2 Feature Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23968)
*Tingan Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMPULSE 通过少量接触"戳动"校准，为冻结的 V-JEPA 2 特征空间预测器注入物体物理经验，显著降低特征预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型（如 V-JEPA 2）在视频编码器特征空间中预测，但仅凭观察无法得知物体的可旋转性、弹性或滑动性，这些物理属性需通过实际交互试错获得。

Method: 用贝叶斯接触记忆汇总三次短校准推动；以预测的物体位姿将其带入预测器；通过轻量随机傅里叶位姿头使预测器利用位姿。在 512 个新物体上进行预注册留出确认实验（模型在数据存在前封存）。

Result: 相对无经验预测器，1 秒特征预测误差降低 11.6–12.8%（全部 8 个训练种子，95% 区间不含零）；对 128 个超范围物理物体增益为 11.7–14.0%；完整扩展比普通预测器高 15.5–16.6%。傅里叶位姿头使完美记忆相对普通位姿 token 的增益约增至三倍（2.8–3.2×）；原始推动测量经同一通路增益相近，增益在接触起始时不存在、随后增长。

Conclusion: 信息阶梯论证（对理想预测器精确）表明物理仅通过运动影响特征；贝叶斯汇总并非必需，仅将试验压缩为八个可解释数值；位姿通路是增益关键。

Abstract: Latent world models such as V-JEPA 2 forecast in the feature space of a video encoder, but one look at an object does not reveal how hard it is to rotate, how much it bounces or how much it slides. People find out by trying: a few pokes reveal how an object responds. IMPULSE, named after the impulse response it infers, gives a predictor in frozen V-JEPA 2 feature space the same ability. A Bayesian contact memory summarizes three short calibration pushes, a predicted object pose carries it into the predictor, and a lightweight random-Fourier pose head lets the predictor use the pose. On 512 fresh objects, in a pre-specified held-out confirmation with models sealed before the data existed, the memory lowers the 1-second feature-forecast error by 11.6-12.8% relative to the same predictor without experience, for all 8 training seeds, with a 95% seed-and-object interval excluding zero. The gain also holds for 128 objects with out-of-range physics (11.7-14.0%), and the full extension beats a plain predictor by 15.5-16.6%. An information-ladder argument, exact for ideal predictors, shows that physics reaches the features only through motion, so we measure how much the pathway lets pose help. On fresh objects, the Fourier head roughly triples the gain of a perfect memory over plain pose tokens (2.8-3.2x). Raw push measurements fed through the same pathway give a similar gain, so the Bayesian summary is not required; it condenses the trials into eight interpretable numbers. The gain is absent at contact onset and grows afterwards.

</details>


### [53] [Same Space or Not: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence Through Cross-View Contradictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23959)
*Huizi Cao,Guanyu Xu,Zhixuan Liang,Ming Yin,Jiuxiang Gu,Manling Li,Mengdi Wang,Shilong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SSoN 基准，考察 VLM 在跨视角场景间区分“同一空间”与“被编辑变体”并定位矛盾视图的能力，揭示当前模型远弱于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间智能是具身感知与真实世界视觉理解的基础，已有基准多考察空间关系、视角转换与心理建模，但缺乏对“跨视角保持连贯场景表征”的检验——仅靠成对比较无法判断哪一视角偏离真实。

Method: 构建 Same Space or Not (SSoN) 基准：来自 7 类室内场景、6 类受控 3D 编辑，共 1000 题；每题给出 3 张未改动场景视图与 1 张编辑变体视图，要求模型找出不一致视图并解释矛盾，且无指定可信参考视图或显式标注目标。采用迭代流程将人工审校转化为生成约束，通过自动检查与穷尽式人工验证剔除视觉捷径题与证据不足、答案不唯一的题目。另设 100 题干预集（含提示设计、相机信息、3D 重建）与 201 题留出测试集（含 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 微调实验）。

Result: 人类准确率 83.3%，最强 VLM 仅 39.7%；若同时要求有效视觉解释则降至 34.9%。干预集基线 24%：提示工程与 3D 重建均不足 50%；仅提供真值相机信息达 61% 答案准确率，但 True solve 仅 48%。201 题测试集上 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为 21.89%，仅答案微调后 33.33%，答案+理由联合微调后 41.79%。

Conclusion: 跨视角矛盾消解是当前 VLM 的显著短板，与人类差距巨大；针对性监督（尤其联合理由与答案的微调）可部分缓解，但距离可靠的空间推理仍有明显距离。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence, the capacity to represent and reason about physical space, underlies embodied perception and real-world visual understanding. Existing benchmarks probe it through spatial relations, perspective-taking, and mental modeling. What remains underexamined is whether a model can maintain a coherent scene representation across views, since pairwise comparison alone cannot reveal which view departs from the truth. We thus introduce Same Space or Not (SSoN), a benchmark of cross-view contradiction resolution comprising 1,000 questions from seven indoor scene sources and six categories of controlled 3D edits. Each question presents three views of an unchanged scene and one view of an edited variant. Models must identify the inconsistent view and explain the contradiction without a designated trusted reference or a marked target. Our pipeline iteratively translates human review into generation constraints. Automated checks and exhaustive human validation screen out both trivial visual shortcuts and questions lacking sufficient evidence for a unique answer. Humans achieve 83.3% accuracy, compared with 39.7% for the strongest vision-language models (VLMs), falling to 34.9% when a valid visual explanation is also required. On a 100-question intervention set with a 24% baseline, prompting and 3D reconstruction remain below 50% answer accuracy, except when ground-truth camera information is supplied, which reaches 61% answer accuracy but only 48% True solve accuracy. On a held-out 201-question test set, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 21.89% accuracy, 33.33% after answer-only fine-tuning, and 41.79% after fine-tuning on both rationales and answers. These results identify cross-view contradiction resolution as a substantial weakness of current VLMs that can be partly addressed by targeted supervision.

</details>


### [54] [Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23919)
*Si Qin,Jiawei Tang,Yaxin Hou,Yan Chen,Yutong Xie,Chen Li,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出词汇表不完备的无监督视觉语言模型自适应任务（VI-UVA）及标签空间重构（LSR）方法，用于在仅有部分类名的条件下适配模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无标注数据获取成本低，视觉语言模型可通过图文相似度生成伪标签实现无监督自适应。但已有方法假设适配时拥有包含全部类名的完整词汇表，而现实中未标注数据可能包含被忽视或超出任务范围的类别，完整词汇表难以构建。

Method: 提出VI-UVA设定：适配阶段仅可获得类名子集。针对词汇表不完备导致的向已提供类别的自适应偏置，提出标签空间重构（LSR），从无标注数据重构潜在标签空间并引入提示微调，使自适应超越不完备词汇表；同时推导了LSR的遗漏类语义差异界，并分析影响该界的关键因素。

Result: 在八个基准上的大量实验表明，LSR优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过潜在标签空间重构可有效缓解词汇表不完备带来的自适应偏置，提升遗漏类识别能力，验证了VI-UVA设定的可行性与LSR的有效性。

Abstract: In certain real-world scenarios, obtaining labeled data is excessively expensive, motivating increasing interest in adapting models without annotations. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide pseudo-labels for unlabeled images through image-text similarity, enabling adaptation without manual labeling. The previous unsupervised vision-language model adaption methods assume access to an adaptation vocabulary containing all class names. However, a complete vocabulary is difficult to construct in real-world scenarios, as unlabeled data may contain classes that are overlooked or fall outside the current task scope. Thus, we propose Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-language model Adaptation (VI-UVA), where only a subset of class names are available during adaptation. The vocabulary incompleteness induces an adaptation bias toward provided classes, which degrades omitted-class recognition. To address this issue, we propose Label Space Reconstruction (LSR), which reconstructs a latent label space from the unlabeled data and incorporates it into prompt tuning, thereby extending adaptation beyond the incomplete vocabulary and mitigating the adaptation bias. Furthermore, we derive an omitted-class semantic discrepancy bound for LSR and identify the key factors affecting the bound. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that LSR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [55] [ContraSafe-VL: A Contrastive Safety Preference Dataset for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23908)
*Di Wu,Yanyan Zhao,Xin Lu,Hao Yang,Taotao Zhang,Yunzhen Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ContraSafe-VL，一个面向视觉语言模型的多模态安全对比偏好数据集。它通过为同一文本查询配对产生不同安全标签的视觉上下文，直接监督"视觉上下文如何影响安全判断"，并辅以无害性/有用性响应偏好对，从而在提升跨模态安全识别的同时缓解过度拒答，实现安全与过度拒答的更好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM作为通用多模态助手被广泛部署，多模态安全对齐成为重要挑战。安全性依赖文本与视觉内容的交互，视觉上下文常起关键作用。但VLM难以恰当利用视觉信息：或忽略安全相关视觉内容，或过度解读敏感视觉内容，导致不安全回复或过度拒答。现有数据集多遵循"响应偏好"范式，只教模型如何回应，却对"视觉上下文应如何影响安全判断"监督不足，因而难以平衡安全性与过度拒答。

Method: 构建ContraSafe-VL对比安全偏好数据集：对每个固定文本查询，构造成对视觉上下文，使形成的多模态查询具有不同安全标签，从而为"视觉上下文如何影响多模态安全判断"提供直接监督；并基于无害性与有用性提供响应偏好对，促使模型生成既安全又有帮助的回复。

Result: 在三种VLM架构和多个基准上的实验表明，使用ContraSafe-VL训练可提升跨模态安全识别能力，实现更好的安全—过度拒答权衡，同时保持通用多模态能力。

Conclusion: ContraSafe-VL通过对比式视觉上下文监督弥补了响应偏好范式的不足，为多模态安全对齐提供了有效数据方案，数据集将公开释放。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as general-purpose multimodal assistants, making multimodal safety alignment an important challenge. Safety depends on the interplay between textual and visual content, with visual context often playing a critical role. However, VLMs may fail to use visual information appropriately, either overlooking safety-relevant visual content or over-interpreting sensitive visual content, leading to unsafe responses or over-refusal. Existing multimodal safety alignment datasets largely follow the response-preference paradigm, which teaches models how to respond but provides limited supervision on how visual context should inform the safety judgment, making it difficult to balance safety and over-refusal. To address this limitation, we introduce ContraSafe-VL, a Contrastive Safety preference dataset for Vision-Language Models. For each fixed textual query, ContraSafe-VL constructs paired visual contexts that result in multimodal queries with different safety labels, providing direct supervision for how visual context should inform multimodal safety judgments. It further provides response preference pairs based on harmlessness and helpfulness to encourage models to generate responses that are both safe and helpful. Experiments across three VLM architectures and multiple benchmarks demonstrate that training with ContraSafe-VL improves cross-modal safety recognition and achieves a better safety--over-refusal trade-off while preserving general multimodal capabilities. The dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [56] [Instance-Specific Classifier-Free Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion/Flow-Based Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23905)
*Wajeeh Atrash,Tom Tirer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出使用实例自适应的CFG尺度替代现有图像编辑方法中固定的CFG尺度，并训练轻量网络预测编辑指标以实现快速选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于文本到图像扩散/流模型的图像编辑需在保持源图（LPIPS）与实现目标提示改动（CLIP-T）之间权衡。该权衡可由CFG尺度控制，但现有方法普遍采用固定CFG尺度，忽视了不同编辑所需修改程度不同。

Method: 首先在基准数据集上以广泛CFG尺度取值穷举重跑主流编辑方法，验证实例特定CFG的收益；由于反复执行编辑流程代价高，训练一个轻量神经网络，对给定编辑实例与CFG尺度预测底层编辑方法的指标；推理时据此快速选取实例特定的CFG尺度。

Result: 实例特定CFG设置可在不损害CLIP-T的前提下显著提升LPIPS；跨多种编辑方法与基准设置的实验显示所提方法优于基线。

Conclusion: 实例自适应的CFG尺度选择是一种高效且有效的提升图像编辑质量的手段，配合轻量指标预测网络可避免缓慢推理。

Abstract: In recent years, a variety of prompt-based image editing methods have been developed based on text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow models. Image editing introduces an inherent trade-off between adhering to the original source image and realizing the change specified by the target prompt, which are typically measured by the LPIPS and CLIP-T metrics, respectively. Intuitively, this trade-off can be controlled by the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. Most existing editing methods, though, use a fixed CFG scale, ignoring that different edits require varying levels of modification. In this paper, we first explore the potential benefits of using an instance-specific CFG by exhaustively re-running prominent editing methods with a wide range of CFG scale values on benchmark datasets. We show that instance-specific setting can significantly improve LPIPS without compromising CLIP-T. Yet, tuning based on repeatedly executing an editing pipeline is inefficient. To prevent slow inference, we train a light-weight neural network that predicts the metrics of the underlying editing method for a given edit instance and CFG scale. At inference time, these predictions enable fast selection of an instance-specific CFG scale. Experiments across multiple editing methods and benchmark settings show the performance advantage of our approach over the baseline methods.

</details>


### [57] [Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25090)
*Junwei Wen,Deshui Miao,Guangming Lu,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Xin Li,Wenjie Pei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TCoVP，将视频推理分割中的思维链显式表示为“视频基元”组成的时序链，每个基元绑定实体引用、时间支撑与带时间戳的空间证据，并以此为目标提供框提示与时间支撑进行掩码预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频推理分割需从隐式描述中定位目标并输出像素级掩码轨迹，同时解决决定答案的空间关系与时序事件。纯文本CoT虽能解释目标选择，却未显式化视觉参考，存在语言推理与跨帧分散证据之间的“视频参考鸿沟”。

Method: 提出Temporal Chain of Video Primitives（TCoVP），一种时空落地的视频CoT：将查询相关观察组织为按时间顺序的推理链，每个基元将实体引用与时间支撑、带时间戳的空间证据关联，链中基元引用与语言交错；选中的目标基元提供框提示与时间支撑用于视频掩码预测。构建TCoVP-SFT-15k与TCoVP-RL-13k，分别通过监督微调与链对齐强化学习学习该表示。

Result: 在五个VRS基准与三个模型骨干上取得强劲性能，验证在推理过程中组织空间与时序证据的有效性。

Conclusion: 显式、时空落地的视频链式推理可有效弥合视频参考鸿沟，提升视频推理分割性能；模型与代码将公开。

Abstract: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) requires a model to identify an implicitly described target and predict its pixel-level mask trajectory, while resolving the spatial relations and temporal events that determine the answer. Text-only Chain-of-Thought (CoT) can explain a target choice without making the underlying visual references explicit, leaving a \emph{video reference gap} between linguistic inference and the evidence distributed across frames. We introduce \textbf{Temporal Chain of Video Primitives (TCoVP)}, a spatiotemporally grounded form of Video CoT that organizes query-relevant observations into a chronological reasoning chain. Each primitive associates an entity reference with temporal support and timestamped spatial evidence, and the chain interleaves these references with language to guide reasoning about which entity is relevant, when the queried event holds, and where its evidence appears. The selected target primitives then provide box prompts and temporal support for video mask prediction. We construct TCoVP-SFT-15k and TCoVP-RL-13k to learn this representation through supervised fine-tuning and chain-aligned reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across five VRS benchmarks and three model backbones demonstrate the strong performance of TCoVP, highlighting the effectiveness of organizing spatial and temporal evidence within the reasoning process. All models and code will be publicly released. Project page: \url{https://victor-wjw.github.io/TCoVP/}

</details>


### [58] [Sufficient Frame Subsets for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25084)
*Lahiru Wijayasingha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"充分帧子集"(Sufficient Frame Subsets)解释方法,找出视频中被掩码其余帧后仍独立保持模型预测的紧凑帧集合,并在UCF101与Something-Something v2上验证其紧凑性与有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解模型在视频哪个时段做出关键观察,对解释视频理解系统至关重要;但现有归因方法常将证据弥散地散布在近乎重复的帧上,难以定位真正的关键帧。

Method: 定义充分帧子集:将其余帧全部掩码后,每个子集仍能独立保持模型原预测;据此算法搜索紧凑且充分的帧子集,在CNN与Transformer两类架构上、两个互补基准(UCF101、Something-Something v2)上评估。

Result: 所提算法能找出高度紧凑且有效的帧子集以解释模型决策;能够依赖更多充分帧子集的模型往往性能更好,可能因其更鲁棒,与既有研究一致。

Conclusion: 提取的帧子集可用于分析失败案例、揭示模型强调的视频方面,并识别改进未来训练流程的机会。

Abstract: Understanding when during a video a model makes its critical observations is essential for interpreting video-understanding systems. However, existing attribution methods often spread evidence diffusely across near-duplicate frames. We introduce Sufficient Frame Subsets: compact sets of frames in which all other frames are masked, yet each subset independently preserves the model's prediction. We evaluate our method on two complementary benchmarks, UCF101 and Something-Something v2, using both CNN- and transformer-based architectures. Our results show that the proposed algorithm identifies highly compact and effective frame subsets for explaining model decisions. We also find that models capable of relying on a greater number of sufficient frame subsets tend to perform better, possibly because they are more robust, consistent with prior research. Finally, the extracted frame subsets help us analyze model failure cases, reveal which aspects of a video the model has learned to emphasize, and identify opportunities for improving future training procedures.

</details>


### [59] [UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24791)
*Kien T. Pham,Yuhao Liu,Chong Hou Choi,Zhenqi He,Yanghao Wang,Chenyang Lei,Rui Liu,Qifeng Chen,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UniAVC，通过“分支解耦训练 + 模态解耦噪声调度”实现单一权重下的文本条件联合生成、双向跨模态生成与指令引导编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一音视频创作需要单模型支持联合合成、双向跨模态生成与双向编辑，但成对数据稀缺（编辑尤甚）；现有方法把宝贵的配对数据浪费在学习单模态数据即可教会的能力上，而非跨模态耦合。同时共享噪声调度忽视了模态信息密度差异（视频需更长时间高噪声以组织空间与运动结构，稀疏音频可更早收敛），且同步去噪导致“以一个模态为条件合成/编辑另一个模态”的非对称流程未被训练。

Method: 先在各单模态数据集上把每个分支训练至完整的生成与编辑能力，再将配对数据专门用于挖掘跨模态对应关系；引入模态解耦调度器，从共享时间步出发对各模态噪声调度独立变换（warp）；并以含单一干净模态的子任务直接监督非对称配置。

Result: 解耦调度与不对称监督分别支持意图感知编辑（保持一个模态不变并用其约束另一模态）与推理后自精炼（仅针对已接受的另一分支重新生成不满意分支）。

Conclusion: UniAVC 以单套权重、无需任务特定适配器即覆盖多种创作任务。

Abstract: Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.

</details>


### [60] [MESS: Multi-Exposure Sequence Synthesis for Generalizable Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24680)
*Ruodai Cui,Shuaizheng Liu,Rongyuan Wu,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MESS框架，通过模拟ISP流程从RAW生成多曝光序列，并训练基于扩散模型的RGB→MES生成器，从单张8-bit RGB图像合成逼真曝光序列，从而构建50万训练对数据集，训练轻量网络实现泛化性更强的图像增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低光增强、曝光校正、逆光增强等模型泛化性有限，主要瓶颈在于缺乏大规模多样化训练数据：真实配对图像采集昂贵难扩展，而现有合成方法难以建模复杂光照条件与相机成像管线。

Method: 1) 基于高比特RAW图像，通过仿真ISP管线在不同曝光设置下渲染得到多曝光序列(MES)；2) 以RAW衍生的MES为监督，训练基于扩散模型的RGB-to-MES生成器，从单张8-bit RGB图像合成合理曝光序列，将合成流程从有限RAW集合扩展到大规模in-the-wild RGB数据；3) 对每张源图像随机采样一个合成曝光变体作为退化输入，原始高质量RGB作为目标，构建50万训练对数据集(MESS)；4) 用该数据集训练轻量网络。

Result: 构建了50万训练对的数据集；所训练的轻量网络在多种图像增强任务上泛化性能显著优于现有模型。代码与数据已开源。

Conclusion: 通过RAW仿真ISP与扩散生成结合的多曝光序列合成策略，可有效突破真实配对数据瓶颈，为野外场景的通用图像增强提供可扩展的数据与训练方案。

Abstract: Despite the significant progress in image enhancement under adverse illuminations, such as low-light image enhancement, exposure correction, and backlit image enhancement, existing models show limited generalizability to different scenarios. A major bottleneck lies in the lack of large-scale and diverse training data, as these tasks typically rely on manually captured, precisely aligned image pairs that are expensive to scale up. Although synthetic data have been explored as an alternative, existing synthesis methods are limited in modeling complex adverse illumination conditions and camera imaging pipelines. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework to synthesize realistic training pairs for generalizable image enhancement in the wild. Specifically, we first derive multi-exposure sequences (MES) from high-bit RAW images by rendering them under different exposure settings through an emulated ISP pipeline. Using these RAW-derived MES as supervision, we train a diffusion-based RGB-to-MES generator to synthesize plausible exposure sequences from a single 8-bit RGB image, extending the synthesis pipeline from limited RAW collections to large-scale in-the-wild RGB data. For each source image, we randomly sample one synthesized exposure variant as the degraded input and use the original high-quality RGB image as the target. With the proposed MES Synthesis (MESS) approach, we construct a dataset of 500K training pairs and train a lightweight network, which demonstrates significantly better generalization performance than existing models across various image enhancement tasks. Code and data are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/MESS.

</details>


### [61] [IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24607)
*Jiaxing Chen,Zizheng Yan,Jingyu Zhuang,Jinwei Chen,Shuguang Cui,Guanying Chen,Qingnan Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 IntriAdapt 测试时适应框架，以相机内参作为输出端几何校验器，通过最小化视角射线一致性残差、优化冻结几何基础模型上的轻量 LoRA 适配器，在无需深度传感器或外部先验的情况下提升度量 3D 几何预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从图像恢复度量 3D 几何因透视投影歧义本质上是病态问题。现有几何模型虽在推理时使用给定或预测的内参，却未用其监督模型适应；而常规 TTA 方法依赖外部深度测量来修正预测，成本高且受限。

Method: 将已知内参用作输出侧几何校验器：比较预测点云对应的视角射线与内参定义的射线，得到闭式的几何不一致性度量；以此残差为损失，在冻结的几何基础模型上优化轻量 LoRA 适配器，使预测对齐特定相机模型。进一步扩展至视频序列，用短序列适应后的模型前馈处理同相机其他序列，无需逐帧重复优化。

Result: 在 10 个单图像基准与 7 个序列基准、多个基础模型上的实验表明，IntriAdapt 在度量精度与相对几何方面均稳定优于未适应基线与 oracle 内参基线。

Conclusion: 相机内参可作为有效的自监督几何校验信号用于测试时适应；该方法无需深度传感器或外部先验，且视频序列上的适应可泛化到同相机的新序列，具良好实用性与可移植性。

Abstract: Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

</details>


### [62] [Dynamic self-ensemble on multi-exit residual vision transformer for small-data image classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24602)
*Stephen Ekaputra Limantoro,Yan-Kai Wang,Ching-Chun Huang,Hong-Han Shuai,Wen-Huang Cheng,Jungwoo Huh,Sanghoon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多阶段残差ViT（ReSEViT），结合自集成学习与动态学习器选择（DLS），在小规模数据集上缓解ViT的数据饥渴问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT依赖大规模数据才能取得高性能，在小样本场景（如医学影像）表现受限；同时单一分类器面对复杂决策边界易产生预测误差。

Method: 构建多阶段残差ViT：每个阶段将ResNet式残差token嵌入与Transformer块结合以建模局部结构；引入自集成学习，在单一模型内集成多个阶段的分类器，并用动态学习器选择（DLS）自适应分配各阶段权重，利用中间特征的多层级信息。

Result: 通过残差token与自集成学习融入多阶段ViT，降低了冗余、预测误差与方差，同时在小规模图像数据集上保持高效模型尺寸。

Conclusion: 多阶段残差结构与自集成学习的结合是提升ViT小样本分类性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) has garnered increased attention for image classification in recent years. However, ViT is notorious for its data-hungry problem as it achieves high-performance results when only trained on large-size datasets. In this paper, we study how ViT specifically works on small-scale datasets with limited data where the availability of image data is often constrained in practice, especially in fields such as medical imaging. To mitigate the issue, we designed a multi-stage residual ViT, dubbed ReSEViT, with the self-ensemble method to utilize multi-level information from intermediate features. Due to the complex decision boundaries for classifications, relying on a single classifier can lead to prediction errors. Hence, we propose a new learning method for ViT, named self-ensemble learning, which ensembles multi-stage classifiers in a single model. Our self-ensemble comprises a novel approach, Dynamic Learner Selection (DLS), to adaptively select the importance of different stages. ReSEViT incorporates residual token embeddings which is a ResNet-like block to model effective local structures alongside with transformer blocks in each stage. The integration of residual tokens and self-ensemble learning into a multi-stage ViT highlights the reduction in redundancy, prediction error and variance while maintaining an efficient model size for small-scale image datasets.

</details>


### [63] [An Optical Music Recognition Tool for String Quartets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24530)
*Jin-Shiang Hu,Bo-Yuan Cheng,Li Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱的光学音乐识别（OMR）系统，结合SegNet区域分割、CNN与图像处理进行符号识别，并用动态规划保证节奏精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱的自动识别需求，尤其是节奏（时值、连音符）提取的准确性不足。

Method: SegNet分割定位乐谱区域；CNN+图像处理分类与提取音乐符号；动态规划施加拍号约束并显式处理连音符（tuplets）。

Result: 在基准数据集上以最长公共子序列（LCS）指标评估多特征矩阵，音高、起始位置、时值、变音记号识别均表现稳健。

Conclusion: 该系统可有效识别弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱，动态规划约束显著提升节奏精度；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: This paper presents an optical music recognition (OMR) system tailored for PDF scores of string quartet pieces. The approach begins with a SegNet-based segmentation model to localize musical regions, followed by convolutional neural networks and image processing techniques to classify and extract musical symbols. To improve rhythmic precision, dynamic programming methods enforce time signature constraints and explicitly handle tuplets. Evaluation using a longest common subsequence metric across multiple feature matrices demonstrates robust accuracy in recognizing pitch, onset, duration, and accidentals on a benchmark dataset. Code and data are available at https://github.com/lattellie/25-omr.

</details>


### [64] [Learning from the Right Regions: Class-Conditioned Explanation Guidance for Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24381)
*Zubair Faruqui,Rahul Dubey*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出类条件解释引导学习框架，为每个阳性类别单独构建解释并惩罚类别特定标注区域外的证据，显著提升多标签医学影像分类器的解释证据对齐度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在医学影像上预测性能强，但可能依赖与预测病灶无关的区域；解释引导学习可缓解该问题，而多标签场景下多个异常共存，要求每个预测与其对应空间证据对齐，这是现有方法的关键挑战。

Method: 构建类条件解释（class-conditioned）引导学习框架：对每个阳性类别单独生成解释，并惩罚落在该类别特定标注区域之外的证据；以Grad-CAM实例化，在14种异常上用EfficientNet-B1、ViT-B/16、ViT-B/32、Swin-B验证。

Result: 解释引导在所有架构上大幅提升标注对齐度：All-Saliency Precision由0.140升至0.625（EfficientNet-B1）、0.052升至0.551（ViT-B/16）、0.060升至0.403（ViT-B/32）、0.095升至0.570（Swin-B）；分类性能变化较小且依赖架构。

Conclusion: 类条件解释引导能在基本保持预测性能的同时，显著改善多标签分类器解释证据的聚焦位置。

Abstract: Deep neural networks can achieve strong predictive performance in medical imaging while relying on regions unrelated to the predicted finding. Explanation-guided learning can address this problem, but multi-label classification introduces a key challenge: multiple abnormalities may coexist in an image, requiring each prediction to align with its corresponding spatial evidence. We propose a class-conditioned explanation-guided learning framework that constructs a separate explanation for each positive class and penalizes evidence outside its class-specific annotated regions. We instantiate the framework using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) and evaluate it on 14 abnormalities using EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, and Swin-B. Explanation guidance substantially improves annotation alignment across all architectures: All-Saliency Precision increases from 0.140 to 0.625, 0.052 to 0.551, 0.060 to 0.403, and 0.095 to 0.570, respectively. These improvements are accompanied by smaller, architecture-dependent changes in classification performance. Our results show that class-conditioned explanation guidance can substantially improve where multi-label classifiers concentrate their explanatory evidence while largely preserving predictive performance.

</details>


### [65] [PACE-Mem: Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence for Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24378)
*Shidu Ren,Rong-cheng Tu,Hang Zhou,Xiao Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练、可插拔的检索方法 PACE-Mem，构建互补证据序列并由同一选择轨迹自适应确定检索深度，在三个长视频基准、两个智能体框架上平均比 Adaptive-k 提升 1.6% 的问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体的长期记忆中，反复出现的场景、动作与实体带来大量相似观测，查询相关记忆间信息重叠；同时固定检索深度对具体问题可能返回过少或过多证据，影响上下文证据质量与答案准确性。

Method: 面向基于片段的智能体记忆：1）查询引导池化，在每个 clip 内聚合记录，得到相关性分数与表示；2）利用该分数与表示做 MMR 选择，在查询相关性与已选证据冗余之间取得平衡，形成互补证据序列；3）从同一选择轨迹上，用前缀长度选择算法比较长度归一化的相邻分数下降量，兼顾分数变化与已累积证据量，确定检索深度。方法免训练，不改变记忆构建与答案生成。

Result: 在三个长视频基准与两个智能体框架上，在相当的平均检索深度下，问答准确率相对最强基线 Adaptive-k 平均提升 1.6%；进一步分析显示，同时增删证据比单独增加或单独删除证据带来更大的净准确率增益。

Conclusion: 以互补选择加轨迹驱动的自适应深度，可在不增加训练成本的前提下改善片段式智能体记忆的检索质量；证据的联合增删是提升净收益的关键设计方向。

Abstract: As multimodal agents accumulate experience, their long-term memories contain many similar observations of recurring scenes, actions, and entities. Answer quality depends on the evidence retrieved from these memories into the model's context. However, query-relevant memories may contain overlapping information, and a fixed retrieval depth may return too little or too much evidence for a given question. To address these challenges, we propose PACE-Mem, Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence, which constructs a complementary evidence sequence and determines its length from the same selection trajectory. For structured memories, query-guided pooling combines records within each clip to obtain relevance scores and representations. Using these relevance scores and representations, maximal marginal relevance (MMR) selection balances query relevance against overlap with previously selected evidence. From the resulting score trajectory, a prefix-length selection algorithm determines retrieval depth by comparing length-normalized adjacent declines, accounting for both score changes and the amount of evidence accumulated. PACE-Mem is a training-free, plug-in retrieval method for clip-based agent memory systems, leaving memory construction and answer generation unchanged. Across three long-video benchmarks and two agent frameworks, PACE-Mem improves question-answering accuracy by an average of 1.6% over Adaptive-k, the strongest baseline at comparable mean retrieval depths. Further analysis reveals that jointly adding and removing evidence is associated with larger net accuracy gains than either change alone.

</details>


### [66] [CRISP: Progressive Illumination Curriculum for Recurrent Low-Light Video Enhancement with Semantic Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24299)
*Ruirui Lin,Xin Yan Lim,Yini Li,Zhiming Liu,Nantheera Anantrasirichai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CRISP：一种采用渐进式光照课程训练的循环框架，用于低光视频增强，通过双帧循环结构传播时序信息，并可选地用冻结的 DINOv3 语义特征增强结构重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光视频增强需同时恢复亮度、颜色与精细空间结构，并在噪声与运动下保持时序一致性；现有方法难以在这些目标间取得平衡，尤其在严重退化区域。

Method: 提出 CRISP 循环框架：1）双帧循环架构跨连续帧传播信息，利用输入对之外的时序上下文；2）训练时使用渐进式光照课程，监督信号从低光输入与参考之间的中间目标逐步过渡到完整参考，逐渐提高亮度与颜色校正要求；3）可选引入冻结的 DINOv3 语义特征，通过 AdaLN 式调制注入，不微调基础模型。

Result: 在 DID 与 BVI-RLV 数据集上，CRISP 在所评估方法中取得 DID 上最高 PSNR、BVI-RLV 上最高 SSIM，同时保持计算效率；消融显示渐进课程在无额外推理开销下带来最大性能提升。

Conclusion: 渐进光照课程可稳定循环训练且不增加推理成本，配合循环时序传播与冻结语义特征调制，CRISP 在亮度、颜色、结构与时序一致性之间取得良好平衡，并实现高效的低光视频增强。

Abstract: Low-light video enhancement requires the recovery of brightness, color, and fine spatial structures while preserving temporal coherence in the presence of noise and motion. Existing methods often struggle to balance these objectives, particularly in severely degraded regions. This paper presents CRISP, a recurrent framework trained using a progressive illumination curriculum. Its two-frame recurrent architecture propagates information across successive frames to exploit temporal context beyond the immediate input pair. During training, supervision progressively transitions from intermediate targets interpolated between the low-light input and the reference to the full reference, gradually increasing the required brightness and color correction. This curriculum stabilizes recurrent training without introducing additional inference cost and yields the largest performance improvement among the components evaluated in the ablation study. To further support structural reconstruction, the framework optionally incorporates frozen DINOv3 semantic features through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN)-style modulation, without fine-tuning the foundation model. Experiments on DID and BVI-RLV demonstrate that CRISP achieves the highest PSNR on DID and the highest SSIM on BVI-RLV among the evaluated methods, while maintaining computational efficiency.

</details>


### [67] [ULIFLOW: Unified Latent Human-Object Interaction Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24286)
*Wenqi Cai,Chunzhi Gu,Weichen Zhou,Yawen Zou,Yijin Wei,Ran Dong,Haoran Xie,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ULIFlow，用稀疏体表标记构造连续“标记-物体”关系作为显式交互模态，与人体、物体流共同建模于统一隐空间，结合 MoT 自编码器与分块 Flow Forcing 实现变长文本条件 HOI 生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于骨架的表示紧凑描述人体运动学，但表面级交互几何高度隐式，常需额外的接触专用正则项；且单独合理的人体与物体运动未必构成连贯交互。

Method: 从稀疏体表标记推导连续标记-物体关系，作为显式交互模态与人体运动、物体动力学并列；设计 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 自编码器联合建模异构流并保留模态特异结构；令关系流直接参与人体与物体重建；引入带全局序列进度条件的分块 Flow Forcing 方案，从定长训练窗口渐进续写以支持变长生成。

Result: 在整体生成质量与人体-物体协调性上稳定优于既有方法，并能在超出训练时长的请求持续时间内保持连贯交互。

Conclusion: 显式建模连续人体-物体关系几何可替代接触专用正则，统一隐空间表示与分块流生成机制共同支撑长时程变长 HOI 生成。

Abstract: Text-conditioned 3D human--object interaction (HOI) generation remains challenging because individually plausible human and object motions do not necessarily form a coherent interaction. We argue that a key limitation lies in conventional skeleton-based representations, which compactly describe body kinematics while leaving surface-level interaction geometry largely implicit, often requiring additional contact-specific regularizers. We propose ULIFlow, a framework that explicitly models continuous human--object relations within a unified latent space. To this end, we derive continuous marker--object relations from sparse body-surface markers and treat them as an explicit interaction modality alongside human motion and object dynamics. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) autoencoder is then designed to jointly model these heterogeneous streams while preserving their modality-specific structures. Importantly, we let the relation stream directly participate in human and object reconstruction, encouraging the shared latent representation to preserve both individual dynamics and the interaction geometry that coordinates them. To further achieve variable-length generation, we introduce a blockwise Flow Forcing scheme with global sequence-progress conditioning, enabling progressive continuation from fixed-length training windows while maintaining consistent long-horizon dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ULIFlow consistently outperforms prior work in overall generation quality and human--object coordination, while preserving coherent interactions over requested durations beyond the training horizon.

</details>


### [68] [Spatio-Temporal Detection of Photovoltaic Systems on Industrial Building Rooftops Using Satellite Imagery and Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23970)
*Frederick Bruch,Christian Knoth,Florian Detsch,Edzer Pebesma,Hanna Meyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究利用开源Sentinel-2多光谱影像与OpenStreetMap建筑几何，构建随机森林模型识别工业屋顶光伏组件的光谱特征，并开发交互式网页原型实现按需站点监测，附带训练数据密度等质量指标提示预测可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球碳中和能源转型依赖光伏基础设施快速部署，但行政登记系统的更新速度已落后于装机扩张速度。高分辨率商业影像虽可用于监测，但成本高、更新频率低，导致电网运营商、能源基础设施开发商和政策制定者面临信息缺口；工业规模屋顶光伏尤其缺乏可扩展的监测手段。

Method: 将OpenStreetMap建筑几何与Sentinel-2反射率数据整合，训练随机森林模型以识别光伏组件的特定光谱特征；在此基础上开发交互式网页原型，支持按需检索最新卫星观测并评估工业建筑屋顶是否存在光伏系统，同时引入质量指标判断预测是否具备充足的训练数据支撑或需人工核验。

Result: 随机森林模型基于开源中分辨率影像实现了屋顶光伏识别；配套网页原型可在线返回光伏存在性判断，并通过质量指标区分高置信预测与需人工复核的情形。

Conclusion: 开源中分辨率数据结合机器学习与交互式工具，可有效弥补现有光伏监测的信息缺口；该端到端框架强调实际部署而非仅停留在理论建模，为可扩展的屋顶光伏监测提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The global transition toward carbon-neutral energy systems is heavily dependent on the rapid deployment of solar photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure, yet the speed of this expansion has outpaced the ability of administrative registries to maintain accurate records. While high-resolution commercial imagery is often used for monitoring, its high cost and infrequent updates can create an information gap for grid operators, energy infrastructure developers and policymakers. This study addresses the lack of scalable monitoring for industrial-scale rooftop PV systems by developing a machine learning framework that utilizes open-access, multispectral Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. By integrating building geometries from OpenStreetMap with Sentinel-2 reflectance data, a Random Forest model was trained to identify the specific spectral signatures of PV modules. Moving beyond theoretical modeling, this work emphasizes practical implementation through the development of an interactive web-based prototype for on-demand site monitoring. The application enables users to retrieve up-to-date satellite observations and assess the presence of PV systems on industrial building rooftops. The tool incorporates quality metrics that inform users whether a prediction is supported by sufficient training data density or requires manual verification. This end-to-end framework demonstrates that open-source medium-resolution data can effectively bridge this monitoring gap.

</details>


### [69] [Functionalizing AI-Generated 3D Shapes via Interior Geometry Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23953)
*Haoyu Tang,Fancheng Gao,Kan Chen,Peng Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种对AI生成3D形状进行"内部几何构造"以赋予功能性的方法：构建内部感知部件图，将各部件的内部几何建模为广义圆柱并优化求解参数，使结果功能有效且保持原外观。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hunyuan 3D、Meshy等AI 3D生成模型只关注物体外部外观，常产生不完整或不合理的内部几何，导致形状缺乏功能有效性，难以直接用于仿真与制造。

Method: 核心观察：部件的功能角色决定其内部几何，且内部几何通常光滑、较简单、与外部形状密切相关。据此构建"内部感知部件图"（interior-aware part graph）编码构造内部几何所需信息，通过基于VLM的形状分割与图属性推理建立该图；在图引导下，将每个部件的内部几何建模为广义圆柱，并通过优化从其外部几何推断参数。

Result: 在多种AI生成3D形状（容器、储物家具等）上验证方法有效性，并制造部分样例进行功能验证，结果表明生成形状保持AI生成外观的同时具备功能有效性。

Conclusion: 通过部件图引导的内部几何构造，可将外观导向的AI生成形状转化为功能可用（可仿真、可制造）的实体，为下游应用提供可行途径。

Abstract: AI-based 3D generation models such as Hunyuan 3D and Meshy can produce visually appealing 3D shapes from an image or text prompt.However, they typically focus on an object's external appearance, often producing incomplete or implausible interior geometry. Consequently, the generated shapes are not guaranteed to be functionally valid, limiting their direct use in downstream applications such as simulation and fabrication. In this paper, we present a computational approach to functionalize AI-generated 3D shapes through interior geometry construction. Our key observations are that a part's functional role defines its interior geometry, and such geometry is often smooth, relatively simple, and closely related to the part's external shape. Inspired by these observations, we introduce an interior-aware part graph to encode information necessary for constructing interior geometry within an AI-generated 3D shape, and build the graph via VLM-based shape segmentation and graph attribute inference. Guided by the graph, we model the interior geometry of each part as a generalized cylinder and infer its parameters from the part's external geometry through an optimization. The resulting 3D shapes are functionally valid while preserving their AI-generated external appearance. We demonstrate our approach on a variety of AI-generated 3D shapes, including vessels, containers, and storage furniture, and fabricate selected examples for functional validation.

</details>


### [70] [EAGLE: Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer for Partially Polygon-Supervised Object Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23900)
*Naveen Stewart*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对多边形监督定位中"简单形状类别反而因分割损失损害框定位"的问题，提出基于信息论与统计形状分析的按类别几何复杂度量化框架，并据此设计轻量后训练模块 EAGLE，在中高 IoU 下稳定提升定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规目标检测仅用边界框监督，定位几何精度不足，在高 IoU 阈值下尤为明显。引入多边形（全监督或部分监督）可提供更强几何信息，但标注成本高；更关键的是，对形状复杂度较低的类别，额外掩码与分割损失会"淹没"框定位信号，反而降低性能。现有方法缺乏对类别几何复杂度的定量刻画，难以判断何处该用何种监督。

Method: 1) 构建数学框架：结合信息熵与统计形状分析，量化每个类别的几何复杂度（如形状重建误差与预测不确定性的熵度量）；2) 基于该框架提出 EAGLE（Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer），作为轻量、后训练阶段（post-training）接入的模型头，为已有定位模型学习几何信息，通过边缘细化（edge refinement）与基于熵的定位重打分（localization rescoring）进行更新；3) 不改变主干检测器结构，推理开销极小。

Result: 在 MS COCO 与 Pascal SBD 上的实验表明：熵框架能有效预测形状重建误差，并能解释掩码派生预测与标准框预测之间的精度差异；EAGLE 在已属 SOTA 的检测框架上取得一致性提升，MS COCO 上 +0.9 mAP50-95，且观测到的推理开销极小。

Conclusion: 几何监督并非对所有类别都有益，其收益取决于类别的几何复杂度；通过熵驱动的复杂度量化可指导监督策略选择，而 EAGLE 以低成本的即插即用方式有效吸收几何信息，提升高 IoU 定位质量。

Abstract: Object detection is a critical application of computer vision, yet models trained uniformly on bounding boxes lack the geometric precision to be fully effective in inference settings, especially at high IoU thresholds. One common approach is the introduction of polygon-supervised localization, where a model is trained explicitly for localization but with access to polygon masks during training. Among such methods, partial polygon supervision is viable due to the higher annotation costs of developing fully supervised training datasets. However, this introduces a further challenge: in object classes of relatively low shape complexity, the addition of training masks and subsequent segmentation loss may obscure box localization, often worsening model performance despite access to deeper geometric information. To address the practical limitations of both full and partial polygon supervision, we introduce a mathematical framework for quantifying per-class geometric complexity by combining information theory and statistical shape analysis. With this framework, we develop Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer (EAGLE), a lightweight, post-training model head that learns geometric information for the localization model, improving accuracy via edge refinement and localization rescoring using entropy-informed updates. Empirical analysis across MS COCO and Pascal SBD demonstrates the entropy framework meaningfully predicts shape reconstruction error and accuracy differences among mask-derived and standard box predictions, while the implemented EAGLE framework achieves consistent improvement on already SOTA detection frameworks (+0.9 mAP50-95 points on MS COCO) at minimal observed inference overhead.

</details>

*1. Anwar Iqbal*1 aiqbal. rime23smme@student. nust. edu. pk 2. Kunwar Faraz Ahmad Khan1 kunwar. faraz@smme. nust. edu. pk 3. Shahbaz Khan1 shahbaz. khan@smme. nust. edu. pk 4. Khawaja Fahad Iqbal1 fahad. iqbal@smme. nust. edu. pk 5. Sara Ali1,2 sara. baber@smme. nust. edu. pk 6. Saqib Nazir1 saqib. nazir@smme. nust. edu. pk 7. Muhammad Azhar Javed3 muhammadazhar6231@gmail. com 1 Department of Robotics,Artificial Intelligence,SMME,National University of Science,Technology,Islamabad,Pakistan 2 Suzhou Industrial Park Monash Research Institute of Science,Technology,Suzhou,PR China 3 Department of Plant Pathology,Bahauddin Zakriya University,Multan,Pakistan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Cotton-Vision——一种融合Ghost Bottleneck、ECA注意力与CSP融合的全卷积单阶段检测器，基于巴基斯坦旁遮普省7块棉田2700余张无人机图像训练，实现棉花病害早期检测，mAP@50达85.6%，优于YOLO系列与DETR系列基线10-20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 棉花年产1.13亿包、支撑80余国纺织经济，但30-60%产量损失仍源于病毒、细菌和真菌病害，且多在人工田间巡查时才被发现。无人机影像+深度学习可构建可扩展的早期预警系统，然而现有模型存在早期阶段精度低、迁移性差、计算成本高的问题。

Method: 设计全卷积单阶段检测器，包含三项轻量化架构创新：(1) Ghost Bottleneck模块，参数量减少20%；(2) Efficient Channel Attention (ECA)实现自适应特征重校准；(3) Cross-Stage Partial (CSP)融合增强梯度流动。数据集自采于巴基斯坦旁遮普省7块棉田，含2700+高分辨率无人机图像，经旋转、剪切、曝光、饱和度等增强扩充至11,704个训练样本。

Result: 留出测试集上取得precision 97.7%、recall 77.7%、mAP@50 85.6%、mAP@50-95 76.6%；相较YOLOv5、YOLOv8、YOLOv11、YOLOv12、RT-DETR、RF-DETR等SOTA基线，precision、recall与mAP提升10-20%。消融实验表明各模块均有贡献，较基线架构mAP提升12-16%。

Conclusion: 轻量化与注意力模块的协同可为棉花病害早期检测提供鲁棒且计算可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Cotton sustains the textile economies of over 80 countries with an annual yield of 113 million bales, yet 30-60% of yield losses are still attributed to viral, bacterial, and fungal diseases that remain undetected until manual field scouting. To address this critical issue, the integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery with deep learning offers a scalable early-warning system; however, existing models suffer from low early-stage accuracy, poor transferability, and high computational cost. In this paper, we propose Cotton-Vision, a fully convolutional single-stage detector that synergizes three lightweight architectural innovations: Ghost Bottleneck modules for a 20% parameter reduction, Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) for adaptive feature recalibration, and Cross-Stage Partial (CSP) fusion for enriched gradient flow. The network is trained on a novel dataset collected across seven cotton fields in the Punjab province of Pakistan, comprising over 2,700 high-resolution drone images. Extensive data augmentation (rotation, shear, exposure, and saturation) expands the dataset to 11,704 training samples. On a held-out test set, Cotton-Vision achieves a precision of 97.7%, a recall of 77.7%, an mAP@50 of 85.6%, and an mAP@50-95 of 76.6%. These results represent a 10-20% improvement in precision, recall, and mAP over state-of-the-art baselines, including YOLOv5, YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLOv12, RT-DETR, and RF-DETR. Through a comprehensive ablation study, we demonstrate that each proposed architectural enhancement contributes to the model's superior performance, yielding a 12-16% mAP improvement over the baseline architecture. Our findings confirm that this synergy of lightweight and attention-based modules provides a robust, computationally viable solution for early cotton disease detection.

</details>


### [72] [MultiAltitudeSR: Multi-Altitude Agricultural UAV Image Super-Resolution via Physical Ground Sampling Distance Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24992)
*Xintong Jiang,Yu Tian,Yixue Liu,Valerio Hoyos-Villegas,Viacheslav Adamchuk,Shangpeng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出MultiAltitudeSR框架，以源/目标地面采样距离(GSD)为条件进行特征调制与重建，联合训练10–70 m真实无人机影像对，单一模型支持21种高度对、1.18×–6.03×任意倍率缩放，并在作物监测分割任务上验证了增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机作物监测中飞行高度与图像分辨率存在根本权衡：高空覆盖大但分辨率低。现有超分辨方法依赖过度简化的合成退化模型，且仅支持固定整数上采样倍率，难以适应真实退化与变化飞行高度。

Method: 提出MultiAltitudeSR：将特征调制与重建条件化于源与目标GSD；在10–70 m离地高度的真实无人机图像上联合训练，一个模型覆盖全部21种源-目标高度对，无需逐对微调；可通过加入相应图像对扩展至新的GSD组合。并对比真实图像对训练与合成退化流程训练的效果，辅以零样本分割下游案例研究。

Result: 20→10 m高度对上LPIPS 0.2236、DISTS 0.2431、NIQE 8.9020，感知性能与逐对专用基线相当；21个高度对上真实图像对训练的平均重建性能优于所测试的合成退化流程；零样本分割显示超分影像对作物监测的收益具有任务依赖性。

Conclusion: 统一的GSD条件化超分框架可跨飞行高度泛化，真实多高度图像对对SR训练具有明确价值，并有望通过提高飞行高度采集影像来节省飞行时间。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) enable high-throughput platforms for crop monitoring but face a fundamental trade-off between flight altitude and image spatial resolution. Many existing super-resolution (SR) methods for UAV imagery rely on oversimplified synthetic degradation models and are restricted to fixed integer upsampling scales, limiting their ability to handle real-world degradations and varying flight altitudes. This study proposes MultiAltitudeSR, a framework that conditions feature modulation and reconstruction on source and target ground sampling distances (GSDs). MultiAltitudeSR trained jointly on real UAV images at altitudes of 10 to 70 m above ground level supports all 21 source-to-target altitude pairs without pair-specific fine-tuning, covering scale factors ranging from 1.18$\times$ to 6.03$\times$. The framework can be extended to additional source-target GSD combinations by incorporating corresponding image pairs into training. On the 20-to-10 m pair, the model achieved competitive perceptual performance compared with pair-specific baselines, with LPIPS of 0.2236, DISTS of 0.2431, and NIQE of 8.9020. Experiments using the same architecture demonstrated the value of acquiring real-world multi-altitude UAV image pairs for SR training, with real-pair training achieving better average reconstruction performance across the 21 altitude pairs than training with the tested synthetic degradation pipeline. Downstream zero-shot segmentation case studies illustrated task-dependent benefits of super-resolved imagery for crop monitoring, suggesting potential UAV flight-time savings through image acquisition at higher altitudes.

</details>


### [73] [VisConf: Quality-Aware Consensus for Best-of-N in Vision-Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24526)
*Muhammad Usman,Muhammad Qasim Ayub,Usman Ahad,Muhammad Tahir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VisConf：将视觉参与度与候选校准的Self-Certainty相乘构成rollout质量分，并用免调参的RWC聚合规则把分数排名转为投票权重，在多视觉基准上稳定超过BoN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N在纯文本LLM上有效，但对VLM而言，答案频率与模型置信度不足以衡量采样轨迹质量，因为不同采样对视觉输入的参与程度差异很大。

Method: 发现分布置信度与视觉注意力是互补的rollout质量指标，单一指标各有局限、双强信号轨迹更可能正确；据此设计VisConf得分，将视觉参与度与候选校准的Self-Certainty相乘，对任一弱信号进行惩罚；再引入Rank-Weighted Consensus（RWC），将题内VisConf排名转化为答案级投票权重。

Result: 在MathVista、MMMU-Pro、MMStar三个基准、三个VLM上，VisConf+RWC一致优于强BoN基线；当正确轨迹存在但在候选池中被低估时增益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 视觉参与度与校准置信度的乘性融合是VLM候选选择的有效质量信号，配合免调参排名聚合可在不训练的情况下提升BoN推理性能。

Abstract: Best-of-N methods improve text-only LLM reasoning by sampling multiple trajectories before selecting an answer. For Vision-Language Models (VLMs), answer frequency and model confidence alone can be insufficient, as sampled generations also vary in their engagement with the visual input. We find that distributional confidence and visual attention are complementary indicators of rollout quality. Each is limited on its own, while trajectories that show strong signals in both are more likely to be correct. Motivated by this, we introduce VisConf, a rollout-quality score that multiplicatively combines visual engagement with candidate-calibrated Self-Certainty, penalizing rollouts that are weak in either signal. We incorporate Rank-Weighted Consensus (RWC), a tuning-free aggregation rule that converts within-question VisConf ranks into answer-level vote weights. Across three VLMs on MathVista, MMMU-Pro, and MMStar, VisConf with RWC consistently outperforms strong BoN baselines. Our analysis shows particularly large gains when correct trajectories are present but underrepresented in the candidate pool.

</details>


### [74] [SAP-Depth: Scene-Adaptive Probability Framework for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24506)
*Bowen He,Li Zhang,Yujie Chen,Chang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SAP-Depth：以场景自适应概率建模为核心的自监督单目深度估计架构，通过可学习参数预测器驱动的动态分箱与分箱级概率分布解码器，提升细粒度细节与边界锐度，在KITTI上超越SOTA并在Make3D上验证泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督单目深度估计仍存在细粒度细节丢失和对多样场景结构适应性不足的问题；传统固定深度分箱/回归方式难以刻画场景特有的深度分布。

Method: 提出Scene-Adaptive Probabilistic架构，含两个核心模块：(1) Dynamic Bins机制，由Learnable Parameter Predictor依据输入图像上下文自适应估计场景特定的深度分布（动态分箱）；(2) Bin-wise Probability Distribution Decoder，融合多尺度表征以预测稠密深度概率分布，增强边界锐度与结构恢复；两模块协同实现对场景特定深度分布的动态预测。

Result: 在KITTI数据集上精度优于现有SOTA，尤其在复杂边缘细节保持方面表现更佳；在Make3D上的测试验证了良好的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 以场景自适应概率分布建模替代静态深度假设，可有效改善自监督单目深度估计的细节保真与跨数据集泛化，动态分箱与概率解码器的耦合是性能提升的关键。

Abstract: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation remains challenging due to the loss of fine-grained details and limited adaptability to varying scene structures. In this paper, we propose SAP-Depth, a novel architecture based on Scene-Adaptive Probabilistic. Unlike traditional methods, we introduce a Dynamic Bins mechanism powered by a Learnable Parameter Predictor, which adaptively estimates scene-specific depth distributions conditioned on the input image context. Furthermore, a Bin-wise Probability Distribution Decoder is designed to effectively fuse multi-scale representations to predict dense depth probability distributions, significantly enhancing boundary sharpness and structural recovery. Through the collaborative coupling of these proposed modules, our model achieves dynamic prediction of scene-specific depth distributions. Extensive experiments on the KITTI dataset show that SAP-Depth outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, particularly in its ability to better preserve complex edge details. Further, tests on the Make3D dataset validate the model's excellent generalization capability and robustness.

</details>


### [75] [RiSE: Residual Subspace Expert for Generalizable Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24480)
*Kahim Wong,Kemou Li,Yiming Chen,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RiSE：冻结预训练SVD主子空间、仅适配残差子空间，并以伪造类型专属残差专家+隐扰动置信度选择，实现文本篡改图像的跨域伪造定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助图像编辑普及，金融与法律记录需文本中心伪造定位（TFL）；现有检测器依赖全参数微调（FPFT），导致低秩特征坍缩与训练伪影过拟合，难以泛化到未见伪造类型；且用单一统一表征捕获多样伪造痕迹，使细微痕迹纠缠难学。

Method: 提出RiSE残差子空间专家模型：冻结预训练SVD主成分、仅适配残差子空间，配以纯ViT分割器以避免特征坍缩；引入伪造感知残差专家，每个专家在含特定伪造类型的训练子集上独立训练；推理时用隐扰动置信度（LPC），通过解析计算隐扰动输出来选择最置信专家，单次前向即可完成置信估计，无需对扰动弹本重复前向。

Result: 仅用合成伪造数据训练，1个专家的RiSE在真实伪造图像上超过先前方法20.4%，训练步数减少10倍；扩展至9个专家增益达35.8%；即使在仅RGB预训练且大部分参数冻结时，RiSE对DCT特征仍有效。

Conclusion: 冻结主SVD子空间+残差专家可保留预训练先验、避免特征坍缩，专家数增加带来跨域定位性能持续提升，LPC提供高效专家选择，验证了参数高效与可扩展的TFL新范式。

Abstract: As AI-assisted image editing becomes increasingly prevalent, Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization (TFL) is essential for protecting trust in financial and legal records. However, we observe that existing TFL detectors predominantly rely on Full-Parameter Fine-Tuning (FPFT) and fail to generalize to unseen forgery types because FPFT can induce low-rank feature collapse and overfit training artifacts. Meanwhile, prior detectors capture diverse forgery traces with a single unified representation, making subtle traces entangled and difficult to learn. To address these challenges, we propose RiSE, a Residual Subspace Expert model that preserves pre-trained priors by freezing principal SVD components and adapting only the residual subspaces with a ViT-only segmentor to avoid feature collapse. RiSE introduces forgery-aware residual experts, where each expert is trained independently on a training subset with a particular forgery type, and we show that cross-domain localization performance improves consistently as more experts are added. At inference, we introduce Latent Perturbation Confidence (LPC), which selects the most confident expert by analytically computing the latent-perturbed output. LPC enables efficient confidence estimation with a single forward pass, avoiding repeated forward passes on perturbed samples and improving expert selection. By training on synthetic forgery data, RiSE with 1 expert outperforms prior methods on real-world forgery images by 20.4% while reducing training steps by 10 times. Scaling the number of experts to 9 yields a 35.8% gain. RiSE remains effective with DCT feature, even when the majority of the parameters is frozen with RGB-only pretraining. Code: https://github.com/KahimWong/RiSE.

</details>


### [76] [BodyBridge: Grounded Body Layers for Sim-to-Real Translation of Vulnerable Road Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24436)
*Mark Azer,Fabian B. Flohr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 BodyBridge 与 Grounded Body Layers (GBL)，一种由仿真器导出的像素对齐表示，将场景几何、逐像素规范身体对应与精确 VRU 掩码结合，为视频扩散模型提供显式关节姿态控制，从而提升仿真到真实驾驶视频中行人/骑行者生成的身份与姿态保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿真到真实的驾驶视频扩散模型把行人与骑行者（VRU）笼统当作"通用物体类别"处理，而 VRU 的安全相关外观依赖其关节姿态与身份，这种粗粒度表示不足以支撑姿态忠实的生成与评估。

Method: 构建 GBL：仿真器导出的、与像素严格对齐的表示，融合场景几何、规范（canonical）逐像素身体对应及精确 VRU 掩码；向扩散模型注入显式关节结构，在控制分支后训练阶段加权强调 VRU 区域，并在推理时与场景几何控制做加性组合；同时支持逐关节评估与身份错误失败分类体系。在 CARLA→真实的翻译任务上对比深度条件基线。

Result: 近距 PCK@0.5 相对已发布深度条件基线提升 22%；以规范对应替代法线图身体控制使肢体翻转减少 18%；加性组合使近距朝向翻转减少 27%。

Conclusion: 显式身体接地与场景级控制互补，可显著提升 VRU 生成的姿态忠实度；代码、数据与模型权重将公开，以支持可复现的、行人感知的自动驾驶研究。

Abstract: Simulation-to-real driving video diffusion models can translate photorealistic scenes, but they typically represent pedestrians and cyclists, vulnerable road users (VRUs), as generic object classes. This is insufficient for vulnerable road users whose safety-relevant appearance depends on articulated pose and identity. We present BodyBridge and Grounded Body Layers (GBL), a simulator-derived, pixel-aligned representation that combines scene geometry, canonical per-pixel body correspondence, and exact VRU masks. GBL provides explicit articulation to the video diffusion model, emphasizes VRU regions during control-branch post-training, and supports additive composition with scene-geometry control at inference. It also enables per-joint evaluation of generated VRUs and a failure taxonomy for identity errors. On CARLA-to-real translation, BodyBridge improves near-range PCK@0.5 by 22% over the released depth-conditioned baseline. Replacing normal-map body control with canonical correspondence reduces body flips by 18%, while composition reduces near-range facing flips by 27%. These results show that explicit body grounding complements scene-level control and improves pose-faithful VRU generation. All code, data, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available to support reproducible, pedestrian-aware autonomous driving research.

</details>


### [77] [Spatons: Spatiotonally Localized Building Blocks for Efficient XR Predistortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24400)
*Mohammadjavad Maheronnaghsh,Sushant Kondguli,Steve Mann,Andreas Moshovos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Spatons——一种组合式、空间局部化的神经算子家族，用于 XR 显示器的低功耗、低延迟预畸变与畸变补偿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XR（AR/VR/MR）显示器存在几何与色彩畸变，且随制造公差与投影系统变化，需要可编程补偿；同时无绳电池供电系统要求低能耗与低延迟。

Method: Spaton 为"patch-to-pixel"混合模块，将微型 MLP 与固定功能插值结合，构成可编程、计算高效的流水线；用闭式可微畸变与一组真实投影仪-相机采集数据训练评估，并做软件实现与解析硬件估算及跨平台优化。

Result: 在 Scenario 5 上 Sequential-5' 的 SSIM 与 CompenNet++ 持平（0.944 vs 0.944），PSNR 略低（27.5 vs 27.7 dB），复杂度显著更低：FLOPs 少 6 倍、参数少 106 倍，内存传输比 UNet++ 少 4–10 倍。

Conclusion: Spatons 为 XR 畸变补偿提供了轻量可编程方案；色散（彩色边缘）是其主要短板，且需在更多真实 XR 设备上验证。

Abstract: We present Spatons, a family of compositional, spatially localized neural operators for computationally efficient XR (extended reality) predistortion and distortion compensation. XR displays (AR, VR, and MR) suffer from spatial (e.g., geometric) and tonal (e.g., colour) distortions. Frames can be pre-distorted so that the projected image looks as intended. Distortions vary with manufacturing tolerances and projection systems, motivating programmable compensation. Untethered, battery-operated XR systems also require low energy and latency. A Spaton is a hybrid patch-to-pixel block combining tiny Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with fixed-function interpolation. Using Spatons, we build programmable, computationally efficient pipelines for varied distortion scenarios. On the full spatiotonal Scenario 5, Sequential-5' matches CompenNet++ in SSIM (0.944 vs. 0.944) and closely matches its PSNR (27.5 vs. 27.7 dB), with substantially lower complexity. We demonstrate a flexible Spaton solution with 6 times fewer FLOPs and 106 times fewer parameters than CompenNet++, and 4-10 times fewer memory transfers than UNet++. We characterize software implementations and analytical hardware estimates, including optimizations across target XR platforms. The distortions considered are drawn mostly from see-through, near-eye displays, where the spatial light path governs local intensity and spectral response. This early systems-level exploration uses closed-form differentiable distortions and one real projector-camera capture set for training and evaluation, rather than through-the-optics measurements. Testing on a wider range of real XR devices remains future work. Chromatic dispersion (color fringes) remains the main artifact where Spatons trail monolithic baselines.

</details>


### [78] [Arbitrary-Scale Anisotropic 3D MRI Super-Resolution with Gaussian Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24858)
*Aditya Rastogi,Ramon Leiser,Prateek Singh,Martha Foltyn-Dumitru,Martin Bendszus,Fabian Bamberg,Klaus Maier-Hein,Kai Schlamp,Alexander Radbruch,Gianluca Brugnara,Philipp Vollmuth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSMR3D：一种连续的体数据超分辨模型，用单一权重支持任意各向同性/各向异性分辨率重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缩短MRI采集时间可提升舒适度、减少运动伪影并提高扫描吞吐，临床常以牺牲层向分辨率为代价；现有超分辨方法多局限于单一尺度或采集几何，难以适配异构临床协议。

Method: 将各向异性3D高斯原型的可学习字典与尺度条件频率编码结合，并加入精确的测量一致性投影，使重建与已采集低分辨数据保持一致；每种对比度仅需一个checkpoint。训练数据为3,731例CE-T1w与30,254例T1w脑MRI（临床与人群队列）。

Result: 与几何专用专家模型对比（各向同性、面内、层向超分辨），在重建质量与下游任务上评估：各向同性2×优于专家；所有几何下LPIPS、DISTS、FID更优；各向异性下专家的PSNR更高；更忠实保留胶质瘤分割，在独立脑转移队列取得最高病灶敏感度，各向同性与面内重建的脑区划分一致性最高；单例重建约6秒。

Conclusion: GSMR3D以每对比度一个模型跨几何实现灵活扫描时间缩减，相比采集时间节省开销很小，并能保留下游任务相关信息。

Abstract: Reducing MRI acquisition time improves patient comfort, reduces motion artefacts, and increases scanner throughput. Clinical protocols often shorten acquisitions by sacrificing spatial resolution, particularly along the slice axis. Super-resolution can recover higher-resolution images, but existing methods are typically specialised to one scale or acquisition geometry, limiting their use across heterogeneous clinical protocols. We present GSMR3D, a continuous volumetric model that reconstructs arbitrary isotropic and anisotropic resolutions with a single checkpoint per MRI contrast. It combines a learned dictionary of anisotropic 3D Gaussian prototypes with scale-conditioned frequency encoding and an exact measurement-consistency projection, keeping reconstructions consistent with the acquired low-resolution data. We train separate models on 3,731 contrast-enhanced T1-weighted and 30,254 T1-weighted brain MRI volumes from clinical and population-based cohorts. We evaluate GSMR3D against geometry-specific specialists for isotropic, in-plane, and through-plane super-resolution using reconstruction quality and downstream tasks: brain tumour segmentation, brain-metastasis detection, and brain parcellation. GSMR3D outperforms specialists at isotropic $2\times$ and achieves better LPIPS, DISTS, and FID across all geometries, although specialists retain higher PSNR in anisotropic settings. It more faithfully preserves glioma segmentations across all geometries, achieves the highest lesion sensitivity on an independent brain-metastasis cohort, and the highest brain-parcellation agreement for isotropic and in-plane reconstruction. Reconstruction takes about 6s per volume, adding little overhead relative to acquisition-time savings. GSMR3D offers a flexible approach to MRI scan-time reduction with one model per contrast across geometries while preserving information relevant to downstream tasks.

</details>


### [79] [SL-Ground: Sentence-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24814)
*Yang-Syu Li,Cheng-Huan Yang,Chia-Yung Jui,Peggy Joy Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SL-Ground，将基于grounding的开放词汇检测从token级打分重构为句子级grounding，以完整句子表示类别描述并直接与目标查询打分，显著提升细粒度开放词汇检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有grounding式开放词汇检测将目标查询对齐到单个文本token，再通过token到类别的聚合恢复类别分数。但细粒度场景下类别由完整组合式描述定义，而非孤立token，因此token级打分成为瓶颈。

Method: SL-Ground将每个类别描述编码为完整句子级表示，直接用目标查询与句子表示打分，替代碎片化token证据的聚合；并构建多粒度Stanford Cars基准（车型、品牌、车款三级），在匹配训练候选采样与全词表训练两种设置下评估，同时对比FG-OVD。

Result: 在最细的车款粒度上，匹配采样下AP由token级变体的14.5提升至70.6，全词表训练下达86.0，且更好保留开放词汇能力并避免重复prompt分块；在FG-OVD上取得对比方法中最优平均AP。

Conclusion: 句子级grounding是细粒度开放词汇检测更合适的打分单元，为构建细粒度grounding式开放词汇检测器提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors provide a widely used framework for text-conditioned localization, with a phrase-grounding formulation that aligns object queries to individual text tokens and recovers class scores through token-to-class aggregation. We observe that this token-level scoring design becomes a bottleneck for fine-grained open-vocabulary object detection, where the target category is defined by a complete compositional description rather than by isolated tokens. Based on this observation, we propose SL-Ground, a sentence-level grounding reformulation for grounding-based open-vocabulary detection. Instead of scoring queries against fragmented token evidence, SL-Ground encodes each category description as a complete sentence-level representation and directly scores object queries against these representations. To evaluate fine-grained recognition across label granularity, we construct a multi-granularity Stanford Cars benchmark spanning vehicle type, brand, and car model. At the finest car-model granularity, SL-Ground raises AP over the token-level variant from 14.5 to 70.6 under matched training candidate sampling and to 86.0 with full-vocabulary training, while better preserving open-vocabulary capability and avoiding repeated prompt chunking. Beyond Stanford Cars, SL-Ground also improves FG-OVD performance, achieving the best average AP among compared methods. These results show that sentence-level grounding provides a more suitable scoring unit for fine-grained OVOD and offers a practical path toward fine-grained grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors.

</details>


### [80] [CorrCLIPv2: Harnessing Unlabeled Images for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24757)
*Dengke Zhang,Fagui Liu,Quan Tang,C. L. Philip Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的目标中心框架 CorrCLIPv2，从 patch 相关性、特征表示与输出正则三方面抑制 CLIP 的类间 patch 噪声，并引入跨图像目标检索与多 CLIP 集成，在 10 个基准上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 具备强开放词汇识别潜力，但其分割能力受类间 patch 交互噪声（noisy inter-class patch interactions）削弱，且存在上下文偏置，导致输出空间不一致、对象预测不准确。

Method: 统一的免训练目标中心框架，含四部分：(1) patch 相关性：用类无关 mask 生成器显式解耦类间交互，并以自监督模型的空间连贯特征计算注意力分数以缓解 mask 不精确；(2) 特征表示：设计细化机制同时增强空间细节与语义表征；(3) 输出空间：在每个 mask 内以投票统一预测以提升空间一致性；(4) 扩展：构建无标注图像的 CorrCLIP 增强特征记忆库，进行跨图像目标检索与 multi-CLIP ensemble，聚合跨上下文语义一致的目标特征以抑制上下文干扰，额外计算开销极小。

Result: 在 10 个标准基准上达到新的 SOTA，并在 22 个多领域数据集上超过全监督开放词汇方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦 patch 交互、强化特征表示、输出投票正则及跨图像检索集成的组合，可在完全免训练条件下显著提升 CLIP 的开放词汇语义分割性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation aims to classify pixels without being restricted to a fixed set of categories. Although Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) demonstrates remarkable potential for open-vocabulary recognition, its segmentation capability is impaired by noisy inter-class patch interactions. To this end, this work proposes a unified training-free object-centric framework, named CorrCLIPv2, from three complementary aspects of patch correlation, feature representation, and output regularization. Specifically, for patch correlation, we leverage class-agnostic mask generators to explicitly disentangle inter-class interactions. Moreover, we utilize spatially-coherent features from self-supervised models to compute attention scores to mitigate mask inaccuracies. Regarding feature representation, we devise a refinement mechanism to simultaneously strengthen spatial details and semantic representation. Within the output space, we unify predictions via voting in each mask to enhance spatial consistency.
