To mitigate contextual bias and enhance prediction accuracy of objects, we further extend the framework by incorporating a cross-image object retrieval paradigm, which incurs minimal computational overhead. We build a memory bank of CorrCLIP-enhanced features from unlabeled images and implement a regime of multi-CLIP ensemble. By aggregating semantically consistent object features across diverse contexts retrieved from the memory bank, CorrCLIPv2 mitigates context-induced interference and obtains more robust predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art on 10 standard benchmarks. Remarkably, it even surpasses fully supervised open-vocabulary methods across 22 multi-domain datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/zdk258/CorrCLIP.

</details>


### [81] [From Views to Worlds: Active Exploration over 3D Worlds for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24676)
*Qijian Tian,Jiayu Ying,Ke Fan,Lizhuang Ma,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 View-to-World (V2W) 主动探索框架，将 VLM 从被动的视图中心感知提升为主动的世界中心空间推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在 2D 视觉理解上进展显著，但其被动、以视图为中心的感知范式限制了 3D 空间推理能力；此类推理常需超出当前可见视图主动获取空间证据（如相机位姿、跨视图空间关系）。现有方法要么缺乏主动探索，要么仅在推理时提供额外视图，未显式获取 2D 图像之外的空间证据。

Method: 给定含多视图图像的空间推理任务，V2W 先重建显式 3D 世界（几何、相机位姿、语言接地的语义），并通过视觉与语言接口暴露给 VLM；VLM 经多轮交互从构建的 3D 世界中迭代获取空间证据。该框架可免训练集成到现有 VLM，并可通过强化学习优化探索策略进一步增强。

Result: 在空间心智建模基准上，V2W 在免训练设置下显著优于 VLM 基线，并在学习到的探索策略下达到 SOTA 性能，凸显主动探索对空间智能的重要性。

Conclusion: 主动探索 3D 世界、显式重建并交互获取空间证据，是突破 VLM 被动视图中心感知局限、提升 3D 空间推理能力的有效路径。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual understanding tasks, yet the passive view-centric perception paradigm limits their capacity for 3D spatial reasoning. Such reasoning often requires actively acquiring spatial evidence beyond the currently visible views, such as camera poses and cross-view spatial relationships, to infer 3D relationships that are not explicitly represented in 2D images. However, existing methods either lack active exploration or merely provide additional views during inference, without explicitly acquiring such spatial evidence beyond 2D images. In this paper, we propose View-to-World (V2W), an active exploration framework that enables VLMs to actively explore 3D worlds and lifts VLMs from passive view-centric perception to active world-centric spatial reasoning. Given a spatial reasoning task with multi-view images, V2W first reconstructs an explicit 3D world with geometry, camera poses, and language-grounded semantics, and exposes it to VLMs through visual and linguistic interfaces. Through multi-turn interaction with these interfaces, VLMs iteratively acquire spatial evidence from the constructed 3D world, enabling active world-centric spatial reasoning. V2W can be integrated with existing VLMs in a training-free manner and can be further enhanced by optimizing the exploration policy via reinforcement learning. Experiments on spatial mental modeling benchmarks demonstrate that V2W substantially improves VLM baselines in the training-free setting and achieves state-of-the-art performance with the learned exploration policy, highlighting the importance of active exploration for spatial intelligence. Project page: \url{https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w}.

</details>


### [82] [Modeling Uncertainty Propagation in 3D Morphable Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24646)
*Megh Shukla,Edo Collins,Prashanth Chandran,Karel Petránek,Sergio Orts-Escolano,Mathieu Salzmann,Alexandre Alahi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CLUE用闭式近似将由全方差定律导出的3DMM参数空间方差映射到逐顶点方差，模块化、低成本且准确，用于in-the-wild人体网格恢复的训练与推理，在关节/网格/不确定性指标上优于基线和随机性基线，并给出SAM 3D Body (CLUE)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上用逐顶点方差可视化3DMM参数不确定性，但通过采样或误差传播将参数空间方差映射到逐顶点计算代价高昂；同时希望在in-the-wild人体网格恢复中高效利用不确定性，并借助网格几何作为归纳偏置提升精度与不确定性解释性。

Method: 提出Closed-form Local Uncertainty Estimation（CLUE）：对3DMM公式应用全方差定律，得到参数空间分布到逐顶点方差的闭式近似；该模块可插拔、计算开销小。将CLUE集成到人体网格恢复的训练与推理中，把网格几何作为预测方差的归纳偏置；通过大量定性与定量实验与概率/确定性基线比较。

Result: 在训练中使用CLUE时，(1) 在评估关节、网格和不确定性的指标上优于概率与确定性基线；(2) 取得最高的不确定性-误差Spearman相关，可用于数据挖掘与可解释不确定性；并发布SAM 3D Body (CLUE)，为回归器附加高分辨率不确定性图。

Conclusion: 闭式全方差定律近似可高效替代采样/误差传播实现3DMM逐顶点不确定性，且作为几何归纳偏置改善人体网格恢复精度；CLUE兼具模块化、低成本与可解释性，代码已开源。

Abstract: We study the problem of mapping parameter-space variance of a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to per-vertex variance. Traditionally, per-vertex variance has been used to visually interpret the learnt parameter uncertainty. However, mapping parameter-space variance to per-vertex using sampling or error propagation is computationally expensive. We address this limitation with Closed-form Local Uncertainty Estimation (CLUE), which transforms the parameter-space distribution of 3DMMs to per-vertex through a closed-form approximation. CLUE emerges from applying the law of total variance to the 3DMM formulation and is modular, computationally inexpensive, and accurate. Subsequently, we study integrating CLUE for in-the-wild human mesh recovery training and inference. We note that CLUE uses the geometry of the mesh as an inductive bias when predicting the variance, leading to improved accuracy. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that when used in training, CLUE (1) outpeforms probabilistic and deterministic baselines on metrics evaluating joints, mesh and uncertainty, and (2) has the highest uncertainty-to-error spearman correlation, with applications including data mining and interpretable uncertainty. Finally, we share SAM 3D Body (CLUE) which augments the regressor with high resolution uncertainty maps. We make our code available at https://github.com/vita-epfl/CLUE

</details>


### [83] [Goal Images Are Control Targets: Spatially-Grounded Goal-Image Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24885)
*Riddhi Chatterjee,Ritish Shrirao,Kushagra Mehrotra,Viswanath Gopalakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 目标条件策略中的目标图像生成器不应按通用图像编辑质量排序；下游成功率由"操作遵循性"决定，据此提出的空间接地分解编辑框架 SGE-Goal 使小规模开源模型超越顶级专有编辑器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域普遍假设"图像编辑质量越好→目标图像越好"，因此目标生成器均以通用图像编辑指标构建与比较。作者要检验该假设是否成立，并揭示真正决定下游策略成功的因素。

Method: 在 CALVIN 与 SIMPLER-Bridge 上，用两个独立的目标条件策略对比两类目标生成器（Gemini 3 Pro Image、GPT Image 1.5 等大型专有编辑器 vs. 微调的小型开源模型），并做逐维度相关性分析（操作遵循性 vs. 照片真实感/美学保真度与成功率的 Spearman 相关）。随后提出 SGE-Goal：在目标图像合成前先预测初始与末态的 2D 编辑区域掩码的空间接地分解编辑框架，用于微调 FLUX.1 Kontext、FLUX.2 klein。

Result: 编辑质量榜单领先的 Gemini 3 Pro Image 与 GPT Image 1.5 产生的控制目标劣于微调开源模型，且差距在多步长程任务上显著扩大。成功率几乎完全由操作遵循性决定（ρ≈0.9），而照片真实感与美学保真度与成功率无关（ρ≈0）；该解离在 CALVIN 与 SIMPLER-Bridge 上均成立。SGE-Goal 使开源基座成为 CALVIN 上最强的目标生成器，在 SIMPLER-Bridge 上仅次于 Gemini 3 Pro Image；在链式任务中最长五步链的成功率约为最佳专有编辑器的 7 倍。

Conclusion: 目标生成器应按下游效用而非图像编辑质量榜单来选择；空间接地的分解式编辑是提升长程操作性能的有效路径。作者开源代码、数据集、检查点及与人类对齐的诊断评估器。

Abstract: Goal-conditioned manipulation policies are steered by a goal image, a picture of the desired post-manipulation scene synthesized from the current observation and a language instruction. The prevailing assumption is that better image-editing quality yields better goals, so goal generators are built and compared using general image-editing metrics. We show this assumption is false. Across two independent goal-conditioned policies on CALVIN, the image editors that top aggregate editing-quality leaderboards (Gemini 3 Pro Image and GPT Image 1.5) produce worse control targets than our proposed far smaller finetuned open models, and the gap widens sharply for the multi-step (long-horizon) tasks robots actually face. A per-dimension analysis explains why. Downstream policy success is governed almost entirely by manipulation adherence (selecting the right object and the right final state; Spearman $ρ\approx 0.9$ with success), while photorealism and aesthetic fidelity, precisely where large proprietary editors excel, are uncorrelated with success ($ρ\approx 0$). This dissociation holds on both CALVIN and the real-world-aligned SIMPLER-Bridge benchmark. We then present SGE-Goal, a spatially-grounded decomposed editing framework that predicts initial and final 2D edit-region masks before goal-image synthesis. SGE-Goal turns open base models (FLUX.1 Kontext, FLUX.2 klein) into the strongest goal generators we evaluate on CALVIN, and second only to Gemini 3 Pro Image on SIMPLER-Bridge. Base models fine-tuned with SGE-Goal also hold up under chaining far better than the best proprietary editor, sustaining roughly seven times the success rate at the longest (five-step) chains. We release code, datasets, checkpoints, and a human-aligned diagnostic evaluator. Our results argue that goal generators must be selected by downstream utility, not by editing-quality leaderboards.

</details>


### [84] [What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23987)
*Tengju Ru,Weitong Lian,Zecong Tang,Zhiheng Liu,Lingyi Meng,Haoran Li,Kaixuan Wang,Bohao Li,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出GAFU后训练框架，将UMM生成通路的原生视觉表征压缩为紧凑G tokens供理解通路按任务检索，从而提升细粒度视觉理解，在VStar-Bench、OmniSpatial、VSR-Bench上相对SFT基线最高提升20.00%、17.94%、8.62%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度视觉理解需要区分局部属性与空间关系的细微差异，现有视觉语言模型仍难以胜任。统一多模态模型（UMM）的生成通路保留丰富视觉信息、与理解通路互补；但已有生成辅助理解方法多依赖生成监督或显式生成，未系统探究直接利用生成侧原生表征的潜力。

Method: 首先系统分析生成侧表征对细粒度理解的作用（发现其对细粒度语义变化更敏感、能捕获理解侧遗漏的任务相关变化、且依赖正确的空间组织）；据此设计GAFU后训练框架，将生成侧视觉表征压缩为保留细粒度细节的紧凑G tokens，支持理解通路进行任务条件化检索。

Result: 在多种视觉理解任务与多种UMM架构上，GAFU一致优于同数据训练的SFT基线；在VStar-Bench、OmniSpatial、VSR-Bench上最大相对提升分别为20.00%、17.94%、8.62%。

Conclusion: GAFU将生成通路的互补信息转化为细粒度视觉理解增益，为UMM中生成与理解的协同提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. However, existing generation-assisted understanding methods mainly rely on generative supervision or explicit generation and have not systematically explored direct use of native generation-side representations. To address this gap, we systematically analyze what generation-side representations offer for fine-grained understanding, finding that they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic changes, capture task-relevant changes missed by understanding-side representations, and depend on correct spatial organization for this advantage. Guided by these findings, we design GAFU, a post-training framework that unlocks native generation-side information for fine-grained understanding. It compresses generation-side visual representations into compact \(G\) tokens that preserve fine-grained visual details, enabling task-conditioned retrieval by the understanding pathway. Experiments show that GAFU consistently outperforms SFT baselines trained on the same data across diverse visual understanding tasks and UMM architectures, with maximum relative improvements of 20.00\%, 17.94\%, and 8.62\% on VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, and VSR-Bench, respectively. Overall, GAFU converts complementary information from the generation pathway into gains in fine-grained visual understanding, providing an effective path toward synergy between generation and understanding in UMMs.

</details>


### [85] [RhinoNet: Unsupervised Learning for Phenoscaping and Generation of High Dimensional Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23898)
*Siddharth Viswanath,Hiren Madhu,Eddie Cavallin,Benjamin Jones,Alistair Wilkinson,Christopher Tape,Michael Perlmutter,Rex Ying,Ian Adelstein,Smita Krishnaswamy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RhinoNet 是一种基于单纯复形的点云神经网络，通过 Vietoris-Rips 过滤学习边结构，结合单纯小波与 MLP 及自编码器，构建保持最优传输距离的几何保真嵌入，实现点云/群体级表征学习与生成建模，并提出"表型景观（phenoscape）"概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维点云（如单细胞数据集）缺乏能在群体层面保持几何结构的表征方法；现有静态映射等方法无法生成有序的群体级表征，也难以从表征反推生成完整点云。

Method: 将队列中每个点云视为以数据点为顶点、由 Vietoris-Rips 过滤学习边的单纯复形；用单纯小波与 MLP 层在自编码器潜空间中计算各数据集的向量表示；优化潜空间使点云对之间的最优传输距离得以保留；并采用两种生成方式——潜空间流匹配与测地插值——经解码还原点云。

Result: RhinoNet 生成的表型景观具有良好组织性（静态映射则不能）；可从该景观采样并解码生成完整点云；在单细胞与空间数据队列上相对基线达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: RhinoNet 将表征学习与生成建模提升到点云/群体层面，为"表型景观构建"提供了通用神经模型。

Abstract: We present RhinoNet, a simplicial complex-based point cloud neural network, that creates a geometry-preserving embedding of high-dimensional point clouds. RhinoNet takes collections of datasets, also called {\em data cohorts}, and processes each dataset (point cloud) within the cohort as a simplicial complex. These simplicial complexes have datapoints as vertices and edges learned by Vietoris-Rips filtration. Using simplicial wavelets and MLP layers, RhinoNet computes a vector representation of each dataset in a latent space produced by an autoencoder. The latent space is optimized such that an optimal transport distance between pairs of point clouds is preserved between the latent representations. We apply RhinoNet to single-cell datasets collected on patients---a common source of such high-dimensional data. RhinoNet creates a patient level representation, known in biological contexts as a phenoscape. We establish that RhinoNet generates organized phenoscapes, whereas other methods such as static maps do not. Next we show that we can generate entire point clouds by sampling and decoding this phenoscape. We show two modes of generation via 1) latent flow matching and 2) geodesic interpolation in latent space, followed by a decoding back into the point cloud space. RhinoNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on single-cell and spatial data cohorts relative to tested baselines. Overall, RhinoNet lifts the concepts of representation learning and generative modeling to the point cloud or population level and defines a neural model for phenoscaping.

</details>


### [86] [Predicting Individual Differences in Lipreading From Eye-Tracking and Pupillometry During Silent Visual Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24898)
*Puneet Kumar,Satyarth Malik,Gao Zheng,Guoying Zhao,Xiaobai Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究利用同步眼动与瞳孔记录，考察唇读能力的个体差异能否由观看行为推断。作者发布LiPS数据集，用四分支跨模态注意力网络在静音唇读任务上以0.680的准确率区分强、弱唇读者，发现瞳孔与注视汇总分支信息量最大，而唇部图像流贡献很小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 唇读能力个体差异显著（包括听障人群），口部定向注意与言语阅读表现相关，但尚不清楚能从观看行为中推断多少唇读技能、以及哪些信号承载该信息。

Method: 发布Lipreading Perception Study (LiPS)数据集与追踪器无关的预处理流程，将SR Research EyeLink注视与瞳孔记录同刺激同步。24名成人（32±10岁）完成四选一强制选择静音唇读任务，极端组设计得到18名强/弱唇读者。每个被试-试次包含四路对齐视图：唇区图像、帧级注视、瞳孔汇总、空间观看比例。采用四分支跨模态注意力神经网络，以被试不相交划分与系统消融实验预测标签。

Result: 完整模型五折准确率0.680±0.040，优于朴素融合基线；瞳孔与观看汇总分支信息量最大，移除后性能降幅最大（准确率0.618，AUC 0.623），该分支单独即达0.675准确率；唇图像流对被试级判别贡献很小。

Conclusion: 唇读个体差异体现在瞳孔关联信号与帧级注视上，而非注视口部的时间比例；同步眼动与瞳孔测量可能成为视觉言语知觉的客观标志物，需在更大、临床多样化人群中验证，LiPS可作为扩展研究资源。

Abstract: Lipreading ability varies widely, including among people who are hard of hearing. Although mouth-directed attention is linked to speechreading outcomes, it remains unclear how much lipreading skill can be inferred from viewing behavior and which signals carry this information. We examine whether individual differences in lipreading ability are reflected in viewing behavior during silent speech and quantify the contributions of gaze dynamics, pupil-linked signals, and spatial viewing allocation. We introduce the Lipreading Perception Study (LiPS) dataset and a tracker-independent preprocessing pipeline that synchronizes SR Research EyeLink gaze and pupil recordings with the stimuli. Twenty-four adults (age 32 $\pm$ 10 years) completed a four-alternative forced-choice silent lipreading task. An extreme-groups protocol yielded 18 participants labeled as stronger or weaker lipreaders. Each participant-trial included four aligned views: lip-region images, frame-level gaze, pupil summaries, and spatial viewing proportions. A four-branch neural network with cross-modal attention predicted labels using participant-disjoint splits and systematic ablations. The full model reached accuracy 0.680 $\pm$ 0.040 across five folds, outperforming naive fusion baselines in accuracy. The pupil and viewing-summary branch was most informative: removing it caused the largest degradation (0.618 accuracy, 0.623 AUC), while it alone achieved 0.675 accuracy. The lip-image stream contributed little to participant-level discrimination. Individual differences in lipreading are reflected in pupil-linked and frame-level gaze signals rather than in how much time a viewer spends looking at the mouth. Synchronized gaze and pupillary measures may provide objective markers of visual speech perception, warranting investigation in larger, clinically diverse populations. LiPS provides a resource for extending this work.

</details>


### [87] [Multi-Speed Field Evaluation of a Semi-Autonomous Precision Sprayer for Weed Control in Vegetable Crops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24893)
*Md Khairul Islam,Boyang Deng,Yuzhen Lu,Daniel Brainard,Ajit Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了半自主拖拉机视觉引导精准除草喷雾系统在萝卜田三种作业速度下的整体性能，发现低速下检测精度高（94.6% mAP@50、93.2% 召回率），但随速度提升杂草命中率由78.3%降至35.0%、作物接触率由20.1%升至28.7%，未达商业可行性阈值，需在运动鲁棒感知、喷雾时序补偿与作物邻近执行精度上协同改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器视觉引导的精准喷雾可实现位点特异性除草、减少除草剂用量并保障产量品质，但喷雾系统作业速度对"检测—跟踪—执行"一体化流程的影响在田间条件下缺乏充分表征，本研究旨在量化这一速度依赖效应。

Method: 构建涵盖五个生长季、10,599张图像、七个类别、84,311个标注实例的数据集；将YOLOv11-medium检测模型与ByteTrack跟踪算法及定制12喷嘴喷雾装置集成于半自主电动拖拉机；在0.13、0.27、0.45 m/s三种速度下开展田间试验，评估检测、目标定位、执行与作物损伤的速度依赖性变化。

Result: 最低速度0.13 m/s下杂草与作物检测达94.6% mAP@50与93.2%召回率；速度提升显著降低系统性能，杂草命中率由78.3%降至35.0%，作物接触率由20.1%升至28.7%，系统未达到预设商业可行性阈值。

Conclusion: 实际部署不能仅依赖检测性能提升，还需在运动鲁棒的植株感知、喷雾时序补偿及作物邻近执行精度方面协同优化；所识别的性能瓶颈为高速蔬菜精准除草系统的工程改进提供了明确目标，相关软件已开源。

Abstract: Machine vision-guided precision spraying is promising for sustainable vegetable production by enabling site-specific weed targeting, reducing herbicide application while protecting crop yield and quality. However, the effects of operating speed of sprayer systems on the integrated detection-tracking-actuation pipeline remain insufficiently characterized under field conditions. This study evaluated a semi-autonomous, tractor-based spraying system for targeted weed control in radish and quantified performance across three operating speeds. A five-season dataset comprising 10,599 images and 84,311 annotated instances across seven classes was curated for model development. A YOLOv11-medium model was integrated with ByteTrack tracking and a customized 12-nozzle sprayer on a semi-autonomous electric tractor. Field trials were conducted at 0.13, 0.27, and 0.45 m/s (i.e., 0.3, 0.6, and 1.0 mph) to characterize speed-dependent changes in weed detection, targeting, actuation, and crop damage. At the lowest speed of 0.13 m/s, the system achieved 94.6% mAP@50 and 93.2% recall for weed and crop detection. However, increasing platform speed substantially reduced system performance, with weed hit rate declining from 78.3% to 35.0% and crop contact rates increasing from 20.1% to 28.7%. Consequently, the system did not meet predefined commercial-viability thresholds. These results demonstrate that practical deployment requires improvements beyond weed detection alone, particularly coordinated improvements in motion-robust plant perception, spray-timing compensation, and crop-adjacent actuation precision. The identified performance bottlenecks provide specific engineering targets for advancing vision-guided precision spraying toward practical, high-speed vegetable weed management. The software programs developed in this study have been made publicly available to support future precision weeding research.

</details>


### [88] [SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24812)
*Yizheng Xie,Yalda Foroutan,George Shramko,Daniel Rebain,Shrisudhan Govindarajan,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SwitchSplat 提出首个面向可交互场景的 3DGS 表示，采用“静态基底 + 状态槽位”分解，从休闲视频中无标注地学习可交互物体的离散状态，支持推理时自由组合状态并从任意视角渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D Gaussian Splatting 假设世界静态；而日常拍摄中用户会开门、拨开关、移动物体，产生离散状态变化，当前框架无法建模。4DGS 等时间条件动态方法将“何时观测到”与“场景处于何种状态”混为一谈，只能回放已见序列，无法组合任意物体构型。

Method: 提出 base+slot 分解：共享静态 base 捕获不变场景，每个 slot 独立存储一个可交互物体的两个二值状态（开/关）；Gaussian 到 slot 的分配完全可微，因此各状态几何可直接从视频中无人工标注地自动发现。推理时用户可自由组合各 slot 状态并从任意视角渲染。

Result: 在新建的休闲拍摄数据集上验证，SwitchSplat 在新视角合成质量上优于静态与动态基线，并独有地支持渲染拍摄中从未出现过的状态组合。

Conclusion: 通过将离散可交互状态与静态场景解耦，SwitchSplat 突破了 4DGS 的序列回放限制，实现了可组合、可编辑的 3DGS 场景表示，为交互式场景重建提供了新范式。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io

</details>


### [89] [Video-Language Entailment for Video Similarity Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24786)
*Benedetta Liberatori,Lorenzo Vaquero,Elisa Ricci,Paolo Rota*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VICE（Video Caption Entailment），用双分支LMM跨视频推理实现概念级视频相似度估计，融合两分支得分并输出解释文本，在ConViS-Bench与StepDiff上优于同时处理双视频的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LMM多以单视频目标训练，难以直接做视频间语义相似度比较；已有工作侧重全局相似度，概念级相似度（如动作、地点）研究较少，且尚无专门利用LMM显式求解该任务的方法。

Method: VICE采用双分支设计：每个分支联合输入一段视频与另一段视频的caption，通过视频-语言蕴含（entailment）判断二者在特定概念上的对齐程度；两支路输出融合得到最终相似度分数，并生成模型推理的文本解释。该设计复用模型原生单视频理解能力，实现细粒度视频-文本比较推理。

Result: 在ConViS-Bench与StepDiff上，VICE优于同时处理两段视频的模型，表明单视频推理范式对概念级相似度估计具有优势。

Conclusion: 将跨视频相似度转化为视频-文本蕴含的双分支单视频推理是有效方向，兼顾可解释性并超越双视频联合输入方案。

Abstract: Comparing videos to assess their semantic similarity remains a challenging task for current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), which are primarily trained with single-video objectives. While most prior works have focused on computing global similarity, recent studies have introduced the more challenging problem of concept-based similarity, which measures how similar two videos are with respect to specific concepts (e.g., activity, location). However, no dedicated approaches have yet leveraged LMMs to explicitly address this task. In this paper, we aim to fill this gap introducing Video Caption Entailment for video similarity estimation (VICE): a dual-branch design that leverages LMMs for cross-video reasoning. Each branch jointly processes one video and the caption of the other, measuring their alignment for a specific concept via video-language entailment. The outputs from both branches are fused to produce a final similarity score, along with a textual explanation of the model reasoning. This approach leverages the model's native single-video understanding while enabling fine-grained comparative reasoning between video and text. Experiments on ConViS-Bench and StepDiff show that VICE outperforms models that process both videos simultaneously, highlighting the promise of single-video reasoning for concept-based similarity estimation.

</details>


### [90] [ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24783)
*Hamidreza Dastmalchi,Ali Cheraghian,Aijun An,Abdelwahed Khamis,Lars Petersson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ATLAS 是一个注意力适配框架，将 LVLM 中跨层、跨头、跨模态的原始注意力学习性地转化为以对象为中心的定位线索，并结合 SAM2 实现推理式视频目标分割（RVOS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RVOS 需要在整个视频中定位并分割自然语言表达式所指对象。LVLM 的注意力图隐含定位线索，但存在噪声大、弥散、跨层/头/模态分散的问题；现有方法依赖手工注意力选择启发式或计算昂贵的注意力精炼，难以直接用于分割。

Method: 提出 ATLAS：将所有层、头与模态的注意力视为结构化特征，融合高分辨率的帧级注意力（空间信息）与低分辨率的视频级注意力（时间上下文）；用一个带时间注意力与 FiLM 调制的轻量 U-Net 融合互补表示，生成粗分割热图，再通过 SAM2 在视频中传播。

Result: 在具有挑战性的指代与推理视频分割基准上，ATLAS 优于现有冻结骨干（frozen-backbone）方法。

Conclusion: 学习式注意力适配可有效替代手工启发式与昂贵精炼，将 LVLM 注意力转化为可用定位线索；配合 SAM2 传播可在 RVOS 上取得领先性能。

Abstract: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to localize and segment objects referred to by natural-language expressions throughout a video. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) implicitly encode localization cues in their attention maps, these attentions are often noisy, diffuse, and scattered across layers, heads, and modalities, limiting their direct use for segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on handcrafted attention-selection heuristics or computationally expensive attention refinement. We propose ATLAS, an attention adaptation framework that learns to transform raw LVLM attentions into object-centric localization cues. ATLAS treats attentions from all layers, heads, and modalities as structured features, combining high-resolution frame-level attentions that capture spatial information with low-resolution video-level attentions that encode temporal context. A lightweight U-Net equipped with temporal attention and FiLM-based modulation fuses these complementary representations to generate coarse segmentation heatmaps, which are propagated across the video using SAM2. Extensive experiments on challenging referring and reasoning video segmentation benchmarks show that ATLAS outperforms existing frozen-backbone methods. Code and models are available at \url{https://hamidreza-136.github.io/atlas/}.

</details>


### [91] [Design Anything, Design at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24771)
*Xuchao Ren,Siyuan Feng,Jing Huang,Yanhua Yao,Jing Wang,Lingyu Alina Wang,Anan Chen,Hangjie Yuan,Tao Feng,Qiong Wu,Sai Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Design Anything：一种基于图的框架，将设计意图外化到模型之外，通过“意图-执行图”把交付物与其生成步骤绑定，以在长程、跨领域项目中保持与任务书对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态资源被转化为媒体产物时，智能体需在长程任务中保持与设计意图一致。设计师依据任务书（目标、约束、交付物）工作，后续工作依赖先前决策。现有工作虽能跨任务复用经验，但同一项目内各产物之间的一致性仍具挑战，智能体需跨领域并在项目规模扩大时保持并应用设计意图。

Method: 1）Design Anything框架：图结构的外部化“外骨骼”，将设计意图保存在模型之外，通过意图-执行图把交付物绑定到产生它们的工作流步骤；2）任务契约记录约束与决策；3）选定设计成为后续生成的显式输入；4）确定性控制器利用绑定与执行记录检查输出类型与数量、识别未完成交付物并引导后续轮次；5）构建DesignAnything-Bench，含19个设计领域的228个任务，其中38个项目族，规模为6/14/24件产物。

Result: 在LLM固定条件下，Design Anything分别以DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High和GPT-5.6 Sol High满足任务书事实性约束的85.0%与92.5%，比同模型最强基线高15.4%与14.4%；在24件产物任务上增益达25.1%与23.0%；每种模型下在19个领域中有18个领域的约束满足率领先或持平；盲评中专业设计师更偏好其完整的交付物集合。

Conclusion: 将设计意图显式外化并用图结构绑定执行过程，是提升长程多产物设计一致性的有效途径，且增益随项目规模增大而扩大。

Abstract: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. Agents therefore need to preserve and apply this intent across domains and as projects grow. We introduce Design Anything, a graph-based harness that preserves design intent outside the model and binds deliverables to the workflow steps that produce them through an intent-execution graph. A task contract retains constraints and decisions, selected designs become explicit inputs to later generations, and a deterministic controller uses bindings and execution records to check output types and counts, identify outstanding deliverables, and guide subsequent turns. We also introduce DesignAnything-Bench, with 228 tasks across 19 design domains, including 38 project families at scales of 6, 14, and 24 artifacts. With the LLM held fixed, Design Anything satisfies 85.0% and 92.5% of the brief's factual constraints with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High and GPT-5.6 Sol High, respectively, exceeding the strongest same-model baselines by 15.4% and 14.4%. These gains reach 25.1% and 23.0% on 24-artifact tasks. Under each model, Design Anything leads or ties in constraint satisfaction in 18 of 19 domains. Professional designers also prefer its complete deliverable sets over those of same-model baselines in a blind evaluation.

</details>


### [92] [Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24738)
*Wen Xue,Yong Liu,Xueheng Li,Si Wu,Yong Xu,Yipeng Sun,Yan Li,Simiu Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LayerEditor 是一个统一的指令引导图像编辑框架，通过 In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling 在单一 token 序列中联合表示编辑画布与有序 RGBA 图层，并借助 Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation 保留预训练模型的编辑先验，实现高保真编辑与可复用图层生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量图像编辑需精准修改目标区域并保留无关区域，但现有编辑模型输出扁平化结果，难以进行精确的局部操作与图层复用；而分解方法通常将图层恢复与指令驱动编辑分开优化，两者割裂。

Method: 提出 LayerEditor 统一框架：(1) In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling 将编辑画布与有序 RGB-Alpha 图层序列共同编码进单一 token 序列，实现语义编辑与图层级内容显式控制；(2) Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation 将预训练模型的编辑先验迁移至编辑画布及由预测图层合成的图像，以在适配分层输出时保持编辑能力；(3) 构建 LayerEditor-100K 大规模配对图像编辑数据集（带有序 RGBA 图层标注）及分层编辑专用基准。

Result: 大量实验表明，LayerEditor 在保持较强编辑保真度的同时生成准确的 RGBA 图层，并支持灵活的图层级操作与多图层分解。

Conclusion: 将指令引导编辑与可控可复用 RGBA 图层生成统一于单一 token 建模范式，可有效弥合编辑与分解的割裂，为分层图像编辑提供数据、方法与评测的完整支撑。

Abstract: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. At its core, In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling jointly represents the edited canvas and an ordered sequence of RGB-Alpha layers within a single token sequence, enabling semantic edits and explicit control over individual layer content. To retain the pretrained model's editing capability during adaptation to layered outputs, we propose Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation, which transfers its editing prior to both the edited canvas and the image composed from the predicted layers. To support training and evaluation, we construct LayerEditor-100K, a large-scale paired image-editing dataset with ordered RGBA layer annotations, and introduce dedicated benchmarks for layered editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayerEditor maintains strong editing fidelity while generating accurate RGBA layers, supporting both flexible layer-level manipulation and multi-layer decomposition.

</details>


### [93] [Geometry-Aware Interpolation for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24687)
*Pourya Shamsolmoali,Masoumeh Zareapoor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何感知插值网络GAIN，将流形几何引入空间变换与图像重建，以提升不完整图像的补全与分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从不完整或退化图像中恢复缺失视觉信息仍具挑战，尤其当存在空间变化和复杂结构时。STN虽能做空间特征对齐，但依赖线性/双线性插值，难以刻画数据的几何特性；且仅基于有限邻域像素的插值会引入梯度传播不一致，影响优化稳定性。

Method: GAIN是基于变分自编码器的框架。它不再仅由固定空间邻居估计像素强度，而是利用数据流形的局部切空间结构构建几何信息驱动的强度近似；引入基于熵的正则化来引导空间变换参数估计，使插值更具自适应性；并提出卷积归一化策略，约束非零激活幅值以改善训练中的梯度稳定性。

Result: 在具有挑战性的图像补全与分类基准上，GAIN相比现有方法提升了预测精度，同时降低了计算开销。

Conclusion: 将流形几何融入空间变换与重建，可有效克服传统插值在几何刻画与梯度稳定性上的局限，为不完整图像处理提供高效方案。

Abstract: Recovering missing visual information from incomplete or degraded images remains a challenging problem, particularly when spatial variations and complex image structures affect reconstruction accuracy. Although Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) facilitate spatial feature alignment, their reliance on conventional linear or bilinear interpolation limits their ability to capture the underlying geometric characteristics of image data. Furthermore, interpolation based on a restricted set of neighbouring pixels can introduce inconsistencies in gradient propagation, potentially affecting optimisation stability. To address these limitations, we propose a Geometry-Aware Interpolation Network (GAIN), a variational autoencoder-based framework that incorporates manifold geometry into spatial transformation and image reconstruction. Rather than estimating pixel intensities solely from fixed spatial neighbours, GAIN exploits the local tangent structure of the data manifold to construct geometry-informed intensity approximations. An entropy-based regularisation mechanism further guides the estimation of spatial transformation parameters, promoting more adaptive interpolation. In addition, a convolutional normalisation strategy is introduced to regulate the magnitude of non-zero activations and improve gradient stability during training. Extensive experiments on challenging image completion and classification benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of GAIN in improving predictive accuracy while reducing computational cost compared with existing methods.

</details>


### [94] [Knowledge Diversion: A Novel Paradigm for Pre-training Decomposable Image Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24664)
*Yucheng Xie,Fu Feng,Ruixiao Shi,Jing Wang,Xin Geng,Yong Rui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: KDiv 提出条件感知的预训练范式，将随机初始化的权重分解为 rank-one Knowledge Units（learngenes + tailors），通过连续条件感知路由分离可迁移先验与条件特异知识，实现生成模型的选择性重组与高效下游适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规预训练目标只优化源域性能，未显式考虑下游需求，导致可迁移知识与任务特异知识纠缠在共享参数空间中，无法选择性复用知识、下游适配效率低。这一问题在需适配多条件、多域的图像生成模型中尤为突出。

Method: KDiv：预训练前将随机初始化权重分解为 rank-one Knowledge Units，并组织为 learngenes（跨条件共享知识）与 tailors（条件相关变化）；预训练中使用连续条件感知路由（continuous condition-aware routing），把共享知识固化为 learngenes、把条件依赖变化导向 tailors，从而得到可分解、可选择性重组的生成模型。

Result: 在 class-conditioned、text-conditioned、image-conditioned 三类生成任务上，KDiv 在相当预训练成本下匹配或超越 dense 基线；在可比 low-rank adaptation（LoRA 类）的可训练参数预算下取得最强的平均下游性能。

Conclusion: 将预训练权重显式分解为可路由的 rank-one 知识单元，可使生成模型在预训练阶段即形成可迁移与条件特异的分离结构，兼顾预训练效率与下游适配的参数经济性，为条件化生成模型的知识复用提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large-scale pre-trained models have become foundational to modern machine learning, yet conventional pre-training objectives primarily optimize source-domain performance without explicitly considering downstream requirements. Consequently, transferable and task-specific knowledge remains entangled within a shared parameter space, limiting selective knowledge reuse and efficient downstream adaptation. This limitation is particularly consequential for image-generation models, which must accommodate diverse conditions and domains. To address this challenge, we introduce Knowledge Diversion (KDiv), a condition-aware pre-training paradigm for learning inherently decomposable generative models. Before pre-training, KDiv factorizes randomly initialized weights into rank-one Knowledge Units, which are organized into learngenes and tailors. During pre-training, continuous condition-aware routing consolidates knowledge shared across conditions in learngenes while directing condition-dependent variations to tailors. This structured organization enables learngenes to capture transferable generative priors and tailors to develop condition-specific expertise, allowing the resulting model to be selectively recombined for diverse downstream conditions. Extensive experiments across class-, text-, and image-conditioned generation demonstrate that KDiv consistently matches or surpasses dense baselines at comparable pre-training cost and achieves the strongest average downstream performance with a trainable parameter budget comparable to low-rank adaptation methods.

</details>


### [95] [MoCKEFA: Model-Conditioned Keyframe Extraction and Fair Attribution for Video Model Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25075)
*Lahiru Wijayasingha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以模型预测为条件提取少量关键帧来表示视频，并用博弈论上公平的Shapley值在关键帧间分配重要性，实现可解释的视频模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频模型的可解释性需求：传统逐帧归因（frame attribution）冗余度高、难以反映模型对视频的整体判断，作者希望用极少关键帧在不改变模型信念的前提下刻画视频，并将模型对视频的重要性公平地分配给这些关键帧。

Method: 首个以模型预测为条件（prediction-conditioned）提取关键帧的方法；随后采用Shapley值（博弈论公平分配）把视频对模型的重要性在关键帧之间予以分配，得到关键帧归因；并通过对相邻关键帧差异的分析，初步探索突出帧间重要变化。

Result: 定性定量实验表明关键帧归因优于传统帧归因；相邻关键帧差异可用于突出关键变化。

Conclusion: 少量关键帧即可保持模型对视频的信念，基于Shapley值的关键帧归因是构建可解释视频模型的有效途径，并为帧间变化解释提供了初步方向。

Abstract: We show that a video can be represented with just a few keyframes without sacrificing a given model's belief about the video. Our method is the first of its kind that extracts these keyframes conditioned on the model's prediction, which is massively helpful for building explainable video models. We then fairly distribute the importance of the video to the model among the keyframes with game theoretically fair Shapley values. Through qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that keyframe attribution is superior to the traditional frame attribution. Further, we conduct preliminary exploration on highlighting the important changes among the frames by looking at the differences between adjacent keyframes.

</details>


### [96] [FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25011)
*Hyebin Kim,Hwasik Jeong,Joonhyuk Park,Gyeongjin Kang,Jungwoo Kim,Younghyun Kim,Eunbyung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FineSplat是一个基于细粒度图像patch的前馈3DGS框架，通过双重分组策略与重建误差反馈，在同等或更少高斯预算下显著提升几何与外观细节并达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3DGS虽能实现即时重建与新视角合成，但在细粒度几何与外观恢复上仍然困难，因此需要重新审视前馈模型在细节视觉信息上的表示、聚合与精炼方式。

Method: 以细粒度图像patch为核心构建前馈3DGS框架；针对高token分辨率下全局多视图注意力代价过高的问题，提出双重分组策略：view-wise分组实现相邻视图间高效交互，3D空间分组将token提升至3D场景空间以重连几何相关但视图分组下无法交互的token；将重建误差作为直接反馈，提供显式渲染信号以恢复细粒度结构；采用紧凑高斯生成方案，避免图元数量膨胀。

Result: 在同等或更小的高斯预算下，相比现有方法取得大幅领先的SOTA结果，同时恢复更丰富的几何与外观细节，并保持高效与紧凑。

Conclusion: 结合细粒度patch表示、双重局部性分组、渲染误差反馈与紧凑高斯生成，可有效突破单次前馈预测的细节瓶颈，实现高效且高质量的即时3DGS重建。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.

</details>


### [97] [Beyond Geometric Closure: Measuring and Diagnosing Mechanical Consistency in Visual Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24619)
*Qibin Gu,Yunfeng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一套诊断视觉动力学"力学一致性"的框架，以刚性闭链的SI审计分离几何可行性、无反应执行器出力与功能量平衡三类指标，并用参考回放量化测量误差；实验表明现有模型视觉预测改进明显，但均未达到有效几何及力/能量要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉保真度（如MSE、像素精度）无法判断预测运动是否服从动力学规律，需要独立于视觉指标的力学一致性度量与诊断手段，以区分"看起来对"与"物理上对"。

Method: 构建视觉动力学机械一致性度量与诊断框架：对刚性闭链进行独立SI审计，分解为几何可行性、无反应执行器出力（reaction-free actuator effort）、功能量平衡（work–energy balance）；采用连续评分对照固定工程目标衡量进展，用参考回放量化测量误差。评估对象包括：KeyCLD与CON在343个平面装配、64/256像素、每设置3个随机种子；V-JEPA + AC与LingBot-VA在100个共享空间测试装配上。干预手段含RK4训练与CAD/IK重建。

Result: CON相对persistence降低图像MSE 37.6%/37.2%，但两个平面模型均未获得有效原生几何；256像素下校准RGB回放的预测误差远高于测量误差。精确状态输入下KeyCLD保持几何，RK4训练将评分由52.65提升至64.30。两条空间通路上CAD/IK重建可恢复几何，但平均执行器残差仍超工程目标五倍以上。

Conclusion: 该干预式诊断能将视觉预测精度增益、几何可行性改善同残余的力与能量误差明确分离，说明视觉指标提升不等于动力学一致，为视觉动力学模型的物理合规性评估提供了可量化的基准。

Abstract: Visual accuracy leaves open whether predicted motion obeys dynamics. We introduce a framework for measuring and diagnosing mechanical consistency in visual dynamics. An independent SI audit of rigid closed chains separates geometric admissibility, reaction-free actuator effort, and work--energy balance. Continuous scoring measures progress against fixed engineering targets, while reference replay quantifies measurement error. With three seeds per setting, we evaluate KeyCLD and CON across 343 planar assemblies at 64/256 pixels and V-JEPA + AC and LingBot-VA on 100 shared spatial test assemblies. CON reduces image MSE by 37.6%/37.2% relative to persistence, yet neither planar model attains valid native geometry. At 256 pixels, calibrated RGB replay places forecast errors far above measurement error. With exact states, KeyCLD preserves geometry and RK4 training raises its score from 52.65 to 64.30. In both spatial pathways, CAD/IK reconstruction restores geometry while mean actuator residuals exceed five times the engineering targets. The interventions distinguish gains in visual prediction and geometric admissibility from remaining force and energy errors.

</details>


### [98] [Cross-polarization pairing for label-free few-shot thin-section classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24546)
*Bingchen Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨偏振配对（XPP）自监督预任务，利用同一视场的PPL/XPL图像构造正确且外观差异大的正样本，实现无标注的岩石薄片少样本识别，并指出旧图像级协议已饱和，提出跨切片协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岩石薄片少样本分类依赖岩相学家逐张鉴定，成本高；新采集的数据集往往缺乏已识别标签。论文研究在没有已识别训练切片时的未见岩石类型少样本识别，仅利用显微采集固有信息（切片来源、PPL/XPL偏振方式）。同时指出通用无监督伪任务在此场景下失效：无标签找到的正样本或错误，或与锚点近似重复，学习信号弱。

Method: 将每张切片视为伪类别，配对同一视场位置的PPL与XPL视图（跨偏振配对，XPP）；由于两种偏振下颗粒相同故正样本构造上正确，但颜色外观差异显著，迫使模型依据颗粒形状与纹理而非颜色进行匹配。在南京大学108类岩石数据集上，支持集与查询集取自不同切片，进行三随机划分评估，并设置颜色增强及其他采集式正样本的对照实验。

Result: 在三随机划分平均上，XPP是表现最好的无标签方法，并可匹敌在78个已识别岩石类型上训练的有监督模型；对照实验表明颜色增强与其他采集式正样本无法复现该增益。此外发现先前工作的图像级协议已饱和。

Conclusion: 偏振光的物理成像特性可提供"正确但外观差异大"的天然正样本对，是无标注岩石薄片少样本识别的有效自监督信号；应弃用饱和的图像级协议，改用跨切片协议以更真实地评估泛化。

Abstract: Few-shot classifiers of rock thin sections are meta-trained on many rock types that a petrographer has identified slide by slide, and this identification is the costly step that new collections lack. We study few-shot recognition of unseen rock types when no training slide is identified, and the only information available is what the microscope records anyway: which slide an image comes from, and whether it was taken in plane-polarized (PPL) or cross-polarized (XPL) light. We first show why generic unsupervised pseudo-tasks fit this setting poorly: the positives they find without labels are either wrong or near-duplicates of the anchor, so they teach the model little. Polarized-light microscopy provides positives that avoid both problems. The PPL and XPL views of one field show the same grains, so they are correct by construction, yet they look very different. We propose cross-polarization pairing (XPP), which treats each slide as a pseudo-class and pairs its PPL and XPL views of the same field location, so that matching must rely on grain shape and texture rather than on colour. On the Nanjing University collection of 108 rock types, with support and query images taken from different slides, XPP is the best label-free method on average over three random splits, and matches a supervised model trained on 78 identified rock types. Controls show that colour augmentation and other acquisition positives do not reproduce the gain. We also show that the image-level protocol of earlier work is saturated, and propose a cross-slide protocol in its place.

</details>


### [99] [OrTeN: Neural Inverse Graphics for Joint Terrain and Line-scan Camera Trajectory Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24075)
*Josef Biberstein,Sertac Karaman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OrTeN：基于神经逆向渲染，从线扫描卫星影像联合优化纹理高度图与轨道相机校正，无需结构先验即可重建行星DTM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从卫星影像生成DTM的多视图立体方法流程复杂，需处理相机误差、光照变化与弱视差问题。

Method: 用神经逆向渲染联合优化纹理高度图与相机校正；直接处理以辐射因子I/F表示像素值的标定线扫描影像；同时校正轨迹位姿不一致与高频指向抖动；以表面投影patch NCC约束多观测一致性并精化粗重建；用半经验反射率模型与阴影渲染拟合多日期光照下的表面外观；仅需标定影像与初始位姿，不用任何结构先验。

Result: 在四个行星数据集上评估，对齐地形RMSE分别为Jezero 2.35 m、Gale 2.82 m、Olympus Mons 16.18 m、McGetchin 0.43 m。

Conclusion: OrTeN可在无深度/粗DTM先验条件下，从标定线扫描影像稳健重建高精度行星DTM。

Abstract: Digital terrain maps (DTMs) are used for landing site selection, terrain-relative navigation, and geological analysis in planetary exploration. Existing state-of-practice reconstruction techniques for creating DTMs from satellite imagery use multi-view stereo, requiring complex pipelines for dealing with camera error, changing illumination, and images with limited disparity. This work introduces Orbital Terrain Networks (OrTeN), a DTM construction method that uses neural inverse rendering to jointly optimize a textured height map and orbital camera corrections from line-scan satellite images. OrTeN operates directly on calibrated line-scan images with pixel values expressed as radiance factor (I/F) and corrects both broad trajectory pose inconsistencies and high-frequency pointing jitter jointly with surface reconstruction during training. Surface-projected patch normalized cross-correlation (NCC) enforces consistency between observations of the same terrain, refining an initial rough reconstruction. A semi-empirical reflectance model and shadow rendering are used to fit surface appearance from multi-date imagery with differing solar illumination. OrTeN requires only calibrated line-scan images and initial camera poses and does not use any structural priors including ranging/depth measurements or initial rough DTMs. OrTeN is evaluated on four planetary imagery datasets. Aligned terrain RMSEs are 2.35 m at Jezero Crater, 2.82 m at Gale Crater, 16.18 m at Olympus Mons, and 0.43 m at McGetchin Crater.

</details>


### [100] [Single-Pass Decision Scores Enable Rapid Classification with Adjustable Thresholds in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23988)
*Patrick Wienholt,Frederik Hauke,Christiane Kuhl,Jakob Nikolas Kather,Sven Nebelung,Daniel Truhn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对MLLM的yes/no token概率做归一化得到连续分数，可在不重训的情况下按需调整临床决策阈值，在6个医学影像数据集上多数优于原始概率与文本诱导概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型回答二分类临床问题时仅输出yes/no token，决策阈值隐含且固定，无法适配不同临床需求。

Method: 单次前向传播中，将yes与no两个token的概率重新归一化以获得连续风险分数，使阈值可事后调整而无需重训练；以MedGemma与Gemma-3（4B/27B）在六个医学影像数据集上评估，并与原始概率、文本诱导概率对比AUROC。

Result: 默认阈值常与任务失配：MedGemma-27B识别正常胸片时将所有图像判为异常，而经验证集选择的阈值达到敏感度0.945、特异度0.696。归一化在6个数据集中4个取得最高AUROC（CheXpert 0.819，原始为0.777，文本诱导为0.743），单次决策在单GPU上耗时53–79 ms。

Conclusion: 该简单的后处理方法将医学MLLM转化为具备可调操作点的快速分类器，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer binary clinical questions with a yes or no token, leaving the decision threshold implicit and fixed. We derive a continuous score from a single forward pass by renormalizing the probabilities of the yes and no tokens, allowing the threshold to be adapted to clinical needs without retraining. We evaluated this approach with MedGemma and Gemma-3 (4B and 27B) on six medical imaging datasets. The default threshold was frequently misaligned with the task: for identifying normal chest radiographs, MedGemma-27B labeled every image as abnormal, whereas a validation-selected threshold yielded a sensitivity of 0.945 and a specificity of 0.696. Normalization achieved the highest AUROC on four of six datasets (CheXpert: 0.819 vs. 0.777 for raw and 0.743 for text-elicited probabilities), and a single decision required 53-79 ms on one GPU. This simple post-hoc method turns medical MLLMs into fast classifiers with adjustable operating points. Code: https://github.com/TruhnLab/llm-threshold-calibration

</details>


### [101] [Learning When to Trust and Reobserve Sparse-Frame VideoQA from Temporal Sampling Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23969)
*Shujia Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 稀疏帧视频语言模型（VLM）的答案会随采样时间戳偏移而改变。论文提出将"答案风险"与"动作价值"分开估计，PhaseGuard+ 在冻结VLM上探测受控时间偏移，分别预测相位投票答案的可靠性和特定补救动作的逐例正确性增益，仅将预期受益的样本路由到更密集帧或更强VLM。在Physics测试集上，可靠度AUROC从68.0%升至74.8%，30%路由到Qwen3-VL-32B达67.87%准确率（较预算匹配随机路由+4.21pp）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏帧视频语言模型对采样时间戳敏感，时间戳稍变答案即变；原始一致性（raw agreement）虽能暴露该问题，但未必比token置信度更好地排序错误，也无法指示哪种额外观测能修复答案。因此需要分别建模"答案是否不可靠"与"某个动作能否修复它"。

Method: PhaseGuard+：在受控时间偏移下探测冻结的VLM，训练两个轻量预测器（基于公开数据）：(1) 预测相位投票（phase-vote）答案的可靠性；(2) 预测逐例（example-wise）执行特定救援动作的正确性增益。第二个分数用于把关，仅将预期从更密集帧或更强VLM中受益的样本路由出去。VLM全程冻结。用256个Perception Test视频做方法开发，在互不重叠的256视频测试集（554道Physics题）上评估。

Result: 以Qwen3-VL-8B为例，可靠性AUROC由token softmax的68.0%提升至74.8%（+6.8pp，95% CI [2.6, 10.7]）。将30%问题路由至Qwen3-VL-32B，准确率达67.87%，而预算匹配的随机路由为63.66%（+4.21pp，CI [1.89, 6.40]）。四组救援配对均显著优于随机路由。

Conclusion: 当系统同时学习"答案是否不可靠"和"可用动作是否可能修复该答案"时，时间敏感性才能转化为可操作的决策；分离建模风险与动作价值是有效且必要的。

Abstract: Sparse-frame video-language models can change their answers when only the sampling timestamps shift. Raw agreement exposes this problem, but it need not rank errors better than token confidence or identify which additional observation will repair an answer. We argue that answer risk and action value must be estimated separately. PhaseGuard+ probes a frozen VLM at controlled temporal offsets, predicts the reliability of the phase-vote answer, and predicts the example-wise correctness gain of a specific rescue action. The second score routes only examples expected to benefit from denser frames or a stronger VLM. Both predictors use lightweight models trained on public data; the VLMs remain frozen. We use 256 Perception Test videos for method development and evaluate on a disjoint 256-video test set comprising 554 Physics questions. For Qwen3-VL-8B, reliability AUROC rises from 68.0% with token softmax to 74.8% (+6.8 pp, 95% CI [2.6, 10.7] pp). Routing 30% of questions to Qwen3-VL-32B reaches 67.87% accuracy, compared with 63.66% for budget-matched random routing (+4.21 percentage points, CI [1.89, 6.40]). All four tested rescue pairs significantly outperform random routing. Temporal sensitivity becomes actionable when the system learns both whether an answer is unreliable and whether an available action is likely to fix it.

</details>


### [102] [VERDICT: Visual Extraction-Result Decoder with Integrated Confidence and Traceable Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23933)
*Harikrishnan P M,Goutham Vignesh,Siva Prasad,Zishan Ahmad,Mahesh Basveshwar Deshmukhe,Varun V,Rohit Agrawal,Vishal Vaddina*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VERDICT：即插即用框架，用小型VLM为结构化字段抽取结果定位证据并校准字段值与证据的置信度，微调定位VLM显著扩展选择性预测可用区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抽取系统准确率持续提升，但两项关键能力落后：一是每个抽取值的文档来源位置（证据定位），二是对字段值及证据的可信度估计；二者在多数抽取系统中缺失。

Method: 提出VERDICT，作为附加于固定外部抽取器、不修改其内部的插件框架：每份文档由小型VLM在抽取器输出基础上做一次证据定位，再对字段值与证据置信度进行校准。用开源权重VLM（而非闭源API）使校准器可用其内部隐状态；并对VLM做证据定位微调。另通过少量目标域标注字段研究分布偏移下的重校准。

Result: 微调VLM显著提升视觉证据质量，并扩展选择性预测工作区间：在0.80严格置信阈值下，微调版在ID与OOD数据集上均给出可用的精确率-覆盖率权衡，冻结版常退化至几乎无覆盖。内部状态优于输出对数概率：ID下AUROC对值置信从0.730升至0.914，对证据置信从0.681升至0.906；该优势在分布偏移后不保持，但信号是位移而非消失，用约120个目标域字段标注即可将证据置信AUROC从0.641提至0.905（一个数据集）与从0.675提至0.829（另一数据集）。

Conclusion: 证据定位与双重置信度校准可作为独立插件层叠加到现有抽取器上；采用开源VLM的内部状态作校准信号收益显著，但需少量目标域标注以在分布偏移下恢复性能。

Abstract: Enterprises run schema-guided structured field extraction on documents with frontier multimodal models, and accuracy keeps improving as new models and systems arrive. Two things have not kept pace: the evidence for each extracted value, meaning the location of the document it was read from, and how far to trust the value and that evidence. Neither is a component of most extraction systems today, so we build them as a framework that attaches to an existing extractor and leaves it untouched. We present VERDICT, a plug-in framework that uses a small Vision--Language Model (VLM) to ground/localize the evidence once per document over a fixed external extractor's output, then calibrates value and evidence confidence. Fine-tuning the VLM for evidence localization substantially improves visual evidence quality and, more importantly, expands VERDICT's selective-prediction operating range. At a strict confidence threshold $0.80$, VERDICT with the fine-tuned VLM gives usable precision--coverage trade-offs for both value and evidence confidence across the in-distribution and out of distribution datasets, whereas the frozen setting often collapses to little or no coverage. Running an open-weight VLM for localization rather than a closed API makes its internal states available to the calibrator, and they are worth more than output log-probabilities: in-distribution AUROC rises from $0.730$ to $0.914$ for value confidence and from $0.681$ to $0.906$ for evidence confidence. This advantage does not survive a distribution shift. We show that the signal is displaced rather than destroyed, and that labeling roughly $120$ fields from the target dataset takes evidence confidence from $0.641$ to $0.905$ on one dataset and from $0.675$ to $0.829$ on the other.

</details>


### [103] [STLQ: Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23931)
*Kuizhi Liu,Junying Zhang,Xindi Ma,Xiangyu Wang,Qi Jiang,Sheng Gao,Chen Gong,Jianfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出拓扑浅层多码本量化方法STLQ，将每个IVF簇组织为带紧凑码与缩放系数的有向森林，通过链接编码利用局部重建信息对残差重编码，在可比比特预算下取得更高召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浅层多码本量化（MCQ）在每个倒排文件（IVF）簇内独立编码向量，未利用簇内局部参考信息，因而表示精度受限。

Method: STLQ将每个IVF簇组织为有向森林，节点携带紧凑码与缩放系数。编码分两阶段：基础编码阶段独立量化向量；链接编码阶段以选定的重建父节点为参考，对相对残差重编码，复用局部重建信息得到更精细表示。对应设计链接式ADC，保持线性扫描复杂度；并对缩放系数与有向森林结构进一步压缩以控制拓扑开销。

Result: 大量实验表明，在可比比特预算下STLQ的召回率高于所评估的浅层MCQ方法，但离线构建成本更高；与深层MCQ相比具有有竞争力的召回率-QPS权衡。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 利用簇内拓扑关联与局部重建信息可有效提升浅层MCQ的编码精度，并保持高效检索复杂度，是ANNS中一种有前景的折中方案。

Abstract: Vector quantization is widely used for large-scale data compression and approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). Multi-codebook quantization (MCQ) is a practical paradigm that represents database vectors with compact codes and supports efficient retrieval through asymmetric distance computation (ADC). However, existing shallow MCQs encode vectors independently within each inverted file (IVF) cluster, without exploiting local references. Therefore, we propose Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization (STLQ), a topological shallow MCQ method that organizes each IVF cluster as a directed-forest with compact codes and scaling coefficients. Its basic encoding phase first quantizes vectors independently, while the linked encoding phase re-encodes relative residuals with respect to selected reconstructed parents, reusing local reconstruction information to obtain finer representations. The corresponding linked-ADC preserves linear scanning complexity. STLQ further compresses the scaling coefficients and directed-forest structure to control the additional topology overhead. Extensive experiments show that STLQ achieves higher recall than the evaluated shallow MCQs at comparable bit budgets, although at a higher offline construction cost. Meanwhile, it has a competitive recall-QPS tradeoff against deep MCQs. The code is available at https://github.com/ighxiy/STLQ.

</details>


### [104] [Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23929)
*Hoyeon Shin,Jeongyeon Kim,Yeong Jun Koh,Yeoneung Kim,Hanul Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以非平衡最优传输(UOT)统一建模视觉文档检索中视觉token压缩的重要性、冗余性与覆盖度，实现高效高精度的多向量检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM类VDR模型采用OCR-free多向量表示，需生成大量token以保留密集视觉细节，严重制约检索可扩展性；现有压缩方法依赖孤立启发式规则，无法平衡token重要性、语义冗余与覆盖能力。

Method: 将视觉token压缩形式化为非平衡最优传输问题，把重要性、冗余性与覆盖度三目标统一到单一交替优化过程中求解；并从理论上证明最小化传输代价可上界MaxSim检索误差，保证排序稳定性。

Result: 在ViDoRe V1与V3基准上大量实验表明，方法保留细粒度文档语义，在效率-效果权衡上优于SOTA基线。

Conclusion: UOT框架为VDR视觉token压缩提供统一且具理论保障的方案，兼顾检索性能与可扩展性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models(VLMs)have advanced Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) by enabling OCR-free, multi-vector representations. However, these models generate excessive tokens to preserve dense visual details, which severely limits retrieval scalability. Existing compression methods mitigate this overhead but rely on isolated heuristics that fail to balance token importance, semantic redundancy, and coverage capacity. We propose a visual token compression framework formulated as an Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) problem. Our approach unifies these three objectives into a single alternating optimization process. Furthermore, we theoretically show that minimizing the transport cost upper-bounds the MaxSim retrieval error, ensuring ranking stability. Extensive experiments on the ViDoRe V1 and V3 benchmarks demonstrate that our method preserves fine-grained document semantics and improves the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off over state-of-the-art base-lines. Code is available at https://github.com/shhhhhyy/Unbalanced-Optimal-Transport-for-EVDR.

</details>


### [105] [Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23915)
*Arthur Aubret,Jochen Triesch,Céline Teulière*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文假设常见自监督学习（SSL）前置任务隐式建模了物体共现统计，并验证了SSL表示中的分层语义编码：骨干网络编码类别，投影头编码类别间共现，且控制共现模式可加速类别级表示的形成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSL在语义视觉表示学习上表现优异，但其成功背后的内在原理尚不清楚，作者希望探究驱动SSL效果的核心机制。

Method: 提出假设：常见SSL前置任务隐式建模物体共现统计；利用先进分割模型从现有视觉基准中构建三个分割物体数据集；在多种SSL模型上开展实验，分析骨干与投影头的表示差异，并通过在预训练中控制共现模式进行干预验证。

Result: 发现分层语义编码：视觉骨干捕捉物体类别，投影头专门编码类别间共现关系；投影头在与人类判断的类别间相似度对齐上优于骨干；控制共现模式可显著加速类别级表示的出现。

Conclusion: 揭示了SSL中此前被隐藏的学习原理，即共现统计的重要性，并指出通过显式利用物体共现结构来设计更有效前置任务的方向。

Abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has achieved impressive success in learning semantic visual representations, yet the underlying principles driving this success remain underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that common SSL pretext tasks implicitly model object co-occurrence statistics, a fundamental cue for visual learning. To test this, we curate three datasets of segmented objects from existing vision benchmarks using a state-of-the-art segmentation model. Through experiments across many SSL models, we reveal a hierarchical encoding of semantic information: while the visual backbone captures object categories, the projection head specializes in encoding co-occurrences between object categories. As a result, the projection head outperforms the backbone in aligning with human judgments of inter-category similarity. Furthermore, by controlling co-occurrence patterns during pre-training, we demonstrate that encoding object co-occurrences can significantly accelerate the emergence of category-level representations. Our findings uncover a previously hidden learning principle in SSL and suggest a path toward designing more effective pretext tasks by explicitly leveraging object co-occurrence structure.

</details>


### [106] [LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23904)
*Liwei Che,Benlin Liu,Dai Li,Xiangyan Li,Zijian Wu,Changjiang Li,Minghao Guo,Chengzhi Mao,Vladimir Pavlovic,Ranjay Krishna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LVMH自动化多智能体框架，将长视频记忆策略开发转化为围绕固定回答模型的多目标代码搜索，并据此发现"文本优先、视觉其次"的SEEM记忆策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频智能体需将数小时乃至数天的多模态证据压缩进有限上下文，同时满足token与延迟预算，因此记忆设计本质是上下文管理问题；现有系统多依赖手工设计策略，缺乏对性能与效率联合优化的系统性方法。

Method: LVMH框架：将记忆策略开发形式化为围绕固定回答模型的多目标代码搜索；实现与独立评审分离，并强制执行受保护的观测边界，以防自我认证与开发集过拟合；持久化元记忆记录历史提案、轨迹、成本与失败，指导后续策略迭代。由此搜索得到SEEM策略：文本优先、视觉其次，基于紧凑结构化事件记忆与证据专家作答，仅在选择性视觉门控下调用局部帧。

Result: 在EgoLifeQA上演化出的SEEM可泛化至未见基准；在GPT-5 mini下于Ego-R1 Bench与Video-MME (L)上优于Meta-Harness。三个基准上SEEM配合GPT-5取得65.7%平均准确率，较此前SOTA提升7.7个百分点，同时平均评估token消耗约降低32倍、平均响应时间约缩短91倍。

Conclusion: 将记忆策略开发视为可自动搜索的上下文管理问题可行；文本优先、选择性视觉调用的记忆范式在长视频问答中可同时实现更高准确率与显著更优的token与延迟效率，且搜索所得的策略具备跨基准泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-video agents must map hours or days of multimodal evidence into a bounded context while respecting token and latency budgets, making memory design a context-management challenge. Existing memory systems largely rely on hand-designed policies, leaving open how to jointly optimize memory design for performance and efficiency. We propose Long Video Meta-memory Harness (LVMH), an automated multi-agent framework that formulates memory-policy development as multi-objective code search around a fixed answer model. To guard against self-certification and development-set overfitting, LVMH separates implementation from independent review and enforces protected observation boundaries. Persistent meta-memory records past proposals, traces, costs, and failures to guide subsequent policy revisions. Through this harness, we discover Self-Evolving Evidence Memory (SEEM), a "text-first, vision-second" policy that answers from compact structured event memory and evidence specialists, consulting localized frames through a selective visual gate. The policy evolved on EgoLifeQA generalizes to unseen benchmarks, outperforming Meta-Harness on both Ego-R1 Bench and Video-MME (L) with GPT-5 mini. Across the three benchmarks, SEEM with GPT-5 achieves 65.7% average accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 7.7 percentage points with approximately 32x lower average evaluation token use and 91x shorter average response time.

</details>


### [107] [Path-Conditioned Attention Mobility: From Depth to Execution Hubs in SegFormer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23893)
*Aleksandr Druzhinin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究分层视觉Transformer中注意力头的深度可迁移性，并据此将保留的注意力从深度维度重组为宽度维度，实现无损质量的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer压缩通常将"保留的注意力容量"与"该容量执行的串行深度数"耦合在一起，作者希望解耦二者，探究任务相关的注意力函数能否在深度上局部迁移，从而挖掘执行深度层面的冗余。

Method: 以SegFormer-B5做人像分割；先验证单个注意力头的跨深度重定位需保持其计算上下文（联合适配头与表示边界、保留供体特有的归一化与空间降采样预处理）。再基于这种"路径条件可迁移性"，将固定父模型Stage-3的120个保留头（分布在40个注意力执行深度）合并到20个执行中枢（K20）；部署时提出FOLDED_VEC，在向量化执行的同时保留供体专属路径。

Result: 在与布局匹配的三种子恢复对照下，K20达0.960686±0.000059 mIoU，State120对照为0.960400±0.000074，配对差值+0.000285，但配对图像自助法置信区间含零，故判定为无可测质量损失而非统计显著优。相对同一State120父模型，FOLDED_VEC在batch size 1/4/8下于NVIDIA L4的端到端延迟分别降低5.28%、3.15%、3.58%。

Conclusion: 注意力冗余不仅包含可移除容量，还包含执行深度冗余；只要保留定义被迁移函数的计算路径，即可在不损失质量的前提下将深度压缩换取宽度并行，获得实际部署加速。

Abstract: Transformer compression often couples two distinct quantities: retained attention capacity and the number of sequential depths at which that capacity is executed. We study whether useful attention functions in a hierarchical vision transformer are locally mobile across depth. Using SegFormer-B5 for human segmentation, we find that some task-relevant attention heads can be relocated to nearby depths, but only when their computational context is respected. Head-only relocation is insufficient, while joint adaptation of the relocated head and surrounding representation boundary improves functional preservation; replacing donor-specific normalization and spatial-reduction preprocessing causes large degradation. We use this path-conditioned mobility to reorganize retained attention from depth into width. Starting from a fixed parent with 120 retained Stage-3 heads across 40 attention execution depths, we consolidate the same 120-head budget into 20 execution hubs. Under a layout-matched three-seed recovery control, K20 reaches 0.960686 +/- 0.000059 mIoU versus 0.960400 +/- 0.000074 for the corresponding State120 control. The paired point difference is +0.000285, while a paired image-bootstrap confidence interval includes zero; we therefore interpret the result as no measurable quality penalty rather than statistical superiority. For deployment, FOLDED_VEC preserves donor-specific paths while vectorizing their execution. Relative to the same 120-head State120 parent, it reduces end-to-end NVIDIA L4 latency by 5.28%, 3.15%, and 3.58% at batch sizes 1, 4, and 8. These results suggest that attention redundancy includes not only removable capacity but also execution-depth redundancy, provided that the computational path defining a relocated function is preserved.

</details>


### [108] [Ghost Attack: Using 19th-Century Illusions to Fool 21st-Century Biometrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24238)
*Tyler Fitzsimmons,Adam Czajka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"Ghost Attack"：利用19世纪Pepper's Ghost光学幻觉，以低成本自由空间硬件和透明介质将高分辨率人脸数据投射到物理3D空间，构成一种物理人脸攻击，可同时攻破现代人脸识别系统的匹配器、呈现攻击检测（PAD）与变形攻击检测（MAD）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物识别系统未考虑透明投影类攻击，且物理攻击向量不断演化；作者发现被遗忘的经典光学幻觉能暴露现代人脸识别的安全盲区，故将其武器化以揭示当前系统的防御缺口。

Method: 将Pepper's Ghost幻觉改造为物理攻击：使用低成本、自由空间的硬件装置与透明介质，把高分辨率人脸数据投射到物理3D空间中对目标系统实施攻击；并在100个身份的采集数据（含/不含ghost投影）上评估其对SOTA人脸匹配器、呈现攻击检测和变形攻击检测的影响。

Result: 该攻击在无需触发呈现攻击或变形防御的情况下，对SOTA算法取得较高的冒名成功（impersonation）率，同时突破FRS的三类组件：人脸匹配器、PAD模块与MAD模块。

Conclusion: 研究表明当前生物识别系统存在显著盲点，无法应对透明投影及不断演化的物理攻击向量；作者发布100个身份的重采集数据集作为表征该新型攻击的基准，以支持后续研究。

Abstract: While the Pepper's Ghost illusion is a 19th-century optical technique, we found that this forgotten gimmick exposes vulnerabilities in modern face recognition systems. This paper introduces the 'Ghost Attack': a physical attack that repurposes this classic illusion using low-cost, free-space hardware and a transparent medium to project high-resolution facial data into physical 3D space. We show in the paper that despite relying on centuries-old optical principles, this new attack type simultaneously breaks three components of modern facial recognition systems (FRS): (a) the face matcher, (b) the presentation attack detection module, and (c) the morphing attack detection component, resulting in high impersonation success rates against state-of-the-art algorithms without triggering presentation or morphing defenses. These findings reveal a significant blind spot in current biometric systems, which fail to account for transparent projections and evolving physical attack vectors. To support further research, we are offering the dataset of face images of 100 identities, re-captured with and without 'ghost' projections as a new benchmark representing a novel attack for face recognition.

</details>


### [109] [SERO: Semantic Prediction for Single-Step Object Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24173)
*Amreen Hasheem Siraj,Alireza Javanmardi,Pragati Jaiswal,Didier Stricker,Alain Pagani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SERO：通过预测隐藏区域的语义先验（嵌入空间）引导潜在桥匹配生成器，实现单步前向的物体移除与语义修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式物体移除虽能生成高分辨率清晰图像，但存在两点不足：(1) 生成内容常仅视觉逼真，难以与周边场景布局和物体关系保持语义一致、上下文合理；(2) 迭代去噪计算开销大，限制下游应用。

Method: 提出SERO语义预测框架：在嵌入空间预测被移除区域的语义先验，为潜在桥匹配（latent bridge-matching）生成器同时提供"编辑位置"与"可能存在的结构"，从而在单次前向中完成上下文连贯的补全。

Result: 在RORD与OBER数据集上取得有竞争力或SOTA的性能，且仅需单步生成。

Conclusion: 以语义先验引导的单步生成可在保证视觉真实性的同时提升上下文一致性，并显著降低推理开销，为高效物体移除提供可行路径。

Abstract: Object removal and semantic inpainting of missing regions remain inherently ill-posed, as multiple plausible completions may exist for a given scene. Recent diffusion-based methods have demonstrated strong potential for high-quality object removal; however, they still face two key limitations. First, although they can synthesise sharp and high-resolution images, they often struggle to complete removed regions in a semantically consistent and contextually meaningful manner, where the generated content should agree with the surrounding scene layout and object relationships rather than merely appear visually realistic. Second, their iterative denoising process makes them computationally expensive, limiting their practicality for downstream applications. We propose SERO, a semantic prediction framework for single-step object removal. Our model predicts a hidden-region semantic prior in embedding space, which guides a latent bridge-matching generator toward plausible scene completion by providing both where to edit and what structure is likely to exist behind the removed object. This enables visually realistic and contextually coherent completions in one forward pass. Experiments on the RORD and OBER datasets show that SERO achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance while requiring only a single generation step.

</details>


### [110] [NV-Generate-Body: 3D Latent Diffusion Model forControllable Anatomy, Tumor, and Demographic Body Mask Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24153)
*Can Zhao,Pengfei Guo,Dong Yang,Yufan He,Yucheng Tang,Ahmed Harouni,Benjamin Simon,Mason Belue,Stephanie Harmon,Baris Turkbey,Daguang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NV-Generate-BodyMask：一个在冻结掩码自编码器潜空间中运行的3D潜扩散模型，可通过19维条件向量联合控制器官解剖、肿瘤负荷与人口学属性，生成256³全身CT分割标签图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模带标注CT数据集的构建成本高，且受患者隐私限制，难以直接共享与扩展；因此需要可合成、可控且保护隐私的替代性标注数据来源。

Method: 在冻结的掩码自编码器压缩潜空间中建模，以19维向量为条件，通过自适应组归一化（AdaGN）与交叉注意力生成256³体素标签图；引入带空间晕环加权的尺寸自适应ROI损失，以及配对肿瘤注入流程，以在肿瘤标注稀缺条件下实现准确的肿瘤尺寸条件控制。训练数据为26个队列、132类标签、8,571个掩码。

Result: 器官尺寸条件控制 Spearman ρ=0.70–0.92；肺、胰腺、结肠与骨病灶的肿瘤召回率85–100%；人口学对齐良好（BMI ρ=0.78，性别条件下的前列腺控制完美）。

Conclusion: 该模型能够以细粒度联合控制生成逼真的全身CT分割掩码，为隐私受限场景下的数据扩充与合成标注提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Curating large labeled CT datasets is expensive and constrained by patient privacy. We present NV-Generate-BodyMask, a 3D latent diffusion model that synthesizes whole-body CT segmentation masks with precise, joint control over organ anatomy, tumor burden, and patient demographics. The model operates in the compressed latent space of a frozen mask autoencoder, generating $256^3$ volumetric label maps conditioned on a 19-dimensional vector via Adaptive Group Normalization and cross-attention. A size-adaptive ROI loss with spatial halo weighting and a paired tumor injection pipeline enable accurate tumor size conditioning despite the scarcity of annotated tumor cases. Trained on 8,571 masks across 26 cohorts spanning 132 labels, the model achieves Spearman $ρ= 0.70$--$0.92$ for organ size, 85--100\% tumor recall for lung, pancreatic, colon, and bone lesions, and strong demographic alignment (BMI $ρ= 0.78$, sex-conditioned perfect prostate control).

</details>


### [111] [Generative Text Modelling and Language-Guided Visual Attention for Deciphering Palimpsests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24060)
*Robin Hollifeldt,Tianru Zhang,Jessica Ström,Ekta Vats*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出生成模型驱动的重写本(羊皮纸底层文字)自动恢复与识别框架，包括定制去噪扩散模型重建底层文字、微调注意力式手写识别网络，以及利用CLIP式视觉注意力图的任务描述语言引导识别；并发布合成重写本数据集、文本描述与预训练模型代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重写本中被擦除后覆盖的底层文字(under-text)对保存失传信息至关重要，但手工恢复困难且耗时，故需自动化建模方法。

Method: 1) 研究GAN与扩散模型等生成模型，设计定制去噪扩散模型学习结构化噪声模式以重建底层文字；2) 用微调的注意力式手写文本识别网络处理恢复结果；3) 探索语言引导识别框架，以词语/句子形式的任务特定类别描述为先验，通过预训练视觉-语言模型(CLIP)生成的视觉注意力图进行文字描述接地，帮助识别模型区分有意义特征与噪声；4) 发布稀缺的合成重写本数据集、CLIP兼容文本描述、预训练模型及代码。

Result: 构建了从生成式底层文字恢复到识别的完整流水线，并通过语言引导框架将文本先验与视觉注意力对齐以提升抗噪识别；同时提供了合成重写本数据集与基准。

Conclusion: 生成模型结合语言引导的识别框架为自动化重写本底层文字恢复提供了可行途径，配套数据与模型将促进该方向的后续研究与基准评测。

Abstract: Recovering obscured text in palimpsests, i.e. the manuscripts where the original writing (under-text) was erased and overwritten for reuse, is vital for preserving lost information. Due to the nature of the material, such a task can be highly challenging and time-consuming. This paper presents an approach towards automated palimpsest handwritten text modeling for under-text recovery. We investigate generative models, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models, and design a custom denoising diffusion model that learns structured noise patterns to reconstruct the under-text. The recovered text is subsequently processed by a fine-tuned, attention-based handwritten text recognition network. Furthermore, we investigate a language-guided recognition framework that leverages textual class descriptions as informative priors, enabling the text recognition model to distinguish meaningful features from noise. This is achieved by grounding task-specific descriptions, phrased in words or sentences, through visual attention maps generated by pretrained vision-language models like CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training). To facilitate future research and benchmarking, we release new datasets for synthetic palimpsests (currently scarce), CLIP-compatible text descriptions, and pre-trained models with code.

</details>


### [112] [Spectral-Aware Proposal Enhancement for Diffusion-Based Multispectral UAV Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24642)
*Xu Lin,Tingfa Xu,Tianhao Li,Haolin Qin,Huawei Gao,Jichuan Xing,Jianan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DSATrack：面向多光谱无人机MOT的扩散引导光谱感知跟踪框架，通过光谱编码器注入RPN生成高质量提案并利用光谱显著性调制置信度，在MMOT上较DiffusionTrack提升4.6 HOTA、9.0 MOTA、7.7 IDF1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱无人机有向框MOT面临小目标、背景杂乱、帧间关联不稳的困难；现有扩散式MOT在提案初始化与置信度校准上缺乏对多光谱线索的专门设计，导致复杂场景鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出DSATrack：(1) 轻量光谱编码器通过特征融合将多光谱信息注入RPN分支，使RPN头生成高质量目标感知提案，并将其并入初始提案集为扩散细化提供空间先验；(2) 光谱显著性置信调制策略在分数阈值化前依据局部多光谱显著性对比重新校准跟踪置信度，增强光谱可靠候选、抑制不可靠候选；不修改原有扩散细化头。

Result: 在MMOT基准上，相较适配后的DiffusionTrack基线，HOTA提升4.6、MOTA提升9.0、IDF1提升7.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 将多光谱线索显式引入扩散式MOT的提案初始化与候选选择环节，可同时提升提案质量与细化后候选筛选效果，验证了该框架对多光谱无人机MOT的有效性，且保持对原有扩散头的即插即用兼容。

Abstract: Multispectral UAV multi-object tracking (MOT) with oriented bounding boxes remains challenging due to small targets, cluttered backgrounds, and unstable inter-frame associations. Although diffusion-based MOT provides an effective iterative proposal refinement paradigm, existing diffusion-based trackers lack dedicated designs for exploiting multispectral cues in proposal initialization and confidence calibration, limiting tracking robustness in complex UAV scenarios. This letter proposes DSATrack, a diffusion-guided spectral-aware tracking framework for multispectral UAV MOT. Specifically, a lightweight spectral encoder injects multispectral information into the RPN branch through feature fusion, enabling the RPN head to generate high-quality object-aware proposals. These proposals are then injected into the initial proposal set to provide reliable spatial priors for diffusion refinement. Furthermore, a spectral-saliency confidence modulation strategy recalibrates refined tracking confidence according to local multispectral saliency contrast before score thresholding, enhancing spectrally reliable candidates while suppressing unreliable ones. Without modifying the original diffusion refinement head, DSATrack improves both proposal quality and post-refinement candidate selection. Experiments on the MMOT benchmark demonstrate that DSATrack outperforms the adapted DiffusionTrack baseline by 4.6 HOTA, 9.0 MOTA, and 7.7 IDF1 points, showing its effectiveness for multispectral UAV MOT.

</details>


### [113] [Write Once, Query Many: Evolving Compact Reusable Memory for Long Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24537)
*Kerui Chen,Jinglu Wang,Yun Wang,Xinjiang Wang,Yan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可演化的视频记忆框架 Video-EMem，以时间锚定的感知观测（文本+稀疏图像）作为可复用记忆，模型冻结下分别演化 Writer 与 Reader 工作流，在存储降低约99.86%的同时提升长视频QA准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频超出多模态大模型（MLLM）上下文容量，而 agentic search 对每个查询都要重复昂贵的视频处理与定位；可复用记忆能摊销成本，但必须在构建时保留对未知问题有用的信息，不能依赖固定语义schema。

Method: 1) 记忆表示：时间锚定的感知观测，融合紧凑自由文本与稀疏图像，跨时间尺度保留语义与互补视觉细节，支持无固定schema的时间导航；2) Writer 仅一次编码视频，整合多尺度重叠观测；Reader 仅从该记忆检索并组织证据；3) 底层模型冻结，用不同反馈分别演化两者工作流与算子——Writer 用与查询无关的源保真度与覆盖率，Reader 用证据定位与利用上的QA失败。

Result: 演化策略较未演化框架平均准确率提升7.2%；相较原始视频平均减少约99.86%存储；相比直接输入2048帧，在三项长视频QA基准上使 Qwen3-VL-30B 平均提升2.6%；与SOTA agentic方法使用相同 o3 答案模型时，平均准确率提升2.5%且单查询延迟更低。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持 Writer/Reader 反馈分离有助于泛化到开发查询之外；可复用、可演化的时间锚定记忆在显著压缩存储的同时优于直接帧输入与代价更高的 agentic 检索范式。

Abstract: Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.

</details>


### [114] [MOMO: Human Motion from Moving Sounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24522)
*Deli Cai,Shuyang Xu,Zhiyang Dou,Zitong Lan,Mingmin Zhao,Changxing Ding,Taku Komura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出并定义了"动态空间音频驱动的人体运动生成"新任务，构建了DySAM和DySAL两个数据集，并提出扩散框架MOMO，从双耳音频直接估计移动声源空间方向并结合语义特征生成人体运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频驱动运动生成方法主要针对非空间或静态声学条件，忽略了声源与听者之间随时间演变的空间关系；而空间音频及其时间动态对人体的反应行为至关重要，该问题尚属空白。

Method: 1) 形式化新任务：动态空间音频驱动人体运动生成；2) 构建DySAM数据集（同步双耳音频、3D人体运动、移动声源轨迹）及辅助数据集DySAL（双耳定位数据，配对声学事件、头部姿态与移动声源轨迹）；3) 提出MOMO扩散框架，遵循定位—理解—生成三原则：从原始双耳音频估计头心坐标系下移动声源的空间方向线索（不依赖真值坐标），提取逐帧音频内容表征，并将语义特征与动态空间线索共同作为扩散模型条件。

Result: 实验表明MOMO在运动保真度、音频—运动对齐以及物理合理性三方面均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 论文开辟了动态空间音频驱动的运动生成方向，通过数据集与基准填补空白，并证明融合动态空间线索的扩散生成框架的有效性，为人机交互、角色动画和行为分析提供支撑。

Abstract: Human responses to sound depend not only on its semantic content, but also on the evolving spatial relationship between source and listener, conveyed through spatial audio and its temporal dynamics. Modeling human reactions to such dynamic spatial audio is important for character animation, human behavior analysis, and robotics. As of yet, existing audio-driven motion generation methods primarily focus on non-spatial or static acoustic conditions, leaving this important problem largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we formulate the novel task of dynamic spatial-audio-driven human motion generation and introduce two motion-captured datasets. We introduce the Dynamic Spatial Audio and Motion dataset (DySAM) as the first dataset and benchmark for this task, providing synchronized binaural audio, 3D human motions, and moving sound source trajectories. Given the importance of dynamic spatial cues of sound sources, we further provide the Dynamic Spatial Audio Localization dataset (DySAL), an auxiliary binaural localization dataset that pairs diverse acoustic events with head poses and moving source trajectories to support spatial audio perception. For benchmarking, we propose MOMO for human Motion generation from Moving Sounds, a diffusion-based framework guided by three coupled principles: localization, understanding, and generation. MOMO performs localization by estimating head-centric spatial direction cues of the moving source directly from raw binaural audio, avoiding reliance on ground-truth source coordinates. It performs understanding by extracting frame-wise audio-content representations, and performs generation by conditioning motion diffusion on both semantic features and dynamic spatial cues. Experiments show that MOMO outperforms existing baselines in motion fidelity, audio-motion alignment, and physical plausibility.

</details>
