### [115] [Investigating Length Bias and Robustness in LVLMs for Multiple-Choice Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24500)
*Md. Atabuzzaman,Hani Alomari,Chris Thomas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)在多选题问答中的长度偏见：模型会系统地偏好更长选项，即使其与图像证据不一致；机制分析表明偏见源于后层对视觉证据的抑制与语言侧长度先验的竞争，现有推理时干预手段不足以实现可部署的缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLMs在多选题问答上表现强劲，但在存在偏见的条件下其可靠性仍缺乏研究；尤其"长度偏见"（对较长选项的系统性偏好）尚未被深入探究，而这一偏见可能严重损害模型在真实场景中的可信度。

Method: 构建覆盖细粒度视觉领域的受控基准来量化长度偏见；跨模型规模进行一致性检验；通过逐层机制分析定位偏见的来源；设计模糊图像实验削弱视觉证据、并用弃答（abstention）测试考察拒绝能力；提出并评估多种推理时缓解策略。

Result: LVLMs一致偏好更长选项，即使视觉上不一致：当正确答案较短时准确率下降2–38%，较长时提升1–70%；该偏见跨模型规模持续存在。机制上，偏见源于后层对视觉证据的抑制、转而依赖语言侧长度先验；图像模糊时偏见加剧，且模型难以拒绝错误预测。多种推理时缓解策略仅带来部分改善，均无法在不依赖推理时不可得的oracle信息的情况下实现可部署的缓解。

Conclusion: 推理时干预不足以解决长度偏见，需转向架构层面的改进与偏见感知的训练范式。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong performance on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), yet their reliability under biased conditions remains underexplored. We investigate length bias, the systematic preference for longer answer options, through controlled benchmarks spanning fine-grained visual domains. LVLMs consistently favor longer options even when visually inconsistent, with accuracy dropping 2--38\% when correct answers are shorter and increasing 1--70\% when longer. This bias persists across model scales. Through layer-wise mechanistic analysis, we reveal that length bias emerges from late-layer suppression of visual evidence in favor of language-side length priors. Blurry-image experiments show that bias intensifies when visual evidence weakens, while abstention tests reveal that LVLMs struggle to refuse incorrect predictions. We propose and evaluate multiple inference-time mitigation strategies; while these provide partial improvements, none achieves deployable bias mitigation without relying on oracle information unavailable at inference time. These results underscore that inference-time interventions are insufficient, pointing to the need for architectural solutions and bias-aware training.

</details>


### [116] [ProV-Mem: Proactive Memory for Streaming Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23998)
*Bingbing Wang,Jing Li,Han Gao,Yishi Lin,Ruifeng Xu,Peng He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的分层记忆框架ProV-Mem，将主动式流式视频问答的"何时说话、说什么、是否输出"三决策解耦为时间触发、指令、情节三级记忆，并引入成本感知指标CAUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式流式视频问答需持续监测视频流并自主决定何时应答、应答内容及是否输出。现有流式系统存在两难：保留长视觉历史成本高，而丢弃历史又会漏检事件并产生重复响应。

Method: ProV-Mem基于冻结VLM主干，免训练；将主动决策分解为三层轻量记忆：时间触发记忆控制何时查询主干并从长时间静默中恢复；指令记忆以固定提示先验引导简洁且视觉有据的生成；情节记忆通过过滤近重复响应决定是否输出。在理想化条件充分性假设下推导了阶段式近似界，将分解过程关联到全状态联合策略；并提出CAUC指标，在PAUC基础上对冗余、过于频繁及过长输出进行显式折扣。

Result: 在ProactiveVideoQA的四个场景上，ProV-Mem在所有场景取得最优CAUC，在WEB、EGO、TV上取得最优PAUC，同时保持较低的每响应推理延迟。

Conclusion: 以无训练的分层记忆解耦主动决策，可在不重训主干的条件下兼顾响应质量、输出成本与延迟，为流式视频问答提供有效的记忆管理范式。

Abstract: Proactive streaming video question answering requires a model to continuously monitor an incoming stream and autonomously decide when to speak, what to say, and whether to emit a response. Existing streaming systems face a fundamental difficulty: retaining long visual histories is costly, whereas discarding them can lead to missed events and repeated responses. We propose \textbf{ProV-Mem}, a training-free proactive memory framework built around a frozen VLM backbone. ProV-Mem decomposes the proactive decision into three lightweight memory tiers: a temporal-trigger memory controls when to query the backbone and recovers from prolonged silence, an instructional memory guides what to say through a fixed prompting prior for concise and visually grounded generation, and an episodic memory determines whether to emit by filtering near-duplicate responses. Under an idealized conditional-sufficiency assumption, we derive a stagewise approximation bound relating the decomposed process to a full-state joint policy. We further introduce Cost-Aware Area Under the Curve (\textbf{CAUC}), which extends PAUC by explicitly discounting redundant, overly frequent, and unnecessarily long emissions. Experiments on the four scenarios of ProactiveVideoQA show that ProV-Mem achieves the best CAUC across all scenarios and the best PAUC on WEB, EGO, and TV, while maintaining low per-response inference latency.

</details>


### [117] [Automatic Cause Determination in Road Scene Understanding Using Qualitative Reasoning and Four-Valued Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23990)
*Nassim Belmecheri,Arnaud Gotlieb,Nadjib Lazaar,Helge Spieker*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出结合时空推理与Belnap四值逻辑，在定性可解释图（QXG）上计算自动驾驶动作的复杂成因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶道路场景理解需识别关键参与者并解释自车动作（停车、减速、左转等）的成因；城市环境成因多元、相互混淆甚至矛盾，简单推理难以表达，而准确的自动成因判定可提升乘客/道路使用者可接受性与道路安全性。

Method: 以定性可解释图（QXG）表示道路场景中道路实体的时空关系，基于时空推理与Belnap四值逻辑形式化并计算指定帧中某自动驾驶动作的复杂成因。

Result: 在NuScenes数据集提取的多个场景上演示了该方法（文中称\tool）判定复杂成因的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于QXG与四值逻辑的时空推理能够为自动驾驶动作提供复杂、可解释的成因判定，适用于真实道路场景数据。

Abstract: Road scene understanding in automated driving (AD) aims to build a comprehensive analysis of video sequences taken on the road by embedded or fixed cameras (e.g., mounted on vertical road signals). One goal is to identify the relevant actors in the scene and another goal is to determine the causes that have triggered a specific action of the ego car (i.e., stop, slow down, turn left, etc.). In a complex urban environment, these causes can be multiple, confusing, possibly contradictory to other causes and not easily expressible using simplistic reasoning. Still, providing accurate {\it automatic cause determination} supports a) user acceptance by providing appropriate explanations to the car passengers and road users; b) increased road safety by providing detailed road scene understanding to traffic. In this paper, we propose using spatiotemporal reasoning and Belnap's four-valued logic to formulate complex causes of AD action in a road scene. We compute these causes by analysing a Qualitative eXplainable Graph (QXG), which is an abstract representation of the road scene capturing spatiotemporal relations between road entities. Starting from a QXG, our approach called \tool, is targeted to determine complex causes of a selected AD action occurring in a specific frame of a road scene. The usefulness of \tool is demonstrated on several scenes extracted from the well-known NuScene dataset.

</details>


### [118] [Pretrained Features as Teachers, Not States: Compact Latent World Models for Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23984)
*Yanbo Wang,Nan Lin,Wendelin Böhmer,Javier Alonso-Mora*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Anchor-WM 将预训练视觉特征（DINO）用作教师来指导紧凑潜状态的蒸馏学习，而非直接作为世界模型状态，从而在保持视觉信息的同时获得可快速规划的紧凑潜空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉世界模型的关键设计在于潜状态应保留何种信息。仅用潜预测目标训练的模型虽能适应动力学，但存在表征坍塌风险，且对保留的视觉信息无显式约束；直接基于冻结预训练视觉特征的模型虽继承强视觉先验，却把预测与规划绑定在冻结状态空间上，效率受限。

Method: 提出 Anchor-WM：以预训练 DINO 稠密表征作为教师，通过仅训练期使用的蒸馏头，将 DINO 表示蒸馏到紧凑潜状态中；该紧凑潜空间同时以动作条件动力学进行学习。推理阶段丢弃 DINO 编码器与蒸馏头，预测与规划完全在学到的紧凑潜空间中执行。

Result: 在四个评测环境中取得最佳平均成功率，且规划速度显著快于直接在 DINO patch 特征上运行的世界模型。

Conclusion: 预训练视觉特征可有效引导世界模型学习，而无需充当用于预测与规划的状态空间；该“教师—紧凑潜状态”范式兼顾视觉信息保留、抗坍塌与规划效率。

Abstract: A key design choice in visual world models is what information the latent state is encouraged to preserve. Models that learn a latent space with only a latent-prediction objective adapt to environment dynamics, but the predictive objective alone admits collapsed solutions and provides no explicit constraint on the visual information retained by the latent. Models built directly on pretrained visual features inherit a strong visual prior, but tie prediction and planning to a frozen state space. We propose Anchor-WM, which instead uses pretrained visual features as a teacher for learning a compact latent state rather than as the world-model state itself. Anchor-WM learns this compact latent with action-conditioned dynamics, while distilling the dense DINO representations through a training-only distillation head. This encourages the compact latent to retain visual information captured by the pretrained representation while discouraging representational collapse. At inference, the DINO encoder and distillation head are discarded, allowing prediction and planning to operate entirely in the learned latent space. Anchor-WM achieves the best average success rate across the four evaluated environments while enabling substantially faster planning than world models operating directly on DINO patch features. These results show that pretrained visual features can effectively guide world-model learning without defining the state space used for prediction and planning.

</details>


### [119] [SPELUNKA: A Framework for Finding Unanticipated Associations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23979)
*Cassandra Parent,Isha Agarwal,Kumail Alhamoud,Charikleia Moraitaki,Rafiya Javed,Walter Gerych,Marzyeh Ghassemi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SPELUNKA，一种推理时自动化框架，在无需预定义子群、无需人工监督、无需微调的情况下，发现视觉语言模型（VLM）检索任务中未预料的分布性偏差与虚假关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 是多模态系统的核心组件，但会从训练数据中继承虚假且有害的关联。已有工作多聚焦于去除已知偏差，而对检索任务中"未预料关联"的发现方法研究不足。

Method: 给定感兴趣概念，SPELUNKA 为相关图像生成描述、从描述中抽取相关实体、筛选语义上有意义的关联；随后基于频率的检测规则，通过比较这些属性在 VLM 高排名输出中的过/欠表示与全数据集分布，识别虚假关联。整个过程无需标注子群、推理时人工监督或模型微调。

Result: 在四个数据集上评估：1) 成功恢复合成与自然发生的虚假关联；2) 在识别与查询强关联图像上平均 AUROC 达 0.93；3) 在寻找与给定查询强关联的特征方面优于基线方法。

Conclusion: SPELUNKA 提供了一种实用、免训练的自动化手段来审计 VLM 检索中的未预料偏差，兼具发现合成与真实虚假关联的能力，且性能优于现有基线。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the backbone of many state-of-the-art multimodal systems, but often encode spurious and harmful associations from their training data. While prior work focuses on removing known biases from VLMs, methods for discovering unanticipated associations for retrieval tasks remain underexplored. We introduce SPELUNKA, an automated, inference-time framework for finding unanticipated distributional biases for retrieval tasks in VLMs without pre-specified labeled subgroups, inference-time human supervision, or model fine-tuning. Given a concept of interest, SPELUNKA generates captions for related images, extracts relevant entities from captions, and selects semantically meaningful associations. A frequency-based detection rule then identifies spurious associations by measuring over- or under-representation of these attributes in a VLM's top-ranked outputs relative to their full dataset distribution. We evaluate SPELUNKA across four datasets, and find that it 1) successfully recovers both synthetic and naturally occurring spurious correlations, 2) achieves an average AUROC of 0.93 across four datasets in identifying images strongly associated with a query, and 3) outperforms baselines in finding features that are strongly associated with a given query.

</details>


### [120] [FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23975)
*Haonan Hu,Shuhao Chen,Weisen Jiang,Lizhao Gao,James Kwok,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FrameScout，用流式选择器架构与帧-查询对比目标改进长视频关键帧选择，在三个长视频基准与六个基座 VideoLLM 上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频产生远超 VideoLLM 处理能力的视觉 token，需关键帧选择器；但现有选择器要么独立编码帧、缺乏时序上下文，要么以孤立分块处理并使用难优化的排序目标。

Method: 两项核心设计：(i) 流式选择器架构，借助滑动窗口 KV cache 与后继聚合（successor aggregation）生成具时序上下文的帧嵌入；(ii) 帧-查询对比目标，在共享空间对齐帧与查询嵌入，直接训练选择器区分相关与无关帧。

Result: 在三个长视频基准、六个基座 VideoLLM 上的大量实验表明 FrameScout 一致达到 SOTA。

Conclusion: 通过时序上下文建模与可直接优化的对比目标，FrameScout 有效提升长视频关键帧选择与问答性能，且具良好通用性。

Abstract: Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant ones. Extensive experiments on three long-video benchmarks and six base VideoLLMs demonstrate that FrameScout consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout.

</details>


### [121] [Super-resolution as Spatial Downscaling: Coherence, Structure and Task Utility in Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23972)
*Bright Wiredu Nuakoh,Ebenezer Afrifa-Yamoah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将单图超分辨视为空间降尺度问题，用像素指标、方向变差函数、谱段相关、协离差与观测相干性等多维标准，评估四个轻量网络（含0.36M参数模型）相对插值的表现，并结合土地利用/建筑变化等下游任务检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有卫星超分辨评估多依赖像素保真度与潜在下行链路节省，无法判定重建场是否保持空间结构或支撑可靠的下游分析。

Method: 在190个场景的735个卫星瓦片上，对比四个轻量网络与插值方法：采用像素指标（PSNR）、方向变差函数（各向异性）、谱带相关、协离差与观测相干性评估；在空间分块、配对设置下，用两个骨干网络与锐化对照开展土地利用分类与建筑变化检测任务测试；并比较全分辨率JPEG 2000传输与降分辨率传输加重建在相同码率下的效果。

Result: 网络间差异≤0.03dB，×2下比双三次插值高1.39–1.42dB；仅恢复约30%的Nyquist频率以上谱能量，×4下各向异性范围0.59（参考0.49，更各向同性）。能量型指标可能奖励虚构细节；施加相干性可达到量化极限，但剩余误差≥99.7%位于观测算子的零空间，相干性无法约束。相对双三次插值，土地利用精度变化−1.0至+3.1个百分点（24次比较中7次显著），建筑变化F1变化−0.015至+0.024（均不显著）；在未变化场景的两次观测间，学习重建将虚假变化放大约1.3–1.5倍（插值则衰减）。全分辨率JPEG 2000在各匹配码率下均不劣于降分辨率传输加重建。

Conclusion: 学习重建在仅有低分辨率影像时最有价值；其评估应结合像素指标、空间结构、观测相干性与空间验证下的任务级测试，而非仅凭像素保真度或能量指标。

Abstract: Learned satellite super-resolution is commonly assessed by pixel fidelity and potential downlink savings, but these criteria do not establish whether the reconstructed field preserves spatial structure or supports reliable downstream analysis. We treat single-image super-resolution as a spatial downscaling problem and evaluate four lightweight networks, including our compact 0.36 million-parameter model, against interpolation using pixel metrics, directional variograms, spectral band correlation, codispersion and observation coherence. On 735 satellite tiles from 190 scenes, the networks differ by at most 0.03dB and outperform bicubic interpolation by $1.39-1.42$dB at $\times 2$. They recover about 30% of the spectral power above the observation's Nyquist frequency and, at $\times 4$, produce more isotropic fields than the reference (range anisotropy 0.59 against 0.49). Energy-based metrics can favour invented detail. Enforcing coherence reaches the quantisation limit, yet at least 99.7% of the remaining error lies in the observation operator's null space, which coherence cannot constrain. Under spatially blocked, paired evaluation with two backbones and a sharpening control, learned reconstruction changes land-use accuracy by $-1.0$ to $+3.1$ percentage points (significant in 7 of 24 comparisons) and building-change F1 by $-0.015$ to $+0.024$ (none significant) relative to bicubic interpolation, and amplifies spurious change between two observations of an unchanged scene by $1.3-1.5$ times where interpolation attenuates it. Full-resolution JPEG\,2000 matches or exceeds reduced-resolution transmission with reconstruction at every matched bitrate. Learned reconstruction is most useful when only low-resolution imagery is available, and its evaluation should combine pixel metrics with spatial structure, observation coherence and task-level tests under spatial validation.

</details>


### [122] [Geo-vision: Native-Resolution Geometry and Sampled Topology for Vehicle-Part Damage Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23967)
*Usef Faghihi,Amir Saki,Serge Jonathan Kogbeti-Wongo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Geo-vision，用外观、多尺度几何、方向与数字拓扑的固定表示进行车辆部件损伤分类，在55,303张裁剪图上AP为0.7577，优于冻结的ImageNet预训练YOLO11n（0.7458），且无需外部编码器预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖预训练编码器（如ImageNet预训练YOLO）进行车辆部件损伤分类，本文希望以无需外部预训练的结构化固定表示替代，并明确其理论性质与标签效率。

Method: Geo-vision构建固定表示，融合外观、多尺度几何、方向与采样数字拓扑（连通分量、孔洞、欧拉特征、空间排布），配合幅值敏感池化与监督树分类器；并证明幅值保持、轴向符号不变性与条件算子稳定性。采用回顾性checkpoint评估，对比冻结YOLO11n，含结构块消融与标签预算实验。

Result: 55,303裁剪图/4,916源组上平均精度0.7577 vs YOLO11n 0.7458；拓扑+占据+分量位置结构块相较仅外观几何提升AP 0.00493；各匹配标签预算下AP点估计均更高；约少25%任务标签时AP点估计超过全量YOLO（调整区间含零）；CPU串行推理26.98 ms/图 vs 11.20 ms，峰值内存185 vs 437 MiB。

Conclusion: 无需预训练的拓扑-几何结构表示可在损伤分类上以更高精度、更低内存与更少标签超越预训练YOLO基线，但推理更慢、标签效率优势的置信区间含零，仍需独立外部验证。

Abstract: Geo-vision classifies vehicle-part damage using a fixed representation combining appearance, multiscale geometry, orientation, and sampled digital topology. Connected components, holes, Euler characteristics, and spatial arrangement complement amplitude-sensitive pooling and a supervised tree classifier. We establish amplitude preservation, axial sign invariance, and conditional operator stability. Retrospective checkpoint evaluation on 55,303 crops from 4,916 source groups yields average precision 0.7577, exceeding 0.7458 for an ImageNet-pretrained frozen YOLO11n comparator on identical crops. The complete added structural block, comprising topology, occupancy, and component location, improves average precision by 0.00493 beyond appearance and geometry. Geo-vision uses no external encoder pretraining and has higher AP point estimates at every matched label budget. With approximately 25% fewer task labels, its AP point estimate exceeds full-data YOLO, although the adjusted interval includes zero. Complete serial CPU inference requires 26.98 ms per crop versus YOLO's 11.20 ms, with peak memory 185 versus 437 MiB. Independent external validation remains necessary.

</details>


### [123] [Generalizable fetal brain biometry via adaptive artificial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23966)
*Yijin Li,Mingxuan Liu,Yi Liao,Le Chang,Hongjia Yang,Kasidit Anmahapong,Xiaotian Hu,Ziang Wang,Yingqi Hao,Haoxiang Li,Yifei Chen,Zihan Li,Ziyu Li,Juncheng Zhu,Min Kang,Yan Song,Hua Lai,Xiaoling Zhou,Dingzhi Yue,Xu Liu,Nan Sun,Rong Hu,Xuesheng Li,Fenglin Jia,Gang Ning,Haibo Qu,Qiyuan Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BioTTA是一个与骨干网络无关、无需源数据的无监督测试时自适应框架，可在推理阶段将预训练模型在线适配到单个无标注目标胎儿脑MRI体数据，跨序列、跨中心、跨国家场景下实现准确可靠的胎儿脑生物测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胎儿脑MRI的可靠生物测量对先天性脑异常诊断至关重要，但AI模型在域偏移（不同序列、中心、国家）下精度显著下降，且目标域标注难以获取、源数据常因隐私无法共享。

Method: 回顾性多队列研究，纳入394例20–39孕周重建3D胎儿脑MRI体数据，由放射科医师标注11项生物测量指标。BioTTA在单中心TSE MRI上开发，在代表跨序列、跨中心、跨国家偏移的三个数据集上评估；采用MAE及4 mm内正确测量百分比评价精度；构建基于网络的报告平台，将测量映射至规范生长轨迹，并在四个多中心疾病队列（含生发基质-脑室内出血、脑室扩大、小脑异常）中与放射科医师对比。

Result: 在三个目标数据集上，BioTTA均优于auto-SVRTK、仅源域模型和FetalSynthGen，并与使用目标标签微调的模型相当。卷积骨干MAE为1.10–1.46 mm，Transformer骨干为1.46–2.25 mm；诊断准确率82.1%–95.0%，与高年资放射科医师相当。

Conclusion: BioTTA支持在异构MRI来源下实现准确、可泛化的胎儿脑生物测量与标准化产前脑生长评估。

Abstract: Reliable fetal brain biometry on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosing congenital brain anomalies, but artificial intelligence models often lose accuracy under domain shifts. We developed BioTTA, a backbone-agnostic, source-free unsupervised test-time adaptation framework that adapts pretrained models online to individual unlabeled target volumes. This retrospective multicohort study included 394 reconstructed 3D fetal brain MRI volumes at 20-39 gestational weeks, with 11 biometric measurements annotated by radiologists. BioTTA was developed on single-center turbo spin-echo MRI and evaluated on three datasets representing cross-sequence, cross-center, and cross-nation shifts. Biometry accuracy was assessed using mean absolute error (MAE) and the percentage of correct measurements within 4 mm. A web-based reporting platform mapped measurements onto normative growth trajectories and was evaluated against radiologists in four multicenter disease cohorts covering germinal matrix-intraventricular hemorrhage, ventriculomegaly, and cerebellar abnormality. Across all three target datasets, BioTTA outperformed auto-SVRTK, source-only models, and FetalSynthGen, while matching models finetuned with target labels. MAEs ranged from 1.10 to 1.46 mm with a convolutional backbone and from 1.46 to 2.25 mm with a transformer backbone. Diagnostic accuracy ranged from 82.1% to 95.0%, comparable to a senior radiologist. BioTTA supports accurate, generalizable fetal brain biometry and standardized prenatal brain growth assessment across heterogeneous MRI sources.

</details>


### [124] [Trimodal Context-Aware Micro-Expression Recognition in Real-World Conversations: A Dataset and a Hierarchical Fusion Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23930)
*Junbo Wang,Yan Zhao,Shigang Wang,Jian Wei,Qiming Zhang,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出多模态微表情数据集TriCoME（视觉-音频-文本，来自真实对话，并配对同时话语与前文语境，按对话角色标注外部刺激/内部背景），以及分层聚焦融合网络HFFNet，通过细粒度对齐声学与语义流、压缩长对话、用语境类型嵌入调制角色注意力，并依视觉置信度在纯视觉与多模态决策间路由，以避免噪声语境损害识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实对话中的微表情短暂、微弱且解释高度依赖语境；现有方法多为"去语境化"，只分析孤立视频片段，忽略周围对话的语义与声学线索。心理学研究表明社会语境在"如何解释表情"和"表情被抑制/产生的强度"两个维度上起作用（如对方的挑衅性话语可引发被压抑的负性反应），而现有微表情研究很少建模这些因素。

Method: 构建TriCoME三模态数据集：视觉、音频、文本均取自真实对话，每个微表情配对同时话语与前置语境，并按对话角色将语境标注为"来自对话者的外部刺激"与"来自被试自身的内部背景"两类。提出HFFNet：细粒度对齐声学流与语义流、压缩长对话序列、经语境类型嵌入调制面向对话角色的注意力、并基于视觉置信度在纯视觉与多模态决策间进行样本级路由。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值；所述设计目标为：利用语境提升对微弱、被抑制微表情的识别，同时通过置信度路由机制防止噪声语境导致性能退化。

Conclusion: 将对话语境（尤其区分外部刺激与内部背景）显式引入微表情识别是必要且有价值的；TriCoME与HFFNet为语境化微表情分析提供了数据与模型基础，并以自适应路由兼顾多模态收益与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Recognizing micro-expressions in real-world conversations is challenging, as these facial movements are brief and faint, and their interpretations are strongly dependent on the contextual circumstances of their occurrence. Most existing methods are de-contextualized, as they analyze isolated video clips while disregarding the semantic and acoustic cues in the surrounding dialogue that help explain the emergence of an expression. Decades of psychological studies have shown that social context exerts influences on facial behavior over two key dimensions: how an expression is interpreted and how strongly it is generated to begin with. However, existing micro-expression research rarely incorporates such contextual factors into its models. As an example, provocative utterances from an interlocutor may elicit suppressed negative affective reactions, which isolated silent clips are unable to account for. We propose TriCoME, a trimodal dataset consisting of visual, audio and text data sourced from real-world conversations. In this dataset, each micro-expression is paired with its concurrent utterance and preceding context. We further annotate the context based on conversational role to denote two categories: external stimuli from an interlocutor's utterance and internal background from the subject's own utterance. On this basis, we propose the Hierarchical Focusing Fusion Network (HFFNet), which aligns acoustic and semantic streams at fine granularity, compresses long dialogue sequences, modulates attention toward conversational roles via a context-type embedding, and routes each sample between visual-only and multimodal decisions based on visual confidence to prevent noisy context from degrading recognition performance.

</details>


### [125] [Junction Geometry Survives an Unidentifiable Blur](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23912)
*Sohail,Sarkar,Shakuntala Baichoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对显微图像与X射线探测器中"交叉/分叉臂"的数量与方向估计问题，作者在存在未知中心高斯混合模糊（含不可辨识情形）下，证明了从格点单元概率到臂参数距离的定量稳定性界，并给出极小极大速率 $n^{-1/2}$；提出约束局部似然联合拟合臂与模糊，在360个交叉/分叉与Chandra谱上显著优于固定尺度Hessian脊检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交叉点和分支点在显微成像中对应细丝交汇、在X射线探测器中对应色散谱线交叠；模糊（PSF）未知时，臂的数量、方向、相对权重与支撑线难以辨识，尤其在"平衡交叉"处不同高斯模糊可给出相同观测分布（不可辨识）。现有脊/线检测器通常假设固定尺度与已知模糊，缺乏理论基础，因此需要给出可辨识性刻画与统计最优性保证。

Method: 1）模型：若干分离的射线（非零权重）+ 未知中心高斯混合模糊；2）建立组合距离（含臂数、方向、相对权重、支撑线），证明其在足够细的固定网格上被单元概率的欧氏差常数倍控制，界在有界模型类（含不可辨识模糊）上一致；3）由 $n$ 个位置或光子计数导出 $n^{-1/2}$ 极小极大误差，并构造全局估计量给出该速率；4）实践算法：对臂与模糊做约束局部似然拟合，以BIC选择臂数；5）评估采用预先固定的协议，在由实测单分子定位拼接的360个交叉/分叉上与调参的固定尺度Hessian脊检测器比较，并在Chandra谱数据上验证。

Result: 1）理论上给出距离—格点概率稳定性不等式，覆盖不可辨识模糊，并证明全局估计量达到 $n^{-1/2}$ 极小极大速率；2）显微数据：在25–400个定位点平均下，"臂数与全部方向均在 $10^\circ$ 内"的命中率比调参Hessian脊检测器高24–37个百分点；当两个探测器一致给出更少臂时，BIC计数下降；3）锐角且计数正确时，平均绝对方向误差 $3.5^\circ$–$4.3^\circ$，对照方法为 $10.4^\circ$–$15.5^\circ$；4）Chandra谱：800光子下90次拟合中38次四条臂均在 $10^\circ$ 内，其中中位误差 $0.023^\circ$。

Conclusion: 交叉/分支结构在未知（甚至不可辨识）高斯模糊下仍可被恢复：格点概率能够以一致方式控制臂的组合距离，且 $n^{-1/2}$ 速率可达。约束局部似然联合拟合与BIC计数在定位显微与光谱数据上同时提升臂数判定与方向精度，说明"臂+模糊"联合建模框架兼具理论保证与实用价值。

Abstract: Thin filaments cross in microscopy, and dispersed spectra cross on X-ray detectors. At a junction, where these structures cross or branch, how many straight arms meet, and which way do they go? Unknown blur obscures the answer. At a balanced crossing, distinct Gaussian blurs can even produce the same observation law. We show that the arms can still be recovered. For separated rays of nonvanishing weight and an unknown centered Gaussian-mixture blur, a distance combining arm count, directions, relative weights and supporting lines is bounded by a constant times the Euclidean difference in cell probabilities on a sufficiently fine fixed grid. The bound is uniform over a bounded model class, including unidentifiable blurs. From $n$ positions or photon counts, the minimax error is of order $n^{-1/2}$. This rate is proved for a global estimator. In practice we fit rays and blur by constrained local likelihood, reducing the BIC count when two detectors agree on fewer arms in the microscopy studies. Across three studies with protocols fixed before evaluation, on 360 crossings and branches assembled from measured single-molecule localizations, the fit gets the arm count and every direction within $10^\circ$ 24 to 37 percentage points more often than a tuned fixed-scale Hessian ridge detector, averaged over 25 to 400 localizations. On acute angles with correct counts, mean absolute error is $3.5^\circ$ to $4.3^\circ$, versus $10.4^\circ$ to $15.5^\circ$. On Chandra spectra, 38 of 90 fits at 800 photons find all four arms within $10^\circ$; among these, median error is $0.023^\circ$.

</details>


### [126] [Grounding Confusable Movie Moments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23910)
*Dong-Hee Kim,Seonwoo Choi,Changbeen Kim,Juyeon Ko,Youngju Choi,Il Hyeon Mun,Hyunwoo J. Kim,Donghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CoM²-Bench（易混淆查询对基准），揭示"检索"是长片时序定位的主要瓶颈，并提出免训练方法 Agentic Window Search (AWS)，将 mIoU 从 18.5 提升到 26.8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电影中人物、地点、动作高度重复，许多时刻仅在细粒度细节上不同；然而现有长片时序定位基准很少测试这一"分辨细节"能力，难以暴露模型是否真正依据区分性细节而非共有属性进行定位。

Method: 构建 CoM²-Bench：每对查询共享大部分属性，仅在单一区分细节上不同，覆盖完整影片。采用"先检索后定位"流水线以分离误差来源（检索 vs 定位）。提出 AWS：由 MLLM 智能体先将查询 Decompose 为属性级子查询，再 Inspect 各候选窗口，证据在窗口边缘被截断时 Expand 窗口；与现有检索器/定位器即插即用，无需额外训练。

Result: 检索被确认为主要瓶颈——SOTA 检索器常选中"易混淆对应时刻"，因其依据共享内容而非区分性细节决策；AWS 使 mIoU 由 18.5 提升至 26.8。

Conclusion: 细粒度区分能力是长片时序定位的关键短板，且问题主要源于检索阶段而非定位阶段；分阶段误差归因有助于精准诊断，而基于 MLLM 智能体分解—检查—扩展的免训练策略可有效缓解该瓶颈。

Abstract: Characters, locations, and actions recur throughout a movie, so many of its moments differ only in fine-grained details. Grounding such a moment in a full-length movie requires resolving that detail rather than matching the attributes it shares with other moments, yet existing temporal movie grounding benchmarks rarely test this. We introduce CoM$^2$-Bench, a benchmark of confusable query pairs, where the two queries in each pair share most attributes but differ in a single distinguishing detail within a full movie, posing a challenge for recent temporal grounding approaches. To locate where grounding breaks down, we analyze a retrieve-then-localize pipeline, in which a retriever first selects a short candidate chunk and a localizer then performs temporal grounding within it. Separating the two stages lets us attribute each failure to either retrieval or localization. We find that retrieval is the major bottleneck: state-of-the-art retrievers often select a moment's confusable counterpart, because their choices follow the content the two moments share rather than the detail that tells them apart. To address these failures, we propose a simple, training-free remedy, Agentic Window Search (AWS): an MLLM agent $\textit{Decomposes}$ the query into attribute-level sub-queries, then $\textit{Inspects}$ each candidate window against them and $\textit{Expands}$ the window when evidence is cut off at its edge. AWS works with existing retrievers and localizers without additional training, raising mIoU from 18.5 to 26.8.

</details>


### [127] [Beyond Generator-Specific Shortcuts: Open-World AI-Generated Video Detection via Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23906)
*Qi Zhou,Yuanfan Li,Huiqi Deng,Hongbin Pei,Yazhe Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FORGE：一种token级对抗训练框架，通过梯度引导的嵌入扰动混淆生成器特定线索，提升AI生成视频检测的跨生成器泛化能力，29个留出基准平均F1达92.62。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGV检测器在开放世界中面对未见生成器泛化差。作者分析跨生成器OOD失效模式，发现检测器表征强烈编码生成器特定线索，导致显著的ID-OOD性能下降；而简单扰动生成器敏感token甚至会降低OOD性能，说明生成器线索与检测相关证据仅部分可分。

Method: FORGE（Forensic Obfuscation of geneRator-specific cues via Gradient-guided Embedding perturbation）：token感知的对抗训练框架。识别与生成器特定捷径强相关、但对真伪判别较不关键的token，训练中对其选择性扰动，从而抑制生成器依赖模式并保留取证证据；通过攻击者与检测器之间的同步对抗训练，促使检测器学习可迁移的生成器不变取证表征。

Result: 在29个留出基准条目上，FORGE平均F1为92.62，较八个强基线高5.31个点；在四种常见后处理攻击下仍保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 选择性扰动生成器捷径token的同步对抗训练可有效提升开放世界AIGV检测的跨生成器泛化与鲁棒性；代码与数据集将于录用后开源。

Abstract: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection is increasingly important for mitigating misinformation, impersonation, and other malicious uses of synthetic media, yet existing detectors often generalize poorly to unseen generators in open-world settings. To better understand this challenge, we analyze the failure modes of AIGV detectors under cross-generator out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts and observe that detector representations strongly encode generator-specific cues, which are associated with substantial ID-OOD performance drops. Further analysis shows that naively perturbing generator-sensitive tokens can even reduce OOD performance, indicating that generator-related cues and detection-relevant evidence are only partially separable. Motivated by these findings, we propose Forensic Obfuscation of geneRator-specific cues via Gradient-guided Embedding perturbation (FORGE), a token-aware adversarial training framework for open-world AIGV detection. FORGE identifies tokens that are strongly associated with generator-specific shortcuts yet less critical to real/fake discrimination, and selectively perturbs them during training to suppress generator-dependent patterns while preserving useful forensic evidence. Through synchronized adversarial training between an attacker and a detector, FORGE encourages the detector to learn more transferable generator-invariant forensic representations. Experiments on 29 held-out benchmark entries show that FORGE achieves an average F1 of 92.62, outperforming eight strong baselines by 5.31 points, while also remaining robust under four common post-processing attacks. We will release our code and datasets upon acceptance.

</details>


### [128] [AI-Experiment: an augmented reality art project co-created with artificial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23903)
*Bernhard Egger,Hans Furer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 艺术家与计算机科学家协作，用微调后的潜在扩散模型生成特定艺术家风格的合成画作，艺术家择优以丙烯重绘于画布，并附加生成式视频驱动的增强现实组件；论文开放训练数据、生成代码与AR体验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索人类艺术家、计算机科学家与生成式AI工具三者协同创作的可能性，并推动艺术、研究与教育领域的可复现性与开放共享。

Method: 在特定艺术家作品照片上微调潜在扩散模型，生成同风格合成图像；从中筛选子集由原艺术家以丙烯在画布上重绘；采用一组生成式视频模型构建增强现实组件，使实体作品"活起来"。

Result: 产出一件融合实体绘画与AR交互的混合艺术品，并公开部分训练数据、生成代码及AR体验（GitHub仓库）。

Conclusion: 展示了"AI生成—人工筛选重绘—AR增强"的人机协同创作流程可行，并强调以开源方式促进艺术、研究与教育中的复用。

Abstract: We describe the creation of a physical artwork that was performed in synergy between an artist, a computer scientist and generative AI tools. A latent diffusion model was finetuned on photographs of the artwork of the specific artist and the generative model then generated synthetic artworks in a similar style. From the generated artworks a subset was selected to be painted again with acrylic on canvas by the original artist. In addition to the physical artifact an augmented reality component was added which brings the artwork to life with a set of generative video models. Together with this paper we release part of the artwork (training data), the code that was deployed to generate the artwork as well as the augmented reality experience for arts, research and education under https://github.com/BernhardEgger/ARTimate

</details>


### [129] [Hexagonal Basis Projectors for Model-Based Iterative CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24363)
*Ke Chen,Alireza Entezari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于盒样条演算的二维扇形束CT常数与线性六边形投影算子，推导解析射线足迹与探测器模糊表达式并实现GPU加速正/反投影，在仿真FORBILD与真实2DeteCT数据上验证六边形表示在定量CT中的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像表示同时影响模型迭代CT重建的前向模型与定量特征恢复；对等向带限信号，二维六边形晶格在相同采样密度下比笛卡尔网格具有更高采样效率、更强方向等向性与更大的无混叠带宽，因此需要可实用的六边形投影算子。

Method: 利用盒样条（box spline）演算构造二维扇形束CT的常数型与线性型六边形投影算子；两类基在共同系数中心上构成单位分解，线性帐篷函数可复现仿射函数；推导解析射线足迹与等效探测器模糊表达式，并实现高效的GPU正投影与反投影。

Result: 在仿真FORBILD数据上，线性模型优于笛卡尔与六边形像素模型，且在较粗分辨率下取得最佳含噪数据精度；真实2DeteCT对比以高剂量、高分辨率笛卡尔重建为伪真值，图像与特征一致性具竞争力。

Conclusion: 结果为定量CT建立了一种实用的六边形表示方法。

Abstract: Image representation affects both the forward model and quantitative feature recovery in model-based iterative CT reconstruction. For isotropically bandlimited signals, the hexagonal lattice is the most sampling-efficient lattice in two dimensions, with greater directional isotropy and a larger alias-free bandwidth than the Cartesian grid at equal density. We develop constant and linear hexagonal projectors for two-dimensional fan-beam CT using box spline calculus. Both bases form a partition of unity on common coefficient centers; the linear tent also reproduces affine functions. We derive analytic ray footprints and effective detector-blur expressions and implement efficient GPU forward and backprojection. On simulated FORBILD data, the linear model improves on Cartesian and hexagonal pixels, with its best noisy-data accuracy at the coarser resolution. Real-world 2DeteCT comparisons use high-dose, high-resolution Cartesian reconstructions as pseudo ground truth and show competitive image and feature agreement. These results establish a practical hexagonal representation for quantitative CT.

</details>


### [130] [Visual Sufficiency Landscapes: Understanding Query-Conditioned Reliability in Visual Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24968)
*Zhenghan Li,Kexin Sun,Wei Zheng,Peng Hu,Xiao Wei,Anbo Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"视觉充分性景观"（visual sufficiency landscapes），用于刻画在固定层与预算下、能够保持稠密模型行为不变的视觉子集数量占比，并证明该占比依赖输入与查询，且可作为剪枝失效预测指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同视觉token剪枝策略保留的子集不同却取得相近任务性能，说明存在大量可互换的"成功子集"。作者希望把这一现象量化：究竟有多少视觉子集能保持模型行为，且这种丰富度是否随查询变化，并将它与剪枝风险识别联系起来。

Method: 定义"视觉充分性概率"：在固定层与预算下，对均匀采样的子集计算同时保持稠密模型答案、参考答案似然与输出分布的比例。采用独立采样重复实验以分离输入变异与估计噪声。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL2-8B、LLaVA-v1.5-7B上于GQA与TextVQA评估景观，并将该概率作为特征加入FastV、VisionZip、SparseVLM的失效预测。

Result: 输入间差异超过重复误差，同一GQA图像的different问题产生不同景观。加入充分性概率后，LLaVA上FastV的AUC提升0.1151、VisionZip提升0.0683、SparseVLM提升0.1401，并降低log loss与Brier分数；另两个模型的架构适配配置复现了增益。原图训练的预测器在新图像上分别降低log loss 9.0%、13.0%、14.1%。

Conclusion: 成功子集的丰富度是可测量的局部可剪枝性维度，可作为剪枝高风险条件的识别信号，并具备跨图像与跨模型的泛化价值。

Abstract: Different visual token pruning strategies retain different subsets while maintaining similar task performance. This motivates a combinatorial question: how many visual subsets can preserve model behavior, and how does their abundance depend on the query? We introduce visual sufficiency landscapes to characterize this abundance. At a fixed layer and budget, visual sufficiency probability is the fraction of uniformly sampled subsets that jointly preserve the dense model's answer, reference-answer likelihood, and output distribution. Independent sampling replicates separate input variation from estimation noise. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5-7B, differences between inputs on GQA and TextVQA exceed replication error, and different questions about the same GQA image produce distinct landscapes. Sufficiency probability also improves failure prediction for full pruning methods. On LLaVA, adding this probability increases AUC by 0.1151 for FastV, 0.0683 for VisionZip, and 0.1401 for SparseVLM, while reducing log loss and Brier score. Several architecture-adapted configurations on the other two models reproduce these gains. Under controlled selection rules, predictors trained on the original images reduce log loss on new images by 9.0%, 13.0%, and 14.1%, respectively. These results establish successful-subset abundance as a measurable dimension of local prunability and connect it to the identification of high-risk pruning conditions.

</details>


### [131] [Meta Inverse Prompting for Video Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24965)
*Yerin Jung,Jongheon Jeong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个实用的高效视频逆提示框架MVIP，将逆提示建模为元学习问题，学习沿时间维度优化的元提示，从而免去测试时迭代优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型（文生视频、图生视频、参考引导合成）均为单向的条件到视频映射，缺乏从视频反推可控文本条件的能力；图像逆提示方法难以直接迁移到视频，因为需刻画超越静态外观的时间动态，且逐视频优化计算开销大。

Method: 将逆提示形式化为元学习问题，提出Meta Video Inverse Prompting（MVIP），学习一个在时间维度上优化的元提示（meta-prompt），把反演过程摊销（amortize），避免测试阶段的昂贵迭代优化。

Result: 相比基于图像的逆演方法与迭代式描述生成基线，MVIP恢复的逆提示质量更高、重建保真度显著提升，同时在效率上取得大幅增益。

Conclusion: MVIP为视频逆提示提供了首个实用高效框架，验证了元学习式摊销在视频条件反演中的有效性，可用于复杂媒体制作中的可控条件恢复。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled flexible conditional generation and editing pipelines, such as text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-guided synthesis. However, these workflows are inherently one-directional, mapping conditions to videos without providing a mechanism to invert this process. In complex media production settings, the ability to recover controllable textual conditions from a given video is highly desirable, yet remains underexplored. While inverse prompting has been studied for image generation, directly extending these approaches to video is challenging due to the need to capture temporal dynamics beyond static appearance, as well as the substantial computational cost of per-video optimization. In this work, we propose the first practical framework for efficient video inverse prompting. Specifically, we formulate inverse prompting as a meta-learning problem and introduce Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP), which learns a meta-prompt optimized over temporal dimensions to enable fast and effective prompt inference. Our approach amortizes the inversion process, eliminating the need for costly iterative optimization at test time. Experimental results demonstrate that MVIP recovers higher-quality inverse prompts with significantly improved reconstruction fidelity compared to image-based inversion and iterative captioning baselines, while achieving substantial gains in efficiency. Code and video results are available at https://ueriniuno.github.io/mvip-page/.

</details>


### [132] [O-SCD++: Replay-Free Online Scene Change Detection via Recursive Evidence Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24462)
*Chamuditha Jayanga Galappaththige,Jason Lai,Lloyd Windrim,Timothy Patten,Donald G. Dansereau,Niko Suenderhauf,Dimity Miller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免回放（replay-free）的在线场景变化检测框架，利用渲染器的线性性与前馈反向传播将多视角融合化为每个高斯原语的精确双标量递归，消除精度-速度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线因果变化检测严格难于离线设定，在线方法精度长期落后离线。O-SCD 虽已弥补差距（基于3DGS变化场、>10 FPS），但其每帧对所有历史线索图重新拟合变化场，占去一半以上单帧预算，迫使精度与速度相互让步。

Method: 参考地图固定，故变化场渲染是线性算子；每个新观测通过渲染器一次反向传播直接搬运到地图高斯上，把多视角融合化简为每个高斯的精确双标量递归，历史观测不存储、不重访；同时指出O-SCD所最小化的自监督目标经排序即可精确确定决策阈值，得到无标签的逐帧截断值，其边界提供选择性预测信号。

Result: 在PASLCD上，mIoU由0.489提升至0.575，吞吐由11.8升至25.6 FPS，并超过O-SCD的离线结果，同时保持严格因果。

Conclusion: 通过消除回放，在线变化检测可在严格因果约束下同时获得更高精度与更快速度，突破原有精度-速度权衡，并附带免标签阈值与选择性预测能力。

Abstract: Online scene change detection requires an agent to detect what has changed in a previously mapped environment while it is still on site, observing from unconstrained viewpoints and without access to future observations. This causal setting is strictly harder than its offline counterpart, and online methods have consistently trailed offline accuracy. O-SCD closed that gap by treating change as a persistent property of a 3D Gaussian splatting map of the reference scene, surpassing the strongest offline methods in change detection accuracy while operating at over 10 frames per second. O-SCD optimizes a change field over the Gaussians of the reference map, refitting it to all past cue maps at every frame, a step that consumes more than half of the per-frame budget and forces accuracy to be traded against speed. We present a replay-free formulation that eliminates this trade-off. Because the reference map stays fixed, rendering the change field is a linear operation. Each new observation can therefore be carried onto the map's Gaussians directly, by a single backward pass of the renderer, which reduces multi-view fusion to an exact two-scalar recursion per Gaussian. Past observations are never stored or revisited. The self-supervised objective that O-SCD minimizes by descent also determines the decision threshold exactly, by sorting, yielding a label-free per-frame cutoff whose margin provides a selective-prediction signal. On PASLCD, our method improves mean intersection over union from 0.489 to 0.575 and throughput from 11.8 to 25.6 frames per second, even exceeding O-SCD's offline result while remaining strictly causal.

</details>


### [133] [MoWE: Spatially Adaptive Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts Pooling for Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25074)
*Reaz Hassan Joarder,Sidratul Tanzila Tasmi,Alif Arshad Bakshi,Md. Bakhtiar Hasan,Md Hasanul Kabir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoWE 用基于上下文的小波专家路由替换 U-Net 中的最大池化与步幅卷积，并在多个超声病灶分割基准上提升精度、降低参数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准池化与步幅卷积会抑制高频空间细节（包括斑点区域的潜在边界线索）；现有频域方法虽保留部分细节，但单一小波族对全图施加相同的频谱偏置，缺乏空间自适应性。

Method: 提出 Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts（MoWE）：上下文感知路由器依据局部纹理与全局特征上下文，将局部区域分配给固定小波族；解码器在逆变换中复用编码器的空间路由图；可学习的通道门控在高频子带重建前对其进行重标定。

Result: 在四个超声病灶基准（BUSI、TN3K、UDIAT、BUS-UCLM）与心脏数据集 CAMUS 上评估，并在 BUSI 上测试 nnU-Net。U-Net 上 BUSI Dice 由 72.59% 提升至 74.55%，HD95 由 47.01 px 降至 43.49 px；nnU-Net 上 Dice 由 80.18% 提升至 81.97%，ASSD 由 20.07 px 降至 17.25 px；U-Net 可训练参数减少 6.4%。

Conclusion: 空间自适应的小波专家路由是一种有效的频域下采样替代方案，在提升分割精度与边界质量的同时减少参数量，并可移植到 nnU-Net 等框架。

Abstract: We present Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts (MoWE), a spatially adaptive routing mechanism that replaces max-pooling and strided convolutions in U-Net architectures for ultrasound lesion segmentation. Standard pooling operations suppress high-frequency spatial details, including potential boundary cues in speckled regions. Recent frequency-domain methods preserve some of these details, but a single wavelet family applies the same spectral bias across the image. MoWE instead uses a context-aware router to assign local regions to fixed wavelet families according to local texture and global feature context. The decoder reuses the encoder's spatial routing maps during the inverse transform. Learnable channel-wise gates rescale the high-frequency subbands before reconstruction. We evaluate MoWE with U-Net on four ultrasound lesion benchmarks (BUSI, TN3K, UDIAT, BUS-UCLM) and one cardiac dataset (CAMUS), and with nnU-Net on BUSI. On BUSI, MoWE improves U-Net Dice from 72.59\% to 74.55\% and reduces HD95 from 47.01 to 43.49\,px. With nnU-Net, MoWE improves Dice from 80.18\% to 81.97\% and reduces ASSD from 20.07 to 17.25\,px. On U-Net, MoWE reduces trainable parameters by 6.4\%.

</details>


### [134] [PRET is a few-shot system for pan-cancer recognition without example training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25054)
*Yi Li,Ziyu Ning,Tianqi Xiang,Qixiang Zhang,Zhihao Lin,Min Yi,Feiyan Feng,Baozhen Zeng,Xuexia Qian,Lu Sun,Jiace Qin,Ling Xiang,Chao Fan,Tian Qin,Qian Wang,Xiu-Wu Bian,Kun-Hsing Yu,Kang Zhang,Qingling Zhang,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PRET——一种无需训练的少样本泛癌识别系统，跨器官、跨医院、跨任务实现灵活可扩展的病理AI诊断，在23个基准的20项任务上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理检查是癌症诊断的基石，但全球病理医生短缺；传统AI模型需要为每种疾病标注大量数据，可扩展性与实用性受限。

Method: PRET（pan-cancer recognition without examples training）为少样本、免训练系统，可在不同器官、医院与任务间实现灵活可扩展的癌症识别。

Result: 在23个国际基准、共4,484张全切片图像上评估，20项任务优于现有方法，15个基准AUC超过97%，最大提升36.76%；仅用8张切片样本即达临床级淋巴结转移检测性能，优于11名病理医生。

Conclusion: PRET提供灵活、低成本的泛癌识别方案，为可及且公平的AI病理系统铺路，尤其惠及少数群体与医疗欠发达地区。

Abstract: Pathological examination stands as the cornerstone in cancer diagnosis, impacting millions worldwide annually. With the shortage of pathologists globally, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged rapidly to automate the diagnostics process. However, conventional AI models require substantial labeled data for each disease, posing huge challenges in scalability and practicality. Therefore, we introduce PRET (pan-cancer recognition without examples training), a few-shot system to achieve flexible, scalable, and effective cancer recognition across diverse organs, hospitals and tasks without training. Evaluated on 23 international benchmarks comprising 4,484 whole-slide images, our method outperforms existing approaches across 20 tasks, achieving over 97% area under the curve on 15 benchmarks with a maximum improvement of 36.76%. Notably, PRET delivers clinical-grade diagnostic performance in lymph node metastasis detection using only eight slide examples, outperforming 11 pathologists. By offering a flexible and cost-effective solution for pan-cancer recognition, PRET paves the way for accessible and equitable AI-based pathology systems, particularly benefiting minority populations and underserved regions.

</details>


### [135] [HAVANA: A Hierarchical Video-Action Model for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24122)
*Dongzhihan Wang,Yi Du,Chen Wang,Xiuxian Li,Liang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HAVANA：双系统视频-动作模型，解耦慢速语言条件潜规划生成与快速反应式局部规划，实现异步执行，推理时无需生成未来视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-动作模型（VAM）在同一过程中联合预测视觉未来与局部轨迹，但两者时间尺度不同：未来预测在多次更新间保持稳定，局部轨迹需对新观测快速反应，导致效率与响应性矛盾。

Method: 提出双系统VAM：慢系统（slow system）从观测历史生成紧凑的语言条件潜规划；快系统（fast system）将最新规划与当前观测结合生成局部轨迹；二者异步执行，避免重复未来预测，且推理时不生成未来视频。

Result: 在OmniNavBench上取得优于既有基线的SOTA导航性能；真实世界部署显示对不同机器人形态在未见环境中具备稳健泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过解耦预测性推理与反应式局部规划，异步双系统设计兼顾长时程指令一致性规划与短时程几何局部控制，提升导航性能与部署泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires long-horizon instruction-consistent planning and short-horizon local planning in current geometry. Video-action models (VAMs) offer a promising way to learn predictive representations for navigation. However, existing VAMs jointly predict visual futures and local trajectories in a single process, even though they operate at different paces: future prediction remains stable across multiple updates while local trajectories must react to fresh observations. To bridge this gap, we introduce HAVANA, a dual-system VAM that decouples predictive reasoning from reactive local planning. A slow system produces a compact language-conditioned latent plan from observation history, while a fast system combines the latest plan with the current observation to generate local trajectories. Their asynchronous execution enables rapid adaptation without repeated future prediction, and no future video is generated during inference. Experiments on OmniNavBench demonstrate state-of-the-art navigation performance over prior baselines, while real-world deployments further show robust generalization to unseen environments across different robot embodiments. Our code and checkpoints will be available at https://github.com/Anastasiawd/HAVANA.

</details>


### [136] [BiNar: Bitstream Native Restorer for Bitstream-corrupted Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24094)
*Fangcheng Li,Zhen Yu,Kejun Wu,Tianyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BiNar：利用比特流原生语义引导的生成式比特流损坏图像修复框架，在码流域提取细粒度语义，结合多模态聚合与盲损坏定位作为扩散模型的视觉/语言提示，在感知与客观质量上均超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比特流域损坏会在像素域引发不可预测的误差传播与失真放大，甚至导致标准解码器完全无法解码，使现有像素域图像修复范式失效，因此需要不依赖像素解码的码流原生修复思路。

Method: 提出BiNar，包含三个模块：(1) Bitstream Semantic Modeling (BSeM)：直接从损坏比特流建模字节序列，提取鲁棒的细粒度语义描述，无需像素解码；(2) Corruption-adaptive Multimodal Semantic Aggregation (CMSA)：在解码后的损坏图像中提取自适应视觉模态线索并与比特流描述聚合，形成连贯的修复引导；(3) Blind Corruption Localization (BCoL)：借助视觉基础模型的分割先验定位需恢复的错误区域。定位区域与细粒度描述分别作为扩散模型的视觉提示与语言提示进行修复。

Result: 在多种比特流损坏条件下的大量实验表明，BiNar在感知质量与客观质量上均优于所有最先进的图像修复模型；消融实验验证了细粒度比特流原生语义在BCIR任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: 码流原生语义可为比特流损坏图像修复提供有效的细粒度引导，结合多模态语义聚合与盲损坏定位，能显著提升修复性能，为BCIR任务提供了新范式。

Abstract: Bitstream-corrupted image restoration (BCIR) aims to reconstruct faithful images from corrupted compressed bitstreams. However, corruption occurs in bitstream-domain may lead to unpredictable error propagation and distortion amplification in pixel-domain, and even result in complete undecodability by standard decoders, posing significant challenge to existing image restoration paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose Bitstream Native Restorer (BiNar), a generative restoration framework that leverages fine-grained bitstream-native semantics to guide bitstream-corrupted image restoration. In BiNar, Bitstream Semantic Modeling (BSeM) extracts robust informative semantics and models sequential bytes directly from corrupted bitstream, enabling to generate fine-grained bitstream descriptions without relying on pixel decoding. Based on the descriptions,the Corruption-adaptive Multimodal Semantic Aggregation (CMSA) further extracts adaptive visual modal cues in decoded corrupted images and aggregates to bitstream descriptions. The multimodal aggregated fine-grained descriptions can serve as coherent restoration guidance. Finally, Blind Corruption Localization (BCoL) exploits the segmentation prior of visual foundation models to identify and locate error regions that requires recovery in corrupted images. The located error regions and the fine-grained descriptions jointly serve as visual prompt and language prompt of diffusion models image restoration, respectively. Extensive experiments under diverse bitstream corruption conditions show that BiNar outperforms all State-of-the-arts image restoration models regardless of perceptual quality or objective quality. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of fine-grained bitstream-native semantics in BCIR task.

</details>


### [137] [SynerGest: Temporal-Spatial Synergistic Gesture Generation for Dyadic Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24031)
*Chengxiang Guo,Jian Wang,Lanmiao Liu,Zhan Tang,Junhua Fei,Xiao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SynerGest，一个基于对比流匹配（Contrastive Flow Matching, CFM）与脉冲-趋势协同注意力（ITSA）的双人对话共语手势生成框架，实现语义对齐与运动学稳定性的平衡，在两个公开数据集上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双人对话虚拟人共语手势生成模型难以兼顾运动学稳定性与节奏响应性，并存在语义纠缠问题，导致结果退化为均值姿态回归或出现不自然的微小抖动。

Method: 1）对比流匹配目标（CFM）：训练中显式惩罚不匹配的语义配对，抑制空间捷径与过度平滑预测，增强条件语义对齐；2）脉冲-趋势协同注意力模块（ITSA）：基于"区分'动什么'与'何时动'"的思路，将语音驱动的尖锐节奏脉冲与连续运动趋势分开建模，从而同时提升音-动同步精度与全局结构稳定性。

Result: 在两个公开数据集上进行定性与定量评估，SynerGest 取得最先进性能，生成上下文响应性强、运动学流畅的双人交互手势。

Conclusion: 通过 CFM 缓解语义纠缠、通过 ITSA 解耦节奏脉冲与运动趋势，可有效解决双人共语手势生成中稳定性与响应性的权衡问题，验证了该解耦式建模范式的有效性。

Abstract: Co-speech gesture generation in dyadic conversations for creating immersive virtual avatars remains highly challenging. Existing models often struggle to balance kinematic stability with rhythmic responsiveness and suffer from semantic entanglement, leading to either generic mean-pose regression or unnatural micro-jitters. To address these challenges, we propose SynerGest, a high-fidelity dyadic gesture generation framework grounded in Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM). Specifically, our CFM objective explicitly penalizes mismatched semantic pairs during training, discouraging spatial shortcuts and over-smoothed predictions while improving conditional semantic alignment. Furthermore, to overcome architectural bottlenecks, we introduce the Impulse-Trend Synergistic Attention (ITSA) module. Grounded in the key insight of decoupling "what moves" from "when it moves," ITSA models sharp, speech-driven rhythmic impulses separately from continuous kinematic trends, supporting precise audio-motion synchronization and global structural stability. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations on two public datasets demonstrate that SynerGest achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering contextually responsive and kinematically fluid dyadic interactions.

</details>


### [138] [Causal Spatio-Temporal Neural Distance Fields for Counterfactual Cardiac Anatomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24001)
*Mathias Lowes,Kurt Butler,Kristine Aavild Sørensen,Klaus F. Kofoed,Sotirios A. Tsaftaris,Rasmus R. Paulsen,Steven McDonagh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将结构因果模型（SCM）与4D时空神经距离场结合，实现反事实的心脏解剖生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有心脏形状生成模型以临床变量为条件，但忽略变量间因果联系，无法回答"某患者在不同临床画像下解剖如何变化"的反事实问题。

Method: 以年龄、性别、吸烟、BMI、心率、收缩压构建SCM，置于时空神经距离场（隐式神经表示，以有符号距离场表示心动周期内左心房复合体）的条件编码之前；将临床变量干预经SCM传播后生成4D反事实。

Result: 年龄干预下生成的反事实呈剂量-反应关系；do(female=1)干预使男性分布趋近女性分布；逆干预可亚毫米精度近似原始解剖。

Conclusion: 首次实现4D心脏解剖的反事实生成，并首次将SCM与隐式神经表示集成为成像机制。

Abstract: Counterfactual cardiac anatomy can support risk modelling and intervention planning, by predicting how a patient's heart would change under altered clinical conditions. However, current shape generative models are conditional on clinical variables and disregard causal links between these variables. Thus, they cannot answer counterfactual questions about how a given subject's anatomy would change under a different clinical profile. Modelling the heart's continuous movement over the cardiac cycle requires a representation that is itself continuous in space and time. Spatio-temporal neural distance fields provide this while separating clinical conditioning from subject-specific shape. We place a structural causal model (SCM) over the set of clinical variables (age, sex, smoking, BMI, heart rate, systolic blood pressure), before the condition encoding of the spatio-temporal neural distance field which represents the left atrial complex over a cardiac cycle by signed distance fields. An intervention of the clinical variables, propagated through a SCM before the 4D counterfactual, is constructed from the neural distance field. The generated counterfactuals follow dose-response under age interventions and transforms the male distribution to closely match the female distribution under the intervention $\mathrm{do(\mathrm{female}{=}1)}$. By doing inverse interventions the model also approximates the original anatomy with sub millimeter precision. To our knowledge, this is the first counterfactual generation of 4D cardiac anatomy and the first integration of an SCM with an implicit neural representation as its imaging mechanism.

</details>


### [139] [Toward AI-Driven Phytoplankton Event Detection from Image Classification: Temporal Aggregation Under Domain Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23932)
*Ali Rohan,Hassan Shayan,Han-Gue Jo,Colin Moffat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向监测的框架，验证AI浮游植物分类在聚合层面能否复现专家判读的时间发生模式，并在独立域数据上评估跨域泛化与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IFCB成像流式细胞仪产生海量浮游植物图像，人工专家分析难以承载；虽然机器学习在图像级分类上表现良好，但其预测能否为监测提供具有生态意义的时间信息尚不明确。

Method: 构建以监测为导向的评估框架，基于MedPlanktonSet开发，并在SMHI独立IFCB数据集上测试；选取8个生物学上可比的目标类群，其余观测保留为背景以维持完整图像流分母；采用按采集会话划分（session-aware）避免时间泄漏；比较多种预处理策略与CNN架构；以EfficientNet-B0做目标-背景判别，并进行聚合后的时间一致性分析。

Result: 跨域实验显示预处理对泛化影响显著；EfficientNet-B0判别能力最强。尽管存在残余图像级误差，聚合后AI导出的目标出现率与专家信号高度一致（MAE=0.0432，Pearson r=0.9696，Spearman ρ=0.9568）；多会话窗口下一致性稳定，并在留出测试中复现了"升高、强、持续"三类出现代理指标。

Conclusion: AI浮游植物分类可支撑超出图像级识别的、与监测相关的时间指标，为未来业务化早期预警系统的开发提供依据。

Abstract: Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) systems generate large volumes of phytoplankton imagery that exceed the capacity of manual expert analysis. Although machine-learning approaches achieve high image-level classification performance, it remains unclear whether their predictions can provide ecologically meaningful temporal information for monitoring. This study investigates whether AI-derived phytoplankton classifications can reproduce temporal occurrence patterns and elevated-occurrence signals under realistic sampling and independent-domain transfer. A monitoring-oriented framework was developed using MedPlanktonSet and evaluated on an independent IFCB dataset from the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI). Eight biologically comparable taxa were selected as targets, while all remaining observations were retained as background to preserve the full image-stream denominator. Session-aware partitioning prevented temporal leakage, and alternative preprocessing strategies and convolutional neural network architectures were evaluated. Cross-domain experiments showed that preprocessing strongly affected generalisation. EfficientNet-B0 provided the strongest target-versus-background discrimination and was selected for temporal analysis. Despite residual image-level errors, AI-derived target-occurrence rates closely reproduced expert-derived signals after aggregation (mean absolute error = 0.0432, Pearson $r$ = 0.9696, Spearman $ρ$ = 0.9568). Agreement remained strong across multi-session windows, and elevated, strong, and persistent occurrence proxies were recovered in held-out testing. These results show that AI-based phytoplankton classification can support monitoring-relevant temporal indicators beyond image-level identification and support future operational early-warning development.

</details>


### [140] [Pseudo-Label Foreground Quality Weighting for Domain-Generalized Fundus Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23911)
*Lucas Gabriel Telesco,José Ignacio Orlando*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种针对视盘（OD）与视杯（OC）分割的Noisy Student改进方法：用多任务Dice预测器从教师生成的掩膜中估计伪标签可靠性，并据此对伪标签损失加权，从而提升跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OD/OC分割是自动化青光眼评估的核心，但在有限标注眼底数据上训练的模型在域偏移下性能退化。半监督Teacher-Student学习可利用无标注数据改善泛化，然而标准Noisy Student训练将所有伪标签视为同等可靠，忽略了伪标签质量差异。

Method: 在Noisy Student框架上做定向扩展：引入多任务Dice预测器，基于教师生成的掩膜估计OD与OC各自的伪标签质量，并用该可靠性估计在Student训练中对伪标签损失进行加权。该加权保留低分前景伪标签的基线贡献，同时对预测更可靠的伪标签赋予更高相对权重。

Result: 在已知域与未见域上的实验显示，相较Noisy Student基线取得提升，尤以OC分割更为明显，同时保持有竞争力的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 按OD/OC分别进行可靠性加权的伪标签监督可有效改善半监督分割的跨域泛化，OC分割受益尤为显著；方法在提升性能的同时未牺牲整体泛化竞争力。

Abstract: Optic disc (OD) and optic cup (OC) segmentation is central to automated glaucoma assessment, but models trained on limited labeled fundus datasets often degrade under domain shift. Semi-supervised Teacher-Student learning can improve generalization by leveraging unlabeled data, yet standard Noisy Student training treats all pseudo-labels as equally reliable. In this paper we investigate a targeted extension of Noisy Student training in which OD- and OC-specific pseudo-label supervision is modulated using a mask-derived reliability estimate. A multitask Dice predictor estimates OD- and OC-specific pseudo-label quality from Teacher-generated masks, and these estimates are used to weight the pseudo-label loss during Student training. This preserves the baseline contribution of low-scoring foreground pseudo-labels while assigning greater relative emphasis to pseudo-labels predicted to be more reliable. Experiments across known and unseen domains show improvements over the Noisy Student baseline, particularly for OC segmentation, while maintaining competitive generalization performance.

</details>


### [141] [Rethinking weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs: position nulls, protocol dependence, and PACE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23902)
*Shixin Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 胸部X光弱监督定位文献中以单一重叠精度汇报、跨论文不可比；作者量化了"位置零假设"与三项报告选择带来的影响，并据此提出PACE方法及其代价评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胸部X光弱监督定位结果以单一重叠精度（IoU类）报告，跨论文不可比；作者希望测量"一个数字里究竟包含了什么"，即区分真实空间能力与位置先验、报告协议带来的虚高。

Method: 构造位置零假设对照：保留读图方法的预测框尺寸、仅随机移动其位置，以此检验CAM与Grad-CAM是否超出位置先验；以3名放射科医师作为参照上界。系统变动三项常被省略的选择——结果统计口径（results regime）、阈值化提取方式、由掩码到框的规则，并用掩码碎片化程度预测box-rule的代价。基于上述发现提出PACE（population anomaly and class evidence）：由标签训练的分类头给出finding identity，乘以来自冻结放射骨干网（从不接触病理标签）的空间证据。

Result: CAM与Grad-CAM仅在ChestX-ray14的7个标注发现中的2–4个、CheXlocalize的8个中的2个上显著优于位置零假设；放射科医师在4–7个上超越零假设，说明该零假设并非不可打破。三项选择各自造成的效应大于多数已报告的方法效应；仅用预测框面积即可反转成对比较。PACE在探索性匹配面积分析中于两个语料上提升严格重叠精度并优于标签派生的第二热图，但对分类器因果图的忠实度在三者中最差，优势依赖box规则，且所有设计选择均在其评测框上调优（该基准无定位验证集）；仅一次干净迁移实验中胜过一基线、输给另一基线。

Conclusion: 弱监督定位的单一重叠数字混合了位置先验与报告协议效应，跨论文比较不可靠；应报告零假设基线与协议敏感性。PACE展示了在严格匹配与代价—收益并报下的可比较评测范式。

Abstract: Weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs is reported as a single overlap accuracy, and those numbers are not comparable across papers. We measure what one contains. Against position-null controls that keep a readout's own box and move only its position, class activation mapping and its gradient-weighted variant beat the null on two to four of seven annotated findings on ChestX-ray14 and two of eight on CheXlocalize. The null is beatable: three board-certified radiologists clear it on four to seven. Three rarely stated choices each move a result by more than most reported method effects: the results regime, the extraction threshold, and the mask-to-box rule, whose cost is predicted by how fragmented the thresholded mask is. Predicted box area alone reverses a paired comparison. These measurements produced PACE, for \emph{population anomaly and class evidence}, which multiplies the finding identity from the label-trained head by the spatial evidence from a frozen radiograph backbone that never sees a pathology label. It is the case study that made the protocol dependence visible, and we report its costs beside its gain: in an exploratory matched-area analysis it improves strict-overlap accuracy on both corpora and beats a label-derived second map, but it is the least faithful of the three readouts to the classifier's causal map, its advantage depends on the box rule, and, this benchmark releasing no localization validation set, every design choice behind it was made on the boxes it is scored on. Its one clean transfer beats one baseline and loses to the other.

</details>


### [142] [PREEMPT: Proactive Robustness Evaluation under Editing for Media Protection Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24205)
*Qiuyu Tang,Aparna Bharati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PREEMPT评估框架，系统刻画主动图像保护在单次与序列编辑下的鲁棒性动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多局限于单次编辑，只能给出静态鲁棒性视图，忽视了真实多步编辑工作流中保护效果随编辑序列演化的动态过程，难以系统刻画不同保护范式下的鲁棒性变化规律。

Method: 构建统一评估框架PREEMPT，覆盖单次与序列编辑场景，包括图像变换、语义编辑以及同质/异质编辑组合；针对不同保护目标，将任务特定有效性归一化为"保护存活轨迹"，并以轨迹级诊断指标汇总长程鲁棒性。

Result: 揭示出单次编辑评估下被掩盖的退化行为；扰动类与水印类保护方法呈现不同的失效模式；首个语义编辑在很大程度上决定后续退化轨迹的走向。

Conclusion: PREEMPT为长程鲁棒性研究提供了标准化协议，并为主动图像保护的退化动态提供了新见解。

Abstract: Proactive image protection methods aim to defend visual content against unauthorized manipulation and generative misuse by embedding protective signals into images before release. Evaluating whether these protections remain effective under image editing is therefore critical. However, existing evaluations remain largely limited to one-shot edits, providing only a static view of robustness while overlooking its evolution under realistic multi-step editing workflows. To systematically characterize robustness dynamics under sequential editing across various protection paradigms, we introduce PREEMPT, a holistic evaluation framework. It evaluates protection robustness under both one-shot and sequential editing scenarios, covering image transformations, semantic edits, homogeneous and heterogeneous edit compositions. To enable consistent analysis across protection paradigms with different underlying objectives, PREEMPT normalizes task-specific effectiveness into protection survival trajectories and summarizes long-horizon robustness through trajectory-based diagnostics. Using this framework, we reveal that degradation behaviors remain hidden under conventional one-shot evaluation. Furthermore, perturbation- and watermark-based protection methods exhibit different failure modes, and the first semantic edit largely determines subsequent degradation trajectories. PREEMPT provides a standardized protocol for studying long-horizon robustness and offers new insights into the degradation dynamics of proactive image protection.

</details>


### [143] [SCOPE-VSR: A Broad-Coverage Training Dataset for Video Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24604)
*Gengyu Liao,Yechun Yong,Zheng Chen,Jianze Li,Ziqing Zhang,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向开放域视频超分的数据策划流程SCOPE，构建语义均衡的SCOPE-VSR训练集与SCOPE-test测试集，并提出可靠性感知的一步式视频复原框架GraCo-VSR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放域视频超分需在差异极大的场景与主体间保持时序一致的细节，但现有训练数据语义分布不均衡、多样性不足，构成数据瓶颈。

Method: SCOPE流程结合面向任务的视频筛选与层次化语义再平衡，基于大规模数据源构建约27k视频的SCOPE-VSR及SCOPE-test；GraCo-VSR为一步式视频复原框架，采用可靠性感知设计并以显式监督抑制退化引起的运动与纹理引导失真。

Result: SCOPE-VSR覆盖真实场景与主体，分布均衡且多样；GraCo-VSR在重建保真度与感知质量上均取得较强表现。

Conclusion: 数据策划与可靠性引导设计相结合，可有效缓解开放域VSR的数据瓶颈并提升复原质量。

Abstract: Open-domain video super-resolution (VSR) requires temporally coherent details across widely varying scenes and subjects. However, existing training datasets are often semantically imbalanced and insufficiently diverse. We address this data bottleneck with a structured curation pipeline for open-domain VSR, SCOPE. In this pipeline, we combine task-oriented video selection with hierarchical semantic rebalancing. Applying this pipeline to a large-scale collection of data sources, we construct the SCOPE-VSR dataset for training and SCOPE-test for testing. SCOPE-VSR has approximately 27k videos and provides balanced and diverse coverage of various real-world scenarios and subjects. We further develop GraCo-VSR, a novel framework for one-step video restoration. GraCo-VSR adopts a reliability-aware design with explicit supervision to reduce degradation-induced distortions in motion and texture guidance, allowing the model to benefit more effectively from the diverse training content in SCOPE-VSR. Evaluations show that our model achieves strong reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gyliao2768/SCOPE-VSR.

</details>


### [144] [Unifying Amplitude-Phase Coupling and Reliable Endogenous Priors for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24467)
*Tongshun Zhang,Zixuan Zhong,Pingping Liu,Jin Kuang,Yubing Lu,Dong Liu,Qiuzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出频率-空间联合框架，通过幅值-相位自适应补偿融合模块建模频谱耦合，并利用内生可靠先验提取伪红外与梯度线索，经双模态引导精炼网络提升低光照图像增强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有频域低光照图像增强方法假设幅值与相位可独立恢复，忽视二者固有的频谱耦合，导致信息不一致与结构失真；同时从原始低光输入直接提取先验不可靠，因严重噪声与欠曝光破坏关键视觉内容。

Method: 1) 实证分析幅值与相位的耦合关系；2) 设计幅值-相位自适应补偿融合模块（APACF），实现二者双向交互而非硬性分离，获得频谱一致的恢复；3) 提出内生可靠先验（ERP），以频域初步恢复、接近真值光照的中间结果为高保真源，提取伪红外与梯度互补线索；4) 基于ERP构建双模态引导精炼网络（DGRN），将净化后的结构线索注入解码器。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法达到最先进性能，在定量指标与视觉质量上均持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 频谱耦合的联合建模与可靠先验引导可有效缓解频域LLIE中的结构失真，为低光照增强提供有效范式；代码已开源。

Abstract: Frequency-domain methods have shown strong potential for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) because they can effectively regulate global illumination. However, most existing methods assume that amplitude and phase can be restored independently, while overlooking their inherent spectral coupling. This artificial decoupling often leads to information inconsistency and structural distortions. To address this issue, we propose a frequency-spatial framework that jointly models spectral interaction and reliable prior guidance. We first empirically analyze the coupling between amplitude and phase and develop an Amplitude-Phase Adaptive Compensation Fusion (APACF) module. Instead of enforcing a hard separation between the two components, APACF enables their bidirectional interaction, resulting in spectrally coherent restoration. In addition, directly extracting priors from raw low-light inputs is unreliable, since severe noise and underexposure destroy critical visual content. To alleviate this problem, we introduce an Endogenous Reliability Prior (ERP). Specifically, we treat an intermediate result, preliminarily restored in the frequency domain and already close to the ground-truth illumination, as a high-fidelity source for extracting complementary pseudo-infrared and gradient cues. Based on ERP, we further design a Dual-Modal Guided Refinement Network (DGRN) to inject these purified structural cues into the decoder, thereby recovering missing fine textures more accurately. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently surpasses existing methods in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/bywlzts/Amplitude-Phase-Coupling-Net.

</details>


### [145] [PCHMR: Empowering and Benchmarking Human Mesh Recovery in Privacy-Constrained Real-World Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24841)
*Zeyu Cao,Qingxuan Wu,Zhiyang Dou,Rui Xu,Yuan Liu,Javier Fernandez-Marques,Nicholas D. Lane,Taku Komura,Wenping Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文构建了隐私约束下人体网格恢复（HMR）的联邦学习基准，并提出结合深度基础模型的本地标注与微调流水线 DePoser，以在不集中原始图像的前提下评估并提升 HMR 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 HMR 模型在用户端数据上微调需将敏感人体图像汇集到中心服务器，存在显著隐私风险；同时常见 HMR 训练流水线默认集中式数据访问，缺乏在隐私受限真实场景下的评估与改进手段。

Method: 构建基准：用联邦学习及安全聚合变体训练 SOTA HMR 模型，覆盖多种客户端规模与数据异质性设置；提出 DePoser，基于深度基础模型的本地标注与微调流水线，使协同训练的 HMR 模型适配终端用户数据分布。

Result: 量化了主流 HMR 骨干在去除集中式数据假设后的表现，揭示常规训练流水线对集中数据的依赖；在 in-the-wild 数据上，基于 DePoser 标注微调可提升个性化精度（以 DePoser 生成的伪真值衡量）。

Conclusion: 该基准为隐私约束下 HMR 模型的研究、真实部署与评估提供支撑，并表明本地标注结合深度基础模型可缓解隐私受限训练的数据瓶颈。

Abstract: Fine-tuning directly on user-side data is an effective way to improve the performance of widely adopted data-driven human mesh recovery (HMR) models. However, doing so for existing HMR methods often assumes aggregating user-side data from real-world HMR-deployed devices to a central training server, posing a significant privacy risk as sensitive human images are transmitted. How can human mesh recovery be evaluated and improved in privacy-constrained real-world settings? We study this question through a benchmark in which state-of-the-art HMR models are trained with federated learning and a secure-aggregation variant, neither of which centralizes raw images, and evaluated across a wide range of client-scale and data-heterogeneity settings. We document that common HMR training pipelines are built around centralized data access and quantify how representative HMR backbones behave when that assumption is removed. Furthermore, to study the data bottleneck of privacy-constrained HMR training, we propose DePoser, a local annotation and fine-tuning pipeline enhanced with depth foundation models, with which collaboratively trained HMR models can be locally tailored to the end user's distribution. On in-the-wild data, fine-tuning on DePoser annotations improves personalization accuracy, measured against DePoser-generated pseudo-ground truth. This benchmark aims to support future work on privacy-constrained HMR models and their real-world deployment and evaluation.

</details>


### [146] [Directionally Factorized Illumination with Spherical Harmonic Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24811)
*Yimeng Dou,Adam M. Saunders,Andre T. S. Hucke,Michael E. Kim,Adam W. Anderson,Eric R. Tkaczyk,Bennett A. Landman,Daniel Moyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DaFISH，将每点发射颜色分解为表面反照率与SH表示的共置光源照明因子，可即插即用于NeRF等NVS管线，实现姿态相关光照的解析泛化，在五个场景平均取得最优PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机闪光灯、水下照明、内窥镜等场景中光源刚性固定于相机，随相机移动导致同一表面点在各视角下光照方向变化；NeRF、3DGS等将该姿态相关光照编码为表面颜色，造成外观不一致并妨碍场景恢复。

Method: DaFISH作为可插拔模块接入任意NVS管线：将逐点发射颜色分解为表面反照率与球谐(SH)表示的照明因子；训练中直接评估SH照明，实现反照率、光照与几何的稳定联合优化；基于SH到辐照度的闭式转换，使从SH评估到体渲染的全流程可微，并解析泛化到任意相机姿态而无需重训练。

Result: 在五个场景的留出帧上平均，DaFISH取得最优PSNR 38.91 dB、SSIM 0.9613、LPIPS 0.0582，优于最强splatting基线与最接近的NeRF基线，且跨视角场景恢复更一致。

Conclusion: 显式分解共置光源的姿态相关照明可有效消除颜色编码伪影，DaFISH以轻量可插拔方式提升NVS的几何-光照解耦精度与跨视角一致性。

Abstract: Many real-world capture scenarios involve an active light source rigidly attached to the camera: camera flashes for dark-environment imaging, underwater vehicle lights, and endoscopic/laparoscopic medical procedures. As the camera moves, the co-mounted light moves with it, causing the illumination direction at each surface point to change across views. Neural rendering methods (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting) encode this pose-dependent illumination as surface coloration, producing appearance inconsistencies and making it harder to recover the underlying scene. We present \textbf{DaFISH}, which can be plugged into any novel-view synthesis (NVS) pipeline such as NeRF. It factorizes per-point emitted color into surface albedo and a spherical harmonic (SH)-represented illumination factor. During training, the SH illumination is evaluated directly, enabling stable joint optimization of albedo, lighting, and geometry. \textbf{DaFISH} provides analytical generalization of illumination to arbitrary camera poses without retraining. Building on the closed-form SH-to-irradiance conversion, the training pipeline is fully differentiable from SH evaluation through volume rendering. Averaged over the held-out frames of the five scenes, \textbf{DaFISH} attains the best mean PSNR (38.91\,dB), SSIM (0.9613), and LPIPS (0.0582) among all compared methods. It improves over the strongest splatting baseline as well as the closest NeRF-based baseline, while recovering the scene consistently across views compared to prior methods.

</details>


### [147] [S3D-Mosaic: Subgradient-Guided Cross-Band Structure Transfer for Spectral Demosaicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24414)
*Weiqiang Zhao,Xian Li,Yuzhe Gui,Tianzhu Liu,Yanfeng Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于次梯度引导跨波段结构迁移的模型驱动光谱去马赛克方法S3D-Mosaic，通过幅度不变机制与DSE-DConv实现高泛化重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱滤波阵列（MSFA）快照成像存在逐波段稀疏采样导致的严重空间混叠；缺失结构虽可跨波段推断，但波长相关对比度变化使直接跨波段迁移不可靠。现有模型方法缺乏显式幅度不变机制，学习方法需特定布局训练或逐图调参，泛化性差。

Method: 1) 建立具有广义余弦相似度解释的次梯度引导正则化框架，提供幅度不变信息迁移的凸机制；2) 设计紧凑的方向稀疏等变差分卷积（DSE-DConv），以低计算成本提取波段级方向选择性与高频结构特征；3) 在光谱相邻波段上实例化该框架，构建跨波段自结构相似正则项，并用双扫描ADMM算法优化，解耦双向依赖、跨波段传播幅度鲁棒的结构信息；DSE-DConv仅两个参数经自监督单次训练。

Result: 在CAVE与NTIRE 2022数据集上优于最先进的无监督方法；以固定重建超参数稳健泛化至不同MSFA布局、全色-马赛克融合及真实无人机数据。

Conclusion: S3D-Mosaic以模型驱动方式结合幅度不变正则与轻量等变卷积，兼顾重建质量、计算效率与跨布局/跨场景泛化，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multispectral filter array (MSFA) imaging enables snapshot spectral acquisition, but its per-band sparse sampling causes severe spatial aliasing. Although missing spatial structures can be inferred across bands, wavelength-dependent contrast variations make direct cross-band transfer unreliable. Existing model-based methods lack explicit magnitude-invariant mechanisms, and learning-based methods require layout-specific training or per-image tuning, limiting generalization. To address these issues, we propose S3D-Mosaic, a model-based spectral demosaicing method built upon a subgradient-guided cross-band structure transfer framework. We first establish a subgradient-guided regularization framework with a generalized cosine-similarity interpretation, providing a convex mechanism for magnitude-invariant information transfer. Then we design a compact Directional Sparse Equivariant Difference Convolution (DSE-DConv) for band-level extraction of orientation-selective, high-frequency structure features at low computational cost. Instantiating the framework with DSE-DConv on spectrally adjacent bands yields a cross-band self-structure similarity regularizer for spectral demosaicing, which we optimize via a dual-scan ADMM algorithm that decouples the bidirectional dependency while propagating magnitude-robust structural information across bands. With DSE-DConv's two parameters trained once via self-supervision, S3D-Mosaic outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised methods on CAVE and NTIRE 2022, and generalizes robustly to varying MSFA layouts, pan-mosaic fusion, and real-world UAV data with fixed reconstruction hyperparameters. The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/bestwishes43/S3D-Mosaic}.

</details>


### [148] [VTF900: A 900-Subject Visible-Thermal Face Recognition Dataset and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24832)
*Jacob Abaare,Bianca Ianetta,Cedric Nimpa Fondje,Shuowen Hu,Benjamin S. Riggan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 VTF900——一个含 900 名受试者、包含表情/姿态/遮挡变化配对图像的大规模可见光-热红外人脸识别基准，支持 1:1 验证与 1:N 闭集识别的大库评估及跨光谱-跨数据集分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可见光-热红外人脸识别基准的注册库规模过小（N≈100），难以在大规模下准确评估系统性能并给出具有实际部署意义的指标。

Method: 构建 900 受试者、配对图像的 VTF900 基准，覆盖表情、姿态与遮挡变化，支持验证与闭集识别评估以及跨光谱+跨数据集场景；在 ARL-VTF 上训练模型后，对卷积基线、视觉 Transformer 与域自适应网络架构进行基准测试，比较其在库规模扩展下的表现。

Result: 在全库规模（N=900）下，Transformer 模型在正面条件下判别力强（ViT-B：97.68% AUC，51.10% TAR@1%FAR）；域自适应方法如 DPIT-ResNet50 在非正面姿态下更鲁棒（94.68% AUC，36.08% TAR@1%FAR）。小规模下的高 AUC 并不能转化为部署规模下的可靠性能，姿态变化会显著加剧性能退化。

Conclusion: VTF900 揭示了现有方法在大库规模评估中的局限性，为跨光谱人脸识别系统提供了更严格的评测手段。

Abstract: Despite advancements in visible-thermal face recognition, where thermal probe (query) face images are matched against visible enrollment templates, existing benchmarks are currently limited by small gallery sizes (N $\approx$ 100 subjects). This limitation inhibits the ability to accurately evaluate visible-thermal facial recognition at scale and to report significant recognition performance metrics, which have better operational relevance. Therefore, we introduce VTF900, a large-scale visible-thermal face recognition benchmark with 900 subjects and paired imagery that includes expression, pose, and occlusion variations. VTF900 is designed to support large-scale (i.e., large gallery) evaluations across verification (1:1 matching) and closed-set identification (1:N matching) for visible-thermal face recognition. Furthermore, VTF900 specifically addresses the challenging combination of cross-spectral and cross-dataset analysis. In this paper, after training models on the ARL-VTF dataset, we provide benchmark analyses across convolutional (baseline), vision transformers, and domain-adaptive neural network architectures to assess how these methods scale. At full gallery scale (N = 900), transformer models achieve strong discriminative performance under frontal conditions (e.g., ViT-B: 97.68% AUC, 51.10% TAR@1%FAR), while domain-adaptive methods such as DPIT-ResNet50 demonstrate greater robustness under off-pose conditions (94.68%AUC, 36.08% TAR@1%FAR). Our results show that high AUC at small scale does not translate to reliable performance at deployment scale, and that pose variation significantly amplifies performance degradation. VTF900 exposes these limitations, enabling more rigorous evaluation of cross-spectral face recognition systems.

</details>


### [149] [HORIA: 4D Human and Object Reconstruction from a Monocular Video with Interaction-Aware Re-Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25960)
*Hyeongjin Nam,Taeryung Lee,Daniel Sungho Jung,Kyoung Mu Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HORIA框架，通过交互阶段语义分解与基于文本到视频扩散先验的交互感知重渲染，实现单目视频中人与物体的联合4D重建，并在遮挡下获得时间一致、几何准确的SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目视频中人物交互的联合4D重建存在两大难点：一是视频包含跨多个交互阶段的复合语义上下文，难以刻画交互的时间变化；二是人物-物体遮挡导致单视角观测信息不完整，重建几何不一致。

Method: HORIA包含两个核心设计：(1) 运动感知描述（motion-aware captioning），将输入视频分解为具有时间定位、语义可区分的交互阶段，并为每阶段生成特定文本描述；(2) 交互感知重渲染，以这些阶段文本为条件，将初始重建的4D人与物体从新视角渲染，并用文本到视频扩散先验精化渲染结果，提供单视角之外的新视角辅助监督。

Result: 在多种交互场景下生成时间连贯且准确的4D重建，取得最先进（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: 将长视频按交互阶段进行语义分解并借助生成式视频先验补足单视角观测，是缓解遮挡与复合语义问题的有效途径，可实现高质量人-物联合4D重建。

Abstract: Joint 4D reconstruction of a human and object from a monocular video is essential for understanding how people interact with their environment. While recent methods have made noticeable progress, capturing such human-object interactions remains difficult due to two main challenges. First, a video typically contains composite semantic context spanning multiple interaction phases, making it difficult to track the temporal changes of the interaction in the reconstruction. Second, under human-object occlusion, a single-view observation contains incomplete visual information about the interaction, resulting in geometrically inconsistent reconstructions.
