To address these challenges, we introduce HORIA, built upon two core designs. First, we decompose the entire input video into temporally grounded and semantically distinct interaction phases with motion-aware captioning, obtaining a specific text description for each phase. Second, conditioned on these text descriptions of the interaction, we propose an interaction-aware re-rendering that compensates for the limited single-view observation. Specifically, we render the initially reconstructed 4D human and object from novel viewpoints and refine the renderings with a text-to-video diffusion prior, which provides auxiliary novel-view supervision beyond single-view cues. As a result, our framework produces temporally coherent and accurate 4D reconstructions under diverse interaction scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [150] [SAPO: Self-Supervised Attention Policy Optimization for Improving Temporal Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25923)
*Zixuan Chen,Depeng Wang,Wei Chen,Ke Xu,Ya Guo,Huijia Zhu,Tanfeng Sun,Xinghao Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"时间生成鸿沟"现象，并设计自监督注意力策略优化（SAPO），在无需时间标注的情况下提升视频VLM的时序定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频视觉语言模型语义理解强但时序定位不精确；已有证据显示显式帧-绝对时间对齐带来收益，暗示模型内部可能已编码较准确的时间位置，只是在输出时间戳时精度损失，因此希望在无精确时序标注（仅有未标注视频-查询对）条件下弥合该差距。

Method: 在4个VLM、2个定位数据集上分析，对比内部注意力区间与预测区间的精度，将差异定义为"时间生成鸿沟"；进而提出SAPO：以内部时序注意力作为自监督信号驱动Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），并采用无需真值的准则筛选高价值样本进行训练。

Result: 约66%的有效样本中注意力区间优于预测区间，证实鸿沟存在；SAPO在多个数据集与不同初始能力模型上一致提升时序定位，相对mIoU增益在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上达33.7%、在较强的Time-R1-7B上达5.4%；改进可跨数据集迁移且不损害通用视频理解。

Conclusion: 模型内部时间定位信息优于其输出时间戳，可通过自监督强化学习策略在无标注条件下有效弥合该鸿沟，实现稳健且可迁移的时序定位提升。

Abstract: Video vision-language models (VLMs) have strong semantic understanding, yet remain unreliable at precise temporal grounding. Existing gains from explicitly aligning video frames with absolute time suggest that VLMs may already encode accurate temporal locations internally but lose precision when expressing them as timestamps. Our analysis across four VLMs and two grounding datasets confirms this hypothesis: attention intervals outperform predicted intervals on approximately 66% of valid examples. We term this discrepancy the temporal generation gap. Because precise temporal annotations are expensive, this finding motivates closing the gap to improve temporal grounding using only unlabeled video-query pairs. We propose Self-Supervised Attention Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses internal temporal attention as self-supervision for Group Relative Policy Optimization and applies a ground-truth-free criterion to select high-value samples. SAPO consistently improves temporal grounding across multiple datasets and models spanning weak to strong initial grounding ability. Relative mIoU gains reach 33.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 5.4% on the strong Time-R1-7B. The improvements transfer across datasets while preserving general video understanding.

</details>


### [151] [LEAP: Accelerating ODE-based Diffusion Sampling with Optimal Linear Leaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25918)
*Haowei Zheng,Zhenyu Zhou,Jiawei Chen,Can Wang,Defang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LEAP: 基于采样轨迹几何分析的最优线性跳跃，实现扩散模型免训练加速采样，无需模型评估即可精确预测后续状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型免训练加速采样主要依赖通用 ODE 数值方法，但在粗时间离散化下性能显著退化，缺乏针对采样轨迹几何特性的专用方法。

Method: 基于对采样轨迹几何的理论与实证研究，利用轨迹低维性与跨轨迹一致性，在局部轨迹子空间内构建监督式最小二乘优化问题，求解最优线性跳跃以精确逼近未来状态，且无需额外模型评估；可插件式集成到现有求解器方法中。

Result: 在文本到图像（Stable Diffusion 3.5、FLUX.1-dev）与图像到3D（TRELLIS.2）等多种模态生成任务上，LEAP 优于已有方法，并能与现有基于求解器的方法无缝融合，实现即插即用增强。

Conclusion: LEAP 通过在局部轨迹子空间内的最小二乘优化实现无需模型评估的精确未来状态逼近，是一种通用、可插件化的扩散模型加速采样方案，跨模态有效。

Abstract: Diffusion models primarily rely on general-purpose ODE-based numerical methods for training-free accelerated sampling, but performance degrades with coarse time discretization. In this paper, we propose optimal linear leaps (LEAP), a specialized method grounded in theoretical and empirical investigations of sampling trajectory geometry. Built upon low-dimensionality and cross-trajectory consistency, LEAP formulates a supervised least-squares optimization problem within the local trajectory subspace, achieving a precise approximation of future states without model evaluations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LEAP outperforms previous methods across diverse modalities, including text-to-image (Stable Diffusion 3.5, FLUX.1-dev) and image-to-3D (TRELLIS.2) generation. Furthermore, LEAP can be seamlessly integrated into existing solver-based methods, offering a plug-and-play enhancement for modern diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/zju-pi/LEAP.

</details>


### [152] [Hihaze: One-Step Diffusion for High-Resolution Real-World Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25832)
*Zheng Chen,Yuchen Huang,Xiaoyang Liu,Jue Gong,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Hihaze，一种面向高分辨率真实图像去雾的单步扩散框架，含雾感知调制模块ASC与SDA，以及免训练全局引导分块融合GPF。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实去雾中高分辨率恢复困难：雾的空间非均匀性，以及分块推理时局部块之间预测不一致。

Method: 单步扩散框架；ASC将编码器可靠信息选择性注入VAE解码器以保留结构、抑制雾退化特征；SDA提取多尺度空间退化表征注入U-Net以按局部雾变化引导恢复；GPF为免训练的全局引导分块融合，用全局预测对齐分块外观并降低不可靠预测权重，再做结构引导细节补偿，可作为即插即用模块。

Result: 在四个真实基准上视觉质量与推理速度均优于SOTA；相较最强基线，Dense-Haze上PSNR提升约3.62 dB，NH-HAZE上约3.69 dB。

Conclusion: 通过雾感知调制与免训练分块融合，单步扩散可高效实现高分辨率真实去雾，并在质量与速度上取得兼顾。

Abstract: Diffusion models have recently achieved encouraging results in real-world image dehazing. However, restoring high-resolution images remains challenging due to spatially non-uniform haze and inconsistent predictions across local patches. To address these issues, we propose Hihaze, a one-step diffusion framework for high-resolution real-world dehazing. Hihaze adopts two haze-aware modulation modules: attentive skip compensation (ASC) and a spatial degradation adapter (SDA). ASC selectively transfers reliable encoder information to the variational autoencoder (VAE) decoder, preserving structural details while suppressing haze-degraded features. SDA extracts multi-scale spatial degradation representations and injects them into the U-Net to guide restoration according to local haze variations. Furthermore, we design a training-free global-guided patch fusion (GPF) method. It uses a global prediction to align patch appearance and downweight unreliable predictions, followed by structure-guided detail compensation. Notably, this training-free design also makes GPF a plug-and-play module for other dehazing models. Experiments across four real-world benchmarks show that Hihaze surpasses state-of-the-art approaches in both visual quality and inference speed. Specifically, it delivers PSNR improvements of 3.62~dB on Dense-Haze and 3.69~dB on NH-HAZE compared with the strongest baselines. Code: https://github.com/zhengchen1999/Hihaze.

</details>


### [153] [See the Future, Classify the Present: Stochastic Latent World Modeling for Hyperspectral Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25781)
*Muhammad Ahmad,Gemine Vivone,Ronny Hänsch,Ahmed Sohaib,Manuel Mazzara,Danfeng Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出随机潜在世界模型（LWM），以随机潜在状态多步预测构建潜空间轨迹来增强高光谱图像分类的表示学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高光谱图像分类（HSIC）依赖由有标签样本学到的静态空谱表示，难以建模潜在表示空间中的结构化依赖关系，因此在有限标签条件下表征能力受限。

Method: LWM为轨迹式表示学习框架：对高光谱patch用独立Transformer分支分别编码光谱与空间信息并融合为统一表示；将其组织为包含中心、邻域、光谱与全局上下文的环境状态；随后以高斯参数化与重参数化的随机潜在转移模块预测多个未来潜状态，并用循环式精修建模相邻状态依赖；由rollout规划器对潜轨迹自适应聚合生成规划表示，与基础表示融合后用于分类。

Result: 在五个基准数据集上，LWM总体精度为89.21%–99.52%，在有限标签设置下表现出稳定的分类性能。

Conclusion: 以随机多步潜在状态建模扩展静态空谱编码，可使分类器利用表示空间中的结构化依赖，为HSIC提供更丰富特征，验证了世界模型式潜轨迹机制在遥感分类任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Hyperspectral image classification (HSIC) relies on static spatial-spectral representations learned from labeled samples, limiting its ability to model structured dependencies in the latent representation space. To address this limitation, this work proposes Stochastic Latent World Modeling (LWM), a trajectory-based representation-learning framework that enriches classification through stochastic latent-state prediction. Given a hyperspectral patch, LWM tokenizes and encodes spectral and spatial information separately using dedicated transformer branches, then fuses their outputs into a unified representation. This representation is further organized into an environment state that captures center, neighborhood, spectral, and global contextual information. A stochastic latent transition module then predicts multiple future latent states through Gaussian parameterization and reparameterization, with recurrent refinement used to model dependencies across successive states. The resulting latent trajectory is adaptively aggregated by a rollout planner to construct a planned representation, which is integrated with the base representation for final classification. By extending static spatial-spectral encoding with stochastic multi-step latent-state modeling, LWM enables the classifier to exploit structured dependencies in the representation space and provides richer features for HSIC. Across five benchmark datasets, LWM achieves overall accuracies ranging from 89.21% to 99.52%, demonstrating consistent classification performance under limited-label settings.

</details>


### [154] [Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25666)
*Yian Zhao,Yu Yan,Hongcan Guo,Ruochong Zheng,Jian Zhang,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Fréchet Forcing，用三条无需教师的约束（生成锚定、上下文保真、真实对齐）在部署采样器上微调流式视频世界模型，使其超出训练视野后仍稳定并遵循动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频世界模型以自身过去与动作流为条件逐块生成，短片段训练导致长 rollout 时误差回灌并累积漂移。常用 DMD 自蒸馏在动作条件世界模型上遇瓶颈：外部视频教师对动作不可知，而模型自身预训练网络漂移方式与学生相同，均非合适教师。

Method: 核心观察：长 rollout 无需匹配教师，只需作为自身场景的真实延续并服从指令动作。据此在部署的多步采样器上联合微调，施加三项约束：(1) 生成锚定——在以真实数据结尾的自生成历史上施加 flow-matching 损失；(2) 上下文保真——以每段 clip 自身真值为中心，对自由 rollout 的隐统计量计算 Fréchet 距离(FD)；(3) 真实对齐——在冻结感知空间中对真实帧计算 FD。三目标均由短真实片段导出，无需长记录未来，故无需教师、在线判别器或长视频。

Result: 微调 MiniWorld-1B（预训练于 253 帧片段），最多 36 GPU 小时、381 帧片段上训练，rollout 在超过 4,000 帧后仍稳定，并在机器人操作与相机控制探索两类任务中持续遵循动作。

Conclusion: 通过分布统计约束替代教师蒸馏，可在极低算力下实现长视野稳定的动作条件世界模型，为流式生成的自回归误差累积提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.

</details>


### [155] [Visual Memory and Textual Alignment for Cross-Modal Few-Shot Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25641)
*Tianqi Wei,Zhi Chen,Xin Yu,Scott Chapman,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViTA-SAM：在SAM 3基础上融合视觉记忆与文本特征并做跨模态对齐的小样本分割框架，平均mIoU领先最强对比方法5%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小样本分割（FSS）旨在用少量标注样本分割目标。SAM 3虽具强视觉表征并支持文本引导分割，但在专业领域语义提示与视觉表征对齐不佳，性能受限。

Method: 构建视觉记忆模块，编码支持集特征及其掩码，为查询预测提供支持感知的视觉引导；并行使用SAM 3文本编码器提取语义特征作为互补先验；引入跨模态对齐模块，以记忆增强的视觉表示对文本特征进行条件化，获得更一致、视觉落地的预测；并提出伪标签精炼策略，用预测的查询掩码更新记忆，实现查询自适应表征学习。

Result: 在多个基准上取得对比方法中最佳的整体性能，平均mIoU超过最强竞争方法5%以上。

Conclusion: 通过视觉记忆与文本语义的跨模态对齐及记忆的自适应更新，可有效缓解专业领域中的模态失配问题，提升FSS泛化性能。

Abstract: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment target objects with limited annotated examples. Recent studies have begun to explore large foundation models to improve generalization for this task. In particular, SAM 3 provides strong visual representations and supports text-guided segmentation. However, its performance remains limited in specialized domains, where semantic prompts and visual representations are often poorly aligned. To address this challenge, we propose ViTA-SAM, a framework built upon SAM 3 that integrates visual memory and textual features through cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we construct a visual memory module that encodes support features together with their corresponding masks, providing support-aware visual guidance for query prediction. In parallel, we leverage the text encoder of SAM 3 to extract semantic features as complementary priors. To bridge the gap between semantic and visual representations, we introduce a cross-modal alignment module that conditions textual features on memory-enhanced visual representations, yielding more consistent and visually grounded predictions. In addition, we propose a pseudo-label refinement strategy that updates the memory with predicted query masks, enabling query-adaptive representation learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ViTA-SAM achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, outperforming the strongest competing method by over 5% in average mIoU.

</details>


### [156] [UBD-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Unimodal Branch Degradation in Multimodal Perception for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25448)
*Ang Liu,Xiang Gu,Ruikai Li,Qiyue Wang,Yizhe Fan,Hao Shan,Ziyang Yan,Han Jiang,Zhenning Li,Xiaoshuai Hao,Yilong Ren,Zhiyong Cui,Haiyang Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 UBD-Bench 基准，系统研究多模态联合训练下各单模态分支的表征退化（UBD）问题，发现 Camera 分支显著退化且呈模态不对称，并据此提出在退化表征处进行单模态到多模态蒸馏以改善性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态感知能提升自动驾驶性能，但输出层面的提升并不代表各模态分支的表征同样变强；分支层面的弱化在传统输出级评测中被掩盖，缺乏系统诊断手段。

Method: 构建 UBD-Bench：采用配对冻结分支探针（Paired Frozen-Branch Probe），在匹配解码条件下比较同一模态经独立单模态训练与多模态联合训练后的任务相关表征质量；覆盖 4 个自动驾驶感知任务与 10 个模型，并进行层级探针分析定位退化环节。基于诊断结果，在退化表征处引入单模态到多模态蒸馏。

Result: Camera 分支在多模态联合训练后一致退化，LiDAR 分支变化较弱且依赖模型，呈现明显的模态不对称；退化自视觉骨干经 Camera-to-BEV 通路延伸，在融合前的 Camera BEV 表征处最严重；所提蒸馏干预在全部四个任务上同时提升 Camera 分支探针性能与全模型性能。

Conclusion: 多模态整体收益可与单模态表征退化并存，分支级表征质量应作为评估与改进多模态感知的重要维度。

Abstract: Multimodal perception improves autonomous-driving performance by combining complementary sensor information. However, stronger multimodal predictions do not necessarily imply stronger representations in each modality-specific branch. Such branch-level weaknesses can remain hidden in conventional output-level evaluation. We introduce UBD-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying unimodal branch degradation (UBD) in multimodal perception. UBD-Bench uses a Paired Frozen-Branch Probe to compare the task-relevant representation quality of the same modality after independent unimodal training and multimodal joint training under matched decoding conditions. Across four autonomous-driving perception tasks and 10 models, we find that Camera branches consistently degrade after multimodal joint training, whereas LiDAR branches exhibit weaker and more model-dependent changes, revealing a pronounced modality asymmetry. Hierarchical probing further shows that Camera-branch degradation extends from the visual backbone through the Camera-to-BEV pathway and is most severe at the pre-fusion Camera BEV representation. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce unimodal-to-multimodal distillation at the degraded representation. This intervention consistently improves both Camera-branch Probe performance and full-model performance across all four tasks. These results show that multimodal gains can coexist with degraded unimodal representations, highlighting branch-level representation quality as an important dimension for evaluating and improving multimodal perception.

</details>


### [157] [Preserving the Manifold: Frozen Expert Alignment for Label-Efficient SAR Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25429)
*Eli A. Underwood,I. Taylor McKechnie,Leslie M. Collins*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Frozen Expert框架：冻结CROMA SAR编码器与CLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量约束残差桥接模块实现跨模态对齐，以缓解模态失配与物理遗忘，并定义Procrustes disparity量化物理遗忘；在零样本SAR场景分类上以更少数据超越微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR与自然语言跨模态对齐存在两大失败：一是模态失配——基于光学图像预训练的文本编码器（如CLIP）难以高效微调至SAR，因主动微波后向散射与被动光学反射在物理上不兼容，且SAR-文本数据集规模小若干数量级，微调易破坏已学语义流形；二是物理遗忘——大规模自监督预训练的SAR编码器所编码的雷达物理特性，在有限caption数据上微调对齐时被逐步抹除。

Method: 核心设计原则为"双端冻结、只学受约束且保持结构的桥接"：保持SAR编码器（CROMA）与CLIP文本编码器均冻结，仅训练轻量级约束残差桥接模块；并用Procrustes disparity形式化定义物理遗忘，衡量对齐后SAR几何被破坏的程度。

Result: 桥接模块比微调更好地保持SAR几何（disparity 0.210 vs 0.351）；在多个SAR骨干与文本编码器上验证了泛化性；零样本SAR场景分类在最多少用8倍训练数据下优于微调基线：DFC2020（R@1 +10.3%、mAP +15.5%），EuroSAT-SAR（R@1 +15.7%、mAP +12.2%），BigEarthNet-MM（R@1 +14.7%）。

Conclusion: 在高差异跨模态场景中，冻结流形对齐是相较微调更原理化且数据高效的替代方案。

Abstract: Cross-modal alignment of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery to natural language is constrained by two distinct failures. The first is modality mismatch: text encoders pre-trained on optical imagery, such as CLIP, cannot be efficiently fine-tuned on SAR, because active microwave backscatter is physically incompatible with passive optical reflectance and the available SAR caption datasets are orders of magnitude too small to bridge this gap without substantially degrading the learned semantic manifold. The second is physical forgetting: SAR encoders pre-trained on large-scale self-supervised objectives encode radar physics that are progressively erased when the encoder is fine-tuned for text alignment on limited caption data. A single design principle addresses both failures: keep both encoders frozen and learn only a constrained, structure-preserving bridge. Our Frozen Expert framework aligns a frozen CROMA SAR encoder with a frozen CLIP text encoder via a lightweight constrained residual bridge. We formally define physical forgetting via Procrustes disparity and show our bridge preserves SAR geometry significantly better than fine-tuning (disparity: 0.210 vs. 0.351). We validate generality across multiple SAR backbones and text encoders. On zero-shot SAR scene classification, our approach outperforms fine-tuned baselines using up to 8x less training data: DFC2020 (+10.3% R@1, +15.5% mAP), EuroSAT-SAR (+15.7% R@1, +12.2% mAP), BigEarthNet-MM (+14.7% R@1). These results establish frozen manifold alignment as a principled, data-efficient alternative to fine-tuning in high-disparity cross-modal settings.

</details>


### [158] [MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25404)
*Houyuan Chen,Fanzhou Wang,Xiangyu Fan,Zesong Qiu,Yukun Wei,Songlin Yang,Zhitao Yang,Lvmin Zhang,Pei Yang,Hao Zhao,Lei Yang,Anyi Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MT Forcing 训练范式，通过单轮分布匹配蒸馏（Single-Turn DMD）与教师强制引导（Teacher-Forcing Guidance）缓解多轮图像编辑中的视觉质量漂移与内容不一致问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮图像编辑方法在仅数轮编辑后即出现明显漂移：一是视觉质量不稳定，伪影累积、细节退化；二是图像内容不一致，非编辑区域与先前编辑被意外改变。

Method: 面向基于自回归扩散的统一多模态模型（UMMs），提出 MT Forcing 训练范式。1）Single-Turn DMD：用教师模型对源图一次性施加累积编辑，监督学生的自rollout，提供视觉质量指导且不产生递归误差累积；2）Teacher-Forcing Guidance：在 warmup 阶段基于参考轨迹监督依赖历史的转移动态，并在蒸馏阶段作为正则项，增强跨轮内容一致性。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提升 UMMs 的多轮图像编辑能力，视觉质量更稳定，跨轮一致性更强。

Conclusion: 单轮蒸馏式质量监督结合历史依赖的教师引导，可有效抑制多轮编辑的漂移，为统一多模态模型的多轮交互式图像编辑提供可行训练方案。

Abstract: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

</details>


### [159] [CASE: Complementary Articulation-Aware Speech Encoder to Enhance Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25342)
*Jaehong Myung,Seungho Eum,Taegon Kim,Hyunjung Chung,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CASE：通过对齐语音片段与3D唇部网格VQ-VAE潜变量的对比式适配，使通用自监督语音编码器获得发音动力学信息，再经残差跨注意力与基线SSL表示融合，在VOCASET四种生成器上降低唇部与全脸顶点误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用自监督语音编码器的预训练目标未显式对齐语音驱动的3D面部动画所需的可见发音（唇部）动力学，表示与下游任务存在目标错位。

Method: 构建CASE编码器：用短语音片段与连续3D唇部网格的VQ-VAE潜变量做对比式对齐适配；适配后移除几何分支，仅保留音频端CASE表示，并通过残差跨注意力与基线SSL语音表示融合，保持原运动解码器结构与训练目标不变。

Result: 在VOCASET四个基线上，平均唇部顶点误差(LVE)下降2.8–6.0%，且每个系统的平均全脸顶点误差均下降；在同一融合协议下，CASE在全部四个生成器上均优于未适配的AV-SE流，幅度依模型而异。

Conclusion: 显式的发音感知对齐可作为通用SSL语音表示的有效补充；由于适配使用韩语语音-几何对、评测使用英语VOCASET，结果与"在共享英语预训练音视频先验下的跨语言下游迁移"相一致。

Abstract: General-purpose self-supervised speech encoders provide strong acoustic representations, but their pretraining objectives are not explicitly aligned with the visible articulatory dynamics required by speech-driven 3D facial animation. We propose CASE (Complementary Articulation-aware Speech Encoder), a complementary speech encoder adapted by contrastively aligning short speech clips with continuous 3D lip-mesh VQ-VAE latents. After adaptation, the geometry branch is removed, and the audio-only CASE representation is fused with the baseline SSL speech representation through residual cross-attention, while retaining the motion-decoder architecture and objective. Across four VOCASET baselines, CASE reduces mean lip vertex error by 2.8-6.0%, and mean full-face vertex error decreases in every system. Under the same fusion protocol, CASE yields lower mean LVE than the unadapted AV-SE stream on all four generators, with model-dependent margins. Because adaptation uses Korean speech-geometry pairs and evaluation uses English VOCASET, the result is consistent with cross-language downstream transfer under a shared English-pretrained audio-visual prior.

</details>


### [160] [CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25333)
*Lin Zhao,Bowen Chen,Qiaohui Gao,Shaowen Wan,Xiang Li,Wei Liu,Tianming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出条件响应状态世界模型CoRe-WM，将纵向pCR预测建模为潜在状态转移动力学学习，冻结参数后用线性读出实现各决策点的病理完全缓解预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新辅助化疗后的pCR是侵袭性乳腺癌的关键预后指标，但现有方法或仅用治疗前影像、忽略患者响应的动态演化，或在直接结局监督下优化多访视分类器，导致表征学习与临床终点耦合、易过拟合于有限标签。

Method: 将纵向pCR预测表述为世界建模问题：学习潜在状态转移模型，由观测序列预测下一影像状态。转移函数通过加性偏移与特征级调制，以患者临床画像和既定治疗方案为条件，实现患者与治疗特异的动力学；并引入因子化响应状态通路，编码"响应主要体现于病灶形态"的结构先验，将治疗响应动力学与影像外观解耦。预训练后冻结全部参数，用线性读出在各临床决策点预测pCR。

Result: 在I-SPY2上以五折交叉验证评估，并在I-SPY1上检验跨队列迁移；CoRe-WM在所有评估方法中于每个前瞻性决策点取得最高判别性能，并展现稳健的跨队列迁移能力。消融实验表明患者画像条件化与因子化响应通路是主要贡献来源。

Conclusion: 结果确立了基于世界模型的表征学习作为肿瘤学及其他领域结局预测的有前景框架。

Abstract: Pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy is a key prognostic indicator in aggressive breast cancer, yet existing prediction approaches either rely on pretreatment imaging alone, missing the patient's evolving response, or optimize multi-visit classifiers under direct outcome supervision, coupling representation learning with the clinical endpoint. We formulate longitudinal pCR prediction as a world-modeling problem and propose Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM), which learns a latent state-transition model that predicts the next imaging state from the observed sequence. The transition function is conditioned on patient clinical profile and assigned therapy through additive shift and feature-wise modulation, enabling patient- and treatment-specific dynamics. A Factorized Response State pathway further decouples treatment-response dynamics from imaging appearance by encoding the structural prior that response manifests primarily in lesion morphology. After pretraining, all parameters are frozen and a linear readout predicts pCR at each clinical decision point. We evaluate CoRe-WM on I-SPY2 under five-fold cross-validation and assess cross-cohort transfer on I-SPY1. CoRe-WM achieves the highest discrimination among all evaluated methods at every prospective decision point, and demonstrates robust cross-cohort transfer. Ablation studies identify patient-profile conditioning and the factorized response pathway as the principal contributors. These results establish world-model-based representation learning as a promising framework for outcome prediction in oncology and beyond.

</details>


### [161] [The Explainability Illusion: Must ViTs Exhibit Patch-Decoding Interpretability?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25289)
*Ronen Schaffer,Hila Manor,Tomer Michaeli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究视觉Transformer(ViT)的token解码可解释性，发现其并非架构固有属性，而高度依赖优化环境，模型可能呈现对齐解释、反转解释或无关联，理论上给出同一toy架构可多种方式实现最优分类规则的证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT中解码单个patch token因常产生人可解释输出而成为流行诊断工具，但作者质疑token解码可解释性究竟是Transformer跨架构、规模与训练目标的固有性质，还是某种隐含偏置的产物，故需系统检验。

Method: 跨多样ViT设置（架构、规模、训练目标），结合受控实验与真实模型系统研究token解码可解释性；并通过构造toy transformer场景进行理论分析，证明单一固定架构能以多种方式实现最优分类规则。

Result: 部分模型呈现对齐且可解释的token解码，另一些则出现反转的解释图或与图像语义完全无相关；这些差异并非架构内在，可随优化景观变化而任意改变。

Conclusion: token解码可解释性并非训练后Transformer的固有属性，而是取决于问题设置的结果，不应被先验假定成立。

Abstract: Transformers are widely assumed to exhibit token-decoding explainability. In particular, in vision transformer (ViT) classifiers, decoding individual patch tokens has become a common diagnostic tool due to its tendency to yield human-interpretable outputs. In light of the increasing popularity of this approach, an important question is whether token-decoding explainability is an inherent property of transformers that should be expected to hold across architectures, scales, and training objectives, or merely an artifact of some implicit bias. In this paper we systematically study token-decoding explainability across diverse ViT settings, spanning architectures, scales, and training objectives, using both controlled experiments and real-world models. We find that while some models indeed exhibit aligned and interpretable token decodings, others exhibit either inverted explainability maps or a complete lack of correlation with the image semantics. As we show, these tendencies toward different explainability behaviors are not intrinsic to the architecture and can vary arbitrarily with changes in the optimization landscape. We provide theoretical support for these observations by demonstrating a setting where a single fixed toy transformer architecture can provably implement the optimal classification rule in multiple ways, which differ in their patch-decoding explainability patterns. Our results show that token-decoding explainability is not an inherent property of trained transformers, but rather an outcome contingent on the problem setting and thus should not be a-priori assumed to hold. Code can be found in https://ronensc.github.io/Explainability-Illusion/ .

</details>


### [162] [Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25276)
*Yushi Lan,Zeren Jiang,Koichi Namekata,Xingang Pan,Chuanxia Zheng,Andrea Vedaldi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Holo4D 提出一种视频重拍框架，将前馈 4D 重建得到的 3D 轨迹作为源视角 4D 脚手架，投影到目标视角以条件化预训练视频扩散模型，实现保持场景几何与运动的新轨迹单目视频合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从新相机轨迹合成单目视频需同时保持已观测场景几何与运动，并补全新可见区域。前馈 4D 重建能恢复已观测结构，视频扩散模型具备生成先验，但二者尚未被有效统一。

Method: 以重建的 3D 轨迹作为整体源视角 4D 脚手架：将轨迹投影到目标视角，编码其几何与源外观，连同源视频和目标相机共同条件化预训练视频扩散模型；无支撑区域交由生成先验完成。框架可替换不同 4D 重建器且无需重训视频生成器。

Result: 实验表明基于轨迹的条件化对相机控制与新视角合成具有价值，并验证了框架对不同 4D 重建器的兼容性。

Conclusion: 将 4D 重建与视频扩散生成先验结合可有效完成视频重拍，且模块化设计使框架可持续受益于源重建技术的进步。

Abstract: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.

</details>


### [163] [PanoDent-KD: From Generalist Knowledge Distillation to Cross-Dataset Specialist Detection and Embedded Deployment in Panoramic Radiographs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25256)
*Muhammad Waqas Ashraf,Imad Ali Shah,Ali Hassan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PanoDent-KD：基于YOLO26m的12类全景牙片检测流程，经知识蒸馏与分类头行迁移得到5类专科模型，并在Jetson Orin Nano上完成TensorRT FP16部署；三组源训练方案macro box F1均约0.82，KD未提升目标域精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景牙片检测在不同数据集类别定义与部署软件间难以保持一致性，需要可审计、可跨域迁移且能落地的检测流程。

Method: 以1280像素YOLO26m为骨干，构建12类源域通用模型；比较三种源训练方案（监督基线B1、单教师蒸馏STKD、多教师蒸馏MTKD）×3个随机种子；通过精确复制5行分类器权重初始化9个OralXrays-9五类专科模型（backbone、FPN-PAN neck与双检测头结构保持不变，无教师微调）；统一训练/评估流程，并在Jetson Orin Nano Super上以FP16 TensorRT部署。

Result: 2,686张测试子集上三种方案macro box F1均接近0.82；B1取得最高三seed平均macro box F1 0.8239±0.0027与mAP50:95 0.6130±0.0067。部署用STKD seed 1（开发期选定、最终测试前确定）：延迟中位77.03 ms、P95 80.86 ms，吞吐12.90 img/s，总模块能耗1.39 J/image，设备内PyTorch与TensorRT FP16推理数值高度一致。

Conclusion: 验证了可审计、面向特定设备的部署流程可行，但未证明临床有效性，也未证明KD能提升目标域精度。

Abstract: Reliable panoramic-radiograph detection requires consistency across datasets with different class definitions and deployment software. We present PanoDent-KD, an auditable 1280-pixel YOLO26m pipeline linking a 12-class source generalist, feature-level knowledge distillation (KD), exact classifier-row transfer, teacher-free five-class specialization, and embedded deployment. A common training and evaluation pipeline compares three source-training arms across three seeds: a supervised baseline (B1), single-teacher KD (STKD), and multi-teacher KD (MTKD). Five shared classifier rows initialize nine OralXrays-9 specialists, while the backbone, FPN-PAN neck, and dual-detection-head topology are retained unchanged. On the 2,686-image test subset, all three arms achieve macro box F1 near 0.82. B1 achieves the highest three-seed arm-level mean macro box F1 (0.8239$\pm$0.0027) and $mAP_{50:95}$ (0.6130$\pm$0.0067). STKD seed 1, selected after development but before final testing, was used for deployment. Its Jetson Orin Nano Super FP16 TensorRT engine achieves 77.03-ms median and 80.86-ms P95 prediction-call latency, throughput of 12.90 images/s, and gross total-module energy of 1.39 J/image, with high numerical agreement between within-device PyTorch and TensorRT FP16 inference. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of an auditable, device-specific deployment workflow, but do not establish clinical validity or improved target-domain accuracy from KD.

</details>


### [164] [Evaluating Cloud and Self-Hosted OCR Systems for Arabic, English, and French Documents: Bounding Box Detection, Text Recognition, and Mathematical Expression Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25235)
*Jumana Alsubhi,Ahmed Alhusayni,Abdulrahman Gharawi,Israa Hamdine,Khadija Alansari,Alshaymaa Allahim,Lamees Alhumaid,Ahmad Shabana*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究系统比较多款云端与自托管OCR系统在多语种（阿拉伯语、英语、法语）档案上的检测、识别与数学公式识别表现，并强调评估需引入不确定性估计与结构化校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语种档案选择OCR系统时需在准确性与部署约束间权衡，而单一汇总识别分数可能掩盖结构性错误（如变量替换、数字体系改写），难以支撑可靠的系统选型决策。

Method: 在三个任务上评估：48页阿拉伯/英/法文档的边界框检测（页面级视觉评级）、9类文档共315页的文本识别（以Gemini生成参考转写计算CER）、83个英/阿数学表达式识别（对照已知答案评分）；主要估计附95%区间并进行配对比较。

Result: Google Document AI与Surya在48页中分别有47页（98%）和46页（96%）生成Good行框；Datalab、Azure Document Intelligence、Document AI平均CER为0.145–0.152，未调整配对比较未见差异；自托管系统中Surya平均CER最低（0.199）；数学测试无统计上明确的领先者；严格校验显示近满分页面分数可能掩盖阿拉伯变量被替换或东阿拉伯数字被改写为西式数字等问题。

Conclusion: 可靠的OCR评估除聚合识别分数外，还必须包含不确定性估计、结构性校验与针对特定记号的测试。

Abstract: Choosing an OCR system for a multilingual archive requires balancing accuracy against deployment constraints. This study compares cloud and self-hosted systems on three tasks: bounding box detection on 48 Arabic, English, and French pages, text recognition on 315 pages across nine document types, and mathematical expression recognition on 83 English and Arabic samples. Detection was assessed by page-level visual grades, text by character error rate (CER) against a Gemini-generated reference transcription, and mathematics by scores against known answers. Main estimates are accompanied by 95% intervals and paired comparisons. Google Document AI and Surya produced Good line boxes on 47 of 48 (98%) and 46 of 48 (96%) pages. Datalab, Azure Document Intelligence, and Document AI had mean CERs of 0.145-0.152, with no difference detected in unadjusted paired comparisons. Surya had the lowest mean CER among self-hosted systems (0.199). No mathematical test had a statistically clear leader. Strict checks showed that near-perfect page scores could conceal a replaced Arabic variable or Eastern Arabic digits rewritten in Western form. Reliable evaluation therefore requires uncertainty estimates, structural checks, and notation-specific tests in addition to aggregate recognition scores.

</details>


### [165] [GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26091)
*Tao Sun,Huanting Guo,Baao Xie,Zhou Fang,Qiuyu Chen,Hao Zheng,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoNaviDiff，将StyleSpace解耦干预迁移为扩散h-空间的局部黎曼轨迹，无需编辑参考或因子专用模型，实现高保真、因子选择性强的真实图像解耦编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实图像解耦编辑需因子级语义控制，同时保持图像保真与非目标内容。StyleSpace虽可解释但受限于GAN反演；扩散模型图像实现能力强，却缺乏显式因子化解耦控制基。

Method: 无监督跨空间框架：从匹配的StyleGAN重建-编辑对中提取球面Log-map切向量，并平行传输至真实图像扩散状态，构建解耦重建的监督；共享的因子条件Navigator在推理时预测该切向量；配合保范测地实现与源锚定rollout稳定反向过程。

Result: 多数据集实验表明，在保真度、因子选择性、编辑局部性与轨迹平滑性上均优于对比方法。

Conclusion: 以StyleSpace解耦先验引导扩散h-空间测地轨迹，可在无编辑参考、无因子专用模型条件下实现可控的真实图像解耦编辑。

Abstract: Disentangled real-image manipulation requires factor-specific semantic control while preserving image fidelity and non-target content. StyleSpace $S$ provides interpretable controls but is limited by GAN inversion, whereas diffusion models offer stronger image realization without an explicit factorized control basis. We introduce GeoNaviDiff, an unsupervised cross-space framework that transfers disentangled StyleSpace interventions to local Riemannian trajectories in diffusion $h$-space. GeoNaviDiff constructs reconstruction-decoupled supervision by extracting a spherical Log-map tangent from a matched StyleGAN reconstruction-edit pair and parallel-transporting it to the real-image diffusion state. A shared, factor-conditioned Navigator predicts this tangent at inference, while norm-preserving geodesic realization and source-anchored rollout stabilize the reverse process without edited references or factor-specific models. Experiments across multiple datasets show that GeoNaviDiff outperforms the compared methods in fidelity, factor selectivity, edit locality, and trajectory smoothness.

</details>


### [166] [RGB--Event Object Detection Across Operating Frequencies via Reliability-Supervised Routing and Asymmetric-Resolution Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26090)
*Peijun Shi,Jiannan Zhao,Xiujin Zhu,Zhenguo Lao,Chee-Onn Chow,Wei Ru Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可靠性监督路由（reliability-supervised routing）与非对称分辨率融合的 RGB-事件检测器 ERA-Det，在 DSEC-Det 上以 63.2 mAP 刷新 SOTA，显著降低高频操作下的精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需以高于帧率的频率做出目标检测决策，此时每个决策对应的事件窗口更稀疏，事件相对帧的可靠性在空间与时间上均变化。现有检测器仅在样本级对传感器加权，且将帧编码到降低后的事件分辨率上，无法刻画逐位置的可靠性差异。

Method: 1) 可靠性监督路由：为每个位置分配融合权重，并以两个单模态分类器的损失在训练阶段构造监督目标，将基于损失的融合权重监督从样本级推进到位置级；2) 非对称分辨率融合：帧以原生分辨率编码，各层级特征池化到事件网格上融合，复用全部预训练权重，使帧在事件失效处承担决策。

Result: DSEC-Det 上，路由将 20→180 Hz 的精度损失由 6.3 mAP 减半至 3.1 mAP，且在每个随机种子下均有效；ERA-Det 达到 63.2 mAP，较 FlexEvent 高 3.7 mAP，在所有操作频率上领先，180 Hz 时精度仍优于 FlexEvent 的 20 Hz；两个 DAVIS346 数据集上，路由器在夜间与弱光下降低帧权重、在事件消失时提高帧权重；可在单 GPU 上 5000 次迭代微调已发布的 FlexEvent 权重。

Conclusion: 逐位置的可靠性监督路由与非对称分辨率融合有效利用了高时间分辨率事件的稀疏性差异，ERA-Det 在多种频率与光照条件下均优于现有方法，并可低成本地从现有权重升级。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles must detect objects faster than a frame camera delivers images. Event cameras record brightness changes with microsecond resolution, so RGB--event detectors can decide between frames, at an operating frequency, the rate of decisions, far above the frame rate. As this rate rises, each decision receives a sparser event window, and the reliability of the events relative to the frame varies over the scene and over time. Existing detectors weight the sensors per sample and encode the frame at the reduced event resolution. Reliability-supervised routing assigns a fusion weight to every location and supervises it with targets from the losses of two single-modality classifiers used only in training, moving loss-based supervision of fusion weights from whole samples to individual locations. Asymmetric-resolution fusion lets the frame carry the decision where the events fail: it encodes the frame at native resolution and pools every feature level onto the event grid, reusing all pretrained weights. On the DSEC-Det dataset, routing halves the accuracy loss from 20 to 180 Hz, from 6.3 to 3.1 mAP, and lowers it in every seed. The resulting detector, ERA-Det, sets a new state of the art at 63.2 mAP, 3.7 mAP above FlexEvent, leads at every operating frequency, and at 180 Hz is more accurate than FlexEvent at 20 Hz. On two DAVIS346 datasets, the router lowers the frame weight at night and in low light and raises it when the events vanish. ERA-Det upgrades released FlexEvent weights in 5,000 iterations on one GPU.

</details>


### [167] [DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26081)
*Deshui Miao,Yuhang Ma,Shaoyong Jia,Wenzhao Gao,Yue Zhang,Shaohui Jiao,Xin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出源锚定流模型DeOverlay，以固定源引导从源潜变量重建无遮挡视频，并构建DVTE-Bench基准，五个指标全面超越四个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频叠加物（字幕、标题、logo）去除方法依赖时序传播或源条件生成，当有用源信息被遮挡时会残留叠加物并扭曲场景结构，缺乏面向多样叠加条件的统一评测基准。

Method: DeOverlay：源锚定（source-anchored）流模型，沿成对源→干净路径训练共享速度网络，采用区域加权流匹配，支持从中间状态逐步修正；提出可见性归一化时序聚合，排除被掩码位置并对剩余观测取平均以选取局部源线索；全局源上下文与编辑区域嵌入通过加性条件注入，保持单一视频token序列。同时构建DVTE-Bench（1,631对视频、8类文本叠加、OCR筛选的干净目标、帧对齐像素掩码及统一评测协议）。

Result: 在完整发布集上，DeOverlay在全部五项重建与感知指标上优于四个基线，Mask LPIPS与Mask VFID相对最强基线分别降低58.3%与70.3%；定性示例显示可去除图形logo与贴纸。

Conclusion: 固定源引导的流式重建思路可有效抑制残留叠加并保持场景结构，配套基准为多样叠加条件下的场景恢复评测提供统一平台；完整基准、评测代码与测试输出将公开。

Abstract: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. Existing methods use temporal propagation or source-conditioned generation, but can leave residual overlays and distort scene structure when useful source information is obscured. We propose DeOverlay, a source-anchored flow model that reconstructs the clean video from the source latent with fixed source guidance. Specifically, we train a shared velocity network along paired source-to-clean paths using region-weighted flow matching, enabling successive cor- rections from intermediate states. To select local source cues, we develop visibility-normalized temporal aggregation that excludes masked positions and averages the remaining observations. Global source context and edit-region embeddings complement these cues through additive condi- tioning, retaining a single video-token sequence. To evaluate scene recovery across diverse overlay conditions, we introduce DVTE-Bench, comprising 1,631 paired videos across eight text-overlay categories, with OCR-screened clean targets, frame-aligned pixel masks, and a common evaluation protocol. Experiments on the complete release show that DeOverlay outperforms four baselines on all five reconstruction and perceptual metrics, reducing Mask LPIPS and Mask VFID by 58.3% and 70.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. Additional qualitative examples demonstrate the removal of graphic logos and stickers. We will make the complete benchmark, evaluation code, and test outputs availabl. Project page:https://yahooo-m.github.io/DVTE-Bench/

</details>


### [168] [PhysSkin++: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26067)
*Yuanhang Lei,Baofei Liu,Xingxuan Li,Tao Cheng,Zixuan Wang,Boming Zhao,Yujun Shen,Siyuan Huang,Ruizhen Hu,Peter Yichen Chen,Hujun Bao,Zhaopeng Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhysSkin++框架，从静态几何学习连续神经蒙皮场，构建紧凑形变子空间，实现跨形状、跨离散化（网格/点云/3D高斯）的实时物理动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实时物理动画方法难以泛化到多样3D形状与不同空间离散化，且逐对象训练网络代价高；同时缺乏仿真轨迹时难以学习形变子空间。

Method: 1) 神经蒙皮场自编码器，无需逐对象训练即可预测形状相关形变子空间；2) 物理信息自监督学习策略，结合蒙皮场归一化与冲突感知梯度修正，在物理与正交约束下稳定联合优化；3) 面向预设骨架动画的自监督互补性目标，学习互补弹性响应而无需运行时施加互补约束。

Result: 实验表明所学蒙皮场具备跨形状泛化能力，支持实时降阶仿真，并可实现可控、碰撞感知及骨架互补的动画应用，且能直接绑定网格、点云与3D高斯。

Conclusion: PhysSkin++以静态几何为输入构建可泛化的连续神经蒙皮场子空间，无需仿真轨迹与逐对象训练，为多表示、实时、可控的物理动画提供统一框架。

Abstract: Generalizing real-time physics-based animation across diverse 3D shapes and spatial discretizations remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce PhysSkin++, a physics-informed framework that learns continuous neural skinning fields from static geometries to construct compact deformation subspaces. Specifically, we propose a Neural Skinning Fields Autoencoder that predicts shape-dependent deformation subspaces without per-object network training. To learn these subspaces without simulation trajectories, we develop a Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Learning strategy that combines skinning-field normalization with conflict-aware gradient correction, stabilizing joint optimization under physical and orthogonality constraints. The learned representation supports efficient reduced dynamics with user control and contact interactions, together with direct animation binding to meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians. For prescribed rig animation, we further introduce a self-supervised complementarity objective to learn complementary elastic responses without enforcing complementarity constraints at runtime. Experiments demonstrate cross-shape generalization of the learned skinning fields, real-time reduced simulation, and applications to controllable, collision-aware, and rig-complementary animation.

</details>


### [169] [MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25345)
*Yifei Wang,Wei Tian,Wenhua Bao,Jia Zhou,Hanshi Wang,Fudong Ge,Jianhua Wu,Shuai Yuan,Zhipeng Zhang,Xingliang Liu,Xianming Zeng,Jianyun Xu,Bingzhao Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MCSplat，一个多视角一致的前馈高斯泼溅框架，通过构建深度引导的规范外观空间解耦几何与相机特定外观，并用Fisher信息不确定性自适应加权表面法向自监督，从而提升稀疏视角驾驶场景重建的质量与泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏多视角图像的前馈高斯泼溅驾驶场景重建面临两大挑战：(1) 跨相机光度不一致（曝光、ISP、光照差异）会被错误地吸收进高斯几何；(2) 深度不连续处的法向约束带来不可靠的局部几何监督。

Method: 1) 基于深度引导的多相机对应关系构建规范外观空间，将几何学习与相机特定外观解耦；2) 多尺度Bilateral Grid Transformer从规范渲染恢复原始相机外观，实现不污染几何的光度监督；3) 从光度敏感性估计Fisher信息不确定性，自适应加权表面朝向自监督。

Result: 在多个驾驶数据集上重建质量与泛化性提升；几何评估显示跨视角深度一致性与局部表面法向一致性增强；定性结果显示重叠视角间的几何伪影减少、结构更连贯。

Conclusion: 通过外观-几何解耦与不确定性加权几何监督，可有效解决稀疏多视角驾驶场景前馈高斯重建中的光度不一致与局部几何监督不可靠问题。

Abstract: Driving-scene reconstruction via feed-forward Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images remains challenging due to two factors. First, cross-camera photometric inconsistency, caused by variations in exposure, ISP, and illumination, can be incorrectly absorbed into Gaussian geometry. Second, unreliable local geometric supervision arises from normal-based constraints near depth discontinuities. To address these issues, we present \textbf{MCSplat}, a multi-view consistent feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for driving scenes. MCSplat constructs a canonical appearance space from depth-guided multi-camera correspondences to decouple geometry learning from camera-specific appearance. A multi-scale Bilateral Grid Transformer restores raw camera appearance from canonical renderings, enabling photometric supervision without contaminating Gaussian geometry. To improve local geometric reliability, we estimate Fisher-information-based uncertainty from photometric sensitivity and use it to adaptively weight surface-oriented self-supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and generalization across driving datasets. Geometry-oriented evaluations further reveal enhanced cross-view depth consistency and local surface-normal agreement, while qualitative results show fewer geometric artifacts and more coherent structures across overlapping views.

</details>


### [170] [From Cause to Effect: Generating Intermediate Event Chains in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26275)
*Ridouane Ghermi,Vicky Kalogeiton,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出因果链生成（CCG）任务及配套评测框架（SODA-Embedding、Causal-QA两指标；SF20K-CC与CMD-CC两测试集），揭示现有VLM叙事因果推理不足，并用GRPO+复合奖励微调显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM视觉识别强但因果推理弱；当前评测存在缺陷：多选题QA可被捷径利用，开放式QA缺乏稳健的自动评估手段，难以可靠衡量真实推理能力。

Method: 提出CCG任务：要求模型生成连接原因与结果的中间事件序列，结构化输出便于自动评分。配套两指标：SODA-Embedding衡量生成链与参考链的语义匹配，Causal-QA通过提问链中是否包含重建叙事所需的特定因果事实来检验因果连贯性。构建两个测试集：SF20K-CC（20部短片的人工标注诊断集）与CMD-CC（基于音频描述的电影片段基准）。并用GRPO微调VLM，奖励为格式奖励、SODA-Embedding与Causal-QA准确率的复合。

Result: 分析显示当前SOTA VLM在叙事因果理解上表现不佳，频繁幻觉或遗漏关键事件；采用GRPO复合奖励微调后，相对强基线取得显著提升。

Conclusion: CCG任务提供了要求真实推理且可可靠自动评测的框架，可作为诊断并改进VLM叙事因果理解的有效手段，微调结果验证了该奖励设计的有效性。

Abstract: Video-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual recognition but struggle with causal reasoning. Current evaluations are flawed: multiple-choice QA allows shortcuts, and open-ended QA lacks robust automatic evaluation. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a novel task where models have to generate the sequence of intermediate events connecting a cause and an effect. This structured setup demands genuine reasoning and enables reliable automatic scoring. We accompany this task with two complementary metrics: SODA-Embedding, which measures the semantic matching of a generated chain against a reference, and Causal-QA, which probes the chain's causal coherence by asking whether it contains the specific causal facts needed to reconstruct the narrative. We provide two test sets: SF20K-CC, a manually annotated diagnostic on 20 short films, and CMD-CC, a movie clip benchmark derived from audio descriptions. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with narrative causality understanding, frequently hallucinating or omitting key events. To address this, we fine-tune VLMs with GRPO using a composite reward that combines a format reward, SODA-Embedding, and Causal-QA accuracy, demonstrating substantial improvements over strong baselines.

</details>


### [171] [RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26244)
*Tiange Xu,Kai Liu,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RECAP: 免训练地将稀疏注意力与分层缓存通过"互惠校正"耦合，由在线误差反馈自适应协调，在视频扩散Transformer上实现3.05倍加速且保真度优于直接组合方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer生成视频质量高但计算昂贵。稀疏注意力（步内）与时间缓存（跨步）天然可组合，但稀疏注意力的误差会作为后续时间复用的输入源，沿采样轨迹累积放大，导致保真度下降。作者观察到：提升这些"源"的精度可在不改变复用调度的情况下恢复保真度；且稀疏化误差在相邻步间方向一致，说明校正信息可共享而非重复计算。

Method: 提出RECAP，一种免训练方法：缓存得到的稠密精化结果校正当前稀疏估计中被省略的注意力交互；新鲜稀疏统计量用于追踪输入变化并调节"老化"校正项；校正后的预测再用于更新整步预测复用的源，使预测历史可在稠密刷新之间持续推进。整个过程由在线误差反馈自适应协调。

Result: 在多个视频扩散模型上与稀疏注意力方法、缓存方法及其直接组合对比；在HunyuanVideo 720p、5秒生成任务上取得3.05倍加速，并在保真度与推理速度上均优于所有测试的直接组合方案。

Conclusion: 稀疏注意力与时间缓存的简单叠加会因误差耦合而受损；通过共享方向一致的校正信息并进行互惠校正，可解耦该误差累积，实现免训练的高效高质量视频生成。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.

</details>


### [172] [SAR2Net: Learning Spatially Anchored Representations for Retrieval-Guided Cross-Stain Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26217)
*Tianle Shen,Fang Yan,Xiaofan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAR2Net将跨染色WSI配准重构成区域级特征检索问题，通过学习相对组织标志点的空间锚定表示，实现形变不变的组织拓扑描述，在严重组织扭曲下实现鲁棒配准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨染色WSI空间对齐是融合形态学与分子信息的关键，但WSI分辨率极高、组织碎片化且存在大尺度非线性形变。传统配准流程依赖全局预对齐与空间一致性假设，在此类形变下往往失效。

Method: 提出SAR2Net框架：(1) 不估计显式变换，而是学习逐点表示，编码相对于组织标志点的空间关系；(2) 给定标志点与任意坐标，预测空间锚定特征，作为形变不变的组织拓扑描述子；(3) 采用两阶段检索框架建立切片间对应关系，无需全局对齐即可完成匹配。

Result: 在面向活检的HE-IHC数据集上，SAR2Net在严重组织扭曲条件下实现鲁棒的区域级对齐，性能优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 将跨染色配准转化为区域级特征检索可规避全局对齐与空间一致性假设的局限，空间锚定表示为实现形变不变的跨染色WSI配准提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Achieving spatial alignment between whole-slide images(WSIs) across stains is essential for integrating morphology and molecular information, yet it remains challenging due to extreme resolution, tissue fragmentation, and large nonlinear deformations. Conventional registration pipelines depend on global pre-alignment and spatial consistency, which often collapse under such distortions. We present SAR2Net, a framework that learns spatially anchored representations and reformulates cross-stain alignment as a region-level feature retrieval problem. Instead of estimating explicit transformations, SAR2Net learns pointwise representations encoding the relative spatial relationships to tissue landmarks. Given landmarks and arbitrary coordinates, it predicts spatially anchored features that serve as deformation-invariant descriptors of tissue topology. A twostage retrieval framework then establishes correspondences between slides, even when global alignment is infeasible. Experiments on biopsy-oriented HE-IHC datasets show that SAR2Net achieves robust region-level alignment under severe tissue distortions, outperforming previous methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.

</details>


### [173] [HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26183)
*Yong Li,Xiaojie Wang,Xiaoyan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HP-PnP-Flow 算法，通过采用不同的时间调度和额外的像素空间投影算子，将 PnP 框架与 flow matching 更高效地结合，在温和假设下获得严格收敛保证，并在多类图像恢复任务上以更少迭代次数超越 PnP-Flow。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PnP-Flow（Martin et al., ICLR 2025）方法依赖受限的迭代条件才能保证收敛，缺乏对一般情形下严谨收敛性的支持，且迭代效率与重构质量仍有提升空间。

Method: 在 PnP 框架与 flow matching 结合的基础上，引入不同的时间调度（time schedule）以及额外的像素空间投影算子（pixel-space projection operator），构建新的高效算法 HP-PnP-Flow。

Result: 在 CelebA 与 AFHQ-Cat 上针对去噪、去模糊、超分辨率、随机修复和盒状修复等任务的实验表明，HP-PnP-Flow 显著优于 PnP-Flow；在 AFHQ-Cat 的去模糊与超分辨率任务上，迭代次数从 500 降至 100 仍达到相当或更好的重构质量。

Conclusion: HP-PnP-Flow 在温和假设下具备严格收敛保证，无需前人工作所施加的受限迭代条件，同时以显著更少的迭代实现更优或相当的重构效果，兼具理论严谨性与计算高效性。

Abstract: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.

</details>


### [174] [ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25861)
*Zhiyang Deng,Yuzhe Wu,Zijun Lin,Yeying Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ActionRoPE将动作驱动的相机位移编码为世界坐标旋转位置，配合CNS噪声调度，实现平面相机世界的空间一致动作控制，回访漂移较最强基线降低66%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏世界模型多把动作实现为特征条件，模型需从数据中自行学习动作如何移动视觉世界，这与俯视、等距等平面相机游戏不匹配——它们的玩家运动对应几何明确的平面相机位移。

Method: 提出ActionRoPE：无参数的动作接口，将动作驱动的相机位移转换为世界坐标下的旋转位置编码，使同一世界位置对应的token跨时间保持相同位置地址；并据此提出坐标条件噪声调度CNS，依据"初始观测已覆盖（几何已知）与新露出（待合成）"的空间非对称性，为token分配逐token去噪调度。

Result: 相较四种代表性动作条件机制，方法更忠实跟随指令运动，回访漂移较最强基线降低66%；接口可跨1.3B至33B参数的视频骨干迁移，并泛化到分布外场景。

Conclusion: 在世界坐标中直接表示动作效果是平面相机世界空间一致控制的关键，ActionRoPE与CNS构成无需训练参数、可跨骨干与场景迁移的通用动作接口。

Abstract: Game world models have made rapid progress toward real-time interactive generation. Yet action control is still predominantly implemented as feature conditioning, leaving the model to learn from training data how each action should move the visual world. This formulation is poorly matched to a broad class of planar-camera worlds, such as top-down and isometric games. In these worlds, player motion induces a geometrically well-defined planar camera displacement. We observe that the key to spatially consistent control in such worlds is to represent the effect of each action directly in world coordinates. To this end, we introduce ActionRoPE, a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions. As a result, tokens corresponding to the same world location retain the same positional address across time. These world coordinates further expose a spatial asymmetry in generation: regions covered by the initial observation are geometrically known, while newly revealed regions remain to be synthesized. We therefore propose Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling (CNS), which assigns token-wise denoising schedules according to this known-new structure. It allows observed regions to stabilize earlier, while new content is generated with reference to them. Compared with four representative action-conditioning mechanisms, our approach follows the commanded motion more faithfully and reduces the revisit drift by 66% over the strongest baseline. The same interface transfers across video backbones from 1.3B to 33B parameters and to out-of-distribution scenes. Project Page: https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/

</details>


### [175] [SlimFormer++: Token Mixing Where It Matters for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25488)
*Yang Hong,Lei Zhang,Zhihong Liu,Jianqing Mo,Xujiong Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过块级冗余与阶段级token-mixer贡献分析，提出SlimFormer++，以阶段感知的token混合策略在8个数据集上取得最优Dice(87.84%)与最低HD95(6.50mm)，参数量仅5.98M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体数据分割网络（卷积、混合与Transformer类）普遍存在计算冗余，但缺乏对"计算应置于何处"的细粒度分析依据，需要量化块内冗余与各阶段token mixer的实际贡献。

Method: 用Centered Kernel Alignment(CKA)度量块内输入-输出表征相似度并据此剪枝；提出Anatomical Relation Distortion(ARD)，通过旁路mixer后标注解剖位置间特征关系的畸变程度衡量其贡献；据此设计SlimFormer++：第一编码阶段用窗口化Mamba混合的Selective Mixing块，深层仅用残差通道MLP；瓶颈处Augmented Mixing将相似度加权稀疏长程上下文注入深度卷积的轴向tap，代价随体素数线性增长。

Result: 相似度引导剪枝在Dice平均下降<0.4个百分点的前提下减少39-75%参数；CKA显示中间编码器mixer冗余高，而ARD表明其贡献小、瓶颈mixer贡献最大；相对12个基线，在8个公开CT/MRI/超声数据集（1,809例）上取得最高平均Dice 87.84%、最低平均HD95 6.50mm、最少参数5.98M。

Conclusion: 阶段感知的token混合是改善体分割精度-效率权衡的有效设计原则，表征冗余分析与ARD可指导网络结构的计算分配。

Abstract: To determine where computation is needed in volumetric segmentation networks, we analyze block-level redundancy and stage-wise token-mixer contribution. Centered Kernel Alignment reveals high input-output representational similarity within blocks of representative convolutional, hybrid, and Transformer-style segmentation networks. Similarity-guided pruning reduces their parameter counts by 39-75% while decreasing mean Dice by less than 0.4 percentage points. To examine token mixers within blocks, we introduce Anatomical Relation Distortion, which quantifies how bypassing a mixer distorts feature relations between labeled anatomical positions. Applied to an unpruned candidate architecture, Centered Kernel Alignment indicates high representational redundancy in intermediate encoder mixers, whereas Anatomical Relation Distortion shows that they contribute little and the bottleneck mixer most. These findings motivate SlimFormer++, which uses Selective Mixing blocks with windowed Mamba mixing in the first encoder stage and only residual channel MLPs in deeper stages. At the bottleneck, Augmented Mixing injects similarity-weighted sparse long-range context into the axial taps of a depthwise convolution at cost linear in voxel count. Evaluated against 12 baselines across eight public CT, MRI, and ultrasound datasets (1,809 cases), SlimFormer++ achieves the highest mean Dice (87.84%) and lowest mean HD95 (6.50 mm) with the fewest parameters (5.98 million). These results support stage-aware token mixing as a design strategy for improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in volumetric segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/WHHHHHY822/SlimFormerPlusPlus

</details>


### [176] [ATLAS: Attention-Guided Test-Time Latent Selection for Compositional Visual Autoregressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25390)
*Hossein Shahabadi,Raya Namazi,Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的ATLAS框架，利用冻结视觉自回归生成器内部注意力信号在图像解码前引导多轨迹搜索，以更低成本提升组合性生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉自回归模型生成的图像在属性绑定与空间关系上常出错；多路径搜索可改善组合性，但完整生成并评估全部候选代价高昂。

Method: ATLAS为training-free框架：在提示内诊断中识别能预测最终组合性偏好的注意力派生分数（在Infinity上有效，向Switti存在类别相关迁移）；用这些在线信号渐进地将算力集中于有前景的轨迹——维护多个粗粒度候选项、在中间尺度不解码即剪枝、仅在最后阶段对部分轨迹做图像空间评估。

Result: 随搜索预算增加，两个骨干在T2I-CompBench与GenEval目标类别上的平均分持续提升；最大预算下T2I-CompBench均值较各骨干提升超10%。性能画像显示相同初始候选数下生成时间减少逾50%，峰值显存更低，且候选数更多时相对节省更大。

Conclusion: 额外采样扩大探索、注意力引导选择限制续算成本，二者结合实现可扩展的组合性搜索，无需参数更新或梯度优化。

Abstract: Visual autoregressive models produce convincing images but can misassign attributes and spatial relations. Searching multiple generation paths can improve composition, yet completing every candidate is costly. We introduce ATLAS, a training-free framework that uses the frozen generator's internal attention to guide search before final images are available. Within-prompt diagnostics identify attention-derived scores that predict final compositional preferences on Infinity, with category-dependent transfer to Switti. ATLAS uses these on-the-fly signals to progressively concentrate computation on promising trajectories. It maintains multiple coarse alternatives, prunes candidates without decoding at intermediate scales, and reserves image-space evaluation for a final choice among partial trajectories. ATLAS scales effectively on both backbones, achieving higher mean scores on the evaluated T2I-CompBench and GenEval categories as more computation is devoted to search. At the largest tested budget, the targeted T2I-CompBench mean improves by over 10% relative to each backbone. Separate profiles show over 50% less generation time than completing and evaluating all candidates at equal initial counts, alongside lower peak allocated GPU memory. Relative time savings are larger at the higher tested candidate count. Together, these results support scalable compositional search: additional sampling expands exploration, while attention-guided selection limits continuation cost without parameter updates or gradient-based optimization.

</details>


### [177] [A New Hope for PRNU on Modern Smartphones? Evidence That Device-Specific Fingerprints Survive Computational Photography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25438)
*Benjamin Loison,Quentin Bammey,Thibaud Ehret,Rafael Grompone von Gioi,Pablo Musé,Marina Gardella*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对现代智能手机PRNU指纹判别力下降的问题，作者发现同型号设备存在共享指纹分量并抬高了sPCE，提出ΔsPCE（减去其余候选指纹的平均sPCE的T-norm式归一化），提升了归属准确率，表明设备特定PRNU信号依然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRNU被视为源相机识别最可靠的标记，但近期研究报道现代智能手机间图像与指纹相关性偏高，质疑PRNU在这些设备上的判别力。作者要判断问题出在指纹本身，还是出在指纹比较方式上。

Method: 在受控采集条件（如不使用数字变焦）下使用30部近期智能手机；分析发现同一型号所有指纹共享一个分量，会抬高标准符号峰值相关能量（sPCE）；据此提出ΔsPCE：查询图像与候选相机指纹的sPCE，减去该图像与其余候选指纹的平均sPCE，思路类似T-norm分数归一化。

Result: ΔsPCE提升了归属准确率，说明设备特定的PRNU信号仍然存在；跨型号共享分量是sPCE虚高的主因，而非指纹本身失效。

Conclusion: PRNU对现代智能手机的归属在指纹比较方式恰当时仍然可行；但数据集规模有限、ΔsPCE依赖候选相机集合，目前限制了其实际应用。

Abstract: Photo Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) is widely regarded as the most reliable marker for source camera identification. Recent studies, however, report high correlations between images and fingerprints from different modern smartphones, which calls into question the discriminative power of PRNU on these devices. Using 30 recent smartphones under controlled acquisition conditions (e.g., no digital zoom), we investigate whether the fingerprint itself is at fault or the way it is compared. We find that a component shared by all fingerprints of the same model inflates the standard signed peak-to-correlation energy (sPCE). To counter this, we propose $Δ$sPCE: the sPCE between a query image and a candidate camera's fingerprint, minus the mean sPCE between that image and the fingerprints of the remaining candidates, in the spirit of T-norm score normalization. $Δ$sPCE improves attribution accuracy, suggesting that the device-specific PRNU signal is still present. Although the limited dataset size and the dependence of $Δ$sPCE on the candidate camera set currently restrict operational applicability, these results suggest that PRNU-based attribution of modern smartphones remains feasible when fingerprints are compared appropriately.

</details>


### [178] [UniState: Unifying Memory and Intervention for Controllable World Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25414)
*Jaeseok Jeong,Kyungmook Choi,Sohyun Chung,Youngsik Yun,Youngjung Uh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UniState 框架，基于统一世界状态表示实现可控世界模拟，将空间记忆与用户干预统一，支持在指定物体运动的同时自由选择观察视角，实现更准确的物体与相机联合控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽提供丰富探索环境，但在对世界进行干预并从任意视角观察其结果方面仍具挑战：物体运动与视角变化在控制信号中容易混淆，且干预往往需要事无巨细地规定所有运动。

Method: 构建统一世界状态表示，将空间记忆与用户干预融合：用户直接在空间记忆中指定物体运动，并独立选择观察相机轨迹。该统一使场景与所请求变化之间的关系显式化，消除物体运动与视角变化之间的歧义。同时设计训练与采样策略，使生成视频既遵循指定的物体运动与相机轨迹，又保留超出规定变换的合理响应能力（合成受控物体内部附加运动及与周围环境的合理交互）。

Result: 实验表明，相比现有方法，该方法在物体与相机联合控制上更准确；定性结果还显示，干预所引发的场景变化可在多次 rollout 中持续保持。

Conclusion: UniState 通过统一世界状态表示有效解耦物体运动与视角控制，并兼顾控制的精确性与生成的自发性，为可控世界模拟提供了可行范式。

Abstract: World models offer increasingly rich environments for exploration, yet intervening in a world while observing the consequences from freely chosen viewpoints remains challenging. We tackle these challenges by introducing UniState, a framework for controllable world simulation built on a unified world-state representation. This representation unifies spatial memory and user interventions. Users specify object motion directly within spatial memory, while independently choosing the camera trajectory from which the resulting world state is observed. This unification makes the relationship between the scene and the requested changes explicit, removing ambiguity between object motion and viewpoint change from the control specification. Crucially, specifying an intervention does not require prescribing every resulting movement: the video model can synthesize additional motion within controlled objects and plausible interactions with their surroundings. We develop training and sampling strategies that help generated videos follow the specified object motion and camera trajectory while preserving this capacity to generate responses beyond the prescribed transformations. Experiments demonstrate more accurate joint object and camera control than the existing methods, alongside qualitative evidence that intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.

</details>


### [179] [A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25395)
*Michael Wakeham,Mrinmoy Kumar Das,Wenqi Wang,Ayush Tewari,Boqing Gong,Deepti Ghadiyaram*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出模块化、3D驱动的框架，将移动相机视频转360°视频的任务分解为观测重建、未观测区域补全、跨视角一致性三个子任务，通过共享3D场景表示串联；无需全景视频训练即达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法把"保留时序观测、补全帧外内容、维持视角变化下的场景一致性"三项要求全部交给单一条件视频模型，依赖全景视频数据联合学习，负担过重。作者希望将职责解耦。

Method: 模块化3D驱动框架：输入观测被显式重建到3D；预训练全景图像模型基于选定的全景渲染结果补全未观测内容；生成内容被提升（lift）到共享3D场景中，从而在相机视角变化时保持空间锚定。各专用组件通过共享场景表示连接。

Result: 在Argus评测集静态场景子集上取得SOTA的输入视角保真度、感知质量和几何一致性，且无需任何额外的全景视频训练。

Conclusion: 结果支持这种分解式、3D驱动的建模是直接视频生成在该设定下的有前景替代方案。

Abstract: Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

</details>


### [180] [MPIG: Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation from a Single Polarization Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25326)
*Jue Wang,Ruilin Huang,Liquan Shen,Zhen Tian,Xia Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MPIG，基于Swin Transformer从单一0°偏振图像预测缺失的45°、90°、135°偏振视图，并构建大规模真实偏振数据集HighPol。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整偏振观测通常依赖专用硬件与多角度测量，系统复杂、部署受限，因此需要从单角度观测重建其余角度偏振信息。

Method: MPIG为Swin Transformer框架，耦合跨角度特征交互与残差解码；引入实测Stokes差与偏振强度感知监督，并以低秩分解降低解码开销。

Result: 在自建HighPol（5,474组高分辨率四角度偏振图像）上达29.729 dB PSNR、0.9505 SSIM、21.514° AoLP MAngE，参数量85.86 M、1.126 T FLOPs；玻璃与语义分割下游任务验证有效。

Conclusion: MPIG可有效预测缺失偏振视图并保留任务相关信息，对下游视觉应用具有实用价值。

Abstract: Polarization imaging provides informative cues for material analysis, scene understanding, and visual perception. However, acquiring complete polarization observations typically requires specialized hardware and multi-angle measurements, thereby increasing system complexity and limiting practical deployment. In this work, we address the problem of predicting the missing $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ polarization views from a single $0^\circ$ observation by leveraging a learned scene prior. To this end, we propose MPIG (Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation), a Swin Transformer-based framework that couples cross-angle feature interaction with residual decoding to predict angle-dependent intensity variations while preserving shared scene structure. Specifically, measured Stokes differences and polarization-strength-aware supervision guide the recovery of polarization modulation, orientation, and magnitude, while low-rank factorization further reduces the decoding cost. We also construct HighPol, a large-scale real-world polarization dataset comprising 5,474 groups of high-resolution four-angle polarization images collected from diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. Experimental results demonstrate improved image and polarization accuracy, achieving 29.729 dB PSNR, 0.9505 SSIM, and $21.514^\circ$ AoLP MAngE while requiring 85.86 M parameters and 1.126 T FLOPs. Furthermore, downstream validation on glass and semantic-segmentation tasks suggests that the generated polarization images can preserve task-relevant information, demonstrating the effectiveness of MPIG and the practical utility of predicted polarization observations for downstream vision applications.

</details>


### [181] [SENRI: Understanding the Space-Event Nexus in Real-Life Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25309)
*Kehan Lan,Kaining Ying,Henghui Ding,Kaipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SENRI任务，研究长时连续第一人称视频中"事件—空间"双向联结的记忆与检索，构建SENRI-Bench基准，并用SENRI-Agent控制器缓解现有记忆方法的失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类记忆将事件与其空间上下文相互关联，而现有AI助手缺乏对这种"事件与空间联结"的建模与评测。现有长视频理解范式在该能力上表现不足，且存在典型失效模式，需要专门任务与基准来揭示缺口。

Method: 定义SENRI任务，含两个方向的六类子任务：Event→Space（由事件线索恢复空间知识）与Space→Event（由区域和轨迹检索事件）。构建SENRI-Bench：10段不间断自录视频、约25.3小时、500道人工标注多选题。评测三种长视频理解范式：直接感知、证据检索、持久记忆。进一步提出SENRI-Agent，其采用Target-Guided Visual Check (TGVC)为并行验证器提出局部视觉核查子任务，并将报告整合进工作记忆辅助推理，且不修改原有记忆系统中的存储内容。

Result: 三种范式在SENRI任务上均表现困难，说明仍有较大提升空间；同时总结出现有记忆方法的两种代表性失效模式。在现有记忆系统基础上，SENRI-Agent无需改动其存储记忆即可提升基线性能。

Conclusion: SENRI为真实第一人称场景理解提供了新的评测视角，揭示现有方法的证据缺口，并以TGVC+工作记忆的控制器思路给出可行的改进方向。

Abstract: Human memories are organized in a way that connects events with their corresponding spatial contexts. An AI assistant should also be able to memorize and recall the nexus of events and spaces. Thus we introduce SENRI, a task that studies this space--event connection in long, continuous real-life egocentric video. It contains six task types in two directions: Event$\rightarrow$Space, which recovers spatial knowledge from event cues, and Space$\rightarrow$Event, which retrieves events from regions and trajectories. To evaluate this, we build SENRI-Bench, containing 500 manually annotated multiple-choice questions over 10 uninterrupted self-recorded videos with around 25.3 hours of content. Also, we evaluate three typical long video understanding paradigms: direct perception, evidence seeking, and persistent memory. The task remains challenging across all three paradigms, highlighting substantial room for improvement. Then we show two representative failure modes of existing memory methods and address these evidence gaps with SENRI-Agent, a controller that uses Target-Guided Visual Check (TGVC) to propose local visual check tasks for parallel verifiers and integrate the reports into a working memory to help with reasoning. Built upon existing memory systems, SENRI-Agent improves the performance of existing baselines without modifying their stored memories. We hope SENRI will provide valuable insights into how real-life egocentric understanding should be evaluated, reveal the gaps in existing approaches, and offer a possible direction for improvement.

</details>


### [182] [Learning Lane-Structured Conditioning Fields for Online HD Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25284)
*Andrea Bertogalli,Anthony Dell'Eva,Marcello Ceresini,Federico Pirazzoli,Lorenzo Cipelli,Filippo D'Addeo,Nicola Marinello,Massimo Bertozzi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Lane Field——一种密集、BEV 对齐的局部车道几何表示，可从车载观测预测或由外部地图先验构建，并以即插即用框架通过 BEV 特征调制与可变形注意力引导提升在线 HD 地图构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外部先验表示存在权衡：密集栅格易集成但忽略地图几何属性；稀疏矢量保留几何结构却需专用编码器、难以嵌入现有架构。此外外部先验可能不准确、采集昂贵、难维护，因此需要一种既能提供几何引导又可学习、广泛适用的结构化表示。

Method: 构建 Lane Field：在每个空间位置编码局部车道结构的密集 BEV 对齐几何表示，可由车载观测预测或由外部地图先验构造。基于该表示提出即插即用框架，包含两种互补机制：(1) BEV 特征调制，将车道结构线索注入潜在 BEV 特征；(2) 可变形注意力引导，将查询采样导向底层车道几何。

Result: 主要在 OpenLane-V2 上评测，结果表明以局部车道几何对 BEV 特征进行条件化并引导可变形注意力，可一致地改进现有方法，并在车道段感知任务上取得 SOTA 性能。

Conclusion: Lane Field 兼顾几何表达力与可学习性、可插拔性，作为通用结构化先验能稳定增强多种在线 HD 建图方法，验证了局部车道几何引导的有效性。

Abstract: High-definition maps provide critical structural information for downstream autonomous driving tasks. Recent methods increasingly rely on external priors to improve prediction accuracy and robustness. Yet, existing prior representations expose a trade-off: dense rasters are easy to integrate but ignore certain map geometric properties, while sparse vectors preserve geometric structure but require dedicated encoders and are difficult to plug into existing architectures. Moreover, external priors can be inaccurate, costly to acquire, or difficult to maintain, motivating a structural representation that can provide geometric guidance while remaining learnable and broadly applicable. We address this limitation with the Lane Field, a dense BEV-aligned geometric representation that encodes local lane structure at each spatial location and can be either predicted from onboard observations or constructed from external map priors. Building on this representation, we introduce a plug-and-play framework that enhances online HD mapping through two complementary mechanisms: BEV feature modulation, which injects lane-structured cues into latent BEV features, and deformable attention guidance, which steers query sampling toward the underlying lane geometry. We primarily evaluate our method on OpenLane-V2, showing that conditioning BEV features and guiding deformable attention with local lane geometry enables our framework to consistently improve existing methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance on lane segment perception. Project page: https://andberto.github.io/LaneField/

</details>


### [183] [GeoART: Geometry-Aware Refinement via Test-Time Scaling for Camera-Conditioned Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25273)
*Liudi Yang,Ziyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoART：一种无需训练的几何感知测试时缩放自精炼框架，在去噪过程中通过"预测-扰动"生成多候选并用几何先验评估选择，提升相机可控性与多视图一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机条件视频扩散模型因去噪过程中相机约束与估计几何仅被弱约束，导致相机控制不准确、几何不一致；现有方法依赖昂贵的几何感知微调或额外3D监督。

Method: 训练无关的测试时自精炼框架：在选定去噪步执行Predict-and-Perturb循环生成多个候选，用几何先验评估但不直接修改去噪轨迹；引入置信度门控抑制不可靠几何证据，并采用秩校准概率选择融合分数幅度与相对秩来确定下一精炼状态。

Result: 在相机可控性、多视图一致性与视觉质量上一致优于现有采样与自精炼方法，且无需训练或修改预训练视频扩散模型。

Conclusion: 通过几何感知的测试时缩放，可在不改动模型参数的前提下显著增强相机条件视频生成的可控性与几何一致性，为免训练自精炼提供有效范式。

Abstract: Camera-conditioned video diffusion models often suffer from inaccurate camera control and geometric inconsisten- cies because camera constraints and estimated geometry are only weakly enforced during denoising. Existing reme- dies often require costly geometry-aware fine-tuning or ad- ditional 3D supervision. We introduce GeoART, a training- free self-refinement framework that improves camera con- trollability through geometry-aware test-time scaling. At selected denoising steps, GeoART generates multiple can- didates within the Predict-and-Perturb cycle and eval- uates them using a geometry prior, without directly modify- ing the denoising trajectory. A confidence gate suppresses unreliable geometric evidence, while rank-calibrated prob- abilistic selection combines score magnitude and relative rank to choose the next refinement state. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in camera controlla- bility, multi-view consistency, and visual quality over exist- ing sampling and self-refinement methods, without training or modifying the pretrained video diffusion model

</details>


### [184] [Persistent Representational Misalignment Induces Vision-Language Model Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25252)
*Yonatan Gideoni,Yoav Gelberg,Tim G. J. Rudner,Yarin Gal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视觉与语言表征存在线性不可对齐性，该错位是数据的固有属性，不会随规模或对齐复杂度增加而消失，并导致可预测的泛化失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉语言模型在人类简单任务上失败的根源，并检验柏拉图表征假说关于"规模增大将使表征对齐"的预测是否成立。

Method: 第一部分：证明现有视觉与语言表征线性不可对齐，并论证该错位源于数据固有属性，与模型规模及对齐方法复杂度无关。第二部分：通过构造性实验证明该错位会引发可预测的泛化失败，并分析其与已有失败模式的相关性，比较不同VLM骨干的表征对齐度与失败率。

Result: 视觉与语言表征线性不可对齐；该错位导致可预测的泛化失败，并与现有失败模式相关；表征对齐度更高的VLM骨干失败更少。

Conclusion: 表征不会仅凭足够规模而自然对齐，为强版本柏拉图表征假说提供了反证。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail at some tasks that are simple for humans---but why? We hypothesize that many such failures stem from VLMs' difficulties translating between vision and language representations, a misalignment the Platonic Representation Hypothesis predicts should disappear with scale. This paper is composed of two parts: in the first, we show that existing vision and language representations are linearly unalignable. This misalignment is an inherent property of the data and hence expected to persist regardless of either scale or the alignment's complexity. In the second, we demonstrate how this misalignment both leads to a predictably induced generalization failure and correlates with existing failure modes, where more representationally aligned VLM backbones accordingly exhibit fewer failures. Overall, these results imply representations will not become aligned simply given sufficient scale, providing evidence against a strong version of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis.

</details>


### [185] [GeoV2V: Geometry-Grounded Video Diffusion Model for Driving Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25245)
*Yuchen Xi,Yuhan Guo,Chenwei Hou,Zixu Liu,Jin Fang,Jason Liu,Ruigang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV
