TL;DR: GeoV2V：几何先验+全视频条件的视频到视频扩散框架，实现轨迹变化下的驾驶视频新视角合成，并发布Para4D同步多车道数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶仿真需要在轨迹变化（如变道、外推到未见视角）下生成时序一致的视频。重建类方法几何一致但大视角变化时画质退化；"先重建后修复"方法视觉合理却存在几何与时序不一致。同时真实数据集缺少同步多轨迹监督，使跨车道变换难以学习。

Method: 提出GeoV2V：将LiDAR与深度导出的几何先验与全视频条件整合进Wan 2.1骨干的视频到视频扩散框架，沿新轨迹合成时序连贯的驾驶视频。并构建Para4D合成数据集，提供动态场景下同步多车道驾驶视频的显式监督，作为几何一致新视角合成的训练先验。

Result: 在Waymo、nuScenes与Para4D上，于大幅轨迹偏移下的视觉质量、几何一致性与复杂光照动态鲁棒性方面取得SOTA。

Conclusion: 以几何为基底的视频扩散+同步多轨迹数据监督可有效解决轨迹变化下的新视角合成，兼顾几何一致性、时序连贯性与视觉质量。

Abstract: Novel view synthesis under trajectory changes is essential for autonomous driving simulation, yet existing methods struggle to generate consistent videos when extrapolating to unseen viewpoints such as lane shifts. Reconstruction-based approaches maintain geometric consistency but degrade in visual quality under large viewpoint changes, while reconstruct-then-restore methods often produce visually plausible frames yet suffer from geometric and temporal inconsistencies. We present GeoV2V, a geometry-grounded video-to-video diffusion framework that synthesizes temporally coherent driving videos along novel trajectories by integrating LiDAR and depth-derived geometric priors with full-video conditioning in the Wan 2.1 backbone. A key challenge in learning cross-lane transformations is the lack of synchronized multi-trajectory supervision in real-world datasets. To address this, we also introduce Para4D, a synthetic dataset capturing synchronized multi-lane driving videos within dynamic scenes, which provides explicit supervision for lane-shift generation and serves as a strong training prior for geometry-consistent view synthesis. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Para4D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in visual quality, geometric consistency, and robustness to complex lighting dynamics under large trajectory shifts. Project page: https://xiyuche.github.io/GeoV2V/

</details>


### [186] [LEVI: Benchmarking Visual Identity Fidelity with Verifiable Low-Entropy Constructs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25716)
*Xiao Ma,Zhonghao Zhan,Hamed Haddadi,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Low-Entropy Visual Identity (LEVI) 与 Visual Identity Spaces (VIS) 框架，用概率刻画"身份保真度"以区分身份违规与允许的外观变化；在此基础上构建声明式语言 Verifiable Visual Grammar (VVG) 及含 1,375 任务、120 个身份空间、6 个领域的基准；十个模型配置最高整任务通过率仅 58.69%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代生成模型能生成视觉上逼真的图像，却违反精确的身份约束；要评估此类失败，必须把"对指定身份的违背"与"可允许的外观变化"区分开，而现有评价缺乏对身份不确定性的形式化界定。

Method: 提出 LEVI：身份由紧凑事实与显式规则确定（低熵指身份不确定性低，而外观可多样）；将身份保真度定义为条件图像分布赋予 prompt 所允许身份的总体概率；用 VIS 形式化可允许身份取值及"哪些不同实现表达同一身份"；据此设计 VVG 声明式语言，以带类型的原语与组合约束描述承载身份的结构，并用其构建基于最终像素证据、逐任务核验身份要求的基准。

Result: 基准覆盖 6 个领域、120 个基础身份空间，共 1,375 个任务；在评估的十个模型配置中，最高整任务通过率为 58.69%。

Conclusion: 视觉逼真度与身份忠实度之间存在持续且显著的鸿沟；LEVI/VIS/VVG 提供了可验证、可组合的身份保真度评估路径。

Abstract: Modern generative models can produce visually plausible images while violating exact identity constraints. Evaluating such failures requires distinguishing violations of the requested identity from permissible variation in appearance. We introduce Low-Entropy Visual Identity (LEVI), which characterizes visual identities determined by compact facts and explicit rules. The low-entropy requirement concerns identity uncertainty, while appearance may remain diverse. We formulate identity fidelity in terms of the probability that a conditional image distribution assigns to the identities permitted by the prompt. Visual Identity Spaces (VIS) formalize this distinction by specifying admissible identity values and which different realizations express the same identity. Building on this formulation, we develop Verifiable Visual Grammar (VVG), a declarative language whose typed primitives and compositional constraints describe identity-bearing structures. Using this grammar, we build a benchmark for image generation. It assesses each output against the task's identity requirements, drawing evidence from the final pixels. The curated benchmark contains 1,375 tasks spanning 120 base identity spaces across six domains. Among ten evaluated model configurations, the highest whole-task pass rate is 58.69%. These results reveal a persistent gap between visually plausible images and faithful realization of their specified identities. Project page (forthcoming): https://maxiao0234.github.io/LEVI/.

</details>


### [187] [Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25634)
*Wenqing Wang,Joonghyuk Shin,Jonathan Tremblay,Chan Hee Song,Yun Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Clean Forcing：在冻结基座上训练 5.9M 参数 LoRA 校正器，回归自回归视频扩散中的"反事实速度差"，无需真实视频、无推理开销，将 50s 文生视频的 Δ-drift 从 +11.3 降至 +1.65（无真实视频）/−0.16（40 段真实视频）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成任意长度视频，但存在曝光偏差：模型在干净上下文上训练，却需从自身不完美输出继续生成，误差累积导致数秒内质量崩溃（漂移）。现有方案各有缺陷：需要集群级基座重训练、免训练推理校正效果不稳定、或训练冻结基座校正器仅针对采样与缓存误差。作者发现漂移在很大程度上是确定性的、可学习的。

Method: 关键观察：固定含噪状态、仅改变历史，可揭示"反事实速度差"，且该差异在约 95% 的噪声种子上具有系统性（deterministic）。据此训练 5.9M 参数的 LoRA 校正器（基座冻结）回归该差值；加入闭环阶段：DAgger 式数据聚合 + 漂移收缩（drift-contraction）目标，使校正器暴露于自身 rollout。干净历史可直接用基座单次生成结果，故训练无需真实视频；校正器合并后不增加推理成本。

Result: 50 秒文生视频生成中，Δ-drift 由 +11.3 降至 +1.65（不使用真实视频）、−0.16（仅 40 段真实视频），优于此前最佳公开结果 +3.57，且数据量减少 150 倍以上。广泛实验显示在长时程视频生成中，美学质量与数据效率均优于既有方法，漂移更低。

Conclusion: 漂移的确定性使其可作为可学习残差被小型校正器吸收；Clean Forcing 以极小参数、极少数据、零推理开销实现显著漂移抑制，为长时程自回归视频生成提供高效实用方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate streaming video of arbitrary length by conditioning each new chunk of frames on those already generated. However, they suffer from exposure bias, where a model trained on clean context must continue from its own imperfect outputs, and errors compound until quality collapses within seconds (drift). Existing methods either require cluster-scale base retraining, apply training-free inference corrections with inconsistent results, or train frozen-base correctors for sampling and cache errors. We instead find that drift is largely deterministic and therefore learnable, as holding the noisy state fixed while varying only the history reveals a counterfactual velocity gap that is ~95% systematic across noise seeds. Based on this observation, we introduce Clean Forcing, which trains a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector on the frozen base model to regress this gap, with a closed-loop stage that adds DAgger-style aggregation and a drift-contraction objective to expose the corrector to its own rollouts. Because the clean histories can be the base model's own single-shot generations, training needs no real videos, and the merged corrector adds no inference cost. In 50 s text-to-video generation, Clean Forcing reduces Δ-drift from +11.3 to +1.65 without real video and to -0.16 with 40 real clips, improving on the best published result of +3.57 with over 150x less data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Clean Forcing outperforms prior methods in aesthetic quality and data efficiency with reduced drift for long-horizon video generation.

</details>


### [188] [Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25622)
*Sofia McLeod,Mohsi Jawaid,Carl Seubert,Tat-Jun Chin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用循环视觉Transformer（RVT）做基于事件的航天器位姿估计，通过循环记忆捕获稀疏事件流中的长期信息以应对慢速相对运动，在真实数据上精度和稳定性优于逐事件帧或固定时间窗方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机因超高动态范围在轨道恶劣光照下鲁棒，但慢速相对运动时事件率骤降、信噪比低；而真实RPO轨迹出于安全常为慢速（低至1 mm/s），低照度进一步加剧问题，故解决慢速运动是提升EBSPE实用性的关键。

Method: 采用循环视觉Transformer（RVT）进行EBSPE：利用循环记忆跨稀疏事件流捕获更长时程信息，并从完整轨迹中学习时间注意力跨度而非固定时间窗；构建基于RVT的热图回归器生成2D-3D对应关系用于位姿估计。

Result: 在代表RPO轨迹的慢速相对运动条件下采集的真实事件数据上验证，位姿估计精度与稳定性均优于此前基于逐事件帧或固定时间窗的EBSPE方法。

Conclusion: 基于RVT的方法能有效缓解慢速相对运动下事件稀疏、低信噪比的问题，提升了EBSPE的实用性；结果支持以学习式时间注意力替代固定时间窗的设计思路。

Abstract: Vision-based object pose estimation is vital for conducting spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO). Recent research has demonstrated the robustness of event cameras against the harsh lighting conditions that often occur in orbit, thanks to the extremely high dynamic range of event sensors. However, event-based spacecraft pose estimation (EBSPE) suffers when the relative motion between the chaser and target is slow, since the event rate drops significantly, leading to data with low signal-to-noise ratio. Unfortunately, for safety reasons, real RPO trajectories often involve slow relative motions (e.g., down to 1 mm/s), and operating under low illumination exacerbates the problem. Addressing slow relative motions is thus crucial to raise the practicality of EBSPE. To this end, we propose using recurrent vision transformers (RVT) for EBSPE. The key idea is to exploit recurrent memory to capture longer-term information across sparse event streams, and to learn the temporal attention span from full trajectories rather than fixing the time window. We developed an RVT-based heatmap regressor to produce 2D-3D correspondences for pose estimation, which was validated on real event data collected under slow relative motions representative of RPO trajectories. Results indicate the superior pose estimation accuracy and stability of our RVT-based method, relative to previous per-event-frame-based or fixed-time-window EBSPE methods.

</details>


### [189] [CheXFuse: Guided Differential Joint Attention Fusion for Robust Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classification in Data-Scarce Medical Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25617)
*Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Priyanka Siddappa,Md Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma,Md Ripon Ahammed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CheXFuse多模态融合框架，其核心为引导式差分联合注意力（GuDJA），在IU胸片数据集上以图文融合实现二分类，原始报告与掩码报告设置下均取得最优平均性能（原始报告准确率95.73%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态学习中各模态预测强度差异显著，当某一模态表征明显弱于另一模态时，无差别的跨模态交互会引入弱、冗余或不稳定信号，导致性能受限甚至低于最强单模态基线。

Method: 提出CheXFuse框架，基于GuDJA将图像与文本token表征置于联合多模态序列中；通过可学习的token引导强化信息量高的表征，并用差分注意力抑制作用较小的注意力响应。在IU Chest X-ray数据集上进行正常/异常二分类，设置原始报告与掩码报告两种条件，后者作为文本信息量降低的受控压力测试。

Result: 原始报告设置下达到95.73%准确率、95.79% F1、96.54%召回率、95.28% Sens@95Spec；掩码报告设置下分别为95.58%、95.60%、95.60%、94.34%，在所有基线对比与消融实验中平均整体性能最优。

Conclusion: GuDJA在模态信息不对称或部分削弱的情形下是一种有前景的融合策略。

Abstract: A central challenge in multimodal learning is how to fuse modalities that differ substantially in predictive strength. When one modality provides a much stronger representation than another, indiscriminate cross-modal interaction can introduce weak, redundant, or unstable signals, limiting or even degrading performance relative to the strongest unimodal representation. To address this problem, we propose CheXFuse, a multimodal fusion framework based on Guided Differential Joint Attention (GuDJA). CheXFuse combines image and text token representations within a joint multimodal sequence, where learned token guidance emphasizes informative representations and differential attention reduces less useful attention responses. We evaluate CheXFuse on the Indiana University (IU) Chest X-ray dataset, using binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification as the downstream task. Experiments are conducted under both original-report and masked-report settings, with the latter serving as a controlled stress test under reduced textual informativeness. CheXFuse with GuDJA achieves the strongest mean overall performance across the evaluated baselines and ablations, reaching 95.73% accuracy, 95.79% F1-score, 96.54% recall, and 95.28% sensitivity at 95% specificity (Sens@95Spec) with original reports, and 95.58%, 95.60%, 95.60%, and 94.34%, respectively, under masked reports. These results suggest that GuDJA provides a promising fusion strategy under asymmetric or partially reduced modality informativeness.

</details>


### [190] [ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25595)
*Bishoy Galoaa,Sarah Ostadabbas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViMoLa 用小型 Transformer 从文本预测压缩轨迹的运动先验，并通过零门控交叉注意力适配器注入冻结的 Wan 2.2 图像到视频扩散骨干，使定向运动准确率从 0.287 提升到 0.442。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言引导的视频生成模型往往能还原场景内容，却遗漏指令中要求的运动，即存在"内容对、运动错"的错位问题。

Method: (1) 空间向量量化自编码器将稠密轨迹压缩为 64 个 token，码本规模 512；(2) 28M 参数的 Transformer 依据文本预测这些运动 token；(3) 通过零门控交叉注意力适配器，借助前向 hook 对每个冻结的 Wan 2.2 DiT 块进行条件注入；训练数据为 Something-Something v2 与 Kinetics-400 共 462K 视频。

Result: 定向准确率由 0.287 升至 0.442（随机为 0.250），生成质量基本持平；跨提示打乱码字仅得 0.283，说明 token 内容与提示匹配是关键；低秩适配器以 1.45% 额外前向 FLOPs 达到 0.428；复用分词器与语言模型、仅重训 CogVideoX 适配器可由 0.301 提升至 0.398。局限：oracle 码字仅 0.531，复合运动增益较小，且适配器未显式保持 token 到图像块的对应关系。

Conclusion: 以离散运动先验+轻量适配器的方式对冻结视频生成骨干做运动条件化是有效的、可迁移的，但运动控制仍不完善，未来需改进复合运动建模与 token–patch 的空间对齐。

Abstract: Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 tokens from a 512-entry codebook; a 28M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan~2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462K videos from Something-Something~v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 to 0.442 (chance 0.250), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283, supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 at 1.45% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 to 0.398. Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531, compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments.

</details>


### [191] [Tricking Synthetic Image Detectors with Amortized Generative Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25554)
*Mohamed Awad,Khaled Elhady,Yasser Rohaim,Samuele Poppi,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文对合成图像检测器在可迁移攻击下的鲁棒性进行系统评估，提出双轴评估协议，分别独立变化代理检测器与输入图像生成器，揭示可迁移性并非检测器单一属性，而强烈依赖生成器分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像合成技术快速发展，亟需可靠的合成图像检测器，但其对可迁移攻击的鲁棒性研究不足。现有评估通常只检验针对某一检测器构造的攻击能否迁移到另一检测器，却很少单独考察当被攻击图像来自不同生成器时攻击效果如何变化，忽视了生成器这一维度。

Method: 系统评估三类代表性攻击：两种迭代扰动方法 MIG 与 MuMoDIG，以及摊销式生成攻击 Tricker。覆盖四个检测器与五个不同架构的生成器，设计双轴评估协议，独立变化用于构造或训练攻击的代理检测器以及提供输入图像的生成器。评估指标包括攻击有效性、跨检测器可迁移性、感知质量、运行时间及与常见后处理操作的交互。同时对 Tricker 进行复现与简化，大幅降低其数据与训练需求。

Result: 实验表明可迁移性并非仅由检测器决定：输入生成器分布同时强烈影响逃逸有效性与被攻击图像质量。MIG 与 MuMoDIG 对“检测器—生成器”组合表现出显著依赖性，而 Tricker 提供更均匀的白盒逃逸效果与图像质量。此外，后处理操作维持了这种非对称的可迁移性拓扑结构。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了攻击评估中被忽视的生成器维度，说明需采用同时考虑检测器与生成器变化的可迁移性感知评估协议。作者将公开代码、评估数据与训练好的攻击模型，并附负责任使用声明。

Abstract: Rapid advances in image synthesis have increased the need for reliable synthetic-image detectors, yet their robustness to transferable attacks remains incomplete and understudied. Existing evaluations generally examine whether an attack constructed against one detector transfers to another, but rarely isolate how its effectiveness changes when the attacked images originate from different generators. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three representative attacks: two iterative perturbation-based methods, MIG and MuMoDIG, and the amortized generative attack Tricker. Across four detectors and five generators spanning diverse architectures, we introduce a two-axis evaluation protocol that independently varies the surrogate detector used to construct or train the attack and the generator supplying its input images. We assess attack effectiveness, cross-detector transferability, perceptual quality, runtime, and interaction with common post-processing operations. We revisit Tricker and show that its data and training requirements can be substantially reduced, enabling broader and more efficient evaluation. Our results demonstrate that transferability is not a detector-only property: the input-generator distribution strongly influences both evasion effectiveness and attacked-image quality. MIG and MuMoDIG exhibit pronounced dependence on the detector--generator pair, whereas Tricker provides more uniform white-box evasion and image quality. We additionally observe that post-processing maintains the asymmetric transferability topology. These findings expose a neglected dimension of attack evaluation and motivate transfer-aware protocols that jointly account for detector and generator variation. We will release our code, evaluation data, and trained attack models with a responsible-use statement.

</details>


### [192] [PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25486)
*Xueyang Li,Alec Girten,Peng Zeng,Mingze Jiang,Shaoyang Huang,Gelei Xu,Danny Z. Chen,Yiyu Shi,John N. Kheir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文发布首个带临床级ICU器械标注的儿科CICU胸片数据集PediaDeviceSeg-1K，并提出器械感知流水线PCXR-Copilot，可实时输出肺与器械分割、器械抑制视图及水肿可视化与量化指标，已在波士顿儿童医院TWIST平台集成部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿科ICU与心脏ICU患者需频繁床旁胸片监测支持器械、血管外肺水与胸壁水肿，但重叠的解剖与医源性结构（器械）遮挡临床相关信号，使阅片与自动分析困难。深度学习可提供决策支持，然而高器械负荷、以及缺乏具临床依据的儿科器械标注数据集，限制了其在儿科胸片上的迁移应用。

Method: （1）构建PediaDeviceSeg-1K数据集：1,000张儿科CICU前后位胸片，对常见ICU器械提供临床级、细粒度标注，用于以器械为重点的基准评测；（2）在此基础上提出PCXR-Copilot器械感知流水线，输出肺与器械掩膜、可选的器械抑制视图（device-suppressed views），以及水肿相关的可视化图谱与标量指数；全流程已集成至波士顿儿童医院TWIST平台并实时运行。

Result: 据作者所知，PediaDeviceSeg-1K为首个公开可用、具临床级器械标注的儿科CICU胸片资源；PCXR-Copilot完整流水线已在TWIST平台实时集成运行，验证了真实临床部署的可行性。

Conclusion: 该工作通过高质量器械标注数据集填补儿科CICU胸片资源空白，并以器械感知的多任务流水线实现分割、器械抑制与水肿量化的一体化实时输出，具备临床落地可行性，为儿科重症影像的器械鲁棒分析提供基准与方法基础。

Abstract: Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.

</details>


### [193] [Image Dehazing as In-Context Tabular Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25142)
*Le-Anh Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将单幅图像去雾重新表述为上下文表格回归问题，提出DehazeTab：用图像块的手工雾相关描述子、预训练视觉嵌入及其混合表示构造表格样本，由预训练表格基础模型（TFM）在无需微调的情况下进行上下文回归预测大气透射率，再经引导滤波与大气散射模型恢复无雾图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统去雾依赖手工物理先验或任务专用深度模型，通常需要精心设计的架构与大量训练；而表格基础模型（TFM）能够仅凭上下文示例直接推断连续关系、无需任务特定训练，因此作者希望探究单幅去雾能否被有效重构为上下文表格回归问题，以提供一种免训练的低层视觉新范式。

Method: 从雾图提取重叠图像块，用三种方式转为表格样本：手工雾相关描述子、预训练视觉嵌入、二者混合；对应透射率块汇总为标量回归目标。预训练TFM以带标签参考块作为上下文，对未见图像进行in-context回归预测透射率，无需任何微调。预测值经空间聚合形成透射率图，用引导滤波细化，再代入大气散射模型恢复无雾图像。实验还分析了特征表示、图像块选择与上下文参考配置的影响。

Result: 在基准数据集上取得有竞争力的复原性能；物理驱动的手工特征可优于预训练视觉嵌入，而混合表示具有互补收益；并系统考察了特征表示、图像块选择与上下文参考配置对复原质量的影响。

Conclusion: 单幅去雾可有效重构为上下文表格回归问题，TFM可作为免训练的低层视觉任务求解范式；研究结果凸显了结构化输入与上下文推理在去雾及其他低层视觉任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Image dehazing is traditionally addressed through handcrafted physical priors or task-specific deep learning models, often requiring carefully designed architectures or extensive model training. Recent advances in tabular foundation models (TFMs), however, offer an alternative learning paradigm in which continuous relationships can be inferred directly from contextual examples without task-specific model training. Motivated by this capability, this paper investigates whether single-image dehazing can be effectively reformulated as an in-context tabular regression problem and introduces DehazeTab, a framework that estimates atmospheric transmission from structured image-patch representations. Specifically, overlapping patches extracted from hazy images are transformed into tabular samples using handcrafted haze-related descriptors, pretrained visual embeddings, or their hybrid combinations, while corresponding transmission patches are summarized as scalar regression targets. A pretrained TFM then performs in-context regression using labeled reference patches to predict transmission values for unseen images without any further fine-tuning. These predictions are spatially aggregated into a transmission map, refined through guided filtering, and incorporated into the atmospheric scattering model to recover haze-free images. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive restoration performance and reveal that physically motivated handcrafted features can outperform pretrained visual embeddings, while hybrid representations offer complementary benefits. Further analyses examine the effects of feature representations, patch selection, and contextual reference configurations on restoration quality. Beyond image dehazing, the findings highlight the potential of TFMs as an alternative paradigm for addressing low-level vision tasks through structured and in-context inference.

</details>


### [194] [HullProbe: Measuring Interventional Part Reliance in Maritime Vessel Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25137)
*Faisal Mohammad,Mohamed Younis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HullProbe，直接度量船舶类型分类器对"通用船体"与"上层建筑"各部件的干预性依赖：将船舶按解剖结构划分为 2×3 部件网格，穷举 64 种同类部件替换，并用 Walsh 变换一次性分解出各部件影响及交互谱。实验表明该度量与最差组准确率高度相关（r = -0.94），揭示在 MARVEL 数据集上分类器约 46% 的校正敏感度集中于通用船体，且现有无需组标签的去偏方法未能显著降低这一比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从图像识别船型可支撑海事监视与制裁监测，但分类器可能通过依赖泛化的船体（hull）而非更具判别性的上层建筑（superstructure）获得高准确率，导致换壳或遮挡时失效。现有去偏方法以最差组准确率作为认证指标，但该代理需要组标签，且只能从准确率间接推断依赖关系，无法直接刻画模型真正依赖的部件。

Method: 提出直接度量依赖的 HullProbe：将已注册的船舶解剖部件替换为另一实例的同类部件，并以同类替换控制合成伪影；利用水面船舶沿单轴排布"船体+上层建筑"的结构先验，构建 2×3 部件网格，穷举评估全部 2^6 = 64 种替换组合；再通过一次 Walsh 变换同时得到各部件的干预性影响强度与交互谱。此外以人工标注替换学习到的分割器进行稳健性检验。

Result: 在已知真实依赖的植入式捷径（planted shortcuts）上，该度量与最差组准确率高度一致（45 种配置下 r = -0.94）；以人工标注替代学习分割器，船体占比变化小于审计分辨率。在 MARVEL 的 26 类船型上，分类器约 46% 的校正敏感度落在通用船体上，但当船体与上层建筑冲突时会跟随上层建筑；可用的无组标签去偏方法未检测到船体占比的显著下降。结论在三种架构与第二个海事数据集上保持一致，方法亦扩展至 Stanford Cars 的细粒度车型识别。

Conclusion: 基于部件干预与 Walsh 变换的直接依赖度量是可行且可验证的审计工具，其与最差组准确率的强相关表明可作为无需组标签的替代认证手段。实证显示船型分类器存在显著的船体捷径依赖，且现有无组标签去偏方法对其无效，提示需要面向部件级依赖的去偏策略。

Abstract: Recognizing a vessel's type from an image supports maritime surveillance and sanctions monitoring, but a classifier can reach high accuracy by leaning on the generic hull instead of the more distinctive superstructure, and is then fooled when a vessel is re-hulled or occluded. De-biasing methods claim to remove such reliance, yet the field certifies them with worst-group accuracy, a proxy that needs group labels and only infers reliance from accuracy. We measure the reliance directly. HullProbe swaps a registered anatomical part of a vessel for another instance's and reads how much that part drives the decision, using a same-class swap to control for compositing artifacts. Because a surface vessel is a hull and a superstructure arranged along one axis, its parts form a 2x3 grid whose 2^6 = 64 swaps we evaluate exhaustively, and a single Walsh transform returns each part's interventional influence and its interaction spectrum. On planted shortcuts, where the true reliance is known, the measure tracks worst-group accuracy (r = -0.94 over 45 configurations), and replacing its learned segmenter with human annotations changes the hull-share by less than the audit's resolution. On the 26 vessel types of MARVEL, the classifier places about 46% of its corrected sensitivity on the generic hull yet follows the superstructure when the two conflict, and the group-label-free de-biasers available there do not detectably reduce the hull's share. The findings hold across three architectures and a second maritime dataset, and the method extends to fine-grained vehicle recognition on Stanford Cars.

</details>


### [195] [LC-TSRNet: A Land-Cover-Guided Two-Stage Network for Annual MODIS Surface Reflectance Time Series Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25120)
*Wenjuan Zhang,Xuesong Ma,Zhen Li,Meixiang Wang,Caimeng Yi,Jie Pan,Nan Su,Bing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LC-TSRNet，利用年度土地覆盖图作为先验并结合多尺度时空上下文与三维注意力机制，实现MODIS地表反射率产品的无缝隙年度重建，并构建AIRMOD-TSR数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MODIS地表反射率产品因云污染和传感器故障存在数据缺失，限制长时序大尺度应用。现有方法依赖光学时序无云观测或引入SAR辅助，但MODIS空间分辨率粗导致无云参考影像难获取，SAR与MODIS分辨率不匹配，难以提供有效先验约束。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 引入年度土地覆盖图作为先验，设计CSPM利用同类地物内光谱相似性为缺失区域提供光谱约束；(2) 设计SMRM自适应挖掘并整合多尺度时空上下文以应对大面积、持续性、重叠缺失，并设计3DAM实现跨维度联合约束以协同利用时空谱信息；同时构建AIRMOD-TSR数据集。

Result: 实验表明LC-TSRNet优于对比方法，重建精度与光谱保真度更佳；空间相邻场景下PSNR提升0.56 dB，SAM降低0.13°；植被监测应用验证了重建时序的实用价值。

Conclusion: 以土地覆盖先验+多尺度时空上下文+跨维注意力的组合可有效实现MODIS地表反射率无缝隙重建，并具备实际应用价值。

Abstract: MODIS surface reflectance (SR) products often suffer from data gaps due to cloud contamination and sensor malfunctions, limiting their applications in long-term and large-scale studies. Most existing methods rely on cloud-free observations from optical time series or introduce SAR time series as auxiliary information. However, due to the coarse spatial resolution of MODIS, cloud-free reference images are difficult to obtain, and SAR imagery is not well matched to the spatial resolution of MODIS, making it difficult to provide effective prior constraints. To address these issues, this study proposes LC-TSRNet for seamless reconstruction of annual MODIS SR products. In the first stage, an annual land cover map is introduced as prior knowledge, and CSPM is designed by leveraging the spectral similarity within identical land cover types, thereby providing prior spectral constraints for missing regions. In the second stage, to address large-area, persistent, and overlapping gaps in MODIS imagery, SMRM is designed to adaptively exploit and integrate multi-scale spatiotemporal contextual information. Meanwhile, to address the limited collaborative utilization of spatio-temporal-spectral information, 3DAM is designed to impose cross-dimensional joint constraints. Considering the lack of publicly available MODIS sample datasets, this study constructs the AIRMOD-TSR dataset. Extensive experimental results show that LC-TSRNet outperforms the comparison methods and achieves better reconstruction accuracy and spectral fidelity. Under the spatially adjacent scenario, LC-TSRNet improves PSNR by 0.56 dB and reduces SAM by 0.13°. The vegetation monitoring application further verifies the practical value of the reconstructed SR time series.

</details>


### [196] [OmniGround: Strengthening Omni-Modal Temporal Grounding via Attention-Consistency Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25929)
*Zixuan Chen,Depeng Wang,Hao Lin,Ke Xu,Ya Guo,Huijia Zhu,Tanfeng Sun,Xinghao Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现全模态大模型存在"时序生成鸿沟"——内部注意力定位时刻比生成的时间戳更准，据此提出TACG注意力一致性后训练方法，并构建580K训练数据，训练出OmniGround，在LongVALE（37.5 mIoU）与UnAV-100（35.7 mIoU）上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全模态大模型虽能联合理解视频、音频与文本，但时序定位（temporal grounding）能力薄弱，而这是真实音视频应用的关键能力。作者不满足于分析最终预测，转而考察模型内部时序证据，发现内部注意力对目标时刻的定位精度高于其生成的时间戳，即存在"时序生成鸿沟"（temporal generation gap）。

Method: 提出TACG（Temporal Attention-Consistency Grounding）后训练方法：将内部注意力视为可靠的时序枢轴（temporal pivot），通过注意力一致性训练使其同时与模型预测和真值标注对齐。同时从稠密音视频标注中重构时序QA，并组织通用全模态指令数据，构建580K样本训练集，用于训练OmniGround，且不引入任何额外时序线索。

Result: OmniGround在全模态时序定位上达到SOTA：LongVALE上37.5 mIoU，UnAV-100上35.7 mIoU；同时在通用音视频理解与纯视觉定位任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 内部注意力可作为比生成时间戳更可靠的时序定位信号，通过注意力一致性后训练可有效缩小时序生成鸿沟；该方法在不依赖额外时序线索的前提下，兼顾时序定位性能与通用多模态理解能力。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models can jointly understand video, audio, and text, yet they remain weak at temporal grounding, a capability essential for real-world audio-visual applications. To understand this limitation, we look beyond final predictions and examine the model's internal temporal evidence. We identify a temporal generation gap: the internal attention of the model localizes the target moment more accurately than the timestamps it generates. To close this gap, we propose TACG (Temporal Attention-Consistency Grounding), a post-training method that treats internal attention as a reliable temporal pivot and aligns it with both the model prediction and the ground-truth annotation through attention-consistency training. We further build a 580K-sample training dataset by reconstructing temporal QA from dense audio-visual annotations and organizing general omni-modal instruction data. Using TACG and this training dataset, we train OmniGround, a general-purpose omni-modal model with stronger temporal grounding capability, without injecting any additional temporal cues. OmniGround reaches state-of-the-art omni-modal temporal grounding, including 37.5 mIoU on LongVALE and 35.7 mIoU on UnAV-100, while staying competitive on both general audio-visual understanding and vision-only grounding.

</details>


### [197] [Do We Need Learned Targets? Classical Gradients as Supervision for 2D Gaussian Initialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25809)
*Kyungjune Baek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究能否用经典图像梯度（归一化Sobel图）替代Instant GaussianImage中昂贵的伪PPM监督目标，提出两条高斯初始化路线：免训练解析初始化器（0.32秒生成初始参数）与基于在线Sobel监督的神经初始化器，两者在Kodak、DIV2K及域偏移场景下均取得有竞争力的重建质量并显著降低流程时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学习的高斯图像初始化器依赖逐图像优化获得的有监督目标（Pseudo-PPM），监督成本高昂。作者希望验证经典图像梯度能否作为廉价替代监督信号。

Method: 框架以归一化Sobel图为监督，分两条技术路线：一是免训练解析初始化器，结合概率提升、并行网格采样与几何处理，平均0.32秒生成初始参数；二是神经初始化器，在DIV2K上用在线Sobel监督训练，无需离线目标优化，从而可将训练扩展至10,000张LSDIR图像且无额外预处理。

Result: 两条路线在Kodak与DIV2K上实现有竞争力的长预算重建。域偏移下，DIV2K训练的神经初始化器在Manga109上从500次拟合迭代起优于Instant-GI（5K迭代时高1.40 dB），改用LSDIR训练后该优势扩大到1.85 dB。在Kvasir-SEG上，免训练解析初始化器在所有报告预算下均超过Instant-GI。受控流程时间对比显示DIV2K上约4.9倍加速。

Conclusion: 结果证明廉价的解析式目标可作为优化衍生监督的实用替代方案，支撑可扩展的高斯初始化。

Abstract: Learning-based Gaussian image initializers can require costly supervision obtained by per-image optimization. We investigate whether the Pseudo-PPM targets used by Instant GaussianImage can be replaced by classical image gradients. Our framework uses normalized Sobel maps in two tracks. A training-free analytic initializer combines probability boosting, parallel grid-based sampling, and geometric processing, producing initial parameters in 0.32 seconds on average. A neural initializer is trained on DIV2K with online Sobel supervision, which removes offline target optimization and allows training to scale to 10,000 LSDIR images without additional preprocessing. Both tracks achieve competitive long-budget reconstruction on Kodak and DIV2K. Under domain shift, the DIV2K-trained neural initializer surpasses Instant-GI on Manga109 from 500 fitting iterations onward (by 1.40 dB at 5K iterations), and training on LSDIR increases this margin to 1.85 dB. On Kvasir-SEG, the training-free analytic initializer exceeds Instant-GI at every reported budget. A controlled pipeline-time comparison yields an estimated $4.9\times$ reduction for DIV2K. These results establish inexpensive analytic targets as a practical alternative to optimization-derived supervision for scalable Gaussian initialization.

</details>


### [198] [Procedural Exposure Bias in Skill-Augmented Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26062)
*Qing Yang,Yuqi Xiong,Pengcheng Huang,Zhipeng Xu,Zhenghao Liu,Zulong Chen,Yu Gu,Ge Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文识别出"程序性暴露偏差"(PEB)：技能中某程序模式被重复呈现时，模型会越来越偏好对应动作，即使状态与动作相关性不变；且视觉表示能显著减弱该偏差并提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部技能为语言模型智能体提供可复用的程序性知识，但模型在获得这些知识后如何使用它仍缺乏理解。作者希望厘清技能表示形式如何影响程序性知识到智能体决策的转化。

Method: 提出并定义PEB现象；对比同一程序内容以文本与视觉两种形式呈现时的动作偏好漂移；通过消融区分"视觉编码"与"结构化布局"的贡献；检验信号的可得性与作为动作证据的使用之间的分离；开展逐层分析与激活干预；在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop上进行完整智能体评测（四个模型）。

Result: PEB程度强烈依赖知识表示：视觉呈现相对文本显著减弱暴露导致的动作偏好偏移，且该减弱主要源于视觉编码而非结构化布局；重复程序信号在视觉表示中仍可恢复但对下游动作预测影响更弱；该效应延伸至可执行动作选择；逐层分析显示暴露相关的动作证据在靠近输出层时更明显、文本条件下更强，激活干预揭示内部组件在传递或抵消偏好偏移中的架构特异性作用；三个环境中视觉技能在四个模型上均取得更高的宏平均任务成功率。

Conclusion: 技能表示是决定程序性知识如何转化为智能体决策的重要因素，视觉技能可缓解程序性暴露偏差并提升任务表现。

Abstract: External skills provide language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge, yet how models use such knowledge after it is supplied remains poorly understood. We identify Procedural Exposure Bias (PEB), the tendency of language models to increasingly favor an action as its associated procedural pattern is repeatedly exposed in a skill, even when the interaction state and action relevance remain unchanged. We find that PEB strongly depends on how procedural knowledge is represented: presenting the same content visually substantially attenuates exposure-induced shifts in action preference relative to textual presentation. Further analysis shows that this attenuation primarily arises from visual encoding rather than structured layout. Although repeated procedural signals remain recoverable from Visual representations, they exert a weaker influence on downstream action prediction, distinguishing signal accessibility from its use as action evidence. This effect also extends to executable action selection, where increasing exposure more strongly favors the corresponding action under Text than Visual. Layer-wise analyses show that exposure-dependent action evidence becomes more pronounced toward the model output, with stronger evidence under Text, while activation interventions reveal architecture-specific roles of internal components in transmitting or counteracting the preference shift. Complete-agent evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop further show that Visual skills achieve higher macro-average task success than Text skills for all four evaluated models. These findings establish skill representation as an important factor governing how procedural knowledge is translated into agent decisions. All code is available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Vis-Skill.

</details>


### [199] [Curvature as a Baseline: Monocular Pose Measurement of Cylindrical Objects with Dual Colour Stripe Markers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26003)
*Jaesung Hong,Dong Won Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种利用圆柱已知曲率的双色条纹标记，通过不同深度的特征点形成“立体基线”以提升单目姿态测量中绕轴滚转角的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细长圆柱表面可用于平面标记的空间很小，难以布置常规平面标记，且单目测量中绕圆柱轴线的滚转角（roll）精度低。

Method: 设计双色条纹标记：两色边界提供长中心线，圆点与印刷边缘在不同深度上提供特征；利用物体已知曲率构造深度分离。用Cramér-Rao下界分析深度分离对roll估计的改善，并进行蒙特卡洛仿真验证，推导曲率矢高与等效立体基线灵敏度的关系。

Result: 在15 cm正对相机时，roll标准差CRLB：平面标记2.00°，单曲面标记0.38°，环绕式标记0.21°；蒙特卡洛roll RMS误差与对应标准差下界相差约10%以内；给出矢高与立体基线roll灵敏度的关系。

Conclusion: 曲率带来的深度分离显著提升单目roll测量精度，解析与仿真结果一致，可为标记几何设计提供依据。

Abstract: Thin cylindrical objects offer little space for planar markers. We propose a dual-colour-stripe marker that uses the known curvature of an object to improve pose measurement with a single camera. The boundary between two colours provides a long centre line, while dots and printed edges supply features at different depths. We analyse how this depth separation improves the estimation of rotation about the cylinder axis, or roll. For a camera-facing marker at 15 cm, the Cramér-Rao lower bound on roll standard deviation is 2.00°for a flat marker, 0.38°for a single curved marker and 0.21°for a wrap-around marker. Monte Carlo roll RMS errors are within about 10% of the corresponding standard-deviation bounds. A first-order relation connects the sagitta of the curved marker to the roll sensitivity provided by a stereo baseline. The analytical and simulation results explain how curvature improves monocular measurement and provide a basis for designing marker geometry.

</details>


### [200] [ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26213)
*Tom Wehrbein,Bodo Rosenhahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ExMR系统，用FootMR与HandMR两个局部细化模块，从单目视频重建身体、手、脚的3D运动，在ARCTIC、MOYO、RICH、MOOF上优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部与足部的精细关节运动对动画与运动分析很重要，但单目视频中难以恢复。现代表达性视频方法从共享的全身表示推断手部关节，低估了局部证据的作用；且2D手指关键点常缺失或不可靠。

Method: 基于"局部证据被低估"的观察，先用时间估计器预测全身运动；FootMR从足部关键点细化踝关节旋转；HandMR融合预训练手部重建模型的图像特征与初始手臂/手部旋转，细化肘、腕、手指旋转。二者预测残差关节旋转，组成ExMR系统。

Result: 在ARCTIC、MOYO、RICH、MOOF上，手部与足部重建优于SOTA；MOYO上相对最强竞品，手部逐顶点误差降低19%，踝关节角误差降低18%。

Conclusion: 细化局部证据以预测残差旋转是提升单目全身捕获中末端肢体精度的有效途径，FootMR与HandMR可集成于统一系统并泛化到多数据集。

Abstract: Detailed hand and foot articulation is important for animation and motion analysis, yet remains challenging to recover from monocular video. Recent expressive video methods infer hand articulation from shared whole-body representations. Our conference work suggests that this underexploits local evidence: the Foot Motion Refinement (FootMR) module refines ankle rotations from foot keypoints, improving reconstruction even when the initial estimator receives the same keypoints. We extend this principle to hands with the Hand Motion Refinement (HandMR) module. Because 2D finger keypoints are often missing or unreliable, HandMR combines image features of a pretrained hand reconstruction model with initial arm and hand rotations to refine elbows, wrists, and fingers. We integrate FootMR and HandMR into ExMR (Extremity Motion Refinement), a system for reconstructing 3D body, hand, and foot motion from monocular video. An initial temporal estimator predicts whole-body motion, after which both refiners revisit local evidence to predict residual joint rotations. Experiments on ARCTIC, MOYO, RICH, and MOOF show that ExMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in hand and foot reconstruction, reducing hand per-vertex error and ankle joint angle error on MOYO by 19% and 18%, respectively, relative to the strongest competitor. Code will be made available for research purposes. Project page: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/

</details>


### [201] [TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26165)
*Jia Li,Xurui Peng,Haowei Zhu,Tianyu Zhao,Jiexi Wang,Youwei Zheng,Yuxi Ren,Xinglong Wu,Xing Wang,Hayden Kwok-Hay So*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TriTD 将自回归视频扩散的误差分解为基模型误差、训练-推理分布失配与上游误差传播三项，据此推导逐步与累积误差的闭式上界，并提出三段式轨迹-分布协同蒸馏框架（NTD + CGN + OP-DMD），在单张 H100 上达到 26.8 FPS 实时吞吐且视觉质量优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散是高效视频生成的主流范式，但生成质量与推理效率之间的权衡阻碍其实际部署；作者将这一瓶颈归因于 AR rollout 中的三类误差来源，希望建立可分析的理论依据，以联合优化质量与效率。

Method: 1) 误差分解与理论分析：将误差拆为基模型误差、训练-推理分布失配、上游误差传播，推导每步与累积误差的闭式上界。2) Next-Node Trajectory Distillation（NTD）：用于 ODE 初始化，缩短监督视野、降低回归误差下界。3) Chunk-Graded Noising（CGN）：按 chunk 单调非递减的加噪调度，收窄训练-推理噪声失配期望，并去除冗余 KV-cache 更新以获得显著加速。4) Orthogonal-Parallel DMD（OP-DMD）：在保留原始 DMD 监督的同时，在正交子空间加入额外回归约束以抑制离轴漂移，提升训练稳定性与生成质量。

Result: 大量实验表明 TriTD 在视觉质量上持续超越现有基线，并在单张 H100 GPU 上实现 26.8 FPS 的实时吞吐。

Conclusion: TriTD 通过理论驱动的三项互补模块，实现了质量与效率的平衡，为交互式流式视频生成提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.

</details>


### [202] [XGLASS: X-Ray, Gaze and Language Assisted Slice Sequencing for CT Volumes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26255)
*Michael Glöckler,Timo Ropinski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出XGLASS，将2D胸片中的放射科医生注视先验迁移到CT，实现任务感知的轴位切片优先级排序，大幅提升预算受限检索与下游分类效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D医学视觉语言模型（VLM）表现优异，但直接处理CT/MRI体数据的3D VLM受限于3D训练数据稀缺与2D基础架构主导而落后。利用强大2D VLM分析数百张切片的体数据，需先筛选出少数具诊断价值的切片，故需一种任务感知的切片优先排序方法。

Method: XGLASS从X光上语言对齐的放射科医生注视数据中导出疾病条件重要性图，并将其与冠状位CT投影进行空间对齐，使注视先验与CT内容进入共享2D表示；融合后的注视先验/CT投影用于预测疾病特异的轴位切片排序，从而优先输出诊断相关切片。

Result: 在预算受限检索上显著优于2D与3D原生基线，最佳疾病top-10命中率达75.9%（仅检查240层扫描的前10层，即4.17%，即在超75%案例中命中诊断相关切片）。下游切片级发现分类中，30层候选集将模型调用减少87.5%，F1较全切片推理提升11.3个百分点、较最强2D选择器提升4.2个百分点，并与3D原生选择器竞争力相当，而每个finding耗时减少至多130.8倍、GPU显存减少至多10.9倍。

Conclusion: XGLASS可作为体CT分析的轻量级预选器，有效桥接2D VLM与3D体数据；代码与预训练权重已开源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve remarkable performance on 2D medical images, such as X-rays or pathology images, while 3D VLMs that directly process CT/MRI volumes lag behind due to limited 3D training data and the predominance of 2D foundation architectures. To leverage powerful 2D VLMs for analyzing medical volumes, which contain hundreds of slices, it is therefore necessary to focus only on those few slices, which are diagnostically relevant. To enable such a prioritization, we propose XGLASS, a method that transfers medical expertise from 2D X-rays to 3D CT for task-aware slice prioritization. XGLASS uses disease-conditioned importance maps derived from language-aligned radiologist gaze on X-rays and spatially aligns them with coronal CT projections, bringing gaze priors and CT content into a shared 2D representation. The fused gaze-prior/CT projection is then used to predict a disease-specific ordering of axial slices, prioritizing diagnostically relevant slices. XGLASS significantly improves budgeted retrieval over 2D and 3D-native baselines, achieving a top-10 hit rate up to 75.9% for the best-performing disease. In practice, this means that after inspecting only the top 10 slices (4.17% of a 240-slice scan), XGLASS identifies a diagnostically relevant slice in more than 75% of cases. For downstream slice-wise finding classification, an XGLASS-selected 30-slice candidate set reduces model calls by 87.5% while improving F1 by 11.3 percentage points over all-slice inference, 4.2 points over the strongest 2D selector, and remains competitive with 3D-native selectors while requiring up to 130.8 times less time and 10.9 times less GPU memory per finding, supporting its use as a lightweight preselector for volumetric CT analysis. The code and pretrained checkpoint are available on https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS.

</details>


### [203] [Toolkit for Facial Deidentification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26079)
*Esteban Leiva-Montenegro,Matthieu Pillot,Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez,Vitomir Struc,Peter Peer,Blaž Meden*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个开源的人脸去身份识别（de-identification）评估工具箱，提供从预处理、去识别处理到性能评估的完整流水线，基于数据效用、图像质量和身份保护三类指标，支持多种数据集，便于对新方法进行标准化基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人脸去识别技术研究缺乏统一的评估框架与标准，导致不同方法之间难以公平比较；作者希望统一未来研究，为面部生物特征中的隐私增强技术提供标准化评估工具。

Method: 构建开源工具包，集成完整评估流水线：预处理、去识别处理与性能评估，并内置可用的评估模型；评估维度涵盖数据效用、图像质量和身份保护指标，支持多种数据集以对新去识别技术进行基准测试。

Result: 结果显示部分技术在保持图像效用的同时能有效保护隐私；工具包（github.com/blazm/deid-toolkit）已开源发布。

Conclusion: 该工具包为人脸去识别研究提供了标准化评估框架，有望统一并推动面部生物特征隐私增强技术的后续研究。

Abstract: This work presents a novel open-source toolkit designed for the evaluation of face deidentification techniques with available evaluation models. The framework provides a complete evaluation pipeline, including preprocessing, deidentification, and performance assessment, based on data utility, image quality, and identity protection metrics. It supports a variety of datasets, enabling researchers to easily benchmark new deidentification techniques. Results show the effectiveness of some techniques on maintaining privacy while preserving image utility. The toolkit is aimed at unifying future research by providing a standard evaluation framework for privacy-enhancing technologies in facial biometrics. Implementation is available at github.com/blazm/deid-toolkit.

</details>


### [204] [Multi-scale Fusion of Fast Vision Mamba and Foundation Model Features for Patch-Level Gleason Grading in Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25904)
*Zihe Zhang,Weimiao Yu,Piumi Don Simonge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于状态空间模型（Mamba）的多尺度前列腺WSI Gleason分级分类器，融合冻结的病理基础模型特征与蒸馏得到的轻量FastVim特征，在PANDA上取得macro F1 0.894、Gleason 5 F1 0.802。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gleason分级面临分级间形态差异细微、罕见模式导致的严重类别不平衡、诊断特征跨多个空间尺度等问题；病理基础模型虽能提取强patch表征，但通常仅单尺度运行，空间上下文受限，对依赖更大范围上下文的类别影响尤为明显；如何在数据与算力有限条件下融合多尺度与互补模型仍未解决。

Method: 构建基于状态空间模型的多尺度分类器：特征来源为冻结的基础模型与在ImageNet上预训练并从基础模型蒸馏的轻量FastVim（直接读取原始图像块）；在每个尺度上，用Mamba以线性时间编码两路特征并建模空间上下文，再由联合训练的分类头融合编码表征输出单一预测；在PANDA数据集上以5折交叉验证评估，并开展覆盖5个基础模型、5个基分类器、3个尺度的控制实验。

Result: PANDA上macro F1为0.894，Gleason 5 F1为0.802，相对最佳单尺度模型分别提升12%与21%；控制实验表明增益在多种编码器下均成立，且尺度越小提升越明显。

Conclusion: 以Mamba为核心的多尺度、多源特征融合方案可在低数据与低算力条件下有效提升Gleason分级性能，且该增益具有跨编码器的稳健性，小尺度场景受益更大。

Abstract: Automated Gleason grading of prostate whole slide images (WSIs) enables faster and more consistent cancer risk stratification. However, it remains a challenging task due to the subtle morphological differences between grades, the severe class imbalance arising from rare patterns, and the diagnostic features that span multiple spatial scales. Pathology foundation models (FMs) extract strong patch representations but often operate at a single-scale, which limits spatial context and disproportionately affects classes that depend on broader context. The challenge of fusing multiple scales and complementary models, with minimal data and computational resources, remains unresolved. We propose a multi-scale classifier built on state-space models. Our method combines two complementary feature sources: a frozen foundation model, and a lightweight FastVim, pre-trained on ImageNet and distilled from the foundation model, that reads the raw image crops. At each scale, a Mamba model encodes the features from both sources with linear-time spatial context, and a jointly trained head fuses the encoded representations into one prediction. On the PANDA dataset, our method reaches macro F1 of 0.894 and Gleason 5 F1 of 0.802 under 5-fold cross-validation, a 12% and 21% relative improvement over the best single-scale model. A controlled study over 5 foundation models, 5 base classifiers and 3 scales confirms that the gain holds across encoders, with larger improvements observed at smaller scales.

</details>


### [205] [Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25645)
*Sooyeon Park,Hemraj Singh,Kyunghyun Min,Youngjae Yu,Sung-Bae Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法Dero，通过对文本嵌入进行双向SVD的语义分解与重组，缓解T2I扩散模型中的否定语义偏置问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型在否定（negation）生成上表现不佳，根源在于文本表示中深度纠缠的隐性语言偏置，使得与偏置一致的语义常压过用户期望的否定约束。现有方法难以在保持语义保真与图像质量的同时修正这一问题。

Method: Dero为免训练、模型无关的推理期框架，仅在文本表示层面操作。它借助辅助提示（auxiliary prompts）分别构造语义保持子空间与偏置子空间，基于双向SVD（bidirectional SVD）实现语义解耦；随后对纠缠表示进行分解，并选择性地重组解耦后的语义分量，将文本表示重新对齐到目标否定语义，同时回注残余的风格特征以维持语义保真度与图像质量。可无缝应用于U-Net与DiT等不同扩散架构。

Result: 在对象级与概念级否定任务上的大量实验显示，否定感知生成效果稳定提升，文本-图像对齐更强、语义保真度更好，人类偏好评分更高。

Conclusion: 通过子空间层面的语义分解与重组来显式分离偏置与目标否定语义，是一种简洁有效的免训练否定生成方案，具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Negation-aware image generation remains challenging for text-to-image diffusion models, which often struggle with negation due to implicit linguistic biases that are deeply entangled within text representations. As a result, bias-aligned semantics frequently dominate over intended negative constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a simple training-free method of Decompose and Recompose text embedding (Dero), which constructs a semantic-preserving subspace and a bias subspace using auxiliary prompts and performs semantic disentanglement based on bidirectional SVD. By decomposing entangled representations and selectively recomposing disentangled semantic components, Dero realigns text representations toward intended negation semantics while restoring residual stylistic features to preserve semantic fidelity and image quality. As a model-agnostic inference-time framework operating solely on text representations, Dero can be seamlessly applied to diverse diffusion architectures, including both U-Net and DiT based models. Extensive experiments on both object- and concept-level negation demonstrate consistent improvements in negation-aware image generation, achieving stronger text-image alignment, better semantic fidelity, and higher human preference scores.

</details>


### [206] [TNVD-SC: Diagnosing Scan Context Failures in Forests with Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25637)
*Jineon Kim,Jhonghyun An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出地形归一化垂直分布扫描上下文（TNVD-SC），在森林长期LiDAR地点识别中通过地形相对垂直概率分布编码缓解结构混叠，标准化协议下平均R@1达91.83%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林长期LiDAR地点识别因重复植被与不平坦地形导致严重结构混叠。作者将Scan Context（SC）的候选检索与精细匹配分离诊断：TNVD支撑键令约99%查询的真实位置进入top-25候选集，但常规SC匹配仅达61.84%平均R@1，说明瓶颈在匹配阶段而非检索阶段；同时相同候选集下垂直分布单元比最大高度单元增益大得多（19.72 vs 1.21点）。

Method: 提出TNVD-SC：保留SC的环-扇区拓扑结构，将描述子改为地形相对（terrain-relative）垂直概率分布编码；并实现无损计数编码与精确层次Jensen-Shannon搜索以降低描述子负载与计算延迟。

Result: 标准化TreeLoc++ Wild-Places协议下平均R@1为91.83%，在对比方法中取得最高R@1均值与最佳R@1稳定性；TreeLoc++在平均MR、MF1、AUC上仍更强。方法未改动即在四会话CVTNet式NCLT评估上取得85.14%平均R@1。计数编码实现将描述子体积压缩3.86倍、计算延迟降低23.8%，且检索输出审计不变。

Conclusion: 消融诊断表明SC精细匹配阶段的垂直表征与地形归一化是关键改进方向；TNVD-SC在保持SC拓扑简洁性的同时显著提升森林场景R@1与稳定性，并具备可无损压缩的高效实现。整体排名指标上仍有提升空间。

Abstract: Long-term LiDAR place recognition in forests is difficult because repetitive vegetation and uneven terrain create severe structural aliasing. We diagnose Scan Context (SC) by separating candidate retrieval from fine matching: on the standardized TreeLoc++ Wild-Places protocol, a TNVD support key places a valid location in the top-25 set for approximately 99% of queries, while conventional SC matching on those candidates reaches only 61.84% mean R@1. With an identical raw-SC candidate set, terrain normalization improves max-height cells by only 1.21 points but vertical-distribution cells by 19.72 points. These observations motivate Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distribution Scan Context (TNVD-SC), which preserves the SC ring-sector topology while encoding terrain-relative vertical probability distributions. Under the standardized TreeLoc++ protocol, TNVD-SC reaches 91.83% mean R@1 and attains the highest R@1 mean and R@1 stability among the compared methods, while TreeLoc++ remains stronger in mean MR, MF1, and AUC. The unchanged method reaches 85.14% mean R@1 on the four-session CVTNet-style NCLT evaluation. A lossless count-coded implementation with exact hierarchical Jensen-Shannon search reduces descriptor payload by 3.86x and compute latency by 23.8% without changing the audited retrieval outputs.

</details>


### [207] [Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25631)
*Jeagon Song,Jhonghyun An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅在训练时使用的“前景吸引损失”，通过伪深度将前景伪标签像素反投影为3D点并牵引附近高斯向该点聚集，从而提升高斯表示对前景体素的密度集中度与前景IoU，推理网络保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机3D语义占据模型可借助2D伪标签渲染监督、无需3D标注训练。但在稀疏高斯表示中，高斯位置仅通过逐像素渲染损失学习，作者假设这会赋予小前景物体过低的权重。实测GaussianFlowOcc模型前景体素上的高斯密度仅约为背景的1.62倍，说明前景与背景区分不足。

Method: 设计训练专用的前景吸引损失：将前景伪标签像素结合伪深度反投影为3D点，把附近的高斯拉向这些点，并偏向已预测出目标类别的高斯；推理阶段网络结构不变。消融还包括与真值体素位置目标对比，以及仅作用于高斯位置的变体。

Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上，三次随机种子下前景/背景高斯密度比由1.62升至2.40；平均前景IoU从6.29升至6.96，且三个种子均提升；平均mIoU从13.53到13.82，但变化处于基线种子间波动范围内。单次运行消融显示伪标签目标优于真值体素目标，仅调整高斯位置并不充分；单种子测试显示推理时保留更少高斯时模型退化更小。

Conclusion: 逐像素渲染监督确实使高斯位置学习对前景欠加权，而显式的3D前景吸引监督可有效缓解该问题，代价极低（不改变推理）。但mIoU提升不显著，效果主要体现在前景IoU与推理时高斯剪枝鲁棒性上，整体增益有限，需在大规模多种子下进一步验证。

Abstract: Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.

</details>


### [208] [DiffGround: Semantic Difference-Guided Zero-Shot Video Question Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25570)
*Cheng-Han Lee,Amir Salimi,Hsiang-Wei Huang,Che-Chun Su,Min Sun,Cheng-Hao Kuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffGround：基于冻结MLLM的动作驱动零样本VideoQG框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VideoQG需同时问答与精确时间定位，但有监督方法依赖昂贵时间标注，现有零样本方法面向VQA、未针对时间定位优化。

Method: 先用冻结MLLM预测与答案相关的动作线索，将推理型问题转为动作中心检索查询；该线索引导VLM选取关键帧；再用免训练的Semantic Diff Refinement，利用相邻SigLIP2嵌入的语义差异从稀疏预测恢复完整动作片段。

Result: 在NExT-GQA与STAR上一致超越现有零样本与有监督方法，刷新VideoQG SOTA。

Conclusion: 动作线索与语义差异细化可在无时间标注下实现精确的时间定位与问答，验证了零样本框架的有效性。

Abstract: Video Question Grounding (VideoQG) requires both accurate question answering and precise temporal localization. Existing supervised methods rely on costly temporal annotations, while existing zero-shot approaches are primarily designed for Video Question Answering (VQA) and are not optimized for temporal grounding. We propose DiffGround, an action-driven zero-shot framework built upon frozen Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our framework first predicts an answer-relevant action cue that transforms the input question into an explicit semantic target for grounding. Action Cue converts a reasoningoriented question into an action-centric retrieval query. Guided by the action cue, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) efficiently selects informative keyframes for reasoning. Finally, we introduce Semantic Diff Refinement, a training-free temporal refinement method that exploits semantic differences between neighboring SigLIP2 embeddings to recover complete action segments from sparse predictions. Extensive experiments on NExT-GQA and STAR show that DiffGround consistently outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods, establishing a new state of the art for Video Question Grounding.

</details>


### [209] [Test-Time Scaling of Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models with Noise-Rejuvenated Sequential Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25479)
*Wenyi Lian,Zheng Zhao,Thomas B. Sch{ö}n*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 noise-rejuvenated SMC，将序列蒙特卡洛测试时缩放迁移到基于确定性 ODE 的 flow matching 文生图模型，通过"换源噪声 + 用当前端点估计重建中间状态"扰动重采样粒子，并加入前瞻细化，在 SD3、FLUX.1-dev、Z-Image 上稳定提升奖励引导生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 SMC 测试时缩放依赖随机性提议，而 flow matching 推理由确定性 ODE 支配，因此 SMC 无法直接迁移；若把采样器改为 SDE 又会偏离原模型性质并增加开销。作者希望在不转换采样器形式的前提下，为 flow matching 模型提供可行的粒子探索机制，以实现用户指定奖励（如人类偏好分数）下的采样。

Method: 核心为 noise-rejuvenated SMC：对每个重采样后的粒子，改变其源噪声，并利用该粒子当前的终点估计重建新的中间状态，使新状态仍处于 flow matching 插值形式可表示的状态空间内，从而实现粒子探索而无需将采样器转为 SDE。此外引入 look-ahead 机制，在加权前对重采样粒子进行前瞻细化，以提升权重评估的准确性。

Result: 在 Stable Diffusion 3、FLUX.1-dev 与 Z-Image 上的实验表明，奖励引导生成效果获得一致性提升；消融实验验证了 noise rejuvenation 与 look-ahead refinement 两个组件的各自贡献。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作为确定性 ODE 采样的 flow matching 模型提供了与 SMC 兼容的测试时缩放方案，保持采样器形式不变即实现有效粒子探索，是一种通用、即插即用的推理时对齐方法。

Abstract: Test-time scaling of diffusion models with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a promising strategy for sampling under user-specified rewards, such as human preference scores. However, the standard SMC framework typically relies on stochastic proposals and therefore does not directly transfer to flow matching models, in which inference is governed by deterministic ODEs. In this work, we introduce noise-rejuvenated SMC, an inference-time scaling method tailored for text-to-image flow matching models. Our key idea is to perturb each resampled particle by changing its source noise and constructing a new intermediate state using its current endpoint estimate. This moves the particle to another state that remains representable under the flow-matching interpolation form, enabling particle exploration without converting the sampler to an SDE. We further introduce a look-ahead mechanism to refine resampled particles before weighting. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, and Z-Image demonstrate consistent improvements in reward-guided generation, while ablation studies validate the contributions of noise rejuvenation and look-ahead refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/NR-SMC.

</details>


### [210] [DragonMoCap: Monocular Video-based Motion Capture for Diverse Dragon Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25437)
*Zhongfei Qing,Xiaoxiang Zhao,Ling-Hao Chen,Zhongang Cai,Wenjia Wang,Yifan Wu,Qianying Liu,Wei Zeng,Bo Hu,Songnan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DragonMoCap框架，将目标骨架视为动态输入而非固定先验，实现龙类角色单目动作捕捉与零样本跨骨架泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 龙类角色动作捕捉目前依赖手工关键帧，缺少高质量数据集与参数化模型；主要障碍是不同龙骨架在关节数量与命名规范上的极端拓扑多样性，使传统固定模板回归器失效。

Method: 将框架范围限定于最常见的制作拓扑；设计语言驱动的关节查询token，构建"骨架内可区分性+骨架间相似性"的双性质表示；提出非参数化查询token检索机制，实现无需重训练的对未见骨架零样本适配。

Result: 在多种龙类拓扑上持续优于HMR类基线；已集成到专业动画工作流，展现实时工业应用潜力。

Conclusion: 通过语言驱动的动态骨架表征与检索式零样本迁移，DragonMoCap为高拓扑多样性角色的单目动作捕捉提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This work explores monocular motion capture for dragon-type characters, which currently relies on manual keyframing due to the lack of high-quality datasets and parametric models. The primary obstacle lies in the extreme topological diversity across dragon rigs, where varying joint counts and naming conventions render traditional fixed-template regressors inapplicable. To address this, we introduce DragonMoCap, a novel framework that treats the target rig as a dynamic input rather than a fixed prior. By deliberately scoping the framework to the most prevalent production topologies, we ensure high-fidelity results across diverse morphologies. The core of our approach is the design of language-grounded joint query tokens, which establish a dual-property representation: ensuring intra-rig discriminability while maintaining cross-rig similarity. We further propose a non-parametric query-token retrieval mechanism to enable zero-shot adaptation to unseen rigs without retraining. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DragonMoCap consistently outperforms HMR-style baselines across diverse dragon topologies. The practical utility of our framework is further evidenced by its integration into professional animation workflows, highlighting its potential for real-time industrial applications.

</details>


### [211] [LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25358)
*Mohammad Omama,Aeyan Ashraf,Sandeep Chinchali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可缓存图像匹配范式与LateMatch方法，将跨图交互推迟到末层，实现离线缓存上下文、在线仅执行少量交互块，并结合E-SToRE熵引导的token约减，在多个基准上降低2倍以上计算成本且精度损失可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度特征匹配器在边缘设备部署受限于巨大计算开销。标准匹配器在每一层紧密交织图内上下文构建与跨图匹配，形成严重交互瓶颈：单次查询对K张数据库图像需独立执行完整网络K次，且无法缓存中间结果。

Method: 提出"可缓存图像匹配"范式，并以LateMatch实现：重构现有匹配器，将跨图交互延后至最后几层；把图内处理隔离为可离线缓存的Context Blocks，在线仅执行少量Interaction Blocks。进一步引入E-SToRE（熵引导的空间token约减与扩展），利用后段交互块Shannon熵下降的特性，在跨图交互前动态缩减token数量。

Result: 在HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth、ETH-3D与Aachen上评估，LateMatch相较标准深度匹配器将有效计算成本降低2倍以上；E-SToRE在此基础上额外节省10%–14%，且精度退化可忽略。

Conclusion: 通过解耦图内与跨图计算并引入熵引导的token约减，可在几乎不损精度的前提下显著降低视觉定位匹配的计算开销，为边缘设备部署提供可行路径。

Abstract: Visual localization is critical for embodied agents, but deploying state-of-the-art deep feature matchers on edge devices is fundamentally limited by their massive computational cost. Standard deep matchers tightly interleave intra-image context building and inter-image matching at every layer, creating a severe interaction bottleneck. Localizing a single query against K database images forces the system to execute the full network K independent times with no capacity for caching. To break this bottleneck, we advocate for a paradigm shift toward cacheable image matching. We realize this paradigm with LateMatch, a versatile approach that restructures existing matchers by deferring inter-image interaction to their final layers. By isolating intra-image processing into offline-cacheable Context Blocks, only a small set of Interaction Blocks must be executed online. To further optimize LateMatch, we introduce E-SToRE (Entropy-guided Spatial Token Reduction and Expansion). E-SToRE leverages the decreasing Shannon entropy of the late Interaction Blocks to dynamically reduce token counts just prior to cross-image interaction. Evaluated across HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth, ETH-3D, and Aachen, LateMatch reduces effective computational cost by over 2x compared to standard deep matchers, while E-SToRE yields an additional 10% to 14% savings with negligible degradation in accuracy.

</details>


### [212] [Functional Cross-layer Experts Routing for One-step Diffusion Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25742)
*Zile Huang,Ser-nam Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeMoE，在一阶蒸馏扩散模型中用"共享专家+条件路由残差"的结构重分配图像FFN内部容量，提升单步生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步蒸馏把扩散轨迹压缩为单次前向评估，但如何在这一剩余的单次前向中组织内部容量（参数如何分配）仍鲜有探索。此时同一组参数须同时保留通用生成先验并解析提示词特定细节，且不能迭代修正，作者将这一问题形式化为"功能分配"(functional allocation)。

Method: 通过分析得出：解耦表征仅在专家干扰超过共享迁移收益时才有利，因此应优先采用"始终激活的共享主干+条件路由残差"，而非标准孤立MoE。据此提出DeMoE：在图像FFN中，以一个常驻共享专家搭配条件路由的专家切片，在一阶分布匹配目标下训练，并加入"已执行路由"的监督信号。

Result: 在一阶FLUX.2-4B生成上，DeMoE取得GenEval 0.8220，仅激活图像FFN宽度的80.5%，大幅优于稠密一步基线，整体与50步教师持平，并在复杂组合与计数任务上超过教师；在COCO-10K上，在单步模型中取得SOTA的保真度与多样性。

Conclusion: 结构化的内部计算重分配为扩散模型提供了一种更优的压缩范式。

Abstract: One-step distillation compresses diffusion trajectories into a single forward evaluation, yet how internal capacity should be structured within that remaining pass remains largely unexplored. In this setting, identical parameters must simultaneously preserve general generative priors and resolve prompt-specific details without iterative refinement. We formalize this challenge as functional allocation. Our analysis reveals that decoupling representations is beneficial only when expert interference outweighs shared transfer, favoring an always-active shared backbone augmented with conditionally routed residuals over standard isolated MoE architectures. We propose DeMoE, which pairs a persistent shared expert with conditionally routed expert slices across image FFNs, trained under a one-step distribution-matching objective with executed-route supervision. On one-step FLUX.2-4B generation, DeMoE achieves a GenEval score of 0.8220 while activating only 80.5% of the image-FFN width, substantially outperforming dense one-step baselines, matching the 50-step teacher overall, and surpassing it on complex composition and counting. Across COCO-10K, DeMoE establishes state-of-the-art fidelity and diversity among single-step models, demonstrating that structured internal computation reallocation provides a superior compression paradigm for diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/toffeecat/demoe-ttt-router.

</details>


### [213] [AVTime: Reinforcing Dense Audio-Visual Captions with Bidirectional Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26046)
*Mingyang Wu,Kaituo Feng,Bohao Li,Kaixiong Gong,Zihao Yin,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对稠密时序音视频字幕生成任务，提出数据集AVTime-50K、模型AVTime（含BiTSA双向时序-语义对齐奖励）与基准AVTime-Bench，三者分别解决数据、方法与评测的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有稠密时序音视频字幕工作存在三个瓶颈：(1) 缺少同时具备高时间分辨率、较长视频以及时间与事件双向对齐的数据集；(2) 现有强化学习方法多依赖checklist式奖励；(3) 缺少能双向评估事件语义正确性与时间准确性的基准。

Method: 提出三项对应贡献：1) AVTime-50K，50K规模、时序精确、语义准确、视频更长的数据集；2) AVTime模型，采用新提出的双向时序-语义对齐（BiTSA）奖励，在时间与事件之间施加显式双向约束进行优化；3) AVTime-Bench基准，引入时间准确性与语义正确性的双向评估。

Result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅声明AVTime为state-of-the-art模型，并公开代码、模型与数据集。

Conclusion: 通过数据集、模型与基准三位一体的方案，缓解稠密时序音视频字幕在数据对齐、奖励设计与评测方式上的缺陷，推动多模态视频理解与生成。

Abstract: Dense temporal audio-visual captioning is important for multimodal video understanding and generation. However, prior work is constrained by three main limitations: (1) the lack of a dataset combining high temporal resolution, longer videos, and bidirectional alignment between time and events; (2) the reliance of most existing RL methods on checklists; and (3) the lack of a benchmark that bidirectionally evaluates event semantic correctness and temporal accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose: (1) AVTime-50K, a high-quality 50K-scale dataset with temporally precise, semantically accurate captions and longer videos; (2) AVTime, a state-of-the-art model optimized with a novel Bidirectional Temporal-Semantic Alignment (BiTSA) reward that imposes explicit bidirectional constraints between time and events; and (3) AVTime-Bench, a specialized benchmark that introduces a novel bidirectional evaluation of temporal accuracy and semantic correctness. Our code, models, and datasets are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Apryle/avtime.

</details>


### [214] [TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26271)
*Yiheng Dong,Yi Lin,Shilong Huang,Xiyan Yang,Xin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架TIM，通过时间解耦表征学习与迭代互精修生成纵向放射报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动放射报告生成（RRG）多局限于单时间点分析，无法刻画纵向检查中的疾病时序演变；已有纵向RRG（LRRG）将不同时间点图像混于单一表征空间，导致语义模糊、时序推理不一致。

Method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 时间解耦表征学习，将时序演变模式与疾病特异特征分离，并分别为既往与当前检查生成报告；Stage II 互报告精修机制，识别既往报告内部的诊断不一致，并通过误差敏感反馈迭代修正既往与当前报告。

Result: 在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上优于现有单图像与纵向基线，在语言与临床指标上均达到新的SOTA。

Conclusion: 显式解耦空间病理与时序进展并结合迭代互反馈，可有效提升纵向放射报告生成的语义一致性与临床准确性。

Abstract: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.

</details>


### [215] [Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26179)
*Xiang Kaibo,Liu Qingfeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用轻量级目标条件网络替代分层世界模型中昂贵的上层候选轨迹搜索，通过冻结的高层预测器训练，在多个任务上取得优于HWM搜索基线的成功率并实现1.28-4.39倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层世界模型通过将粗粒度模型的预测状态传递给低层控制器来实现长时程规划，但选择这些状态代价高昂：上层规划器需对候选宏动作轨迹反复求导（differentiation）进行搜索。

Method: 用目标条件网络（goal-conditioned network）替代搜索，该网络经冻结的高层预测器训练。网络提供条件向量，预测器生成下一个潜在路标（latent waypoint）。训练采用hindsight goals与状态预测损失，基于离线轨迹，无需搜索解目标或宏动作标签。推理保留自回归高层rollout但无需高层候选优化。

Result: 在H-JEPA分发的共享潜在HWM检查点上评估（3个骨干种子×3个头初始化）：平均成功率Cube 70.4%、Push-T 48.7%、FourRoom 100.0%、Visual AntMaze 71.1%。在三个环境上优于HWM搜索基线，Push-T持平。NVIDIA L40S上批评估端到端加速1.28–4.39倍。

Conclusion: 消融表明状态自适应条件（state-adaptive conditioning）是稳定贡献因素，而预测器介导的子目标（predictor-mediated subgoals）和无限制条件（unrestricted conditions）的收益依赖环境。该方法在保持自回归高层rollout的同时消除了高成本的候选优化。

Abstract: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.

</details>


### [216] [Auditing Semantic and Relational Reliability in Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25849)
*S M Asif Hossain,Ruksat Khan Shayoni,Md Kishor Morol*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种五视角诊断协议，用于评估开放词汇人-物交互检测中"语义评分"与"关系有效性"的混淆问题，并在HICO-DET上验证了不同评分视角会改变系统排名结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇HOI检测器用自由文本描述交互，导致评估困难：类别评分会误拒合理改写，语义相似度评分又可能奖励"动作错误"或"角色反转"的预测。现有评估无法区分"匹配引擎的效果"与"语义给分的效果"。

Method: 固定所有预测结果不变，用五个视角打分：官方类别评估、身份对照、词汇归一化、分级语义给分、严格命题等价。配套使用保义/破义的受控变换与对自然预测的盲审，并推导连接平均给分、无效接受率与变换计数的自洽性检查。

Result: 在HICO-DET的六个系统上，各视角对领先系统判断不一致：官方评估GEN-VLKT领先，SHOE下SL-HOI领先，严格等价下GEN-VLKT再次领先。语义增益约1.6–20.3 mAP；AgentHOI在强制等价后保留不足一半增益。

Conclusion: 建议同时报告语义分数、关系有效性与配对不确定性，避免把"回收的给分"误读为更好的交互理解能力。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction detectors describe interactions in free text, and this creates a problem for evaluation. Category scoring rejects valid paraphrases, while semantic similarity scoring can reward predictions that name the wrong action or reverse the roles of the participants. We present a diagnostic protocol that holds every prediction fixed and scores it under five views, namely official category evaluation, an identity control, lexical normalization, graded semantic credit, and strict propositional equivalence. Comparing these views separates the effect of the matching engine from the effect of semantic credit. The protocol pairs controlled transformations that preserve or break meaning with a blinded audit of natural predictions, and we derive consistency checks that link mean credit, invalid acceptance, and transformation counts. Applied to six systems on HICO-DET, the views disagree on which system leads. GEN-VLKT leads under official evaluation, SL-HOI leads under SHOE, and GEN-VLKT leads again under strict equivalence. Semantic gains range from 1.6 to 20.3 mAP, and AgentHOI keeps less than half of its gain once equivalence is enforced. We recommend that semantic scores be reported together with relational validity and paired uncertainty, so that recovered credit is not read as better interaction understanding.

</details>


### [217] [VHA: VQA-based Hallucination Assessment for Generative Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25770)
*Donghun Ryou,Inju Ha,Jaeyoo Park,Bohyung Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于双向VQA的幻觉评估指标VHA及其轻量化学习版本VHA+，并构建人工标注基准VHA-bench，验证二者与人类幻觉判断高度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式图像超分辨虽能产生视觉逼真的高分辨率图像，但可能添加无依据内容或篡改已有细节，形成幻觉。现有超分辨评价指标无法衡量生成细节是否仍与参考图像保持一致（grounded），缺少针对幻觉的度量手段。

Method: 1) VHA：利用视觉语言模型（VLM）为每张图像构造问答对，在超分图像与其真值图像上双向互答；通过两个方向得分的差异揭示真值信息的缺失/篡改以及无依据的新增内容。2) VHA+：由于VLM推理计算开销大，训练一个轻量学习模型，直接从真值-超分图像对回归预测VHA分数。3) VHA-bench：通过人类主观研究构建幻觉评测基准，用于验证指标与人类判断的一致性。

Result: 实验表明VHA与VHA+均与人类对幻觉的判断呈高度相关性；VHA+在保持评估效果的同时避免了昂贵的VLM逐次推理。

Conclusion: 双向VQA是一种有效且可量化超分辨幻觉的评估范式，可通过蒸馏式轻量模型高效近似；配套基准与开源代码为后续幻觉评估研究提供了可复现的评测基础。

Abstract: Generative image super-resolution produces visually realistic high-resolution images, but may also introduce hallucinations by adding unsupported content or altering existing details. Because existing super-resolution metrics fail to measure whether generated details remain grounded in the reference image, we present a hallucination assessment technique based on bidirectional visual question answering (VQA), which we term VQA-based Hallucination Assessment (VHA). The proposed approach uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine whether the semantic content and low-level visual evidence in a super-resolved image are supported by its ground-truth counterpart. To this end, it constructs question--answer pairs from each image and evaluates them on both images. Discrepancies between the resulting scores in both directions reveal missing or altered ground-truth information and unsupported additions. However, obtaining these scores requires computationally expensive VLM inference. We therefore develop VHA+, a learned, lightweight model that directly predicts VHA scores from ground-truth and super-resolved image pairs. We construct a hallucination benchmark, VHA-bench, through a human study and show that both VHA and VHA+ correlate highly with human judgments of hallucination. The code, benchmark, and model weights are available at https://github.com/dhryougit/Hallucination-Assessment

</details>


### [218] [PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25664)
*Liwei Lan,Hui Chen,Jungong Han,Guiguang Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PoSTCache将扩散缓存重构为"可修正的轨迹推断"：先用缓存策略为跳过步生成前向提议，再利用后续完整计算的预测误差作为校正信号反向精修已提交的预测，并提出PVR策略按期望不确定性下降选择锚点，在图像与视频生成上稳定改善质量-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型采样迭代开销大，缓存类免训练加速方法虽实用，但现有方法强制"单向信息流"：为跳过步生成的近似值被立即固化进采样轨迹，无法利用后续完整计算提供的反馈，导致误差不可修正、锚点选择仅依赖局部近似误差。

Method: 提出PoSTCache（Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache）框架：1）沿用现有缓存策略为跳过步构造前向提议；2）在后续完整计算步，用刷新预测与其前向提议之差构造校正信号，并反向传播以精修、重新整合先前预测；3）提出后验方差缩减（PVR）策略，从离线去噪轨迹估计跨时间步依赖，按对代理轨迹不确定性的期望缩减量而非局部近似误差来选择完整计算锚点。方法免训练、即插即用。

Result: 在代表性图像与视频生成模型上的实验表明，PoSTCache相较代表性缓存方法能一致地提升质量-效率权衡。

Conclusion: 将完整计算步视为校正反馈源，使缓存近似从"一次性提交"变为"可回溯修正"，并相应改变锚点选择准则，可为扩散采样提供更优的免训练加速范式。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models achieve impressive visual generation quality but remain computationally expensive due to iterative sampling. Caching-based acceleration provides a practical training-free solution by reusing or predicting intermediate features. However, existing methods largely enforce a forward-only information flow: approximations produced for skipped model evaluations are immediately committed to the sampling trajectory and cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full-computation steps. We propose \textbf{PoSTCache} (\emph{Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache}), a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference. PoSTCache first uses an existing caching strategy to construct forward proposals for skipped steps. At a later full-computation step, the discrepancy between the refreshed prediction and its forward proposal yields a correction signal, which PoSTCache propagates backward to refine and reintegrate the preceding predictions. Viewing full-computation steps as sources of corrective feedback also changes how they should be selected. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and selects anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty rather than local approximation error alone. Experiments on representative image and video generation models show that PoSTCache consistently improves the quality--efficiency trade-off over representative caching methods.

</details>


### [219] [FluidGen: Physics-Aware Fluid Video Generation via Motion-Guided Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25660)
*Yang Zheng,Zizhang Li,Boyang Deng,Jan Ackermann,Lei Shu,Yinghao Xu,Jiajun Wu,Gordon Wetzstein,Leonidas Guibas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FluidGen，将数据驱动的流体先验注入预训练视频模型，通过双流架构联合预测逐帧速度场与RGB，并结合速度感知的DPO，显著提升生成流体视频的物理真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型能产生视觉上吸引人的运动，但在烟雾、火焰、爆炸碎片等流体现象上系统性失败：缺乏连贯的涡旋结构、动力学平淡且违背流体物理。经典求解器虽物理保真度高，却依赖精细3D场景与调参，难以用于野外图像与视频生成。

Method: 将数据驱动流体先验注入预训练视频模型。训练数据混合两类：带配对速度场真值的高保真Houdini仿真数据，以及精选的野外流体视频以增强外观多样性。核心是双流架构，在生成RGB的同时预测逐帧速度场，并以仿真真值监督；该辅助信号正则化生成趋向物理一致运动，同时提供可解释物理量，进一步作为奖励用于速度感知的直接偏好优化（DPO）。

Result: 模型生成的流体动力学序列在真实感上显著优于强视频基线与基于优化的方法。

Conclusion: 通过速度场预测作为物理正则与奖励信号，可有效弥合视频生成模型与流体物理之间的差距，实现更物理一致的野外流体视频生成。

Abstract: Video generation models produce visually compelling motion but systematically fail on fluid phenomena, including smoke, fire, and explosion debris, where outputs lack coherent vortical structure and collapse to bland dynamics that violate the physics of real fluids. Classical solvers achieve high physical fidelity but require detailed 3D scenes and carefully tuned parameters, making them impractical for in-the-wild imagery and video generation. We address this gap by injecting a data-driven fluid prior into a pre-trained video model, trained on a mixture of high-fidelity Houdini simulation data with paired velocity-field ground truth and curated in-the-wild fluid video data for appearance diversity. The core of our approach is a dual stream architecture that predicts per-frame velocity fields alongside RGB, supervised by simulation ground truth. This auxiliary signal regularizes generation toward physically consistent motion and exposes an interpretable physical quantity that we further leverage as a reward for velocity-aware direct preference optimization.
