Our model produces substantially more realistic fluid dynamics sequences than strong video baselines and optimization-based methods. Project page: https://y-zheng18.github.io/FluidGen/

</details>


### [220] [ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25517)
*Abteen Arab,Guile Wu,Dongfeng Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReDT：一种前馈视觉几何Transformer，通过“基元token”解耦内部表示与输入分辨率，实现高清多视图重建，在保持质量优势的同时大幅降低计算与显存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉几何Transformer多在固定SD分辨率下训练，扩展到高输入分辨率时重建质量下降且计算规模恶化。已有高效架构主要降低帧间注意力复杂度，但昂贵的帧内注意力与编码器注意力仍未解决，使HD重建在现有架构下不可行。

Method: 分辨率感知架构：先将每个视图映射为固定数量的基元token（basis tokens），在该紧凑且尺寸恒定的基元空间中计算跨视图对应关系，再将输出投影回原始分辨率进行稠密预测；注意力阶段内部表示与输入分辨率解耦。

Result: 在SD至FHD(2K)多数据集实验中，重建质量与计算效率均优于SOTA视觉几何Transformer。以ETH3D(2K)为例，相较VGGT-Ω实现16倍加速、峰值GPU显存降低34%、Chamfer距离降低33%。

Conclusion: 通过将内部表示与输入分辨率解耦，ReDT显著降低高分辨率3D重建成本并提升各分辨率下性能，使HD多视图重建在实用层面可行。

Abstract: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}

</details>


### [221] [Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26203)
*Fuyao Zhang,Wenwen He,Jiaming Zhang,Yurong Hao,Xuan Wang,Guowei Guan,Che Wang,Longtao Huang,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Focused Perception（聚焦感知）表示要求与 FocusGUI 轻量适配器，通过对多模态通道按步动态加权、压缩为紧凑潜表示并无损注入冻结解码器嵌入，仅用动作监督训练，即可显著提升全模态 GUI 智能体的动作匹配性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI 智能体在流式全模态观测（截图、音频、视频、交互历史、设备状态）上动作时，若每步均匀暴露全部上下文，会忽视相关性具有瞬时性和稀疏性——某步的关键信号在下一步即变为噪声；且已执行动作会回灌进上下文，使错误累积成"序列性分心"（Sequential Distraction），导致不可逆的轨迹漂移。

Method: 将需求形式化为 Focused Perception：表示需具备步自适应、动作充分、非侵入三项性质。据此设计 FocusGUI：轻量适配器，以步级决策参考为条件动态优先化多模态通道，将最相关证据压缩为紧凑潜变量，并微妙地注入冻结解码器的嵌入中以引导注意力，不改动其原生参数空间；训练仅依赖动作监督，无需模态相关性标注，也无需骨干微调。

Result: 在四个全模态骨干上平均，Type Match 相比冻结骨干提升 +33.2，Exact Match 提升至 3.0 倍；Type Match 相比最强现有增强方法再提升 +30.1。

Conclusion: 注意力引导式的轻量适配（聚焦感知 + 潜表示注入）是提升全模态 GUI 智能体决策的有效、低成本的范式，且与骨干解耦、标注需求低，具有较好可移植性。

Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

</details>


### [222] [Wan-Alpha++: Animating a Single RGBA Asset into Controllable Transparent Video Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26189)
*Haotian Dong,Xin Wang,Wenjing Wang,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Yan Tina Luximon,Ping Li,Wanchao Su,Ke Xu,Di Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Wan-Alpha++，一个统一框架，将可控 RGBA 视频生成同时扩展到文本和图像条件扩散骨干，通过共享 RGBA 潜空间、透明度感知双向扩散目标、透明度引导均值采样器和时间相位重参数化实现高质量且时间一致的透明视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGBA 视频生成对于影视、游戏和数字内容中的可合成视觉资产至关重要，但现有文本到 RGBA 方法将 RGB 与 alpha 分布纠缠、对目标外观控制有限；引入图像条件时因边界帧完全透明而出现"出现-消失"效应，导致首帧或首末帧条件失效。

Method: 构建统一框架，将会议版 Wan-Alpha 从文本条件扩展到以内部参考帧为条件的图像条件生成；在保持预训练 RGB 先验的同时学习可位移的 RGB-alpha 分布，具体采用透明度感知双向扩散目标获得可区分的 RGBA 潜表示，并用透明度引导均值采样器偏移噪声分布以改善透明度生成与空间可控性；随后提出时间相位重参数化，将零-正-零 alpha 模式循环转换为正-零-正模式，把可见内容迁移到时间边界，从而在有限 RGBA 数据下实现有效的外观条件化。

Result: 在文本与图像两种条件骨干下实现可控 RGBA 视频生成，缓解 RGB 与 alpha 分布纠缠，改善透明度的空间可控性与时间一致性，并克服图像条件中的出现-消失效应，使边界帧条件可有效使用。

Conclusion: Wan-Alpha++ 通过共享 RGBA 潜空间与相位重参数化，统一了文本与图像条件的 RGBA 视频生成，为可合成视觉资产的高质量、可控生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: RGBA video generation is essential for creating compositable visual assets in filmmaking, game development, and digital content production. However, generating high-quality RGB appearance alongside temporally coherent transparency remains a significant challenge. Existing text-to-RGBA video methods often entangle RGB and alpha distributions and offer limited control over the precise appearance of a target asset. In addition, incorporating image conditioning typically suffers from the emergence-disappearance effects, which fail existing first-frame or first-and-last-frame conditions due to their fully transparent boundary frames. To address these issues, we present Wan-Alpha++, a unified framework that brings controllable RGBA video generation to both text- and image-to-video diffusion backbones through a shared RGBA latent space, extending our conference version Wan-Alpha from the text-conditioned setting to image-conditioned generation with an interior reference frame. Our method first learns shiftable RGB-alpha distributions while preserving the pretrained RGB prior. Specifically, we introduce a transparency-aware bidirectional diffusion objective to produce distinguishable RGBA latent representations, and a transparency-guided mean sampler that shifts the noise distribution to improve transparency generation and enable spatial controllability. Building upon this RGBA generation prior, we introduce temporal phase reparameterization for image-conditioned effect generation. By cyclically transforming a zero-positive-zero alpha pattern into a positive-zero-positive pattern, it relocates visible content to both temporal boundaries, facilitating effective appearance conditioning with limited RGBA data.

</details>


### [223] [PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26096)
*Emirkan Burak Yilmaz,Yakup Genc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PnP-Transformer 是一个无迭代、可微的神经位姿求解器，用于替代经典 PnP-RANSAC，以 0.46s/obj 的延迟在 BOP 七个数据集上取得 41.2% 平均 AR，但精度仍低于 EPnP-RANSAC 替代方案（52.2% AR，额外 +60ms/obj），呈现精度—延迟权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 PnP-RANSAC 求解器需要迭代与随机采样，速度与可微性受限；作者希望提供一种无迭代、可微的替代方案，并验证其在零样本 6D 位姿估计流程中的实际可用性。

Method: PnP-Transformer 以预测的半稠密 2D-3D 对应场及置信度分数为输入，将几何输入映射到连续隐空间，直接回归 6D 物体位姿。实验中将其嵌入零样本 6D 位姿估计流程，对应模块与位姿求解器分开训练；并做消融对比：保持对应模块不变，将求解器替换为 EPnP-RANSAC。

Result: 在七个核心 BOP 数据集上取得 41.2% 平均 AR，延迟低至 0.46 s/obj，超过除 Co-op（58.4% AR）外的所有基线（如 RayPose 39.1% AR）。替换为 EPnP-RANSAC 后，在七个数据集中的六个上更优，平均 AR 达 52.2%，但每物体额外增加约 60 ms。

Conclusion: PnP-Transformer 提供了低延迟、完全可微的 PnP 求解路径，但其精度尚不能全面超越基于 RANSAC 的传统求解器，二者存在明确的精度—延迟权衡；代码与预训练模型已开源。

Abstract: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer

</details>


### [224] [Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26084)
*Peijun Shi,Xiujin Zhu,Zhenguo Lao,Chee-Onn Chow,Wei Ru Wong,Zhen Liu,Xiaobing Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CTD-GNet：以EEG特征为电极图节点，眼动与历史窗口调制边、节点与读出（边通过电极专属提示实现），并用图、节点关系、预测的双向蒸馏耦合多模态教师与单窗口EEG学生，在SEED/SEED-IV上取得最高平均精度且对眼动缺失与噪声鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG-眼动融合情绪识别模型多将两模态视为并行特征、逐窗口独立分类，缺乏跨模态与跨时间的上下文建模，且在眼动数据缺失时性能明显下降。

Method: 构建Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network：以EEG特征作为电极图节点，用眼动信号与前序窗口调制图的边、节点与读出，边调制通过电极专属提示（electrode-specific prompts）实现；采用对图结构、节点关系与预测的三重双向蒸馏，将多模态教师与单窗口EEG学生耦合，使两图对齐约35倍。

Result: 留一被试交叉验证中，SEED与SEED-IV平均精度最高（84.91%、76.17%），Holm校正后显著优于13个眼动基线中的9个和6个；跨被试方差最小、最差被试精度最高。SEED-IV各眼动缺失率下均最优，SEED无眼动时保持66.1%（优于所有EEG单模态模型），眼动噪声1个标准差下比所有单窗口融合模型高9.3与11.9个点；未见影片片段上SEED达77.1%领先。

Conclusion: 上下文感知的拓扑图建模与双向蒸馏能有效融合EEG与眼动信息，并在精度、跨被试稳定性及模态缺失/噪声条件下全面优于现有基线，支持心理健康监测与自适应接口等应用。

Abstract: EEG-eye movement emotion recognition can support mental-health monitoring and adaptive interfaces, but most fusion models treat the two signals as parallel features, classify each window alone and degrade when eye data are lost. We propose the Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network (CTD-GNet), in which EEG features form the nodes of an electrode graph, and eye movements and preceding windows modulate its edges, nodes and readout, the edges through electrode-specific prompts. Bidirectional distillation of the graph, node relations and predictions couples this multimodal teacher with a single-window EEG student, improving the teacher and aligning the two graphs 35-fold. In leave-one-subject-out tests on SEED and SEED-IV against 17 baselines, CTD-GNet has the highest mean accuracy, 84.91% and 76.17%, significantly above 9 and 6 of 13 eye-based baselines after Holm correction, the smallest cross-subject spread among multimodal models and the highest worst-subject accuracy. It is the most accurate model at every rate of missing eye data on SEED-IV, keeps 66.1% on SEED without eye data, more than any EEG-only model, and stays 9.3 and 11.9 points above all single-window fusion models under eye-movement noise of one standard deviation. On film clips unseen in training, it leads on SEED with 77.1%.

</details>


### [225] [DCR-TSF: Dual-Level Compositional Reasoning with Triadic Spherical Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26078)
*Gwang-Ho Na,Ho-Joong Kim,Seong-Whan Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练零样本组合图像检索框架DCR-TSF：用双级组合推理（DCR）生成细/粗粒度目标描述，再用三元球面融合（TSF）在单位超球面上经加权Karcher均值融合参考图像-修改文本锚点，兼顾细节视觉证据、高层语义与原始组合查询信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练ZS-CIR方法依赖细粒度生成的目标描述，常过度强调参考图像特有的视觉细节，导致检索偏向外观；且描述由MLLM生成，原始图文查询对最终检索表征的直接影响被削弱。

Method: DCR-TSF由两部分构成：(1) Dual-level Compositional Reasoning，从参考图像与修改文本生成细粒度与粗粒度描述，捕获不同粒度的互补目标侧语义；(2) Triadic Spherical Fusion，对参考图像特征与修改文本特征做球面插值构造组合查询锚点，再在单位超球面上用加权Karcher均值将其与细、粗粒度表示融合，得到最终查询表征。

Result: 在CIRCO、CIRR和Fashion-IQ三个基准上，该方法在免训练方法中取得最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过双级语义描述与三元球面融合，可在免训练设定下缓解外观偏置并保留原始组合查询信息，验证了多粒度+锚点约束融合对ZS-CIR的有效性。

Abstract: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that reflects an intended textual modification while maintaining semantic consistency with a reference image. Existing training-free ZS-CIR methods typically rely on fine-grained generated target descriptions, which often overemphasize reference-specific visual details and lead to appearance-biased retrieval. Moreover, since these descriptions are generated through multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the direct influence of the original image-text query can be weakened in the final retrieval representation. In this paper, we propose DCR-TSF, a training-free ZS-CIR framework that combines Dual-level Compositional Reasoning (DCR) and Triadic Spherical Fusion (TSF). DCR generates fine- and coarse-grained descriptions from the reference image and modification text, capturing complementary target-side semantics across different granularities. To preserve the original image-text query information, TSF constructs a composed-query anchor by spherically interpolating the reference image feature and modification text feature, and fuses it with the fine- and coarse-grained representations using a weighted Karcher mean on the unit hypersphere. The resulting final query representation balances detailed visual evidence, high-level semantic abstraction, and direct preservation of the original composed query. Extensive experiments on CIRCO, CIRR, and Fashion-IQ demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.

</details>


### [226] [Risk Decomposition for Hallucination-Aware Video Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26069)
*Chenyan Zheng,Fan Wu,Ruibo Li,Jiaxing Li,Minghao Yang,Bang Zhang,Guosheng Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出二维物理幻觉风险框架（低密度采样风险与高密度漂移风险），据此设计 HA-Sampler 采样器与 HA-Scorer 评分器，在 Physics-IQ 与 VideoPhy 上优于 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频模型视觉保真度高但仍存在物理幻觉，损害其作为世界模拟器的可靠性；现有基于模型内部或外部信号的方法缺乏统一解释其作用与局限。

Method: 构建二维风险框架：低密度采样风险对应模型低似然生成，高密度漂移风险对应高似然但物理不一致的生成。分析表明模型内部信号可将采样导向高密度区域以缓解前者，但高似然不保证物理合理性，故需外部引导缓解后者。基于此提出 HA-Sampler，在潜空间精化中施加外部物理引导；并提出 HA-Scorer，利用连续归一化流（CNF）从生成器导出基于似然的评分信号，采用粗粒度 ODE 积分与有限差分散度估计。

Result: 在 Physics-IQ 与 VideoPhy 基准上的实验支持理论分析，采样与评分方法均优于对比的 SOTA 基线。

Conclusion: 内部似然信号与外部物理引导分别对应两类幻觉风险、互为补充；二者结合可提升视频生成的物理合理性与可评估性。

Abstract: Despite achieving high visual fidelity, video models still suffer from physical hallucinations, limiting their reliability as world simulators. Existing methods leverage model-internal or external signals to improve physical plausibility, but their roles and limitations require a unified explanation. We propose a two-dimensional physical-hallucination risk framework that defines low-density sampling risk and high-density drifting risk. The first risk captures generations assigned low likelihood by the video model, for example, a ball suddenly teleporting despite the model favoring continuous motion, while the second risk captures physical inconsistencies in high-likelihood generations, for example, a ball bouncing progressively higher without additional energy. Our analysis explains how model-internal signals steer sampling toward higher-density regions of the learned distribution to address low-density sampling risk. However, higher model likelihood does not guarantee physical plausibility, motivating external guidance to address high-density drifting risk. Based on this framework, we develop Hallucination-Aware Sampler (HA-Sampler), which applies external physical guidance within latent refinement to generate physically plausible videos, and HA-Scorer, which derives a likelihood-based signal from the generator itself for evaluating generated videos using continuous normalizing flow (CNF), with coarse ODE integration and finite-difference divergence estimates. Experiments on Physics-IQ and VideoPhy benchmarks support our theoretical analysis and demonstrate that our methods outperform the compared sampling and scoring SOTA baselines.

</details>


### [227] [Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26064)
*J. Boyer-Chammard,R. Vauclin,M. C. Biston,P. Maury,M. Gau,S. Stathakis,V. Grégoire,N. Paragios,E. Deutsch,N. Komodakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LaDose：基于潜空间扩散的全容积剂量预测框架，通过自编码器将剂量图压缩128倍实现单GPU三维扩散，处方以精确标量向量注入，并用多尺度无分类器引导在推理时调节临床权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动治疗计划（ATP）多依赖剂量预测后参数优化；扩散方法受放疗数据高维性限制多为切片式处理，且假设解剖与最优剂量一对一的映射，忽视治疗计划的多目标本质；评估多限于与参考剂量的匹配度，鲜有嵌入ATP流程的端到端验证。

Method: 构建潜空间扩散框架LaDose：在剂量分布上训练自编码器，使扰动后的潜变量解码为合理剂量，从而将剂量图压缩128倍并在单GPU上完成三维扩散；处方值以精确标量向量表示，绕过图像编码器以避免重采样与潜压缩；采用多尺度无分类器引导，在推理阶段调制临床权衡而无需重训练或额外标注数据。

Result: 在来自5个中心的900例临床头颈VMAT计划上，中位绝对误差1.18 Gy（处方的1.4–1.8%），是六个框架中唯一相对参考分布无系统性偏倚者；引导尺度对靶区覆盖与危及器官保护的调节具有可预测性；与直接孔径优化集成后，全流程15.2分钟生成计划；盲审中资深临床医师对15例计划中的14例评价为无需编辑即可接受。

Conclusion: LaDose实现了高效的全容积三维剂量预测与推理时可调控的多目标权衡，并可直接嵌入ATP流水线产出临床上可接受的计划，表明剂量预测方法应以端到端ATP集成为评估维度。

Abstract: Automated treatment planning (ATP) aims to reduce the unwarranted inter-planner variability of manual planning, while improving treatment quality and efficiency. Most ATP pipelines rely on the prediction of the achievable three-dimensional dose distribution for a given anatomy and the subsequent optimization of machine parameters to reproduce it. Diffusion-based methods are largely slice-wise due to the high dimensionality of radiotherapy data, and assume a one-to-one mapping between anatomy and optimal dose despite the multi-objective nature of treatment planning. They are evaluated on their ability to match reference doses and rarely on their integration in ATP frameworks. We present LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric dose prediction. An autoencoder learned on dose distributions, trained so that perturbed latents decode to plausible doses, compresses dose maps 128-fold and enables 3D diffusion on a single GPU. Prescription values are represented as exact scalar vectors that bypass the image encoder, avoiding resampling and latent compression. Multiscale classifier-free guidance allows for the modulation of clinical trade-offs at inference, without retraining or additional labeled data. On 900 clinically delivered head-and-neck volumetric modulated arc therapy plans from five centers, LaDose reached a median absolute error of 1.18 Gy (1.4--1.8\% of the prescription) and was the only one of six frameworks free of systematic bias with respect to the reference distribution. Guidance scales acted predictably on target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing. Integrated with direct aperture optimization, the pipeline generated plans in 15.2 minutes; in a blinded review, senior clinicians rated 14 of 15 plans acceptable without editing.

</details>


### [228] [After the Federation: Benchmarking Knowledge Portability to Heterogeneous Newcomers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26026)
*Xinyuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FEDNBO 七数据集基准，分离知识供给、策略识别与私有模型编译三类数据角色，揭示 oracle 增益虚高、架构依赖的迁移反转以及教师准确率与私有模型效用之间的落差，并给出无需公开任务标签的普通公开响应蒸馏作为强参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史客户端离线后，联邦学习只能依靠遗留产物服务新加入者；其后所选架构中究竟有多少知识仍有用，缺乏可控、可审计的评测手段，且现有结论可能被高估的 oracle 增益与架构差异所混淆。

Method: 构建 FEDNBO 七数据集基准，在互斥数据角色下分别考察知识供给、策略识别与私有模型编译；通过受控实验检验 oracle 增益、迁移方向与教师精度—私有效用关系；并以普通公开响应蒸馏（无公开任务标签、无新客户端样本）为参考，与 HeteroFedTTA 重建在相同 epoch 预算下比较（含 CelebA 300 身份、FedEMNIST 300 写手及等量公开输入干预至可训练视觉骨干）。

Result: 相对增强的本地训练，公开响应蒸馏分别提升 23.52 与 16.62 个百分点；完整流水线 FedEMNIST 上达 97.13% 精度、每架构编译 12.4 秒，而 HeteroFedTTA 重建为 97.03%、67.5 秒。

Conclusion: FEDNBO 提供了可审计的评测协议，普通公开响应蒸馏是其上强而廉价的参考方法，可用于系统评估联邦后知识迁移的效用、成本与可靠性。

Abstract: Once historical clients become unavailable, a federation must serve newcomers through the artifact it leaves behind. How much of its knowledge remains useful in an architecture chosen afterward? We introduce FEDNBO, a seven-dataset benchmark that separates knowledge supply, policy identification, and private-model compilation under disjoint data roles. Controlled studies expose inflated oracle gains, architecture-dependent transfer reversals, and a gap between teacher accuracy and private-model utility. Ordinary public-response distillation provides a competitive reference without public task labels or newcomer samples: gains over strengthened local training are 23.52 and 16.62 percentage points on 300 CelebA identities and 300 FedEMNIST writers, respectively. In a complete-pipeline FedEMNIST comparison, this reference reaches 97.13% accuracy with 12.4 seconds of compilation per architecture, versus 97.03% and 67.5 seconds for a HeteroFedTTA reconstruction at the same epoch budget. Equal-count public-input interventions extend support sensitivity to trainable visual backbones. Together, these results establish an auditable benchmark and a strong reference for evaluating the utility, cost and reliability of post-federation knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [229] [RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25400)
*R. D. Lin,Pengcheng Weng,Ge Wang,Han Ding,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RAHF-Net，通过柱坐标到透视投影保留3D语义先验，并利用范围感知的异构融合按LiDAR可靠性分区增强，实现LiDAR辅助RGB语义分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有2D融合方法多将点云投影为浅层深度/距离图并采用空间均匀融合，丢失丰富3D结构，且忽略户外LiDAR可靠性的距离依赖性。

Method: C2P模块将预训练柱状体素特征投影到图像平面；RAHF模块以软深度引导的范围掩码在近场做LiDAR引导几何增强、在稀疏远场做视觉上下文增强。

Result: KITTI-360上达65.76 mIoU，优于代表性RGB-only与RGB-LiDAR基线，超CMX 1.45点；DELIVER上在恶劣天气、光照退化与传感器损坏下鲁棒性提升。

Conclusion: 距离感知的异构融合能有效利用3D语义先验并兼顾LiDAR可靠性差异，提升密集像素预测精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract: This paper studies LiDAR-assisted RGB semantic segmentation, where LiDAR point-cloud features improve dense pixel-wise predictions in the RGB image plane rather than 3D point labels or detections. Existing 2D fusion methods often project point clouds into shallow depth/range maps and apply spatially uniform fusion, discarding rich 3D structure and ignoring the range-dependent reliability of outdoor LiDAR. We propose RAHF-Net, a Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network. Its Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) module projects pretrained cylindrical voxel features into the image plane, preserving structured 3D semantic priors. A Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) module then uses a soft depth-derived range mask to perform LiDAR-guided geometric enhancement in reliable near-field regions and visual-context enhancement in sparse far-field regions. On KITTI-360, RAHF-Net achieves 65.76 mIoU, outperforming representative RGB-only and RGB-LiDAR baselines, including CMX by 1.45 points. Experiments on DELIVER further demonstrate improved robustness under adverse weather, illumination degradation, and sensor corruption.

</details>


### [230] [Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25369)
*Markus Pobitzer,Chang Liu,Niccolò Biondi,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Painting Change Map，一种时空控制机制，通过编码RGB空间追踪1000步归一化结构变化，实现对绘画过程视频生成的精细定位控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有绘画过程视频生成模型将创作过程视为黑箱，控制机制要么过刚性（依赖Canny边缘、深度图等静态几何线索），要么过于整体（仅用标量进度变量），缺乏局部控制，用户无法引导绘画随时间的演化方式。作者认为真正控制需联合理解"艺术家在何处作画"与"动作何时发生"两个维度。

Method: 引入Painting Change Map：在1000个时间步的连续区间上显式追踪归一化结构变化，分辨率足以捕捉笔触级细节且计算可行；将局部视觉差异映射到编码RGB空间，为前向绘画和逆向"去绘画"过程提供细粒度引导。

Result: 大量基准测试表明该方法优于现有控制基线，与最先进绘画方法相比达到竞争性或更优结果；在oracle条件下显著超越所有基线。

Conclusion: 时空联合的Painting Change Map实现了对绘画过程视频生成的细粒度局部控制，前向与逆向过程均可引导，性能优于现有控制方法且有进一步提升空间。

Abstract: Digital art generation has undergone a massive paradigm shift, moving from static image synthesis to dynamic video generation that can mimic the human painting process. While existing models can synthesize visually stunning time-lapses of paintings being created or "unpainted," they largely treat the creative process as a black box. Current conditioning mechanisms are either too rigid, relying on static geometric cues like Canny edges or depth maps, or too holistic, utilizing simple scalar progress variables that offer no localized control. Consequently, users lack the agency to steer how a painting evolves over time. In this work, we argue that true control over the video generation of artwork requires a joint understanding of two fundamental dimensions: where an artist acts, and when those actions take place. To achieve this, we introduce the Painting Change Map, a novel spatio-temporal control mechanism that explicitly tracks normalized structural changes across a 1,000-timestep continuum, a resolution sufficient to capture fine-grained stroke-level changes while remaining computationally tractable. By mapping localized visual differences into an encoded RGB space, our representation enables fine-grained guidance for both the forward painting and reverse unpainting processes. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. We outperform existing control baselines and achieve competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art painting methods. Furthermore, under oracle conditions, our method surpasses all baselines by a significant margin. Code is available at https://github.com/Markus-Pobitzer/painting-change-map.

</details>


### [231] [Edge Deployable Lightweight Framework for Real-Time Driver Safety System with Integrated Lane Departure and Traffic Sign Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25340)
*Hassaan Ali Qureshi,Danish Hussain,Ali Hassan,Aon Safdar,Anas Bin Aqeel,Muhammad Rafiq,Zohaib Riaz,Farhan Hussain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个可在边缘设备部署的统一ADAS框架，同时完成车道偏离预警（LDW）与交通标志检测识别（TSD/TSR），并在Jetson Orin Nano上实现端到端15 FPS实时运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车道偏离与交通标志疏忽是道路事故的主要成因，尤其在标志非标准化、标注数据稀缺的地区。现有ADAS方案多为割裂的子模块，很少验证实时性，且难以在嵌入式部署中兼顾精度与低延迟。

Method: 框架整合两部分：一是轻量级车道分割驱动LDW，并引入可行驶区域回退机制以应对标线退化；二是两阶段TSD/TSR流程（高效标志定位＋细粒度分类）。同时构建35类本地交通标志数据集，并提出通用增强与均衡策略，将359张图像扩增至8,750个样本。

Result: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上，集成系统端到端达15 FPS（LDW 32 FPS，TSD/TSR 18 FPS）。TSD/TSR分支检测mAP为97.4，验证准确率95.6%（本地真实场景集93.1%），参数量约13.9 M。

Conclusion: 相较仅针对单一任务或仅在桌面级GPU上验证的近期方法，该工作在同一边缘硬件上同时实现LDW与TSD/TSR的实时性能，为资源受限场景下低成本、可落地的ADAS提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Lane departure and traffic-sign negligence are leading contributors to road accidents, particularly in regions with non-standardized signage and limited annotated data. Existing Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) solutions are often developed as disjointed submodules, are rarely validated for real-time operation, and struggle to balance accuracy with low-latency inference for embedded deployment. We address these gaps with a unified, edge-deployable ADAS framework that simultaneously performs lane-departure warning (LDW) and traffic-sign detection and recognition (TSD/TSR), and validate the proposed system on automotive-class devices. Our framework combines a lightweight, lane-segmentation-driven LDW, which includes a drivable-area fallback for degraded markings, with a two-stage TSD/TSR pipeline consisting of efficient sign localization followed by fine-grained classification, designed to preserve accuracy at embedded latency. To support region-specific deployment under data scarcity, we curate a 35-class local traffic-sign dataset and introduce a generalized augmentation and balancing profile, expanding the corpus from 359 images to 8,750 samples. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, the integrated system sustains 15 FPS end to end (32 FPS for LDW and 18 FPS for TSD/TSR). The TSD/TSR branch achieves 97.4 mAP for detection and 95.6% validation accuracy (93.1% on a local real-world set) while maintaining an approximately 13.9 M parameter footprint. Relative to recent methods that target a single task or report results only on desktop-class GPUs, our approach delivers both LDW and TSD/TSR with real-time performance on edge hardware, providing a practical pathway to low-cost, field-ready ADAS in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [232] [MotionShift: Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer via Planner-Evaluator Synergistic Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25290)
*Yanchen Liu,Junyao Gao,Yanan Sun,Wensheng Chen,Guangming Lu,Wenjie Pei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MotionShift 提出一种无需训练的"规划器—评估器"迭代运动适配框架，利用 LLM 生成运动轨迹、VLM 依据场景理解修正轨迹，再作为 I2V 生成条件渲染目标场景视频，实现高保真且物理兼容的运动迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动迁移方法擅长从参考视频到目标场景的精确、刚性运动复制，但忽略了迁移运动与目标场景环境之间是否符合物理规律（物理兼容性），导致迁移结果在复杂场景中不真实。

Method: 设计 planner–evaluator 迭代运动适配机制：LLM 作为规划器，凭借语义推理生成运动轨迹；VLM 作为评估器，凭借视觉感知与场景理解对运动进行修正；二者协同推理，以 training-free 方式将运动适配到目标场景。适配后的运动作为图像到视频（I2V）模型的生成条件，用于在目标场景中渲染视频。

Result: 大量实验表明，MotionShift 在多样且复杂的场景中实现了高保真、物理兼容的运动迁移；并且可便捷地集成到现有以轨迹为条件的 I2V 模型中，使其具备真实的运动迁移能力。

Conclusion: 通过 LLM 规划与 VLM 评估的协同推理实现无训练运动适配，MotionShift 在保证高保真迁移的同时满足目标场景的物理兼容性，并具备良好的可插拔性与通用性。

Abstract: Existing motion transfer methods excel at exact, rigid motion replication from reference videos to target scenes, whereas they often fail to account for the compatibility between the transferred motion and the target scene environment in accordance with physical laws. In this work, we propose MotionShift, a novel motion transfer framework that achieves high-fidelity motion transfer while ensuring physical compatibility with the target scene. In particular, we design a planner--evaluator iterative motion adaptation mechanism, in which a Large Language Model (LLM) acts as the planner to generate motion trajectories by leveraging its strong semantic reasoning capabilities, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the evaluator to rectify the motion based on its superior visual perception and scene understanding. Through this planner--evaluator synergistic reasoning process, the motion is adapted to the target scene in a training-free manner. The adapted motion is then used as a generative condition for an image-to-video (I2V) model to render videos in the target scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionShift achieves high-fidelity and physically compatible motion transfer across diverse and complex scenes. Moreover, we show that MotionShift can be readily integrated into existing trajectory-conditioned I2V models, endowing them with realistic motion transfer capabilities.

</details>


### [233] [From Label Priors to Task Evidence: Efficient Long-Video Frame Selection via Bayesian GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25418)
*Shuochen Chang,Bingjie Gao,Qingyang Liu,Qianli Ma,Yibo Miao,Haonan Zhao,Zhaohe Liao,Xiaofeng Zhang,Jiangtong Li,Li Niu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出概率框架将长视频帧选择重构为隐变量推断，先监督初始化策略，再以冻结MLLM为环境用答案似然作稠密证据，经Bayesian GRPO精炼，从静态标签先验转向任务证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM长视频理解受二次注意力复杂度与上下文窗口限制；现有检索方法依赖静态关键帧标注的监督学习，其标签先验与下游MLLM复杂推理实际所需信息不一致，训练目标与推理需求错位。

Method: 将帧选择建模为隐变量推断：先用监督学习初始化轻量策略以捕捉通用视觉显著性；再将冻结MLLM视为任务环境，以ground-truth答案token上的负对数似然(NLL)作为稠密奖励，配合先验匹配KL项保持与标签先验的语义一致性，通过Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)精炼策略。

Result: 在Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench上，选择器精度与基于MLLM的打分器相当，同时保持轻量方法的推理效率；且仅需在冻结MLLM环境下训练一次，即可直接迁移到多个下游MLLM而无需重训。

Conclusion: 该框架将选择准则由静态标签先验转变为任务证据，兼顾精度与效率，并具备跨MLLM的良好可迁移性。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at \url{github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame_Selection_GRPO}.

</details>


### [234] [PolarVis: A Dataset and Diffusion Framework for RGB-to-Polarization Perception in Adverse Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25396)
*Ruilin Huang,Jue Wang,Zhen Tian,Xia Hua,F. Richard Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RGB-P Wild数据集（1万组配对RGB与四角度线偏振图像）及PolarVis——一个从单张RGB图像重建偏振表示的扩散式框架，实现0°/45°/90°/135°偏振强度图的重构，并验证其对下游车辆感知任务的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆相关场景中的反射、眩光、透明结构与材质相关外观变化会给基于RGB的视觉感知带来歧义；偏振能提供反射与材质的互补信息，但需专用传感硬件采集。因此希望从普通RGB图像中恢复偏振信息。

Method: 构建RGB-P Wild真实数据集（10,000组配对RGB与四角度线偏振图像）；提出PolarVis扩散式框架，包含分层RGB特征提取、扩散式特征精化、四个角度专用解码器与多尺度注意力重校准，从单张RGB重建0°/45°/90°/135°偏振强度图；并在车载图像上做跨数据集评估及下游PCDNet冻结评估。

Result: RGB-P Wild上归一化域MSE 0.0465、PSNR 27.83 dB、SSIM 0.8597；相比PolarAnything，AoLP误差25.66° vs 46.03°，DoLP MAE 0.0404 vs 0.1084；990张RGBP-Car测试图上冻结PCDNet AP50/AP50:95为86.3%/59.1%（实测偏振为87.0%/59.8%）。

Conclusion: RGB衍生偏振在所评估的感知任务中保留了有用的偏振信息，但在数值上仍与标定的物理偏振测量存在差异，不可等同视之。

Abstract: Reflections, glare, transparent structures, and material-dependent appearance variations can introduce ambiguity into RGB-based visual perception in vehicle-relevant environments. Polarization provides complementary reflection- and material-sensitive information, but its acquisition requires dedicated sensing hardware. This paper presents RGB-P Wild, a real-world dataset containing 10,000 paired RGB and four-angle linear-polarization image sets, together with PolarVis, a diffusion-based framework for recovering polarization representations from a single RGB image. PolarVis combines hierarchical RGB feature extraction, diffusion-based feature refinement, four angle-specific decoders, and multi-scale attention recalibration to reconstruct polarization intensity images at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$. On RGB-P Wild, PolarVis achieves a normalized-domain MSE of 0.0465, a PSNR of 27.83 dB, and an SSIM of 0.8597. Compared with the released PolarAnything model under the adopted evaluation protocol, PolarVis obtains an AoLP error of $25.66^\circ$ and a DoLP MAE of 0.0404, compared with $46.03^\circ$ and 0.1084, respectively. Cross-dataset evaluation on vehicle-mounted imagery further examines transfer beyond the training domain. In downstream evaluation, a frozen PCDNet achieves AP50/AP50:95 of 86.3%/59.1% on 990 RGBP-Car test images using PolarVis-generated polarization, compared with 87.0%/59.8% using measured polarization. These results indicate that RGB-derived polarization retains useful polarimetric information for the evaluated perception tasks, while remaining distinct from calibrated physical polarization measurements.

</details>


### [235] [Only Means Only: what a harmonization benchmark score averages over](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25387)
*Imad Buljić,Delaida Muminović*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现图像协调领域常用基准的测试集存在训练/测试照片重叠：1,399张照片同时出现在两个划分中，基于其构建的合成图像占测试集四分之一，导致端到端评测误差被系统性低估；作者发布了一份5,581张无构造身份重叠的测试列表以修正评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像协调（image harmonization）方法的排名依赖单一基准在单个测试集上的平均误差，而该基准承诺训练集与测试集不含同一张照片。作者怀疑这一承诺未被真正满足，且常规的文件名/字节查重无法发现这种泄漏——因为同一张照片可派生出多张不同的合成图像文件。若泄漏存在，官方分数将混合两个分布，排名可能失真。

Method: 以"构造身份"（即合成图像所基于的原始照片）为粒度做跨划分匹配，而非文件名或字节比对；统计训练/测试重叠照片数量及其在测试集中的占比。对三种方法做端到端评分，比较重叠子集与其余子集上的误差，并对来源集合做分层分析以区分"共享泄漏"与"构图差异"的贡献。最后按构造身份过滤，构建无重叠测试列表（对四对已确认近重复样本予以披露而非删除）。

Result: 1,399张照片同时出现在训练与测试划分，其合成图像占测试集四分之一。在该四分之一子集上，三种被端到端评分的方法误差比其余子集低2–5倍；但差距主要源于构图而非数据共享：共享合成图像几乎全部来自基准四个来源集合中的一个，在该集合内部差距降至约1.5倍。最终发布含5,581张合成图像的测试列表，其构造身份未出现在训练集中，保留并公开四对确认的近重复样本。

Conclusion: 现有基准的官方分数实际上是两个分布按未公开比例混合后的平均值，可比性与排名可靠性存疑。所提测试列表可在不重新训练的前提下采用，代价是每个检查点需重新评分一次。数据共享本身是否改变模型所学内容仍为开放问题。

Abstract: Image harmonization methods adjust the colour and lighting of an object pasted into a photograph so that it looks native to its new scene, and they are ranked by average error on one benchmark whose test images are real photographs with one object recoloured. One photograph can yield several such test images, and the benchmark promises that no photograph appears in both the training and the test split. We find that 1,399 photographs do, and the composites built on them are a quarter of the test set. Duplicate checks over file names or bytes miss this, because every composite is a different file. On that quarter the three methods we score end to end read two to five times lower error than on the rest, but most of the gap is composition rather than the sharing: the shared composites come almost entirely from one of the benchmark's four source collections, and inside that collection the gap falls to about one and a half times. An official score is therefore an average over two populations, mixed in a proportion the benchmark does not report. We release a test list of 5,581 composites whose construction identities do not appear in training, with four confirmed near-duplicate pairs disclosed rather than removed, adoptable without retraining at the price of one rescore per checkpoint. We leave open whether the sharing itself changes what a model learns.

</details>


### [236] [Visual Scaffolding: Toward Native Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25247)
*Run Shao,Zhaoyang Zhang,Ziyu Li,Linrui Xu,Ji Qi,Xiu Su,Yichao Cao,Chao Tao,Haifeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"原生多模态推理"定义，即原生视觉表征与语言共同承载可复用的中间状态，并实现"视觉脚手架"机制：MLLM可在任意推理步骤自主发起检索动作，由轻量检索器选出原生视觉特征并直接纳入演进的CoT；在自建NMR-Bench上，仅增加约2%参数即在Burden Counting与Path Tracing任务上超越GPT-5.5与Gemini 3.1 Pro。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT的成功源于"文本脚手架效应"——显式中间结果可被检验、复用与组合以支撑后续推理。但主流多模态LLM缺乏针对"难以用简洁语言表述的视觉区分"的等价脚手架，因此作者追问：原生视觉表征能否成为与语言并列的一等公民，为推理提供视觉脚手架。

Method: (1) 将原生多模态推理定义为原生视觉表征与语言共同承载可复用中间状态的推理范式；(2) 提出视觉脚手架机制：允许MLLM在任一推理步骤自主触发retrieval action，由轻量检索器选择原生视觉特征，并将其直接写入不断演进的CoT中、对后续步骤保持可用；(3) 构建NMR-Bench，含Burden Counting与Path Tracing两个受控视觉需求任务；(4) 在Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking上仅新增88M参数（约2%）实现该机制。

Result: 在Burden Counting上达66.43%、Path Tracing上达72.50%准确率，超过所评估的GPT-5.5与Gemini 3.1 Pro基线。控制干预实验显示：改变被选中的视觉内容会影响任务准确率，且在文本干预保持固定的情况下仍能改变后续的视觉选择。

Conclusion: 原生视觉状态可作为中间推理材料发挥作用，为视觉之外的更多模态提供了可复用脚手架的路径。

Abstract: The success of chain-of-thought (CoT) in complex reasoning can be attributed to a textual scaffolding effect: explicit intermediate results can be examined, reused, and composed to support subsequent reasoning, much as scaffolding supports a building under construction. However, mainstream multimodal LLMs lack an equivalent scaffold for visual distinctions that are difficult to express in concise verbal descriptions. We therefore ask: Can native visual representations become first-class citizens alongside language, providing a visual scaffold for reasoning? We define native multimodal reasoning as reasoning in which native visual representations and language jointly carry reusable intermediate states. As a concrete implementation, the visual scaffolding mechanism we proposed lets the MLLM autonomously initiate a retrieval action at any reasoning step. A lightweight retriever selects native visual features, which are then incorporated directly into the evolving CoT and remain available to subsequent steps. To evaluate this mechanism under controlled visual demands, we introduce NMR-Bench, comprising Burden Counting and Path Tracing. With 88M added parameters (approximately 2%) on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking, our model achieves 66.43% and 72.50% accuracy, respectively, surpassing the evaluated GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro baselines. Controlled interventions show that changing selected visual content affects task accuracy and can redirect subsequent visual selection even when intervening text is held fixed. These findings show that native visual states can function as intermediate reasoning material and point toward reusable scaffolds for additional modalities.

</details>


### [237] [Map2Vid: Embodied Navigation Video Generation with Human-Friendly Motion Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25223)
*Yulin Dai,Yuqian Fu,Tianwen Qian,Zhen Xing,Bojia Zi,Xiaoling Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Map2Vid任务，将具身导航视频生成重构为BEV地图到视频的合成问题，并构建大规模基准、数据集与统一框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成范式不适配具身导航：文本提示空间歧义大，相机轨迹控制属低层运动规格，对用户不直观且难以操控。

Method: 以BEV地图（提供全局场景布局与预期导航路线的视觉表示）作为控制信号；构建含61个室内场景、超10万条导航序列的数据集（配对第一视角视频、BEV地图、相机轨迹与语言指令）；设计整合多控制信号的统一框架，并采用逐步削弱非地图输入的课程训练策略，支持全条件与仅地图输入两种推理。

Result: 在多个基础生成模型上的大量实验表明，基于BEV地图的可控导航视频生成是可行且有前景的方向。

Conclusion: BEV地图是一种人机友好的导航视频生成控制范式，Map2Vid任务及其基准为后续研究提供了系统评估基础。

Abstract: Controllable video generation has recently achieved impressive visual quality, yet existing control paradigms remain poorly suited to embodied navigation. Text prompts are spatially ambiguous, while camera-trajectory control relies on low-level motion specifications that are unintuitive for human users and difficult to manipulate. In this work, we introduce Map2Vid, a novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV-map-to-video synthesis problem, together with a large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation. By using BEV maps, which provide a visual representation of global scene layout and intended navigation routes, Map2Vid enables human-friendly navigation video generation. To support this task, we construct a dedicated dataset with over 100K navigation sequences across 61 indoor scenes, each paired with egocentric videos, BEV maps, camera trajectories and language instructions. We further develop a unified framework that integrates multiple control signals, together with a curriculum training strategy that progressively weakens non-map inputs, enabling flexible inference under both full conditioning and map-only input. Extensive experiments across multiple foundation generation models demonstrate that controllable navigation video generation via BEV map is a viable and promising direction.

</details>


### [238] [Multi-View Structural Representations for Physically-Consistent TeX Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25695)
*Daoheng Li,Jianjun Qian*,Mengkai Yan,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MVR-MoE框架，从红外与可见光图像中挖掘多视角结构表征，在缺乏配对数据条件下生成物理一致性图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外与可见光图像提供互补线索，基于物理的方法更利于利用该互补性；但现有物理方法严重依赖配对数据，限制其泛化与实用性。

Method: MVR-MoE由三部分组成：(1)从红外与可见光图像中挖掘内在结构线索并组织为多视角表征；(2)多视角超连接扩展特征空间，同时保留共享证据与模态特有细节；(3)分层路由机制在结构视角层与专家层双重调节特征利用，实现异质线索的自适应利用。预测温度、发射率与纹理图，并以Stefan-Boltzmann定律约束实现物理一致。

Result: 在挑战性数据集上，MVR-MoE在保持轻量化的同时实现了更优的鲁棒性与判别性。

Conclusion: 多视角路由混合专家机制可有效缓解配对数据依赖，为物理一致的低光图像生成提供可行范式。

Abstract: Infrared and visible images provide complementary cues for low-light image generation, and physics-based methods can better exploit this complementarity. However, existing physics-based methods still rely heavily on paired data. To address these limitations, we propose Multi-View Routing Mixture-of-Experts (MVR-MoE), a framework for physically consistent TeX generation that learns multi-view structural representations. MVR-MoE mines intrinsic structural cues from infrared and visible images to organize them into multi-view representations, while the proposed multi-view hyper connections expand the feature space and preserve both shared evidence and modality-specific details. A hierarchical routing mechanism further regulates feature utilization at both the structural-view level and the expert level, enabling adaptive exploitation of heterogeneous cues. The predicted temperature, emissivity, and texture maps are constrained by the Stefan-Boltzmann law to ensure physically consistent. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate that MVR-MoE achieves superior robustness and discriminability while remaining lightweight.

</details>


### [239] [RxGS: Relightable Gaussian Stylization via BRDF Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25681)
*Wanrong Hong,Liu Jiang,Mukesh Prasad,Jun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RxGS是一个基于BRDF感知3D高斯表示的可重光照3D场景风格化框架，仅优化逆渲染得到的漫反射反照率场，从而在风格化后仍支持重光照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于NeRF/3DGS的参考图像三维场景风格化方法优化的是RGB外观表示，单点颜色混合了材质反射率、环境光照、着色与视角方向效应；风格化会将这些光照效应"烘焙"进存储外观中，导致风格化场景无法在不同光照下渲染，即不支持重光照。

Method: 采用BRDF感知的3D高斯表示；不修改逐点RGB颜色，而是仅优化逆渲染恢复的漫反射反照率场，保持粗糙度、金属度、表面法线与估计环境光照不变；优化时使用最近邻特征匹配损失并结合以高斯中心为对象的空间平滑先验。

Result: 以基于光流扭曲误差的几何一致性代价（GCC）进行评估：在所有测试的NeRF-Synthetic场景上取得最低GCC，在真实拍摄场景上具有竞争力，并额外支持可重光照风格化。

Conclusion: 通过将风格化限制在反照率场而非联合RGB外观，RxGS保留了基于物理渲染器所需的除被编辑反照率外的全部组件，实现可重光照的参考式三维场景风格化，弥补了现有方法无法重光照的不足。

Abstract: Reference-based 3D scene stylization transfers the appearance of a reference image onto a reconstructed 3D scene while preserving scene geometry. Recent methods perform this transfer by optimizing the appearance representation of neural scene models including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). These methods optimize an RGB appearance representation, in which a single per-point colour combines the effects of material reflectance, environment illumination, together with the shading it produces, and the viewing direction. When stylization modifies this combined colour, the illumination effects present during stylization are baked into the stored appearance, so the stylized scene cannot be rendered under different illumination. To address this limitation, we present RxGS, a relightable 3D scene stylization framework built on a Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF)-aware 3D Gaussian representation. Rather than modifying a per-point RGB colour, RxGS optimizes only the diffuse albedo field recovered by inverse rendering, while leaving roughness, metallicity, surface normals, and the estimated environment lighting unchanged. As a result, the stylized scene keeps all the components a physically-based renderer needs other than the edited albedo, and can therefore still be relit. RxGS optimizes the albedo field using a nearest-neighbour feature matching loss together with a spatial smoothness prior over Gaussian centres. We evaluate the method using a Geometry Consistency Cost (GCC) based on optical-flow warping error. RxGS achieves the lowest GCC on all evaluated NeRF-Synthetic scenes and remains competitive on real-captured scenes, while additionally supporting relightable stylization, which existing reference-based 3D scene stylization methods do not provide.

</details>


### [240] [Confidence-Guided Pseudo-Label Refinement for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25633)
*Sundas Iqbal,Danish Ali,Qing Tian,Yuhui Zheng,Jianping Gou,Weihua Ou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CGPLR，一种置信度引导的伪标签精炼框架，用于无监督域自适应行人重识别，通过样本级可靠性估计与三向选择性决策缓解噪声伪标签被迭代强化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督跨域行人重识别中，域偏移会产生噪声伪标签，并在迭代自适应过程中被不断强化；现有基于聚类的方法多依赖有限的可靠性线索或全局置信度准则，对歧义目标样本施加硬性身份监督，易引入错误标签。

Method: 构建样本级可靠性估计，联合建模质心兼容性、局部邻域一致性、与最强竞争簇的分离度以及时序分配稳定性；由置信度分布导出簇自适应的上下阈值，进行三向选择性决策：保留可靠分配、仅在替代簇获得充分几何与邻域支持时对可恢复样本重新指派、对高度歧义样本暂缓硬身份监督；学习目标相应采用置信度加权监督、谨慎的纠正标签加权以及无标签表示一致性约束。

Result: Market-1501→MSMT17 达到 76.4% Rank-1 与 47.6% mAP；MSMT17→Market-1501 达到 95.1% Rank-1 与 87.7% mAP，验证了可靠性感知的选择性自适应有效性。

Conclusion: 多线索联合的置信度估计与簇自适应三向决策能够有效抑制噪声伪标签的强化，实现精细化、可靠性感知的跨域自适应，为无监督行人重识别提供可行的选择性监督范式。

Abstract: Unsupervised cross-domain person re-identification remains challenging because domain shifts generate noisy pseudo labels that are reinforced during iterative adaptation. Existing clustering-based methods often rely on limited reliability cues or global confidence criteria and may impose hard identity supervision on ambiguous target samples. To address these limitations, we propose CGPLR, a confidence-guided pseudo-label refinement framework for unsupervised domain-adaptive person re-identification. CGPLR estimates sample-level reliability by jointly modeling centroid compatibility, local neighborhood consistency, separation from the strongest competing cluster and temporal assignment stability. The resulting confidence distribution is used to derive cluster-adaptive upper and lower thresholds for a three-way selective decision. Reliable assignments are preserved, recoverable samples are reassigned only when an alternative cluster receives sufficient geometric and neighborhood support and highly ambiguous samples are deferred from hard identity supervision. The learning objective adapts to these decisions through confidence-weighted supervision for preserved samples, cautious corrected-label weighting for reassigned samples and label-free representation consistency for deferred samples. CGPLR achieves 76.4% Rank-1 accuracy and 47.6% mean average precision (mAP) on Market-1501 to MSMT17, and 95.1% Rank-1 accuracy and 87.7% mAP on MSMT17 to Market-1501, demonstrating effective reliability-aware selective adaptation. The code is available at https://github.com/Sundas058/CGPLR.

</details>


### [241] [GroundedVDR: Grounding Video-to-Web Evidence Dependencies in Video Deep Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25493)
*Xiyuan Liang,Yu Wang,Zuhao Yang,Ziting Wang,Duo Li,Sudong Wang,Zhongyu Yang,Xiaoqin Zhang,Ling Shao,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出证据锚定的视频深度研究基准，独立评测视频定位、网络证据定位与答案正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频深度研究（VDR）基准只评测工具调用轨迹与最终回答，无法验证模型是否真正使用了时序视频信息或检索到的网络证据。

Method: 新基准具备三点特征：(1) 结合人工审核与多模型受限访问探测，剔除可凭参数化知识或单一信息源回答的问题；(2) 每道题配有结构化的“视频到网页”证据标注，将相关视频片段与其支撑网络证据关联；(3) 评测协议分别对视频定位、网页证据定位和最终答案正确性打分。

Result: 在八个多模态智能体系统上评测，最佳系统答案准确率达 76.0%，但没有任何系统能在超过 8% 的问题上召回完整的所需网页证据。

Conclusion: 高答案准确率掩盖了证据使用上的严重缺陷，表明现有 VDR 系统缺乏真正的证据锚定能力；基准已公开。

Abstract: Video large multimodal models have improved at identifying cross-frame visual evidence and conducting open-web retrieval, as reflected in recent video deep research (VDR) benchmarks. However, existing VDR benchmarks primarily evaluate tool-use trajectories and final responses without verifying whether a model actually uses the temporal video information or the retrieved web evidence. To fill this gap, we introduce \method{}, an evidence-grounded benchmark with three features. First, it combines human review with restricted-access probing across multiple models to exclude questions answerable from parametric knowledge or a single information source. Second, each question carries structured video-to-web evidence annotations that link the relevant video segments to their supporting web evidence. Third, its evaluation protocol separately scores video grounding, web evidence grounding, and final-answer correctness. Across eight multimodal agent systems, the best reaches 76.0\% answer accuracy, yet none recovers the complete required web evidence for more than 8\% of questions. Our benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hh721/vdr_temp}.

</details>


### [242] [Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26262)
*Yuanyu He,Zhuokun Chen,Yefei He,Zhiwei Tang,Jiasheng Tang,Yinghao Yu,Jianfei Cai,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA)，将自回归扩散Transformer的视频生成从稠密计算转为稀疏、运动驱动计算，通过动静区域解耦实现KV缓存选择性压缩与区域级计算分配，并辅以动力学引导蒸馏，在VBench上实现2.16x加速且保持高视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归扩散Transformer是长视频生成的强大范式，但计算开销与内存占用过大。其低效源于稠密计算机制对所有时空区域分配均匀资源，未能利用视频固有的时间冗余性——运动通常只局限于稀疏区域。

Method: 受视频编解码原理启发，显式将视频内容解耦为动态区域与静态区域：1）内存侧，对历史KV缓存进行选择性压缩，仅保留已生成chunk内的动态特征，缓解内存瓶颈；2）计算侧，基于局部动力学强度采用区域级计算资源分配策略以降低开销；3）引入动力学引导的蒸馏方法，通过轻量蒸馏训练过程提升性能。

Result: 在VBench上的实验表明，方法将自回归视频生成加速2.16倍，同时保持高视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 通过将稀疏性从数据冗余先验转化为计算与存储层面的结构性优化，DASA为长视频自回归扩散生成提供了一种统一的高效框架，验证了运动驱动稀疏化在加速与保真之间的良好权衡。

Abstract: Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.

</details>


### [243] [RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26216)
*Yang Yue,Fangyun Wei,Yitong Wang,Jinjing Zhao,Henry Zheng,Dong Chen,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"鲁棒预测"原则：生成相关信息应能从受扰动的latent中恢复，并据此设计RoAR-VAE（RobustAlign+RobustRecon），在同等训练预算下兼顾重建保真与下游扩散可学习性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉tokenizer需同时保证重建保真度与latent对下游扩散模型的可学习性（diffusability）。既有方法依赖语义对齐或tokenizer-扩散联合训练，但作者重访REPA-E发现：去掉其扩散目标与专用生成模块、仅保留从受扰动latent预测语义特征，在匹配设置下即可达到相当的下游生成效果，说明关键在于"鲁棒预测"本身。

Method: 以"鲁棒预测"为一般原则，实例化为两个互补目标：(1) RobustAlign——从受扰动latent预测预训练语义特征，保留高层结构；(2) RobustRecon——从受扰动latent重建干净图像，保留细粒度空间与外观信息。二者构成RoAR-VAE。并给出分析：鲁棒预测使有用信息集中于方差较高的latent方向，而扩散模型倾向于更早学到这些方向，从而提升可扩散性。

Result: 相同训练预算下，RoAR-VAE在生成基准上平均超过最强基线tokenizer 2.19分；小文本重建准确率较FLUX.1-VAE提升16.93个百分点。

Conclusion: RoAR-VAE在重建保真度与下游生成可学习性之间取得良好平衡；鲁棒预测是提升latent可扩散性的一种简洁有效机制。

Abstract: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.

</details>


### [244] [CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25927)
*Feiyang Hong,Yujie Wei,Bo Zhao,Xiu Su,Hongxun Yao,Shuo Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CondenseVLA：一种多帧VLA策略，在解码器侧引入可学习的历史压缩模块，用可学习查询与多头交叉注意力将缓存的历史逐帧特征蒸馏为固定数量的slot token，以增强动作解码对短期视觉上下文的利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作常依赖单帧难以消歧的短期线索（短暂接触、临时遮挡、中间物体状态），需跨时间整合观测；但仅扩大历史窗口计算代价高，且因冗余大、采样与任务无关且不灵活，收益有限。

Method: 基于VLM主干缓存的逐帧特征序列，采用可学习查询与多头交叉注意力把观测历史压缩成固定数量的slot token；并用简单辅助正则惩罚slot注意力图之间的重叠、对slot嵌入去相关，促使注意力互补、降低slot冗余。

Result: Simpler-WidowX成功率由58.7%提升至69.8%（+11.1个百分点）；LIBERO达97.2%；真实世界任务52.8%；依赖记忆的RMBench任务21.6%。

Conclusion: 所评估任务的结果支持对有限近期视觉证据进行选择性压缩以服务动作解码；但更困难的多观测任务暴露了有限历史窗口的局限。

Abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

</details>


### [245] [MIRA: A Multimodal Illustrated Deep Research Agent for Controllable Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25926)
*Hongrui Wu,Kaiwen Tuo,Congcong Wang,Gen Li,Shuai Dong,Xinlei Yu,Yuqi Xu,Haowen Hou,Zelin Peng,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MIRA——面向可控报告生成的多模态图文深度研究智能体，通过 MIRA-Harness（需求→生成契约+四阶段工作流）与 MIRA-Data（多跳多模态轨迹）实现图文证据贯通，基于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 7 个多模态检索与深度研究基准上取得开放智能体 SOTA，并输出可溯源、符合用户要求的图文报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态深度研究要求智能体处理交错文本/视觉输入、经多步网页检索收集多模态证据，并按用户约束产出图文报告。现有系统存在两点不足：(1) 推理阶段对搜索轨迹中发现的图像利用不足；(2) 生成阶段形式固定，对报告粒度、多模态编排与证据可溯性的控制力弱。

Method: MIRA-Harness：将用户需求转译为生成契约（generation contracts），串联证据收集、报告提交、反馈驱动修订、最终交付四阶段，使文本与视觉证据贯穿研究与写作全过程。MIRA-Data：据此构造高质量多跳多模态研究轨迹，用于对基座模型进行后训练，使其适配该工作流。

Result: 以 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 为基座，MIRA 在 7 个代表性且成熟的多模态搜索与深度研究智能体基准上，在开放智能体中获得 SOTA 表现；同时生成与用户需求对齐的图文报告，文本与视觉证据均可溯源。

Conclusion: 通过契约化的工作流约束与轨迹后训练，可有效解决多模态深度研究中图像利用不足与生成可控性弱的问题，实现过程可追溯、形式可控制的高质量图文报告生成。

Abstract: Deep research agents are increasingly capable of searching the open web and synthesizing evidence, yet they remain poorly suited to controllable report generation in multimodal deep research. This task requires agents to handle interleaved textual and visual inputs, gather multimodal evidence through multi-step web search, and deliver comprehensive illustrated reports under user-specified requirements. Existing systems face two limitations. During reasoning, they often underuse images discovered along the search trajectory; during generation, they tend to produce fixed-form answers with limited control over report granularity, multimodal composition, and evidence grounding. We introduce MIRA, a Multimodal Illustrated Deep Research Agent for controllable reports. MIRA integrates textual and visual evidence throughout research and writing. At its core, MIRA-Harness translates user requirements into generation contracts and connects four stages: evidence collection, report submission, feedback-driven revision, and final delivery. Building on this harness, MIRA-Data constructs high-quality multi-hop multimodal research trajectories, and we post-train foundation models to operate within the workflow. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MIRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among open agents on 7 representative, established multimodal-search and deep-research-agent benchmarks, while producing user-aligned illustrated reports with traceable textual and visual evidence.

</details>


### [246] [Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25887)
*Lejia Ye,Bin Wu,Jingjing Gao,Yiyang Wu,Xiaohu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将稀疏视角3DGS重构为少样本学习问题，把每个Gaussian基元视为神经元，引入深度学习正则化技术，从数据监督增强与训练期正则化两方面统一改善稀疏视角新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成对AR/VR与实时通信至关重要，但3DGS在稀疏输入下存在过拟合与几何退化问题；现有方法多从局部视角分别处理数据质量或训练正则化，缺乏统一且可解释的框架。

Method: 提出少样本学习视角的统一框架，将Gaussian基元类比为神经元并借用深度学习正则化：(1) 数据相关监督增强——光流引导的伪视角合成与相机-场景联合优化；(2) 训练期正则化——运动感知dropout与早停，抑制过拟合同时保持动态场景稳定性。

Result: 在SIGGRAPH Asia 2025体视频挑战赛稀疏视角数据集上，显著优于SOTA的优化类与前馈类基线；系统获该挑战赛稀疏视角赛道第一名。

Conclusion: 少样本学习视角为稀疏视角3DGS提供了统一、可解释的系统化改进范式，数据增强与训练正则化的结合有效缓解过拟合与几何退化，并在竞赛中验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement.
  We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.

</details>


### [247] [UniJev: Separating Accuracy from Calibration in Trimodal System One Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25784)
*Jianing Wang,Youwen Jian,Derong Wang,Jinyang Yu,Qingyi Si,Chuanyu Qin,Yanghua Xiao,Hongcheng Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三模态(文本/图像/视频)联合监督的置信度打分框架UniJev,并给出独立于强化学习的监督校准目标Cora,在2B与9B规模上降低图像与视频ECE且保持准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One模型输出的概率判断需被软件直接消费,因此置信度可靠性不亚于答案准确率;但文本-图像-视频联合训练研究不足,且SFT与RLCD(用于校准决策的强化学习)的各自贡献难以分离。

Method: UniJev:用共享打分头对候选答案打分,在三种模态上联合监督训练;实验对比backbone直接读出、监督决策模型与现有RLCD。进一步提出Cora(Confidence–Outcome Reliability Alignment):按置信度将当前预测分箱,将每条预测的置信度对齐到其所在箱的经验准确率,作为独立的监督校准目标,无需强化学习阶段。

Result: 监督决策模型在三种模态上均较backbone读出提升准确率;现有RLCD算法准确率变化很小,且在不同配方下对视觉校准影响不一致。Cora在2B与9B规模上均降低图像与视频的ECE,同时保持准确率。

Conclusion: SFT与RLCD在置信度校准上的作用可被分离,校准更适合以独立监督目标处理;Cora提供了无需RL阶段的简易有效方案,并开源代码。

Abstract: System One models produce probabilistic judgments that software can consume directly, making reliable confidence as important as answer accuracy. Yet joint training across text, images, and video remains underexplored, and the contributions of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) are difficult to separate. We introduce UniJev, a trimodal framework that scores candidate answers with a shared head under joint supervised training across text, images, and video. Supervised decision models improve accuracy over their backbone readouts across all three modalities, while the existing RLCD algorithms change accuracy little and have inconsistent effects on visual calibration across recipes. These findings motivate a separate supervised objective for confidence calibration. We introduce Cora (Confidence--Outcome Reliability Alignment), which groups current predictions by confidence and optimizes each prediction's confidence toward the empirical accuracy of its bin. At both 2B and 9B, Cora lowers image and video expected calibration error (ECE) while preserving accuracy, without a reinforcement stage. We release our code at https://github.com/wjnwjnwj/UniJev.

</details>


### [248] [Think Densely, Act Sparsely: Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25734)
*Jie Wang,Guang Li,Zhijian Huang,Jinlong Li,Chenxu Dang,Hangjun Ye,Yahong Han,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"稠密思考、稀疏行动"(Think Densely, Act Sparsely)范式,并用LECDrive框架实现:在VLA模型中嵌入紧凑的潜在专家认知链(token载体),从DINOv3、SAM3、DepthAnything3蒸馏视觉、语义、几何稠密知识,以课程学习渐进监督,提升多项自动驾驶任务性能并保持高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA自动驾驶模型仅用语言指令或轨迹等稀疏信号监督,迫使模型将稠密视觉观测压缩甚至丢弃关键场景信息;作者认为瓶颈不在模型容量,而在缺乏促使隐空间形成稠密世界表征的显式机制。

Method: 模拟人类分层感知,在VLA中嵌入渐进式潜在专家认知链:注入少量任务特定latent tokens作为载体,使其内化基础视觉模型(DINOv3视觉表征、SAM3语义结构、DepthAnything3空间几何)的稠密知识;按"表征→语义→几何"的课程学习原则渐进构造监督,同时保持推理高效与可解释。

Result: 在多个自动驾驶基准上,覆盖目标感知、状态预测、轨迹规划等关键任务,LECDrive持续提升基础VLM的性能,同时保持高效推理。

Conclusion: 通过结构化潜在专家链构建稠密世界模型,是VLA自动驾驶的一条有前景的方向;性能提升源于稠密隐表征机制而非单纯扩大模型容量。

Abstract: Autonomous driving fundamentally demands dense understanding of visual, semantic, and geometric information, yet existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with sparse supervision such as language instructions or trajectory signals. This direct mapping from dense visual observations to sparse representations forces the model to compress or even discard critical scene information essential for safe driving. We argue that this limitation does not stem from insufficient model capacity, but from the lack of explicit mechanisms that encourage the formation of dense world representations in the latent space. In this spirit, we propose a novel paradigm for driving intelligence, Think Densely, Act Sparsely, and instantiate it with an efficient and interpretable framework, LECDrive (Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action autonomous Driving). The core idea is to mimic the hierarchical perception process of humans by embedding a progressive chain of latent expert cognition within the VLA model. Concretely, we inject a compact set of task-specific latent tokens as carriers, enabling the model to internalize dense knowledge from foundational vision models, including visual representations (DINOv3), semantic structures (SAM3), and spatial geometry (DepthAnything3), while maintaining efficient inference. This interdependent cognitive chain follows a curriculum learning principle, where supervision is progressively structured from representation to semantics and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LECDrive consistently improves the performance of base VLMs across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks, covering key tasks such as object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning. These findings suggest that constructing dense world models through structured latent expert chains is a promising direction for VLA-based autonomous driving.

</details>


### [249] [TriScore: Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection with Energy, Boundary Probes, and Transform Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26323)
*Ege Gursoy,Nicolas Mansard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TriScore，将能量先验、边界脆弱性分数与变换一致性分数三个 ID 校准信号融合，用输入相关的 ID 残差门控融合，无需 OOD 标签或辅助模型，在对抗性偏移下优于单信号后处理 OOD 检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事后（post-hoc）OOD 检测多依赖从冻结分类器中提取的单一信号（置信度、能量、特征、梯度），在分类器级对抗性偏移下脆弱：偏移可保留检测器所依赖的线索而改变模型决策行为。作者探究能否用互补的多判据融合来缓解该失效模式。

Method: TriScore 为后处理方法，基于同一冻结骨干网络提取三个在 ID 数据上校准的信号：能量先验、边界脆弱性分数、变换一致性分数；在 ID 验证集上标准化后，通过输入相关的 ID 残差门控进行融合。方法不需要 OOD 标签、辅助模型、再训练或特征库存储。

Result: 在四种 ImageNet 规模骨干网络上，非自适应对抗性偏移协议下 TriScore 在 15 个事后基线中取得最高平均 AUROC，同时在标准 OOD 基准上保持竞争力；消融实验表明性能提升来自互补线索的融合，而非单一检测信号的优化。

Conclusion: 多判据后处理检测是提升分类器级偏移下 OOD 检测鲁棒性的可行路径。

Abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detection usually relies on a single signal extracted from a frozen classifier, such as confidence, energy, features, or gradients. This dependence becomes fragile under classifier-level adversarial shift, where the shift can preserve the detector's chosen cue while changing the model's decision behavior. We investigate whether this failure mode can be mitigated by combining complementary detection criteria instead of selecting a single score. We introduce TriScore, a post-hoc OOD detector that combines three ID-calibrated signals from the same frozen backbone: an energy prior, a boundary-fragility score, and a transform-consistency score. These signals are standardized on ID validation data and fused by an input-dependent ID-residual gate, requiring no OOD labels, auxiliary model, training, or stored feature bank. Across four ImageNet-scale backbones, TriScore achieves the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines under a non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, while remaining competitive on standard OOD benchmarks. Ablations show that the gains come from combining complementary cues rather than optimizing a single detector signal. These results support multi-criterion post-hoc detection as a practical route toward more robust OOD detection under classifier-level shift. The source code is publicly available at github.com/gursoyege/TriScore.

</details>


### [250] [InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26853)
*Yi-Chuan Huang,Hao-Jen Chien,Zheng-Hui Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfiniDream：VLM驱动的开放式程序化3D世界生成框架，通过符号约束资产生成与确定性视锥引导网格布局实现可编辑、多样化的大规模3D场景生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化生成相比静态网格具有更强的可控性、可编辑性与多样性，但VLM代码生成的三维资产往往过于简单，而写实级程序化系统依赖大量人工开发；现有VLM引导方法受限于预定义工厂与API，难以创造新资产类型。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation，利用已有程序化算法生成新颖写实资产，同时保持可编辑性与基于种子的多样性；(2) 端到端 text-to-world 流程，结合语义场景规划与 Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement，实现精确物体放置、程序化填充与动画的大规模3D世界构建。

Result: 在100个物体生成任务与20个场景生成任务上评测，四项感知指标均有提升；多样性分析、消融实验与人类偏好评估进一步验证框架有效性。

Conclusion: InfiniDream证明了VLM可在符号约束下突破预定义API限制，实现开放式的程序化3D资产与世界生成，兼顾写实性、可编辑性与多样性。

Abstract: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

</details>


### [251] [GenOlympiad: Benchmarking Frontier Image Models at Their Capability Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26850)
*Xi Hu,Martin Bell,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GenOlympiad，一个从九个能力轴构建最困难提示词的文生图基准，用于压力测试前沿模型；配套可自动、可视觉验证的 grounding 评估框架，最佳模型（Nano Banana Pro）严格得分仅 23.9/100。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型已能生成高质量图像，但缺乏对"前沿模型究竟在何处失效"的系统性刻画；需要以客观可验证的方式探测模型在数量生成、深度推理、物理一致性、复杂规则遵循等维度的能力边界，避免依赖风格等主观指标。

Method: 构建覆盖九个能力轴的高难度提示词集合（大批量生成、深度推理、硬物理一致性、复杂规则遵循等），提示词设计保证 prompt alignment 可视觉验证（如计数）而非主观判断；提出自动化评估框架，将提示拆解为易/难子问题，并对多数难题绘制辅助线（help lines）以 grounding 证据进行精确打分；评测 20+ 个强模型。

Result: 最优模型 Nano Banana Pro 仅获严格分数 23.9/100；部分代码类模型（如 GPT-6 Astra）在 prompt alignment 上得分更高但视觉美观度较低；并得出关于模型演进、与 Elo 分数一致性、以及 grounding 评估协议有效性的结论。

Conclusion: 当前前沿文生图模型在困难能力轴上仍存在显著短板，GenOlympiad 提供了可复现、客观可验证的压力测试与评估范式，对模型能力诊断与迭代方向具有参考价值；代码与项目页已公开。

Abstract: Text-to-image models have made tremendous progress and can produce high-quality images. However, a question which would be asked in any other discipline is where the frontier models fall short. We introduce GenOlympiad, a benchmark which provides the most challenging text prompts from nine capability axes for stress-testing frontier text-to-image models. The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/

</details>


### [252] [V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26780)
*Ruicheng Li,Qixiu Li,Yu Deng,Sicheng Xu,Jiaolong Yang,Baining Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: V-JEPA Hand：基于自监督视频编码器的前馈模型，单次前向联合重建自我中心视频中的双手与相机运动，在ARCTIC/HOT3D/EgoStandard上取得最优MPJPE，93.4 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自我中心视频恢复度量3D手部轨迹需同时估计手部运动与相机自运动以统一参考系；现有流程分阶段（手部检测、手部重建、相机跟踪、轨迹精化）级联，复杂且误差累积，缺少端到端的联合建模方案。

Method: 以自监督V-JEPA 2.1编码器提取全帧视频时空特征，配合query-based预测器解码出逐帧手部姿态、手部存在性与相机运动；用预测的相机运动将手部轨迹表达至统一世界坐标系；支持已知或预测焦距；单阶段端到端训练，混用多样伪标注视频与高精度3D标注；推理为单次前向。

Result: 单一模型在ARCTIC、HOT3D、EgoStandard上取得覆盖感知MPJPE最低值（对比同类基线），世界坐标轨迹误差优于SLAM类流程；消融验证视频预训练、时序上下文与混合监督的有效性；单张RTX A6000上前向吞吐达93.4 FPS。

Conclusion: 统一的单阶段前馈框架可取代多阶段级联流水线，在精度与效率上均具优势，表明视频预训练时序表示对自我中心手-相机联合重建具有关键价值。

Abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.

</details>


### [253] [PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26711)
*Kaiwei Chen,Moran Li,Zhenye Gan,Yabiao Wang,Chengjie Wang,Kexin Zhang,Yong Liu,Jiangning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PVBench，一个从 7 大领域、46 个维度定量衡量生成视频物理合理性的基准，含 600 条提示词（30% 涉及具身智能体），对可物理求解维度引入专用视觉模型给出可验证的物理测量，并验证自动指标与人类判断的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉质量高但物理合理性缺乏有效度量；已有基准依赖粗粒度视觉语言模型判断，或针对具身世界模型而非视频生成本身，缺少细粒度、可验证的物理量化评测手段。

Method: 构建 PVBench：将物理合理性分解为指令与语义保真、行为与因果一致、感知与时间质量、几何与空间一致、材质属性与场状态、运动学与时空持续性、力学合理性与守恒律 7 大领域共 46 个维度；设计 600 条提示词，其中 30% 含机械臂、人形、四足及多智能体等具身智能体；对物理可解维度配对专用视觉模型，提取物体级 6D 位姿、度量尺度、表面法线、运动学及守恒律数值残差等可验证测量，避免仅依赖主观打分；同时支持文生视频与图生视频，并通过人类评估校准自动指标。

Result: 人类评估表明自动指标与人类判断具有一致性；对主流开源与闭源模型进行评测，给出若干实证发现与洞见。

Conclusion: PVBench 提供了细粒度、可物理验证的视频生成评测框架，公开基准、提示词与校准协议，以推动物理接地的视频生成研究。

Abstract: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems.
