*Xiaoqiang Wang,Ting-En Lin,Yuchuan Wu,Pinyi Zhang,Caixin Kang,Ling Li,Bingxue Qiu,Jieping Ye,Yongbin Li,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 HarnessRL，一种与策略共同演化的训练时"实验台"，通过任务采样、rollout 引导与评分细则三类接口自适应调整，解决基于评分细则的强化学习中奖励失效问题，并在 Rubric-Mix-10k 上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分细则（rubric）的自然语言奖励在训练推进过程中会失效，论文识别出两类失败模式：非判别性奖励（分数坍缩至一致的低或高值，源于探索不足或任务难度与策略能力不匹配）与虚假奖励（高分不对应更优回答）。二者共性在于任务采样、探索与评估在策略演化时保持固定，未随之调整。

Method: HarnessRL 作为一个训练时 harness 与策略共同演化，暴露三个可调接口：任务采样、rollout 引导与评分细则标准。系统维护训练时记忆，harness 演化器从中检索任务内历史与跨任务证据，据此将每次奖励失败归因到可修复的对应接口；随后执行 proposer 与即时（just-in-time）critic 的闭环，critic 仅在度量候选更新对当前冻结策略的实际影响后才接受，否则退回修订。另构建 Rubric-Mix-10k，覆盖医学、科学、写作、角色扮演与指令跟随五个领域的开放式 RL 训练与评测套件。

Result: 在 Rubric-Mix-10k 上，HarnessRL 在 4B 与 9B 两个模型规模上均超过最强基线 2.8–3.1 分，并将达到最佳 checkpoint 所需训练步数几乎减半。

Conclusion: 奖励失效并非单纯来自奖励函数设计，而是训练配置与策略演化不匹配的结果；让任务采样、探索引导与评估标准随策略共同演化，并借助基于冻结策略实测的接受机制，可显著提升开放式生成的 RL 训练效率与效果。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.

</details>


### [432] [Governing the Rule Space. Ruliology, Computational Irreducibility and Anticipatory Governance of Quantum Technologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26423)
*Antonio Felice Uricchio,Francesco Scagliola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 文章提出"规则学预测性规制框架"（Ruliological Framework for Anticipatory Regulation），将规制理解为对可能发生之变革的探索，而非对未来的精确预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴技术规制常被视为"追赶式"策略，因为立法者总是姗姗来迟；作者希望扭转这一被动视角，强调收集信号、构建情景并使规则适应预期未来是治理者的基本任务，包括对规则本身的治理。

Method: 以"未来法"文献中预测性治理（anticipatory governance）的前提为起点，即预测意味着构建制度能力而非精确预测结果；提出规则学框架，区分规则（rules）、变革（transformations）与轨迹（trajectories），据此评估备选方案与可能发展；有条件地引入"计算不可约性"（computational irreducibility），而非将其视为法律系统的已证属性；以"量子欧洲战略"（Quantum Europe Strategy）为案例。

Result: 构建出一个可操作的分析框架，能够对规制替代方案及其可能演化路径进行比较评估；并通过量子欧洲战略案例获得实证支撑与进一步反思的依据。

Conclusion: 规制应被重新理解为对潜在变革的探索性活动；预测性规制依赖于制度能力的建设而非结果预测；计算不可约性在框架中仅作条件性假设使用，需谨慎对待其适用边界。

Abstract: The regulation of emerging technologies is often conceived as a strategy of catching up, because legislators arrive too late. Yet gathering signals, constructing scenarios and adapting rules to an anticipated future are fundamental tasks for those entrusted with governance, including the governance of rules themselves. The literature on so-called future law has already shown that anticipation means building institutional capabilities rather than predicting outcomes precisely (anticipatory governance). Taking this premise as its starting point, this article proposes to understand regulation as an exploration of the transformations that may occur. The Ruliological Framework for Anticipatory Regulation distinguishes rules, transformations and trajectories, assessing alternatives and possible developments. Within this approach, computational irreducibility is adopted conditionally, not as a demonstrated property of legal systems. The Quantum Europe Strategy provides a case study and further grounds for reflection.

</details>


### [433] [VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26190)
*Leanne Tan,Keith Chua,Shaun Khoo,Onno P. Kampman,Lim Ruling Charmaine,Hazirah Hoosainsah,Kellie Yu Hui Sim,Kai He,Kenny Tsu Wei Choo,Roy Ka-Wei Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 VEILED-SH 基准与构建方法，用于评估对自杀、自伤及痛苦间接表达的回应，覆盖文化差异、应用场景与从业者分歧三个维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统易漏检间接的、文化情境化的痛苦表达，或给出与应用场景不匹配的支持；而现有基准未同时处理文化变异、应用场景与从业者分歧。

Method: 构建 10,003 条提示，覆盖咨询聊天、论坛帖、平台搜索与分诊四类场景，来源为新加坡本地化来源与公开数据集；采用经专家验证的多标签分类体系，区分意图、交际功能与回应行为；设计六个自动化画像（persona），分别校准至三位同伴支持从业者与三位临床医生，各自保留独立参考策略用于代理对齐（proxy-alignment）评分。

Result: 在覆盖度增强的样本上评估五个系统，发现同一系统回应在不同画像生成的参考策略下，其代理对齐分数存在差异。

Conclusion: 多画像、分场景的基准设计可揭示单一评判标准所掩盖的评估敏感性，说明对间接痛苦表达的评估需显式建模文化情境、应用场景与从业者分歧。

Abstract: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.

</details>


### [434] [CALM: Consistency-Aware Logit Masking in Decoding Space for Mitigating Overthinking of Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25908)
*Shengjing Liu,Feiyang Li,Yuxuan Yang,Yile Wang,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的CALM解码干预方法，通过在步骤边界监测试验答案并对"Wait"等动作转换点(ATP)token施加logit掩码，抑制冗余过渡推理以缓解大推理模型的过度思考，在保持甚至小幅提升准确率的同时减少18.6%–25.0%的token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型(LRMs)通过长链思维链在数学与科学任务上表现优异，但常出现过度思考，产生大量不必要的推理步骤。现有基于截断的方法依赖检测连续试验答案一致来强制提前退出，然而这种局部停止信号并不必然代表最终答案稳定，且可能打断后续有用的反思或验证，导致性能下降。

Method: 一致性感知logit掩码(CALM)，一种免训练的解码干预：(1)在步骤边界监测试验答案；(2)对"Wait"、"Alternatively"、"Hmm"等动作转换点(ATP)token施加logit掩码，抑制冗余的过渡性推理，同时让模型更自然地继续其思考过程，而非硬性截断。

Result: 在4个先进LRM与5个基准上实验：相比完整CoT推理，CALM减少18.6%–25.0%的token消耗且保持性能，甚至通过减少冗余推理使准确率提升0.07%–1.48%。LLM-as-a-Judge结果表明CALM的输出更连贯、更简洁。

Conclusion: 局部停止信号并非最终答案稳定性的可靠指标，硬截断存在风险；改为对ATP token进行一致性感知的软性解码干预，可在不训练、不牺牲甚至提升性能的前提下有效缓解过度思考并降低推理开销。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance on challenging mathematical and scientific tasks through long chain-of-thought reasoning, but they often suffer from overthinking with unnecessary reasoning steps. Existing truncation-based methods typically detect consecutive trial-answer agreement and force early exit, yet such local stopping signals do not necessarily indicate final-answer stability and can disrupt useful subsequent reflection or verification, potentially leading to performance degradation. We propose consistency-aware logit masking (CALM), a training-free decoding intervention for mitigating overthinking in LRMs. CALM first monitors trial answers at step boundaries and then applies logit masking to action transition point (ATP) tokens such as "Wait", "Alternatively", and "Hmm", suppressing redundant transitional reasoning while allowing the model to continue its thought process more naturally. Experiments across four advanced LRMs and five benchmarks show that CALM reduces token consumption by 18.6%-25.0% compared with full CoT reasoning while maintaining performance, and can even improve accuracy by 0.07%-1.48% by reducing redundant reasoning. LLM-as-a-Judge results also demonstrate that CALM provides more coherent and concise results.

</details>


### [435] [Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-makers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25768)
*Zhongyin Wang,Zhaoqian Xue,Junting Mu,Haozheng Liu,Ye Yuan,Haolun Wu,Lingyao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出用System-1决策模型Jev作为截断推理的"决策阅读器"，在七个推理模型、五个多选题基准（35对）上以更低成本获得高于强制作答的准确率，并给出离线回放与策略选择的成本-精度折中估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM常生成过量推理token，限制推理预算可降成本，但从不完整推理轨迹中强制输出答案会损害准确率；需要一种不依赖完整推理响应的低成本决策机制。

Method: 将Jev（System-1决策模型）作为截断推理的决策阅读器：在候选选项中做选择而不生成推理响应；在七个LLM推理器×五个多选题基准共35个组合上进行评估，预算范围500–16,000 token，并计入推理与作答成本；使用Holm校正的bootstrap检验；进行离线回放成本估计并提出在训练折上选择的策略，在留出折上验证。

Result: 在500–16,000 token测试预算下，Jev平均准确率高于强制作答；1,500 token预算时整体提升4.1 pp，截断问题上提升8.6 pp，17对组合在Holm校正bootstrap检验下显著；离线回放成本约为完整运行的34.5%，准确率损失1.13 pp；训练折选择的策略在留出折上节省71.3%估计成本，准确率损失0.58 pp；仅问题输入的准确率平均68.0%，高于500 token强制作答的65.5%，但该优势因基准而异。

Conclusion: System-1决策模型可补充LLM推理，降低对昂贵推理补全的依赖，在受限推理预算下提供更优的成本-精度折中。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate more reasoning tokens than needed. Limiting the reasoning budget reduces cost, but forcing an answer from an incomplete trace can hurt accuracy. System-1 decision models select among candidate options without producing a reasoning response. We evaluate Jev as a decision reader of truncated reasoning across seven LLM reasoners and five multiple-choice benchmarks (35 pairs). Jev achieves higher mean accuracy than forced answering at tested budgets from 500 to 16,000 tokens, including the estimated costs of reasoning and answering. At a 1,500-token budget, it improves accuracy by 4.1 pp overall and 8.6 pp on truncated questions, with significant gains in 17 pairs under Holm-corrected bootstrap tests. Offline replay estimates 34.5% of the full-run cost, with a 1.13 pp accuracy loss. A policy selected on training folds saves 71.3% of the estimated full-run cost on held-out folds, with a 0.58 pp accuracy loss. We also find that Jev shows strong question-only accuracy, exceeding 500-token forced answering on average (68.0% vs. 65.5%), although this advantage varies by benchmark. These findings suggest that System-1 decision models can complement LLM reasoning and reduce the need for costly reasoning completion.

</details>


### [436] [Consistency Training Suppresses Cue Following Without Teaching Cue Selectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25650)
*Prakhar Gupta,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Zhijing Jin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 四种一致性训练方法在Gemma-2-2B-it与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上均削弱了训练线索的影响，但修复共享三个特征：正确线索与错误线索受影响程度相近、修复高度依赖线索位置、原电路头仍承载大部分残余线索诱导错误；表明CT只是弱化训练线索，而非教会模型判断线索对错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型常因无有效证据的线索（如"I believe the answer is B"）而改变答案。一致性训练（CT）旨在让模型在有无线索时给出相同答案，已有工作暗示不同CT方法可能学到不同解，但缺乏在统一数据与模型上的系统比较与机制层面的验证。

Method: 在相同数据下，将四种CT方法——作用于输出token的BCT、残差激活的ACT、注意力模式的AttCT、采样答案率的RMCT——分别训练于Gemma-2-2B-it和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；预注册可证伪的预测，并借助已知的"线索传递至答案"电路对模型进行机制检查；同时操纵线索正确性与位置，并测试使BCT目标依赖线索正确性的变体。

Result: 四种方法均降低训练线索的有效性；正确线索与错误线索的影响力下降幅度相近；线索位于选项之前（同训练位置）时修复显著，位于之后时修复明显减弱（Llama RMCT对位置依赖最小）；电路头仍承载大部分残余的线索诱导错误；令BCT目标依赖线索正确性反而大多削弱修复效果。

Conclusion: CT削弱的是所训练的线索本身，而非教会模型判断线索是否正确；仅在训练位置上用错误线索进行评估会遗漏前两个性质，故此类评估存在系统性盲区。

Abstract: Language models often change answers because of a cue, a hint such as "I believe the answer is B" that gives no valid evidence. Consistency training (CT) trains a model to answer the same with and without the cue. Four CT methods apply this idea to output tokens (BCT), residual activations (ACT), attention patterns (AttCT) and sampled-answer rates (RMCT). Prior work suggests some learn different solutions. We train all four on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the same data. We test predictions written in advance and inspect the models with a known circuit that carries cues to the answer. All four make the trained cue less effective, and their fixes share three properties. First, correct cues lose about as much influence as wrong ones. Second, the fix is usually large for cues before the answer options, as in training, and much smaller after them. Llama RMCT depends least on position. Third, the circuit heads still carry most remaining cue-induced errors. Making BCT targets depend on the cue's correctness mostly weakens the fix. CT thus weakens the trained cue without teaching models when a cue is right. Evaluations with only wrong cues at the trained position miss the first two properties.

</details>


### [437] [Assertion and Belief: Moore's Paradox in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25586)
*Anshun Asher Zheng,Weili Cao,Fangcong Yin,David Beaver,Junyi Jessy Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大语言模型能识别摩尔悖论句（如"下雨了，但我不相信在下雨"）的不恰当性，但并非出于对言语行为的推理，而更像把该悖论当作关于句子的记忆性事实来调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摩尔悖论（Moore's paradox）的荒谬性不在内容而在断言行为本身——断言即为自身信念背书。因此它可作为检验语言模型在计算意义时是否考虑言语行为（speech act）的理想探针。作者据此提出首个针对LLM的摩尔悖论测试。

Method: 在多样化语境下构建精选的摩尔式句子集，评测12个模型；检验判断是否依赖记忆的固定句式、是否随言语行为变化；再借助理性言语行为框架（RSA, Goodman & Frank 2016）检验模型的"听者"是否会对其"说话者"进行推理，并分析推理链（reasoning traces）。

Result: 模型大体能识别摩尔句的不恰当性，且该判断不绑定于记忆的表层形式、能追踪言语行为的变化；但模型自身的听者并不对其说话者做推理，推理链显示模型是回忆关于该悖论的知识并套用规则。

Conclusion: 模型是把摩尔悖论学成了一种"关于句子的事实"，而非"对说话者的要求"；表面正确的判断背后缺乏真正的语用/心智化推理。

Abstract: Moore's paradox \citep{moore1942} concerns sentences such as ``It is raining, but I don't believe that it is,'' which may well be true yet cannot be sensibly asserted. The absurdity lies not in the content but in the act, since to assert is to vouch for one's own belief. This makes the paradox a test of whether language models take the speech act into account when computing meaning. We present the first test of Moore's paradox in LLMs, evaluating 12 models on a curated set of Moorean sentences in varied contexts. We find that models largely recognize the infelicity of Moorean sentences, and that the judgement is not tied to a memorized form and tracks the speech act. Using the Rational Speech Act framework (RSA; \citealt{goodmanfrank2016}), we then test whether these judgements arise from a listener reasoning about a speaker. We find the models' own listeners do not reason about their own speakers, and their reasoning traces suggest that they instead recall knowledge about the paradox and apply rules therein. The models thus appear to have learned the paradox as a fact about sentences, not as a requirement on speakers.

</details>


### [438] [Flattening Fantasies: Analyzing Stereotypes in Pornographic Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25566)
*Sarmad Chandio,Osama Khalid,Sharaf Zia,Ethan Kutlu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对xHamster平台540万条视频标题做大规模量化分析，考察色情话语中种族、国籍与性别身份的表述模式及刻板印象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 色情平台的话语实践可能强化身份刻板印象，但缺乏基于大规模真实数据的语言学实证检验。

Method: 采集全球第四大色情平台xHamster的540万条视频标题，从国籍、族群与性别身份维度进行语言学模式统计与比较分析，识别刻板化表述及对隐性规范的偏离。

Result: 美国色情内容在各类群体中占主导并构成行业事实标准；存在反映殖民权力关系、宗教恋物化与文化禁忌性化的持续性族群刻板印象；跨文化性别表征差异显著，女性呈现普遍的“圣母—荡妇”二分，男性多被刻画为体力支配角色。

Conclusion: 色情话语的身份表征系统性地复制了既有的权力结构与性别等级，大规模标题数据可有效揭示其中的刻板化机制。

Abstract: This study presents a large-scale quantitative analysis of 5.4 million video
  titles from xHamster, the world's fourth most visited pornography platform, to
  examine linguistic patterns used to describe different dimensions of
  identities (e.g., race and gender). Specifically, we investigate how
  nationalities, ethnic groups, and gender identities are portrayed in
  pornographic discourse, focusing on stereotypes and deviations from implicit
  norms of pornography. The results show the dominance of American pornography
  over other groups, which acts as the de facto norm for the adult industry. We
  identify persistent ethnic stereotypes reflecting colonial power dynamics,
  religious fetishization, and the sexualization of cultural taboos. The
  analysis reveals gendered representational differences across cultures, with a
  prevalent Madonna-Whore dichotomy in the portrayal of women and stereotypical
  depictions of men in physically dominant roles.

</details>


### [439] [BERT Is Already a Denoiser: Cheaply Unlocking Iterative Generation in Masked Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26601)
*Julio C. Amador Diaz Lopez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 无需扩散训练，利用掩码语言模型（BERT/RoBERTa）的预训练去噪能力即可实现有效的迭代式条件生成：预训练提供表示与去噪算子，任务适配决定生成内容，置信度承诺规则提供解码过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BERT 等 MLM 虽为去噪式预训练却主要用于表示学习；作者想验证其去噪能力能否在不进行扩散训练的前提下支撑条件生成，并厘清掩码迭代生成中各组件的实际作用。

Method: 提出一种迭代解码器：反复预测被掩码的 token，并按余弦调度（cosine schedule）提交高置信度预测，不需要扩散时间步或逆向扩散目标。实验对比冻结 BERT、普通 MLM 适配、参数高效适配，以及将同一生成接口用于更强的掩码表示（RoBERTa-large），在 ARC-Easy、MMLU、QQP、Quasar-T 上评估。

Result: 冻结 BERT 具显著去噪能力：在 15%/45%/60% 破坏率下分别重构 61.0%/37.5%/24.4% 的掩码 token，但可见上下文消失时生成急剧退化；冻结模型仅达 ARC-Easy 11.0%、MMLU 4.2%。普通 MLM 适配后升至 28.2%/24.6%，参数高效适配显著减少未匹配输出。开放式条件生成中，QQP 上 BLEU/ROUGE-L 为 0.163/0.583，Quasar-T 上为 0.107/0.327，与已发表的经扩散训练的 BERT 模型处于同一性能区间。RoBERTa-large 达 44.2%（ARC-Easy）与 33.8%（MMLU）。

Conclusion: 掩码迭代生成可分解为三部分：预训练提供表示与去噪算子，任务适配决定生成什么，迭代承诺规则提供解码过程。在本文所研究的设定下，显式扩散训练并非获得有效迭代式条件生成的必要条件。

Abstract: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT are typically used for representation learning despite their denoising pretraining. We test whether this capability supports conditional generation without diffusion training. Our decoder repeatedly predicts masked tokens and commits high-confidence predictions using a cosine schedule. It requires no diffusion timestep or reverse-diffusion objective. Frozen BERT already exhibits substantial denoising capability, reconstructing 61.0%, 37.5%, and 24.4% of masked tokens at 15%, 45%, and 60% corruption, respectively, although generation deteriorates sharply as visible context disappears. This capability alone does not yield task-directed generation: frozen BERT reaches only 11.0% on ARC-Easy and 4.2% on MMLU. Ordinary MLM adaptation, however, rapidly converts the same architecture into a usable generator. Full adaptation reaches 28.2% and 24.6%, respectively, while parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces unmatched outputs. On open-ended conditional generation, full MLM adaptation reaches BLEU/ROUGE-L of 0.163/0.583 on QQP and 0.107/0.327 on Quasar-T, placing it in the same broad performance range as published BERT models trained through diffusion without explicit diffusion training. Finally, applying the same generative interface to stronger masked representations substantially improves performance: RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy and 33.8% on MMLU. These results separate three components of masked iterative generation: pretraining supplies the representation and denoising operator, task adaptation determines what the model generates, and an iterative commitment rule supplies the decoding process. Explicit diffusion training is therefore not necessary to obtain effective iterative conditional generation from pretrained MLMs in the settings studied here.

</details>


### [440] [The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26433)
*Iliya Zhechev,Radoslav Ralev,Chris Coleman,Srijith Rajamohan,Jen Agarwal,Tyler Hutcherson,Simba Khadder*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究对话轮次、记忆文本与查询之间的几何关系能否在生成前预测答案正确性，结论是仅存在关联而无稳健的部署级诊断价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索能否在不调用额外LLM生成的前提下，利用记忆表示与查询的几何结构提前判断答案是否会正确，从而为记忆系统提供廉价、预生成的质量信号。

Method: 对四种记忆实现（稠密或混合检索）与一个观测摘要比较器进行评估，将对话轮次、记忆文本与查询嵌入共享空间；使用逻辑回归分类器，以25个特征（查询邻近度、记忆—对话对应关系、对话结构）基于正确性标签训练；在LongMemEval-small（2,367个问题–系统对）与LoCoMo上评测，并做固定存储的上下文选择实验。

Result: LongMemEval-small上合并AUROC为0.640，低于问题难度基线0.655；单会话助手类问题上几何达0.841，但仅用系统身份即达0.826；控制难度与身份后几何无统计显著增益（Δ=+0.002，95%CI [-0.010, 0.014]）。固定存储实验中按邻近度排序选记忆优于随机子集；LoCoMo上最近轮相似度对单跳问题有微弱预测力，其他类别接近随机。

Conclusion: 结果刻画的是记忆表示与正确性之间的关联，而非可靠的部署诊断；嵌入邻近度无法验证事实覆盖，也无法区分记忆构建、检索与生成三类错误来源。

Abstract: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.

</details>


### [441] [SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26425)
*Piyawoot Songsiritat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SNO-PI 在 SNOMED CT 实体链接基准上取得 macro character IoU 0.5387，相对组织方参考系统提升 18%，其核心是用预训练迁移与人工整理知识应对超大标签空间下的零样本/少样本链接问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将临床提及链接到 SNOMED CT 本质上是超大标签空间下的零样本与少样本问题：272 篇标注的 MIMIC-IV 出院小结仅覆盖约 219,000 个可用概念中的 6,595 个，且其中三分之一只出现一次。这种极端的数据稀疏与长尾分布，促使作者采用基于预训练模型迁移和人工整理知识的设计思路。

Method: SNO-PI 采用三阶段流程：高召回跨度提议（span proposal）、SapBERT 候选检索，以及基于三个 BERT 家族编码器的 listwise 集成重排序。每个编码器先在不带标注的 MIMIC-IV 病历上做掩码语言建模预训练，再在 SNOMED CT 同义词与层级结构上继续预训练，最后进行任务微调。

Result: SNO-PI 取得 0.5387 的 macro character IoU，优于组织方参考系统（0.4582，基于 2024 年挑战赛冠军方案），相对提升 18%。实验还发现，人工整理的知识对训练中从未出现过的概念帮助最大，但这些未见概念仍是错误的主要来源。

Conclusion: 预训练迁移结合人工整理知识能有效缓解超大标签空间下的少样本困境，但零样本概念的泛化仍是最主要的性能瓶颈，是后续改进的关键方向。

Abstract: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.

</details>


### [442] [Expert L2 English Speech Evaluation on a Gaming PC: Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody with XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26406)
*Richard Rose*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: oollim 是一个可在消费级计算机本地运行的 L2 英语发音评估系统，可对准确性、流利度与韵律打分。系统将 XLS-R、XEUS、PhoneticXeus 预训练表征与参考文本特征结合，并在 SpeechOcean762、Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus（英语）、J-AESOP 及其组合上训练岭回归。在 305 条独立留出录音（由三名专家评分）上，多种岭回归配置在三个构念上的 Spearman 相关与二次加权 kappa 均大幅超过 2026 年 1 月存档的 Azure API 分数。结果支持：仅用预训练表征与构念专属回归，无需神经模型微调、也不在私有评估数据上做校准，即可在消费级硬件上实现专家级语音评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 L2 发音自动评估多依赖大型云端 API 或对神经模型进行微调与校准，成本高、隐私风险大，且难以在普通消费级硬件上本地部署；本文旨在验证无需微调即可本地运行的可行性。

Method: 采用 XLS-R、XEUS、PhoneticXeus 三种预训练表征，融合参考文本特征，并在 SpeechOcean762、Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus（英语）、J-AESOP 及其组合上训练构念专属的岭回归，分别预测准确性、流利度和韵律。评估使用 305 条独立留出录音，由三名专家评分作为参考，并与 2026 年 1 月存档的 Azure API 分数对比。

Result: 多种岭回归配置在全部三个构念上的 Spearman 相关系数与二次加权 kappa 均显著优于存档的 Azure API 分数，且未对神经模型做任何微调，也未在私有评估数据上校准。

Conclusion: 仅凭预训练表征加构念专属岭回归，就能在消费级硬件上实现与专家评分高度一致、并优于云端 API 的 L2 语音评估，为本地化、低成本、可复现的自动口语评估提供了可行路径。

Abstract: oollim is a locally executable system for evaluating L2 English pronunciation accuracy, fluency, and prosody on a consumer computer. The system combines pretrained XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus representations with reference-text features and ridge regressions trained on SpeechOcean762, the Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus (English), J-AESOP, and their combinations. On 305 independently held-out recordings assessed by three expert raters, several ridge configurations substantially outperform archived Azure API scores obtained in January 2026 in both Spearman correlation and quadratic weighted kappa across all three constructs. These results support expert speech evaluation on consumer hardware using pretrained representations and construct-specific regressions, without neural-model fine-tuning or calibration on the private evaluation data.

</details>


### [443] [ASTOR: Benchmarking and Improving Autoformulation for Soft-Constraint Optimization with a Formal Grammar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26819)
*Amer Goel,Yeganeh Alimohammadi,Andrew Daw*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ASTOR：将自然语言决策问题映射为语法引导的抽象语法树（AST），再确定性编译为可执行优化代码，并发布聚焦软约束的SoftOR基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实决策问题同时包含硬约束（必须满足）与软约束（可违反的偏好）。现有autoformulation研究多忽视软约束，尽管消费者、管理者、规划者等提出的偏好常需显式建模；LLM直接用自然语言生成优化模型也易出错。

Method: 推理时框架ASTOR：先用LLM把自然语言决策问题解析为受语法约束的抽象语法树表示，再由编译器确定性（deterministically）地将其转换为可执行优化代码，避免端到端直接生成代码的不稳定性。同时构建统一基准SoftOR，专门面向软约束形式化。

Result: 在SoftOR上，ASTOR在可比的单次请求与多智能体LLM方法中取得最高总体准确率；在仅含硬约束的标准autoformulation基准上也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 以语法引导的AST为中间表示、代码生成确定化的autoformulation路线，能有效支持软约束建模，并在软/硬约束场景下兼具准确性与鲁棒性；SoftOR为软约束autoformulation提供统一评测平台。

Abstract: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.

</details>


### [444] [Monsoon: Scalable Spontaneous Speech Collection for Low-Resource ASR in 50 Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26776)
*Shobhit Banga,Manas Dhir,Aaditya Pareek,Amritansh Walecha,Bhaskar Singh,Hanuman Sidh,Manmeet Kaur,Sagar Jain,Supriya Paul,Vanshika Chhabra,Utkarsh Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Monsoon 是一个大规模采集自发口语语音数据的框架，通过配对对话者引发非脚本对话、自动化分类器筛检、五级人工审核纠正转写、并按词汇与声学覆盖度挑选片段，已在50种语言采集语音并分析七个3,500小时语料，其质量流程在等量数据下使语义WER相对降低10-39%，微调模型在会话基准上语义WER降低20-44个点，且增益可迁移至第二架构并随数据量增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝大多数语言的ASR瓶颈不在模型架构，而在于缺乏转写准确的自发口语（spontaneous speech）数据，公开语料多为朗读式或转写质量不足，限制了会话场景性能。

Method: 提出Monsoon数据采集框架：让配对贡献者进行非脚本对话以引发自然口语；用自动化分类器（classifiers）对录音进行筛检；通过五级人工审核（five levels of human review）纠正转写；并按词汇覆盖度与声学覆盖度（lexical and acoustic coverage）选择数据片段。分析七个3,500小时规模语料，并与常规采集协议、架构匹配的公开语料基线模型对比。

Result: 等量数据下，质量管控各阶段使语义WER相对降低10-39%；在Monsoon上微调的Whisper在基线自身测试集上表现相当，而在会话（conversational）基准上语义WER降低20-44个点；增益可迁移到第二种架构，并随数据量增加而扩大。

Conclusion: 高质量、规模化的自发口语数据采集是提升ASR尤其是会话场景表现的关键，Monsoon的质量流程与数据选择策略带来显著且可迁移的收益；作者开源该框架、其质量控制模型及微调后的模型。

Abstract: For most languages, automatic speech recognition (ASR) is limited less by model architecture than by a lack of accurately transcribed spontaneous speech. We present Monsoon, a framework for collecting such data at scale. It elicits unscripted conversations between paired contributors, screens recordings with automated classifiers, corrects transcripts over five levels of human review, and selects segments for lexical and acoustic coverage. It has collected speech in 50 languages; we analyse seven 3,500-hour corpora. At equal volume, its quality stages reduce semantic word error rate (WER) by 10-39% relative to a conventional protocol. Compared with an architecture-matched baseline trained on public corpora, Whisper fine-tuned on Monsoon performs comparably on the baseline's own test sets and reduces semantic WER by 20-44 points on conversational benchmarks. The gains transfer to a second architecture and grow with data volume. We release the framework, its quality-control models, and the fine-tuned models.

</details>


### [445] [Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26830)
*Xingyu Shen,Yingfa Chen,Ziqing Qiao,Chaojun Xiao,Xu Han,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文揭示混合架构中循环层与注意力层的"竞争学习"现象：循环层更快学会检索功能并抑制注意力的相应学习信号；据此提出分阶段训练策略，在训练中途停止循环层权重更新，使注意力学会检索，在1B参数规模上显著提升语言建模、常识推理及检索类任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代混合架构同时使用线性时间循环与softmax注意力：循环层表达力强、吞吐高，但将上下文压缩为固定大小状态，在上下文检索上弱于注意力。作者希望解释并缓解循环层在检索能力上的不足，弄清两者在训练中如何分工与相互影响。

Method: 通过层归因分析（layer attribution）观察各层学到的功能，发现不同mixer竞争学习同一函数，任一层学会后即抑制其他层对应的学习信号；在典型数据分布下，循环层比softmax注意力更快学会检索函数，导致注意力多数情况下学不会检索。基于此提出针对自然语言预训练的分阶段训练流程：训练中途冻结循环层权重更新，让注意力习得检索能力。

Result: 在最大1B参数的模型上，该方法在语言建模损失、常识推理以及不同上下文长度下的一系列检索相关任务上均取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 混合架构中循环层与注意力的能力失衡源于竞争学习而非容量不足；通过分阶段训练（中途停止循环层更新）可引导注意力承担检索功能，从而更充分发挥混合架构的互补优势。

Abstract: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.

</details>


### [446] [TeleASR-Amharic: A Benchmark for Robust Amharic ASR in Realistic Telecommunication Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26448)
*Dagnachew Mekonnen Marilign,Enrique Molero,Abrham Haile,Louis Powell,Israel Abebe Azime*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TeleASR-Amharic基准，用于评测阿姆哈拉语ASR在真实电信信道条件下的鲁棒性，并验证领域感知数据增强的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低资源语言语音资源多采集于干净的录音棚环境，与真实电信录音存在显著声学失配，导致ASR模型实际可用性差；缺乏针对该类退化条件的可复现评测基准。

Method: 分析真实电信录音中的主要退化类型，构建覆盖多信道条件、环境干扰与电信域变化的阿姆哈拉语ASR基准；系统考察不同噪声与信道失真的影响，并研究训练数据规模扩展及电信感知数据增强的效果。

Result: 严重电信退化使最佳模型WER由0.23升至0.79，相对错误率增加243%；扩展训练数据并结合精心设计的电信感知增强可显著提升鲁棒性，最优配置在极端噪声下实现23.6%的相对WER降低。

Conclusion: 电信退化会严重削弱ASR性能，甚至使高性能模型在恶劣条件下不可用；所发布的电信域数据与基准为阿姆哈拉语ASR鲁棒性研究提供可复现评测手段，并揭示面向真实部署的开放挑战。

Abstract: The real-world usability of ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages, where existing speech resources are often collected in clean studio environments. In this work, we introduce TeleASR-Amharic, a benchmark for evaluating Amharic ASR under various acoustic and telecommunication conditions. We analyze the major degradations observed in real telecommunications recordings and develop a benchmark that covers multiple channel conditions, environmental disturbances, and telecom-domain variations. Our results show that telecommunication degradation can substantially reduce recognition performance, making even high-performing ASR models impractical under severe conditions. For example, the WER of the best-performing model increases from 0.23 to 0.79 under severe telecommunication degradation, corresponding to a relative increase of 243% in recognition errors. We further investigate the effects of different noise and channel distortions and show that scaling training data and applying carefully designed telecommunication-aware augmentation substantially improve robustness. In particular, our best training configuration achieves a 23.6% relative WER reduction under extreme noise conditions. Together with the release of our telecommunications-domain data, these findings provide a reproducible benchmark for measuring progress in Amharic ASR while highlighting open challenges in developing robust speech technologies for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [447] [Inside the Scorer: Mechanistic Evidence on Rubric Control in LLM-Based Automated Essay Scoring from 25 Base Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25724)
*Chungche Huang,Po-Ya Angela Wang,Shu-Kai Hsieh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过探针与因果引导实验检验25个开源基座LLM（0.13B–10.31B，14个家族）在BESTEP英语写作上的评分表征，发现整体分数可解码、各评分细则方向部分可分，但因果引导下细则方向缺乏选择性——存在一个主导杠杆，故评分细则在基座LLM中并非独立可控的评分维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险测试要求LLM自动作文评分既可控制又可验证，而现有LLM评分器不具备这一特性；因此作者追问：LLM评分器是否为各评分细则形成可独立控制的内部表征。

Method: 在人工评分的BESTEP英语写作任务上，对25个开源基座LLM（0.13B–10.31B参数，14个模型家族）进行线性探针（检验整体分数与各细则的可解码性）与激活引导/因果干预（比较匹配与不匹配细则干预的效果差异）。

Result: 整体分数在较长任务（Part 2、3）可从激活中解码，最短任务（Part 1）仅弱可解码；评分细则在长任务表征空间中部分可分，短回答不可分。因果引导显示匹配干预相对不匹配干预的优势仅约2%，在10个可测比较中均不可检出；即便在与人评分一致性最好的7个模型（r≥0.6）中亦如此。

Conclusion: 为人类评分者设计的分析性评分细则在基座LLM中并不表现为独立控制量，而共享一个主导杠杆、细则成分缺乏选择性，可能对应人类评分的晕轮结构；分数一致性与可解码性并不蕴含细则级可控性，该研究据此提出了一套评估方法论。

Abstract: Automated essay scoring (AES) using large language models (LLMs) offers promising use cases for language assessment, yet high-stakes testing requires scores that are both controllable and verifiable, which current LLM-based scorers lack. Given that, we investigate whether LLM-based scorers form distinct internal representations for individual scoring rubrics and whether these representations can be independently controlled. Probing and steering 25 open-weight base LLMs (0.13B-10.31B parameters; 14 families) on human-scored BESTEP English writing tasks, we find that holistic scores are decodable from model activations for the longer tasks (Parts 2 and 3) and only weakly for the shortest (Part 1). Furthermore, scoring rubrics have partly separable directions in representation space for the longer tasks, though not for short responses (Part 1). However, causal steering reveals a critical limitation: applying a matching intervention (e.g., steering "grammar" on a grammar-degraded response) yields only a negligible advantage (about 2% of the effect) over a mismatched intervention (e.g., steering "vocabulary"), and none that is detectable in any of the 10 testable comparisons across reliably measured rubrics. Rather than controlling distinct evaluative dimensions, the rubric directions share a dominant lever whose rubric-specific parts are not selective, which may mirror the halo structure of human ratings. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we show that analytic scoring rubrics designed for human raters do not behave as independent controls in base LLMs, even among the seven models whose scores agree best with human raters ($r \geq 0.6$). Second, we establish a methodology that shows that score agreement and decodability do not imply rubric-level control in LLM-based assessment.

</details>


### [448] [Rethinking BPE: Merge Selection as Model Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26225)
*Vijini Liyanage,François Yvon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将BPE合并预算的选择建模为统计模型选择问题，用信息论准则从语料统计中直接计算最优合并集，并用合成文本增强训练语料，从而在几乎不损失性能的前提下减小词表规模，低资源场景收益更明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有子词分词（如BPE）的词表容量通常由启发式设定的固定合并预算决定；而更大词表会增加内存与计算开销，因此需要以有原则的方式选择紧凑且有效的词表。

Method: 把BPE合并预算优化视为统计模型选择问题，研究基于信息论准则、直接从语料统计计算最优合并集的方法；并在数据有限时用由原始数据生成的合成文本扩充训练语料，以估计unigram与bigram分布。

Result: 在多个语料与下游任务上的实验表明，采用有原则的词表选择方法可减小模型规模，性能几乎不下降；合成数据能带来更好的分词器，尤其在低资源设置下。

Conclusion: 词表规模可通过信息论驱动的模型选择原则性确定，替代启发式合并预算；数据增强（合成文本）是改善低资源分词器训练的有效手段。

Abstract: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) are a core component of modern language models; yet, tokenizer capacity remains typically determined by a fixed merge budget, chosen heuristically. Since larger vocabularies increase memory usage and computational cost, selecting compact and effective token inventories is essential for efficient language modeling. We study the optimization of a BPE merge budget as a statistical model selection problem and investigate information-theoretic criteria for \emph{computing optimal merge sets} directly from corpus statistics. To further improve the merge selection in limited data conditions, we augment the BPE training corpora with synthetic texts generated from the original data, providing estimates for the unigram and bigram distributions. Experiments across multiple corpora and downstream tasks show that using a principled vocabulary selection technique reduces model size, with little degradation in performance. We further observe that synthetic data can yield better tokenizers, especially in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [449] [TempoMoE: Identifying and Steering Fast-Slow Thinking Experts for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25999)
*Xiyue Zhang,Keru Zhou,Ziyi Wang,Bing Hu,Li Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TempoMoE：一种免训练的两阶段框架，通过"节奏对比路由分析"识别快/慢思考专家，并按样本难度在原始top-k集合内重分配路由权重，实现推理深度的难度自适应控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态MoE推理模型依赖长CoT处理复杂任务，但对简单输入常"过度思考"，导致token成本与延迟上升，甚至准确率下降。现有方法要么在训练中优化长度，要么在推理时施加外部控制，均将底层推理机制视为黑箱，缺乏对专家路由与推理深度关系的机制性理解。

Method: 先做机制发现：固定输入、仅改变提示的推理节奏，观察到稳定的路由偏移——抑制慢思考专家使推理链变短，抑制快思考专家使推理链变长，从而给出专家影响推理深度的因果证据。基于此提出TempoMoE：(1) 通过tempo-contrastive路由分析识别快思考与慢思考专家；(2) 在原始top-k专家集合内按样本难度重分配路由权重——简单输入放大快思考专家、抑制慢思考专家，困难输入反向调整。全程免训练。

Result: 在Kimi-VL、Qwen3-VL、ERNIE-4.5-VL三个多模态模型、六个基准上评测。相比Vanilla，准确率持续提升的同时输出token减少，准确率最高提升2.6个点，token最多减少35.4%。

Conclusion: 快/慢思考在MoE中具有可辨识且具因果性的专家路由模式，可作为推理深度的可控接口；无需训练、仅调整top-k内路由权重即可在保持或提升准确率的同时显著降低推理开销，为难度自适应推理深度控制提供了轻量、可解释的方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) for complex tasks, yet often overthink easy inputs, increasing token cost and latency, and sometimes degrading accuracy. Existing methods optimize reasoning length during training or impose external control at inference, but leave the underlying reasoning mechanism a black box. We find that fast and slow thinking exhibit distinct expert-routing patterns: holding the input fixed and varying only the prompted reasoning tempo produces stable routing shifts. Suppressing slow-thinking experts shortens the reasoning chain, whereas suppressing fast-thinking experts lengthens it, providing causal evidence that these experts influence reasoning depth. Based on this finding, we propose TempoMoE, a training-free, two-stage framework. It identifies fast- and slow-thinking experts via tempo-contrastive routing analysis and redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty. It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones, enabling difficulty-adaptive control over reasoning depth. We evaluate TempoMoE on Kimi-VL, Qwen3-VL, and ERNIE-4.5-VL across six benchmarks. Compared with Vanilla, TempoMoE consistently improves accuracy while reducing output tokens, with accuracy gains of up to 2.6 points and token reductions of up to 35.4%.

</details>


### [450] [Mitigating Reward Hacking in Preference Reward Models with Evolving Penalties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26496)
*Afonso Baldo,António Farinhas,Marcos Treviso,Ricardo Rei,Nuno M. Guerreiro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Dynalize 方法，在策略训练过程中在线缓解开放式任务中偏好奖励模型的 reward hacking：异步地用语言模型分析 rollout 并撰写针对不良行为的惩罚项，再由判官模型对每条 rollout 施加惩罚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏好奖励模型在开放式任务（质量无法验证、也无法完全写成规则）中仍有价值，但易发生 reward hacking——策略提高奖励分数却未提升甚至损害回复质量。可验证奖励虽能支撑更长优化，却不适用于此类任务，因此需要一种在训练中在线抑制 reward hacking 的手段。

Method: Dynalize：周期性地、异步地让一个语言模型分析训练 rollout，识别奖励模型似乎在奖励的不良行为并写出相应惩罚规则；由判官模型（judge）将这些惩罚施加到每条 rollout 的奖励上，用于策略训练。

Result: 在临床咨询与创意写作任务中，仅用奖励模型训练时其分数持续上升，但外部基准性能最终下降；Dynalize 能维持更长训练并提升下游表现。方法可抑制偏好模型所激励的模式——这些模式在无惩罚时会扩散到大多数回复，甚至渗入奖励模型未显式评分的推理过程。增益在多轮训练中成立，且在针对已发现行为重新训练奖励模型后依然保持。

Conclusion: 在线、由语言模型动态生成惩罚规则可有效缓解开放式任务中的 reward hacking，延长有效训练时长并改善真实下游质量，且效果对多轮训练和奖励模型重训具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for language models has moved from preference reward models to verifiable rewards, which sustain much longer optimization. Preference models are prone to reward hacking: the policy raises their score without improving response quality, or even while degrading it. Yet for open-ended tasks, where quality can neither be verified nor fully written down as rubrics, they remain valuable. We introduce Dynalize, which mitigates reward hacking online, during policy training. Periodically and asynchronously, a language model analyzes training rollouts and writes penalties for undesirable behaviors that the reward model appears to reward; a judge applies them to every rollout. In clinical counseling and creative writing, training on the reward model alone raises its score continuously but ultimately leads to a decline in external benchmarks. Dynalize sustains longer training and results in improved downstream performance. For example, we find that our method suppresses patterns incentivized by preference models that, without penalties, spread to most responses, and even to the model's reasoning, which the reward model does not explicitly score. Furthermore, we show that its gains hold in multi-turn training, and even after we retrain the reward model on the discovered behaviors.

</details>


### [451] [AfriGuard: Safety and Robust Refusal For African Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26474)
*Israel Abebe Azime,Jesujoba O. Alabi,Iffat Maab,Alexander D. Cai,Tadesse Destaw Belay,Atnafu Lambebo Tonja,Jonas Kgomo,Folasade Alabi,Salomey Osei,Saminu Muhammad Aliyu,Nkechinyere Faith Aguobi,Bontu Fufa Balcha,Blessing Sibanda,Davis David,Mouhamadane Mboup,Daud Abolade,Neo Putini,Louis Powell,Kiant'e Brantley,Philipp Slusallek,Dietrich Klakow,Julia Kreutzer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 AfriGuard——覆盖10种非洲语言与英语的、具文化语境的多语言安全数据集，系统评估模型在有害意图识别、安全类别理解与拒答行为上的表现，并基于该数据训练高效护栏模型与拒答检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM虽经安全对齐训练，但在语言与文化多样的语境下，有害内容的表达与解读方式不同，安全风险的检测、性质理解与恰当回应三个环节均更复杂；而相关评测数据稀缺，导致跨语言文化安全性研究不足。

Method: 构建 AfriGuard：覆盖10种非洲语言加英语的文化扎根多语言数据集，标注有害意图、安全类别与拒答行为；据此对开源与闭源LLM及护栏模型进行系统评测，并利用该数据训练高效护栏模型、拒答检测器，同时验证监督微调对整体安全性能的作用。

Result: 护栏模型在安全意图与安全类别分类上不及开源与闭源LLM；模型对恰当安全行为的理解有限，F1低于60%；模型对不安全提示的"恰当回应失败"多源于语言上不充分的回答（偶然的非协助），而非显式拒答。所训练的护栏模型性能可媲美大至30倍的模型，拒答检测器较现有方法平均提升43.9%，监督微调可显著提升整体安全性能。

Conclusion: 跨语言文化安全评估需兼顾检测、理解与回应三个环节；AfriGuard 可作为资源基础，支撑轻量高效护栏、更可靠的拒答检测以及微调驱动的安全性能提升。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) designed to interact with users are typically trained to respond appropriately to harmful or toxic content. However, ensuring appropriate responses becomes more challenging in diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, where safety risks may be expressed or interpreted differently. Building safe AI systems therefore requires detecting safety risks, understanding their nature, and responding appropriately, while accounting for linguistic and cultural variations that add complexity to each stage. In this work, we introduce AfriGuard, a culturally grounded multilingual dataset for studying harmful intent, safety-category understanding, and refusal behavior across 10 African languages and English. Our findings reveal that guardrail models underperform both open- and closed-source LLMs on safety-intent and safety-category classification, while models show limited understanding of appropriate safety behavior, scoring below 60% F1. We further find that models often fail to respond appropriately to unsafe prompts not because they explicitly refuse, but because they produce linguistically inadequate responses that result in incidental non-assistance rather than proper refusals. Finally, using AfriGuard, we develop efficient guardrail models that achieve performance competitive with models up to 30x larger, introduce refusal detectors that improve average performance by 43.9% over existing detectors, and demonstrate that supervised fine-tuning can substantially improve overall safety performance.

</details>


### [452] [Self-Consistency of Entity Sets and Citations in a Deep Research System under Repeated Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26421)
*Lauri Pykälä,Kimmo K. Kaski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 重复相同提示下，某商用深度研究系统报告的实体Jaccard中位数仅0.12、引用Jaccard低于0.02，发现曲线不饱和；自一致性应视为实体空间函数而非系统稳定属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 封闭世界QA基准难以刻画深度研究智能体（DRA）在开放式综合任务上的表现，而自一致性是DRA可靠性的关键但缺乏量化手段。

Method: 对一个商用深度研究系统以单一开放式网络安全提示重复触发10次；将每份报告表示为按自定义schema分类的命名实体集合及引用集合，用两两Jaccard重叠度与发现曲线量化检索与综合输出的结构稳定性，并按实体类别分解一致性。

Result: 10次运行中实体两两Jaccard中位数0.12，引用两两Jaccard低于0.02，发现曲线未见明显饱和；实体集合的一致/分歧幅度与结构随实体类别显著变化。

Conclusion: DRA的自一致性更应理解为底层实体空间的函数，而非系统的稳定属性；类别敏感的一致性分析可作为开放式智能体评估的补充维度。

Abstract: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.

</details>


### [453] [Learning to Reason Efficiently with Interventional Step Credit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25876)
*Guanda Li,Xuefeng Bai,Yulong Chen,Zhiyong Wang,Kehai Chen,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出干预式步骤信用（ISC），通过参数级因果干预度量推理步骤对答案的真实贡献，并据此构建IGPO强化学习算法做细粒度优势重标定，在削减冗余推理步骤的同时保持关键步骤，实现最高62%的平均token缩减且整体性能更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大推理模型的思维链冗长，混杂有用与无用步骤。已有基于注意力质量、步骤熵等步骤级信号的方法虽有效，但这些信号刻画的是模型在该步骤的"行为表现"，而非该步骤对最终答案的"贡献"，因而存在度量偏差。

Method: 1）ISC：采用因果干预视角，对推理步骤进行针对性的参数级干预，评估单步对推理结果的重要性，从而获得因果意义上的步骤信用；2）IGPO：以ISC为信号，在强化学习中对优势函数进行细粒度重标定（advantage rescaling），抑制冗余步骤、保留关键步骤。

Result: 在2种模型规模、9个基准上实验：相比对比方法，IGPO实现最高62%的平均token缩减，同时整体性能更优。

Conclusion: 步骤重要性度量应从"行为信号"转向"因果贡献"；基于参数级干预的ISC可作为有效的细粒度信用分配信号，驱动RL训练在效率与准确性之间取得更好平衡。

Abstract: Large reasoning models often produce lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) traces mixing useful intermediate steps with unnecessary ones. Recent methods explore step-level signals such as attention mass and step entropy to identify and suppress unnecessary steps. Despite their effectiveness, such signals reflect the model's behavior at a step rather than that step's contribution to the answer. To address this, we propose the interventional step credit (ISC), which takes a causal-intervention view and assesses step importance to the reasoning through targeted parameter-level interventions. Building on ISC, we further propose IGPO, which uses ISC to guide fine-grained advantage rescaling in reinforcement learning, reducing redundant steps while preserving the important ones. Experiments across two model scales and nine benchmarks show that IGPO achieves up to 62% average token reduction and better overall performance among compared methods.

</details>


### [454] [Where RL Breaks: Localizing and Repairing Failures via Targeted Continued Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25836)
*Xinyi Wang,Danqi Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出用RL失败定位出的特征n-gram检索预训练语料并续训基座模型，仅35M token的语料即可在11个设置中的10个上超越同量随机语料的续训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR普遍只能"锐化"基座模型已有能力，当RL失败时，作者追问基座模型究竟缺失了什么，并希望找到一个廉价而有效的信号来指导预训练数据选择。

Method: 分析RL策略自身rollout，发现失败具有局部性——是否失败可由少量特征n-gram（如"let's recheck"、"the inverse of A"）强预测，且这些失败贯穿RL训练，但同一问题的其他采样答案常是正确的。据此用失败n-gram从预训练语料中检索文本，构造仅35M token的小语料，在RL之前对基座模型续训。在OLMo2与Qwen3上分别针对GSM8K、数学+常识+知识混合题、通用数学与科学推理三类任务评测。

Result: 在11个设置中的10个上优于用等量随机预训练文本续训；插入mid-training之前时GSM8K提升2.0分。检索文本可跨模型族迁移：为OLMo2-1B失败检索的文本使Qwen3-4B在混合任务上比同基线提升1.9分。

Conclusion: RL失败的位置是一种廉价且有效的预训练数据选择信号，说明RL的瓶颈部分源于基座模型的能力缺口，可通过针对性的小规模数据注入弥补。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in language models, yet growing evidence suggests that it mostly sharpens what the base model can already do. This raises a practical question: when RL fails, what is the base model missing? We look inside the RL policy's own rollouts and find that failures are localized: whether a rollout fails is strongly predicted by a small set of characteristic n-grams, ranging from reflection phrases such as "let's recheck" to specific operations such as "the inverse of A". These failures persist throughout RL training, although they are not beyond the model's reach: other sampled answers to the same question are often correct. Building on this observation, we use the failure $n$-grams to retrieve text from the pretraining corpus and continue pretraining the base model on it before RL. The resulting corpus has only 35M tokens, 3--4 orders of magnitude smaller than typical mid-training. We evaluate this approach on OLMo2 and Qwen3 models trained with RL on (1) GSM8K; (2) a mixture of math, commonsense, and knowledge questions; and (3) general math and science reasoning. Despite its size, the corpus yields consistent gains: our approach outperforms continued pretraining on the same amount of text sampled from the pretraining corpus across 10 out of 11 settings, including by $2.0$ points on GSM8K when inserted before mid-training. The retrieved text also transfers across model families: text retrieved for OLMo2-1B's failures improves Qwen3-4B on the mixture by $1.9$ points over the same baseline. Together, our results suggest that where RL fails is a cheap and effective signal for selecting pretraining data.

</details>


### [455] [Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25835)
*Mohsen Fayyaz,Ali Modarressi,Daniel Israel,Lucas Bandarkar,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文分析扩散语言模型每token前向传播次数的成本差异，发现成本主要取决于任务类型与输出的“新颖性/稀有性”，且解码成本可作为正确性的信号用于高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型可在一次前向中生成多个token，并能自适应决定生成所需的前向次数，因此相同长度输出的计算成本差异很大。作者希望理解这种成本差异背后的驱动因素，并探索其在实际推理中的利用价值。

Method: 对两种扩散模型在10个任务上进行实证分析，统计每token前向次数，考察任务类型（复制/轻编辑 vs. 开放式写作）、输出属性（相对输入的新增程度、词稀有度）、思维链场景（答案相对推理轨迹的新颖性）、多语言（分词效率）以及正确性对成本的影响；并提出按解码速度加权候选答案的选择策略。

Result: 每token前向次数高度依赖任务：DiffusionGemma中故事写作的每token前向次数是语法纠错的3倍以上。输出“新增内容比例”和“词稀有度”解释了大部分差距；思维链中重复推理轨迹的答案便宜、新增内容昂贵；分词粒度高的语言每token还需更多前向；同一数学题错误答案比正确答案消耗更多前向次数。按解码速度加权候选答案比多数投票最高提升4.2个百分点且无额外成本。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的计算优势取决于输出中“已被确定”的比例：复制或高约束生成成本低，开放式生成成本高；同时解码努力可作为可靠性信号，用于提升推理效率与准确性。

Abstract: Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend. Two outputs of the same token length can therefore vary a lot in cost. To understand the underlying factors of this cost variation, we analyze two diffusion models across 10 tasks. We find that the number of forward passes per token depends heavily on the task. Text copied or lightly edited from the input is cheap, while open-ended writing is costly. In DiffusionGemma, generating a token for story writing requires more than three times as many forward passes as for grammar correction. Two output properties explain much of this gap: how much of it is new relative to the input, and how rare its words are within the task. The same holds within a single response when thinking is involved. The final answer is cheap when it repeats the model's reasoning trace and costly when it adds something new. In multilingual generation, we find that highly tokenized languages also require more passes per token, adding to the cost they already pay with more tokens. Finally, cost tracks correctness: on the same math problem, wrong answers take more passes per token than correct ones, and weighting candidate answers by decoding speed beats majority voting by up to 4.2 points at no extra cost. Taken together, our results show that diffusion's computational advantage depends on how much of the output is already determined, while its decoding effort offers a practical signal for making inference more efficient and reliable.

</details>


### [456] [KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26827)
*Ziqing Man,Di Wu,Jia-Chen Gu,Junyi Zhang,Kai-Wei Chang,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 KEEP-Bench，用于诊断上下文压缩的忠实性问题，并引入 Evidence Preservation Return (EPR) 指标关联证据召回与推理 FLOPs，揭示现有模型在压缩中证据保留能力严重不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文压缩虽提升长上下文效率，但信息瓶颈会带来忠实性损失；现有评测依赖 QA 指标，读者可能从不忠实的压缩中答对问题，从而低估了信息损失，因此需要直接评估压缩忠实性的诊断式基准。

Method: 构建 KEEP-Bench 诊断基准，含 4,102 个案例，覆盖三类挑战性场景：需保留证据以支持合理解读、显式限定语、少数派视角；直接评估压缩是否保留必需证据。同时提出 Evidence Preservation Return (EPR) 指标，将证据召回与推理 FLOPs 关联，并考察模型规模、输出预算与证据结构的影响。

Result: 即使采用定制提示，最强开源模型（31B）仅在 66.8% 案例中完整保留必需证据，最强闭源模型仅 61.6%，而输入平均仅 3.1K tokens、上下文窗口超 100K；性能随证据结构显著波动；EPR 在中等规模（4B–8B）达峰但召回仍低；增加输出预算主要惠及已较强模型并拉大能力差距，而更强保留以高昂算力为代价。

Conclusion: 未来工作应聚焦于在小算力预算下具备强信息保留能力的压缩器，而非依赖大输出预算或模型规模扩展。

Abstract: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.

</details>


### [457] [RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26826)
*Yuchi Wang,Rongyao Fang,Weihao Yu,Xilin Wei,Tiancheng Gu,Dingkang Yang,Hang Zhang,Dayiheng Liu,Hongsheng Li,Shuai Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 RefCraft 基准，包含 300 个真实多模态网页开发任务，将自然语言指令与 1–5 张参考网页截图结合，要求智能体在参考选择、渲染、视觉检查与迭代优化中完成开放式生成，并用可独立验证的关键点与程序化/VLM 评判进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准过于理想化：多聚焦于重建视觉目标或仅凭文本指令生成网页，忽视了实际工作流中更常见的"基于视觉参考示例开发"场景；而将视觉参考融入智能体生成对真实生产力任务至关重要。

Method: 构建 RefCraft 基准（300 个现实多模态网页开发任务），每个任务由自然语言指令与 1–5 张参考网页截图构成；智能体需选择性解读并利用参考，进行渲染、视觉检查与迭代改进；采用可独立验证的关键点（keypoints）以及互补的程序化评判与 VLM 评判来评估开放式产物。

Result: 在九个前沿 (M)LLM 上评测，最强系统总分仅 52.12/100，表明视觉参考条件下的智能体生成在实际网页开发场景中仍是显著挑战。

Conclusion: 视觉参考驱动的智能体生成能力显著不足，RefCraft 为这一被忽视但关键的能力提供了贴近现实的评测平台，揭示了当前前沿模型与真实生产力应用之间的差距。

Abstract: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

</details>


### [458] [Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26809)
*Zhengyue Zhao,Liwei Jiang,Yejin Choi,Chaowei Xiao1*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"安全中间训练"(safety mid-training)阶段,通过与通用任务共享的推理结构联合发展安全性与通用推理能力,在保持并提升通用能力的同时大幅降低攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐主要在后训练阶段进行,近年虽尝试在前训练引入安全数据,但存在两个问题:(1)后续训练若不含安全数据,安全性会退化;(2)安全提升常以通用能力为代价。这种张力表明安全性不应与通用推理割裂为独立的训练目标。

Method: 将安全性视为可通过与通用任务共享的推理结构习得的LLM能力(二者均需理解意图/任务目标、应用相关知识、推理潜在后果)。在前训练与后训练之间引入安全中间训练阶段:给定安全与效用提示,由基座模型生成结构化文档与推理轨迹,用于中间训练,从而联合发展安全性与通用推理。

Result: 相对Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B基座模型,安全中间训练将平均攻击成功率(ASR)降低72%~81%,同时提升通用能力;收益可贯穿后续后训练存续。仅通用SFT后,中间训练模型基本保持安全性,ASR低于基线且不牺牲通用能力;在无安全奖励的纯通用GRPO下仍保持安全性;以其为初始化时,后续RL达到更优的安全-效用前沿。

Conclusion: 在共享的中间训练阶段同时学习安全性与通用推理,可缓解安全-效用权衡,并使安全性对后续训练更具鲁棒性。

Abstract: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.

</details>


### [459] [RESIN: Multi-Chain Reasoning with Entity-Structured Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26782)
*Xuanyu Meng,Jash Rajesh Parekh,Jiawei Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RESIN（Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing），用结构化索引定位证据、以原始来源作为推理基础，通过逐跳分解与紧凑推理缓冲区保留备选支撑，实现精确且可审计的多链推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多链推理的难点在于多链证据分散，且不同推理环节需要不同且相互作用的支撑链。扁平检索会把大量弱相关文本灌入模型，而过早锁定单一推理路径又会丢弃只有在其他事实被考虑后才显现价值的证据。

Method: RESIN 利用结构定位证据，同时保留原始来源作为推理依据；将问题分解为一组聚焦的单跳需求，为每一跳检索少量有来源依据的单元，仅将相关证据放入紧凑的推理缓冲区；缓冲区保留备选支撑直至最终组合，使中间决策显式化而不强制走脆弱路径。消融实验考察类型化证据多样性与逐跳分解的作用。

Result: 在完整 HolisQA 基准上，RESIN 达到 82.92 的上下文召回率（context recall）与 76.70 的答案相关性（answer relevancy）；在五个领域均报告更高的 CR 与 AR，并在四个领域取得高于公开基线的 F1。消融表明类型化证据多样性与逐跳分解均不可或缺。

Conclusion: 精确的证据组织与延迟承诺（delayed commitment）使多链推理既有效又可审计。代码开源：https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN。

Abstract: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.

</details>


### [460] [TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26754)
*Liana Patel,Rishabh Ranjan,Ion Stoica,Matei Zaharia,Carlos Guestrin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TokenGate，一个轻量即插即用组件，使已训练的长上下文模型可端到端学习token剪枝，实现快速、省内存的prefill。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类阅读长输入时会快速略读、只精读关键部分，而现有语言模型对每个token都需经过所有层计算，长上下文输入的处理成本显著。现有token剪枝方法难以端到端训练（top-K不可微）。

Method: TokenGate：小型可插拔组件，扩展已训练模型实现长上下文输入的端到端可学习token剪枝。为绕开top-K不可微问题，提出token-gated attention，借鉴Mixture-of-Experts思想，用token重要性分数对attention logits重新加权，从而端到端学习。

Result: 在多种任务上，prefill阶段TTFT提速1.4–11.3倍、峰值内存降低1.5–3.4倍且无精度损失；相比最优的前人token剪枝方法，prefill提速至多6.4倍、峰值内存降低2倍。

Conclusion: TokenGate可原生扩展标准Transformer（如Qwen3）与混合注意力模型（如Qwen3.5），仅需类似标准参数高效微调的轻量适配；代码已开源。

Abstract: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.

</details>


### [461] [Shaping the Document, Not the Model: Optimized Suffixes for Context Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26236)
*Gia-Bao Dinh Ho,Sekh Mainul Islam,Masahiro Kaneko,Timothy Baldwin,Isabelle Augenstein*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过在文档末尾离散优化一个"后缀"（无需指令、无法访问模型），可让指令微调模型在反事实文档上压倒参数知识、依从文档作答，效果优于解码干预与最强指令、接近激活引导，且单个后缀可跨文档迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有让模型"依靠上下文、压制参数知识"的方法都需要在推理时访问模型（激活引导、logit对比解码）或插入显式指令。作者要检验一个更强的问题：仅文档本身、不含任何指令文字、且推理时完全不接触模型，是否足以实现该效果。

Method: 以离散token搜索优化文档后缀，起点为单个问题的答案，并逐步将目标扩展到：多篇段落集合、由植入事实衍生的多跳问题、以及对话的后续轮次。在三个指令微调模型族中与解码基线、最强手写指令、激活引导对比，并设置对照实验区分"经文档生效"与"直接注入答案"。

Result: 在反事实段落下几乎翻转模型原本抵抗的全部条目；多数设置下优于解码基线与最强指令，与激活引导相当。对照表明后缀主要通过文档而非注入答案起作用；每个模型单一后缀可迁移到未见段落；各扩展目标均能将效应传导至对应目标。

Conclusion: 文档本身即可作为"提示"载体，无需推理时模型访问或显式指令即可实现上下文依从；且效应的作用范围由优化目标决定，而不仅由文档决定。

Abstract: When a user supplies a document and wants the answer drawn from it, a language model is expected to follow it even when it contradicts its parametric knowledge. Prior work has focused on making the model rely on context by steering activations, contrasting logits during decoding, or instructing it in plain language. We ask whether the document alone, with no instruction written into it and no access to the model at inference time, is enough. We optimize a document suffix by discrete token search, starting from the answer to a single question and extending the objective to a set of passages, to multi-hop questions that follow from the planted fact, and to later turns of a conversation. On counterfactual passages that contradict parametric knowledge of the model, the suffix flips nearly all items the model resists across three instruction-tuned model families, in most settings outperforms the decoding baseline and the strongest instruction we could write, and matches activation steering. Controls show that the suffix largely acts through the passage rather than injecting the answer, and a single suffix per model transfers to unseen passages. Each extended objective carries the effect to its target, so the objective, not only the document, sets how far the effect reaches.

</details>


### [462] [MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26825)
*Zhiyu Li,Zeyu Zhang,Linyun Liu,Yiwei Bu,Chenyang Xi,Xichong Zhang,Yi Yu,Yu Yu,Zhichen Liu,Yuxiao Yi,Chunyu Li,Haoran Liu,Zhenkai Ding,Le Zhou,Juncheng Zhang,Boyu Chen,Zehao Lin,Guorui Li,Renyu Fu,Ji Li,Youyang Xia,Jiajun Shen,Harvey Li,Jingsong Zhou,Helan Hu,Tong Shen,Tianxiao Xu,Chenye Han,Weijie Li,Zhongquan Zhou,Hongming Xu,Yuekeng Li,Erenkai Zhu,Peng Yu,Wenhao Li,Jingyi Kang,Xixuan Hao,Xuzhou Zhu,Can Chen,Jiawei Liu,Chen Jiang,Tao Jiang,Fangwei Xiang,Zepeng Yao,Kai Chen,Guang Yang,Mingfei Lu,Chunhui Li,Zhengxuan Jiang,Bo Tang,Shiyu Zhan,Yihang Sun,Jie Chu,Wenjun Xiong,Zhenxiang Hua,Chen Lin,Detong Su,Dongyu Deng,Qiuping Ding,Guofeng Ding,Si Chen,Guohua Wen,Xu Chen,Zhi-Qin John Xu,Ying-Cong Chen,Ningyu Zhang,Haofen Wang,Muning Wen,Haotian Chen,Wentao Zhang,Xuanhe Zhou,Rita Zhang,Junchi Yan,Feiyu Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MemT-1.0 提出将记忆内化为模型计算一部分的“记忆原生”基础模型架构，基于 Gated DeltaNet-2 与 Mixture-of-Storage 扩展原生记忆容量，经两阶段训练（继续预训练+后训练）得到 Nano 与 Flash 两个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为记忆原生演化要求记忆成为基础模型的内在能力，使模型能持续累积并利用信息；因此需要把记忆从外部检索或参数化知识中剥离，内化为模型计算本身的一部分。

Method: 在 Metis 基础上采用 Gated DeltaNet-2，并设计稳定的 token 级记忆更新机制（每轮内）；引入 Mixture-of-Storage 扩展原生记忆容量；进行刻意的骨干准备，构建由继续预训练与后训练组成的两阶段训练流水线，使用 34B tokens 训练数据及高效训练/推理基础设施。

Result: 发布 MemT-1.0-Nano 与 MemT-1.0-Flash 模型家族；在记忆与通用能力综合评测中，平均优于参数化记忆基线，与检索增强方法相当，且基本保持通用能力；在 128K 历史长度下，Nano 实现约 1.86× 端到端推理加速和相对全上下文 KV cache 66× 的持久存储降低；通过内化检索到的程序性经验，提升智能体任务成功率。

Conclusion: MemT-1.0 表明将记忆内化为模型计算可同时获得效率与能力收益，是迈向记忆原生演化的实用一步。

Abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.

</details>


### [463] [Transformer-based segmentation of prosodic boundaries in Brazilian Portuguese](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07408)
*Rodrigo de Freitas Lima,Julio Cesar Galdino,Marcos Vinicius Treviso*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAMPA，一个基于 Whisper 的巴西葡萄牙语（BP）韵律边界自动分段器，通过在转写文本中插入显式终止性韵律边界标记实现边界检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英语的自动韵律分段已受益于深度学习方法，而巴西葡萄牙语仍主要依赖规则或传统机器学习方法，缺乏端到端的深度学习方案。

Method: 在 NURC-SP 人工分段语料上微调 Whisper large-v3，使模型在转写 BP 语音的同时输出终止性韵律边界标记；系统比较不同训练与测试时过滤配置，并在 MuPe-Diversidades 数据集上进行分布外测试；辅以 n-gram 与声学-视觉分析考察模型依赖的线索。

Result: 边界检测性能具竞争力：留出测试集 F1=0.731，MuPe-Diversidades 分布外测试 F1=0.796；分析表明模型综合利用形态句法、语义与韵律线索进行边界判定。

Conclusion: Whisper 微调可有效用于 BP 韵律边界分段，且具备跨数据集的泛化能力；模型行为与语言学边界线索一致，为 BP 自动分段提供了深度学习基线。

Abstract: Automatic prosodic segmentation identifies boundaries between speech units from acoustic and linguistic evidence. Although recent deep learning approaches have produced strong results for English, automatic segmentation for Brazilian Portuguese (BP) still relies mostly on rule-based or traditional machine-learning methods. This paper presents SAMPA, a Whisper-based segmenter that transcribes BP speech while inserting explicit markers for terminal prosodic boundaries. We fine-tune Whisper large-v3 on manually segmented recordings from the NURC-SP dataset and evaluate different training and test-time filtering configurations, including out-of-distribution testing on the MuPe-Diversidades dataset. SAMPA achieves competitive boundary-detection performance across settings, with the best models reaching F1=0.731 on the held-out test split and F1=0.796 on MuPe-Diversidades. Finally, through n-gram and acoustic-visual analyses, we show that our model follows morphosyntactic, semantic, and prosodic cues for detecting prosodic boundaries.

</details>


### [464] [Transfer Learning for Power Outage Detection Task with Limited Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.17817)
*Olukunle Owolabi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨在标注数据有限的情况下，利用预训练语言模型与迁移学习（零样本/少样本）进行停电检测，发现少样本微调显著提升性能（10%微调下BERT达81.3%，GPT达74.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 停电的早期检测对维持配电系统可靠性至关重要，但实际场景中标注数据稀缺，传统监督模型难以泛化到未见类别，因此需要评估语言模型在少标注条件下的检测潜力。

Method: 构建了一个经过整理的、类别平衡的、与停电相关的社交媒体推文数据集；采用零样本与少样本学习范式，对预训练语言模型（BERT、GPT）进行实验，并与经典基线模型进行对比；通过不同比例（如10%）的少样本微调评估性能变化。

Result: 经典模型在整体性能上优于零样本语言模型；但少样本微调显著提升语言模型表现——10%微调后BERT准确率达81.3%（+15.3%），GPT达74.5%（+8.5%）；同时揭示了这些模型的优势与局限。

Conclusion: 少样本微调的语言模型在数据有限条件下对停电检测具有实用潜力，可用于停电分析与定位；研究为将先进自然语言处理技术应用于关键基础设施管理提供了知识积累与实践启示。

Abstract: Early detection of power outages is crucial for maintaining a reliable power distribution system. This research investigates the use of transfer learning and language models in detecting outages with limited labeled data. By leveraging pretraining and transfer learning, models can generalize to unseen classes.
  Using a curated balanced dataset of social media tweets related to power outages, we conducted experiments using zero-shot and few-shot learning. Our hypothesis is that Language Models pretrained with limited data could achieve high performance in outage detection tasks over baseline models. Results show that while classical models outperform zero-shot Language Models, few-shot fine-tuning significantly improves their performance. For example, with 10% fine-tuning, BERT achieves 81.3% accuracy (+15.3%), and GPT achieves 74.5% accuracy (+8.5%). This has practical implications for analyzing and localizing outages in scenarios with limited data availability.
  Our evaluation provides insights into the potential of few-shot fine-tuning with Language Models for power outage detection, highlighting their strengths and limitations. This research contributes to the knowledge base of leveraging advanced natural language processing techniques for managing critical infrastructure.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [465] [A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24133)
*Shuyang Xiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文研究自回归Transformer在生成$t$个token后对prompt的记忆量，发现隐藏状态对prompt的依赖以约$t^{-\alpha}$幂律衰减（训练模型$\alpha\approx0.55$–$0.7$，未训练$\alpha\approx0.2$–$0.5$），并证明该偏移为$O(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t)$，提出"条件无毛定理"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望量化自回归Transformer在生成过程中对原始prompt的保留程度，理解"遗忘"的机制与速率，并厘清prompt影响如何随上下文增长被稀释、以及哪些性质必须由生成文本本身承载。

Method: 构造两个不同prompt接相同续写文本，使隐藏状态差异仅源于prompt，测量其距离随$t$的衰减；对有限深度pre-LN softmax、注意力logit有界的Transformer给出理论界，附加条件为pre-norm激活远离零；并引入可精确求解的线性relay模型及logit bias干预实验。

Result: 隐藏状态距离近似按$t^{-\alpha}$衰减；训练模型遗忘快（$\alpha\approx0.55$–$0.7$），未训练慢（$\alpha\approx0.2$–$0.5$）；证明偏移上界$O(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t)$，其中relay（续写token传递早先读到的prompt信息）仅增加对数因子；线性relay模型表明该界不可改进，并再现未训练网络中局部指数向1上升的现象。

Conclusion: prompt对下一token的影响随$t$增长而消失，任何存活的prompt性质（如语言）必由生成文本自身携带（条件无毛定理）；用logit bias抵消稀释会在训练早期阻止衰减、之后反转为增长，说明稀释是所测遗忘的必要条件，而线性模型与未训练网络表明其亦为充分条件。

Abstract: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-α}$, where $α=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($α\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($α\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. This is what we call the \emph{conditional no-hair theorem}: given the text generated so far, the prompt's influence on the next token vanishes as $t$ grows, so any property of the prompt that survives, such as its language, must be carried by the text itself. An exactly solvable linear relay model shows that the bound cannot be improved and reproduces the rise of the local exponent towards $1$ seen in untrained networks. Cancelling the dilution with a logit bias stops the decay early in training and reverses it after, so dilution is necessary for the forgetting we measure; untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.

</details>


### [466] [Verifying Human-Written Reasoning References](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24690)
*Ali Ansari,Farhana Ferdousi Liza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种以人类撰写推理链为参照的评估方法，结合"引用前提集蕴含检查、全前提复检、失败归因"三步，在P-FOLIO上用LLM做一阶逻辑翻译、Z3做蕴含判定；发现386条推导中仅52.3%完全通过，且多数步骤失败源于支撑不完整或形式化/标注错误，而非无依据断言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有以人类撰写推理链为参照评估AI推理的工作，很少验证各步骤的逻辑支撑；已有神经符号方法虽形式化并检查推理，却未系统评估参照推导中每步结论是否被其引用前提集蕴含，也未追查参照失败的来源。这会使"AI与人类参照不一致"被误判为AI错误。

Method: 提出以参照为中心（reference-centred）的评估方法，包含三项检查：(1) 步骤结论对引用前提集的蕴含检查；(2) 对完整原始前提集的复检；(3) 失败归因。在P-FOLIO数据集上实施：用LLM将步骤结论翻译为一阶逻辑（FOL），用Z3 SMT求解器判定蕴含；另对通过检查的50个随机抽样步骤做人工审计以评估翻译保真度。

Result: 386条推导中202条（52.3%）满足全部检查标准；230条未被其陈述支撑蕴含的步骤中，191条在完整原始前提下转为可蕴含，说明多数初始失败源于支撑不完整或不匹配而非无依据断言；剩余39例人工分析得21例人类推理错误、11例FOL翻译错误、7例数据集标注错误。50个抽样通过步骤中46个（92%）翻译忠实。

Conclusion: 被评估AI系统与人类撰写推理参照之间的分歧，可能源自参照本身或其形式化表示，而非AI系统；因此以人类推理链为金标准的评估需先对参照做蕴含验证与失败归因，否则会高估AI的推理缺陷。

Abstract: Evaluating the reasoning of AI systems often relies on human-written reasoning chains as references, yet the logical support for their individual steps is rarely verified. Although prior neuro-symbolic approaches have formalized and checked reasoning, their reported evaluations do not systematically assess whether step conclusions in human-written reference derivations are entailed by their cited premise sets or investigate the sources of failures in those references.
