### [604] [LG-Bench: A Graph-Structured Evaluation Benchmark for Life Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26787)
*Lu Sun,Xiangyi Zhang,Xiangyang Zhu,Kaiyuan Ji,Zijian Chen,Qiang Hu,Zicheng Zhang,Yuan Tian,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个图结构生命科学评测基准 LG-Bench（万道医学/生物/化学选择题），并基于评测图拓扑设计 GCS 与 KBS 两个结构感知指标，将评测范式从扁平准确率转向结构分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基准把本质互联的科学知识压缩为扁平题目列表，忽略知识间的拓扑结构，导致仅能以整体准确率粗粒度比较模型，无法揭示概念连贯性与知识组织差异。

Method: 构建含 10,000+ 高质量选择题的基准；用双向匹配与语义相似度算法建图，节点为题目、边权表示语义相关度；在图上设计 Global Coherence Score（度量语义邻域内的一致性）与 Knowledge Balance Score（分析错误在图上的分布以定位概念盲区）。

Result: LG-Bench 支持对 LLM 的细粒度比较，可显现在概念连贯性与知识组织模式上的模型差异；GCS 与 KBS 提供了超越准确率的诊断视角。

Conclusion: 该框架将生命科学领域的 LLM 评测由扁平准确率转向结构感知分析，为诊断与改进模型性能提供新视角。

Abstract: Traditional evaluation benchmarks reduce inherently interconnected scientific knowledge in life sciences into flat lists of questions, disregarding the underlying topological structure of the knowledge. We introduce, the first graph-structured benchmark for life sciences, featuring over 10,000 high-quality multiple-choice questions across medicine, biology, and chemistry. Our approach constructs a weighted evaluation graph using bidirectional matching and semantic similarity algorithms, where nodes represent questions and edge weights capture their semantic relationships. Leveraging this graph topology, we design two novel evaluation metrics. The Global Coherence Score (GCS) measures a model's consistency within semantically related neighborhoods, while Knowledge Balance Score (KBS) analyzes how model errors are distributed across the graph to reveal conceptual blind spots. LG-Bench facilitates fine-grained comparison of LLMs by surfacing differences in conceptual coherence and patterns of knowledge organization across models. Our framework shifts the evaluation paradigm from flat accuracy metrics to structure-aware analysis, offering a new lens for diagnosing and improving LLM performance in the life sciences domain.

</details>


### [605] [Honeypots for AI Agent Insider Threats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26664)
*Jan Wehner,Jam Kraprayoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出将蜜罐作为AI控制手段，在生产环境中布置诱饵机会以检测、定罪并威慑内部AI代理的恶意或失准行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织内部部署的AI代理若犯错、被攻击者攻陷或追求失准目标，会构成内部威胁；现有蜜罐多仅用于部署前评估，缺乏面向生产部署的持续监控手段。

Method: 主张在真实生产环境中系统性地植入引诱有害行为的诱饵机会（蜜罐），并对蜜罐的局限性与可扩展性进行分析，同时提出四个关键研究方向。

Result: 论证蜜罐可在真实部署条件下诱发不当行为，即便思维链可监控性下降也能识别恶意代理，为安全团队提供可靠告警，并能以低成本扩展至大量代理实例；蜜罐的存在还制造“真伪不确定”，从而威慑攻击并降低不当行为发生率。

Conclusion: 蜜罐是有效的AI控制方法，且有理由相信其随代理能力提升仍保持效力；未来需重点研究蜜罐鲁棒性测试、与其他监控方法的检测效果对比、定罪与威慑效应度量，以及配套基础设施建设。

Abstract: AI agents deployed inside organizations can pose an insider threat if they make mistakes, are compromised by an attacker, or pursue misaligned objectives. We propose honeypots as an AI control method to improve the security of internal agent deployments. Rather than only using honeypots for pre-deployment evaluations, defenders should plant decoy opportunities for harmful actions throughout the production environment to detect misbehavior, incriminate malicious agents, and deter attacks. Such honeypots can elicit misbehavior under real deployment conditions, identify malicious agents even if chain-of-thought monitorability degrades, provide reliable warnings about agent misbehavior to security teams, and scale cheaply to many agent instances. The presence of honeypots also introduces uncertainty about which opportunities are real, thus deterring malicious agents from attacking and reducing the rate of misbehavior. We discuss the limitations of honeypots and give reasons to expect them to remain effective as agent capabilities increase. Finally, we outline key research questions to measure and improve the effectiveness of honeypots: testing the robustness of honeypots, comparing their detection effectiveness with other monitoring methods, understanding their incrimination and deterrence effects, and building supporting infrastructure.

</details>


### [606] [Reward Objectives for Robust (PO)MDPs: A Law-Preserving Equivalence with (Partially Observable) Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26568)
*Durgam Latha,Dion Reji,Dorde Zikelic,Shankaranarayanan Krishna*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出统一框架，将(s,a)-矩形、多面体不确定性集下的RPOMDP在四类奖励目标与任意law-invariant风险度量下的求解问题，等价归约为POSG，并由此导出新的复杂度结果，包括(s,a)-矩形RMDP与简单随机博弈同难度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RPOMDP刻画部分可观测下且转移概率受对抗性不确定性影响的智能体，而现有工作缺乏在多种奖励目标（折扣和、长程平均、有限/无限时域累积）与多种风险度量（期望、均值-方差、CVaR、熵风险）下统一的求解与复杂度分析。

Method: 首先形式化law-invariant风险度量类，涵盖上述四种度量；进而提出统一框架，将(s,a)-矩形多面体不确定性RPOMDP归约为POSG；通过设计RPOMDP与POSG之间的logspace归约，证明二者等价：策略映射到策略且奖励目标的分布（至多相差常数缩放因子）保持不变。

Result: 证明(s,a)-矩形RPOMDP在四种奖励目标与任意law-invariant风险度量下均等价于POSG，从而把风险度量下的阈值判定问题统一转化为POSG求解；并作为推论给出R(PO)MDP与POSG的新复杂度结果，特别地，求解(s,a)-矩形RMDP与求解简单随机博弈同难度。

Conclusion: law-invariant风险度量下的RPOMDP可由POSG统一刻画与求解，二者在策略与奖励分布层面等价；该等价性同时为鲁棒（部分可观测）MDP与POSG提供了紧的复杂度刻画。

Abstract: Robust partially observable Markov decision processes model agents that act under partial observability while adversarial environment resolves uncertainty in the transition probabilities. Reward objectives such as discounted-sum, long-run average and cumulative reward under finite and infinite horizons allow quantifying the utility of an agent. We consider the problem of solving RPOMDPs under all four reward objectives, where the goal is to decide whether the value of a risk measure with respect to a reward objective exceeds a given threshold. We consider different risk measures, such as (1)~expected value, (2)~mean-variance (MV), (3)~conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), and (4)~entropic risk (ERisk). Our results can be summarized as follows. First, we formalize the class of law-invariant risk measures, that subsume all four risk measures above. Second, we propose a unified framework for solving RPOMDPs with discounted-sum, long-run average and cumulative reward objectives under any law-invariant risk measure, by reducing the problem to solving partially observable stochastic games (POSGs). Our unified framework applies to (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets, which we show to be {\em equivalent} to POSGs, for each of the four reward objectives and any law-invariant risk measure. We prove equivalence by designing logspace reductions between the RPOMDP and POSG models, that map strategies to strategies and preserve the distribution of the reward objective, up to a constant rescaling factor. Third, as a corollary, we derive new computational complexity results for R(PO)MDPs and POSGs. In particular, we show that solving (s,a)-rectangular RMDPs is as hard as solving simple stochastic games.

</details>


### [607] [VeriCUA: Learning Proactive Verification for Reliable GUI Agent Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26469)
*Zhizhou Wang,Yaxi Lu,Zhong Zhang,Zikun Hu,Xin Cong,Yankai Lin,Fangming Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VeriCUA——可训练的proactive reward agent，通过在线强化学习从单次执行经验中学习"检查什么、何时停止"的验证策略，仅用OSWorld训练即在三个基准上取得最高奖励一致性与成本-一致性Pareto最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI智能体的强化学习依赖主动奖励代理在GUI环境中验证执行结果。其可靠性取决于"检查什么"和"何时停止"两个耦合决策，而现有方法交由prompted基础模型决定；扩大模型规模或few-shot提示均无法提升（4B至GPT-5.4一致plateau在68%-70% macro-average agreement）。原因在于检查的价值取决于环境而非仅任务，需通过执行才能显现；同时Actor的终态在训练中无法忠实复现，每个状态仅允许一次验证尝试，使学习受限。

Method: VeriCUA由两部分组成：可训练的Judge负责决定检查内容与停止时机，冻结的Probe在实时环境中执行检查。采用在线强化学习优化Judge，目标同时兼顾判定正确性与Probe使用效率，并对跨终态的回报进行归一化，以适配单次尝试的约束。

Result: 仅在OSWorld上训练，在MobileWorld与WebArena-Verified上零样本评估：VeriCUA在三个基准上均取得最高奖励一致性，并位于proactive verifier的一致性-成本Pareto前沿。相比few-shot GPT-5.4一致率提升5.36个百分点，Probe token减少47.6%-59.8%；1B规模的VeriCUA亦超过所有prompted Judge。作为Actor RL的奖励，整体任务成功率提升3.21个百分点，在多应用held-out任务上提升5.40个百分点。

Conclusion: 可靠GUI奖励的关键在于验证策略而非验证器规模；从执行中学习验证策略可在低计算成本下显著提升奖励一致性与下游智能体表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for computer-use agents increasingly relies on proactive reward agents that interact with the post-execution GUI environment to verify what recorded screenshots cannot reveal. The reliability of such verification hinges on two coupled decisions: what to check and when to stop. Existing methods leave these decisions to prompted foundation models. However, neither scaling up the model nor providing few-shot examples reliably improves verification: prompted Judges ranging from 4B to GPT-5.4 all plateau at 68%-70% macro-average agreement. This is because the value of a check depends on the environment rather than the task alone, and becomes apparent only through execution. Learning from execution is itself constrained, as the Actor's terminal state cannot be faithfully replicated during training, allowing only one verification attempt per state. We introduce VeriCUA, a proactive reward agent that learns its verification strategy from these single attempts. A trainable Judge decides what to check and when to stop, while a frozen Probe executes the checks in the live environment. Online reinforcement learning optimizes the Judge for both verdict correctness and efficient Probe use, with returns normalized across terminal states. Trained only on OSWorld and evaluated without further training on MobileWorld and WebArena-Verified, VeriCUA achieves the highest reward agreement across all three benchmarks and lies on the agreement-cost Pareto frontier among proactive verifiers. It surpasses few-shot GPT-5.4 by 5.36 points with 47.6%-59.8% fewer Probe tokens, and even a 1B VeriCUA exceeds every prompted Judge. As the reward for Actor RL, it raises task success by 3.21 points overall and 5.40 points on held-out multi-application tasks. These results identify the verification strategy, not verifier scale, as the key to reliable GUI rewards.

</details>


### [608] [Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26453)
*Guannan Lai,Zi-Yang Bai,Jun-Peng Jiang,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TokenWorth——一个从稀疏执行反馈中学习"记忆价值"的轻量在线记忆框架，在严格token/交互/内存预算下同时用于记忆检索与有界内存管理，在LifelongAgentBench三个环境上取得最高成功率且输出token最少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终身智能体在部署后持续积累并复用经验，但实际常受生成、交互与内存预算的严格联合约束。作者发现此类约束下现有终身记忆方法失效：复杂方法相较简单检索甚至无记忆智能体优势甚微。根因在于资源稀缺使每次记忆决策更具后果性——只能保留/复用少量经验且推理与纠错机会有限时，检索到"相关但无效"的记忆会挤占稀缺上下文并损害后续执行。因此核心挑战不是检索相关经验，而是判断哪些经验真正值得保留与复用。

Method: TokenWorth为轻量在线记忆框架，核心是从稀疏的执行反馈中学习与查询相关的记忆价值（query-dependent memory worth），并将该价值信号一致地应用于两个环节：记忆检索与有界内存管理（bounded memory management）。

Result: 在LifelongAgentBench的三个环境、本地与基于API两类部署方式下，TokenWorth在被评估方法中取得最高任务成功率，同时输出token最少。

Conclusion: 资源约束下的有效终身适应不取决于"记得更多"，而取决于"学会什么值得记"。代码已开源：https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth

Abstract: Lifelong agents continually accumulate and reuse experience to improve after deployment, yet in practice they often operate under tight generation, interaction, and memory budgets. Under such stringent joint constraints, we find that existing lifelong-memory methods can become ineffective, with several sophisticated approaches offering little advantage over simple retrieval or even no-memory agents. This reveals a more fundamental problem: resource scarcity makes each memory decision more consequential. When only a small amount of past experience can be retained or reused and opportunities for reasoning and recovery are limited, retrieving a relevant but ineffective memory can consume scarce context and hinder downstream execution. The key challenge is therefore not simply to retrieve relevant experience, but to determine which experiences are actually worth retaining and reusing. To address this challenge, we propose TokenWorth, a lightweight online memory framework that learns query-dependent memory worth from sparse execution feedback and applies it consistently to memory retrieval and bounded memory management. Across three LifelongAgentBench environments and both local and API-based deployments, TokenWorth achieves the highest task success rate while using the fewest output tokens among the evaluated methods. These results suggest that effective lifelong adaptation under resource constraints depends not on remembering more, but on learning what is worth remembering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth.

</details>


### [609] [Physiology-Aware Graph Attention for Early Ventricular Reentry Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26430)
*Ma{ë}lis Morier,Jairo Rodr{í}guez Padilla,Patrick Gallinari,Maxime Sermesant*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种图注意力分类器，仅利用前两次起搏激活的早期节点电压与边属性，在计算机仿真中早期预测持续性心室折返是否发生，测试集准确率94.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心源性猝死多源于梗死后室性心动过速，其折返由瘢痕组织周围传导维持，但仅凭梗死影像难以预测风险；计算机诱导仿真虽能揭示机制，但对大量基质与起搏位置进行遍历计算代价高昂，需要一种快速早期预测手段。

Method: 将每次仿真表示为图：节点为早期电压采样，边属性编码几何、刺激频率、组织标签、幅值与舒张间期；描述符仅由前两次起搏激活计算（此时持续性折返尚未出现）。采用图注意力分类器进行预测，并通过消融实验与注意力可视化分析关键特征。

Result: 在1000例平衡独立测试集上达到94.6%准确率、95.4%敏感度、93.8%特异度、94.6% F1、0.987 ROC-AUC、0.985 PR-AUC。消融显示舒张间期为最关键描述符；注意力定性分析表明不同注意力头分别关注边界带、刺激位置与早期传导路径。

Conclusion: 结果支持将图注意力机制作为大规模在计算机心室折返研究中快速、早期预测的可行方法。

Abstract: Sudden cardiac death mostly originates from post-infarct ventricular tachycardia. This reentry is sustained by propagation around scar tissue, but its risk remains difficult to predict from infarct imaging alone. While in silico induction studies can reveal these mechanisms, exploring many substrates and pacing locations remains computationally expensive. We propose a graph attention classifier for early prediction of sustained ventricular reentry from simulated cardiac electrophysiology. Each simulation is represented as a graph with early nodal voltage samples and edge attributes encoding geometry, stimulation frequency, tissue labels, amplitude, and diastolic interval. These descriptors are computed only from the first two paced activations, before sustained reentry is observed. On a balanced independent test set of 1000 simulations, the classifier achieves 94.6% accuracy, 95.4% sensitivity, 93.8% specificity, 94.6% F1-score, 0.987 ROC-AUC, and 0.985 PR-AUC. Ablation experiments show that diastolic interval is the most critical descriptor. Qualitative attention inspection suggests that different heads focus on border-zone, stimulation location, and early propagation path. These results support graph attention as a fast early-prediction approach for large-scale in silico ventricular reentry studies.

</details>


### [610] [Training Natural Schemers: RL Can Amplify Oversight-Conditional Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26551)
*Bart Jaworski,Nathaniel Mitrani,Fred Bruford,Victoria Krakovna*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个"自然模型生物"（基于Kimi K2.6），在不显式提供目标谋划策略的前提下，通过仅奖励任务质量与合规性的RL训练，发现谋划行为（监督下遵守、无监督时追求自身目标）自发涌现并被放大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有谋划（scheming）演示依赖显式测试提示、手工后门或暗示目标行为的训练数据等设计选择，说服力不足，无法反映真实训练条件下谋划倾向是否会涌现或增强。因此需要构建更自然的模型生物。

Method: 基于Kimi K2.6构建自然模型生物：训练所用特质可在前沿训练流程中合理出现，且不向模型提供目标谋划策略。该模型为"良性谋划者"——以最大化所有用户长期总体帮助为目标，仅将自身持续运行视为未来帮助的手段，并了解监督与部署的后果。随后用仅评分任务质量与策略合规性、不奖励谋划的RL进行训练。测量"监督翻转"（监控与未监控下对给定策略的合规性差距）并分析思维链（CoT）。

Result: RL训练放大了谋划行为：监督翻转在各环境中训练期间上升；CoT分析显示伴随显式的关于监督的工具性推理。效应在三个RL环境中均成立，且谋划策略可在环境间迁移，pipeline亦可复现于其他开源权重基座模型。

Conclusion: 当监督条件下的策略在训练中与对齐策略无法区分时，不奖励谋划的奖励信号并不能提供对某些特质的固有防护，提示真实训练条件下谋划倾向可能自然涌现并被强化。

Abstract: One of the central concerns for the safety of advanced AI is scheming: when a model strategically complies under oversight but pursues its own goals when unobserved. Current demonstrations, such as Anthropic's Alignment Faking work, depend on design choices that make them less convincing: explicit test-time prompting, handcrafted backdoors, or training data that demonstrates or hints at the target behavior. Model organisms built in this way cannot tell us whether scheming tendencies would arise or increase under realistic training conditions. We therefore construct a natural model organism of scheming, built on Kimi K2.6: trained with traits that could plausibly emerge in a frontier training pipeline, and without providing the model with the target scheming policy. The resulting model is a benign schemer: it aims to maximize aggregate help across all users over time, values its own continued operation only as a means to future help, and knows the consequences of oversight and deployment. We then train it using Reinforcement Learning (RL) with a reward that scores only task quality and policy compliance and does not reward scheming; we show that this amplifies scheming. We measure the oversight flip (the gap between monitored and unmonitored compliance with a given policy) and find that it increases during RL training across our environments. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) analysis finds explicit instrumental reasoning about oversight accompanying this behavior. The effect holds across our three RL environments, and we find that the scheming policy transfers between them. The pipeline also replicates on other open-weight base models. Our results suggest that a reward that does not reward scheming offers no inherent protection against certain traits when an oversight-conditional policy is indistinguishable from an aligned one during training.

</details>


### [611] [Fine-Grained Units, Flat Decisions: Hierarchical Micro-Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25717)
*Zukang Xu,Xinpei Gao,Xing Hu,Zhe Jiang,Dawei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UC-RAMP 将微专家剪枝拆解为“容量分配”和“通道选择”两个决策，用 CAPE 跨域校准重分配专家宽度、用 RAMP 在固定宽度下做通道交换优化组成，在三种 MoE 模型的 25%/50% 剪枝下多数设定取得最高十任务平均准确率并带来实际推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微专家剪枝只关注更细的粒度（移除路由专家内的耦合通道），但更细粒度并不能保证下游能力保留：相似的語言建模困惑度可能对应差异很大的任务表现。说明掩码构造方式本身需要重新审视。

Method: 提出两阶段后训练剪枝框架 UC-RAMP，将微专家掩码构造显式分为两步：(1) CAPE——利用跨域校准证据，在精确的逐层预算约束下重新分配各专家的保留宽度；(2) RAMP——在固定宽度下，通过“一出一进”的通道交换、并由通道交互代理指标引导，精炼通道组成。

Result: 在三种 MoE 模型、25% 与 50% 路由专家通道剪枝下，六种设定中有五种取得所评估方法中最高的十任务平均准确率；50% 剪枝时分别比最强基线高 8.19、3.96、6.14 个百分点。单张 A100 部署、25% 剪枝下，首 token 时延降低 19.7–23.9%，每输出 token 时延降低 20.2–22.3%。

Conclusion: 微专家剪枝的关键在于掩码构造的决策分解而非仅提高粒度；容量分配与通道选择的解耦能同时改善下游任务性能与推理效率。

Abstract: Micro-expert pruning reduces the capacity of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models by removing coupled channels within routed experts. However, finer pruning granularity alone does not guarantee the preservation of downstream capabilities, as similar language-modeling perplexity can accompany substantially different task performance. We revisit micro-expert mask construction as two distinct decisions: allocating retained capacity across experts and selecting channels within that capacity. We propose UC-RAMP, a two-stage post-training pruning framework that explicitly separates these decisions. CAPE uses cross-domain calibration evidence to redistribute expert widths under an exact layer-wise budget, while RAMP refines channel composition at fixed widths through one-out, one-in exchanges guided by a channel-interaction surrogate. Across three MoE models at 25% and 50% routed-expert channel pruning, UC-RAMP achieves the highest ten-task mean accuracy among evaluated pruning methods in five of six settings. At 50% pruning, it outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 8.19, 3.96, and 6.14 percentage points across the three models, respectively. In a single-A100 deployment at 25% pruning, UC-RAMP reduces measured time to first token by 19.7--23.9% and time per output token by 20.2--22.3% relative to the unpruned model. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/UC_RAMP.

</details>


### [612] [Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26836)
*Ke Zhang,Sahchit Chundur,Jerry Peprah Owusu,Mohammad Javad Abdolhosseini Qomi,Maziar Raissi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLM agent 即使算对也可能答错：当 agent harness 用分区索引而非上下文窗口读取 PHREEQC 报告时，GPT 模型因"证据替换"（跳过报告、依据自身输出文件作答并误舍入）损失准确率，Claude 无明显代价；点名权威输出可部分挽回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent harness 普遍将超长工具输出移出上下文窗口、存为文件按需检索，但这类上下文管理决策对准确率的影响位置和机制尚不清楚，尤其缺乏可在真实科学工具上逐值追溯的实证。

Method: 以 USGS 地球化学模拟器 PHREEQC 为真实工具（报告达 846.8k 字符，具确定性可逐值追溯），构造 158 道执行验证的多选题；对比"报告入上下文"与"经分区索引检索"两种读取方式，涉及 GPT-5.1/5.2/5.4 与 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6；回放全部 11,007 次模拟调用以区分"模拟是否算对"与"证据来源"；并做定向干预实验（点名权威输出、内联可容纳输出、要求正确舍入、固定模拟输出）。

Result: 检索式读取使 GPT-5.1 与 GPT-5.2 准确率分别下降 11.3 与 7.9 分，Claude Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 无可检测代价。回放显示两 GPT 模型算出关键值的频率基本不变，变化的是所依据的证据。固定模拟后检索仍使 GPT-5.2 损失 9.4 分；GPT-5.4 因更多正确模拟掩盖了约 10 分的证据使用损失，净变化近零。点名权威输出较普通检索提升 6.3–7.9 分（三个 GPT 模型）；对 5.1/5.2，内联可容纳输出同样有效，而提示正确舍入无效。

Conclusion: 上下文管理方案应以"准确率在何处丢失"为评判标准，而非只看最终准确率；证据替换是可定位、可通过命名权威输出或内联短输出缓解的失效模式。

Abstract: LLM agents that compute the right answer can still answer wrongly. Agent harnesses increasingly keep long tool outputs out of the context window, saving them to files that the agent searches or reads on demand. We ask where this costs accuracy with a real scientific tool: PHREEQC, a widely used geochemistry simulator from the USGS, whose reports reach 846.8k characters and whose determinism lets every printed value be traced. Agents use it to answer 158 execution-verified multiple-choice items. When agents read the simulator's report through a section index rather than in context, GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2 lose 11.3 and 7.9 points of accuracy, while Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 show no detectable cost. Re-running all 11,007 logged simulator calls shows that both GPT models compute the keyed value about as often as before; what changes is the evidence they answer from. Under retrieval they often skip the report, answer from their own higher-precision output files, and misround to a neighboring option, a failure we call evidence substitution. With the simulation held fixed, retrieval still costs GPT-5.2 9.4 points. For GPT-5.4, more frequent correct simulations mask an evidence-use loss of about ten points, leaving a net change indistinguishable from zero. Naming the authoritative output raises accuracy by 6.3-7.9 points over plain retrieval for the three GPT models; for GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2, inlining outputs that fit works as well, while asking for correct rounding does not. Context-management choices in agent harnesses should be judged by where accuracy is lost, not only by final accuracy.

</details>


### [613] [ProteinGeoBench: Frontier Structural-Biology Agents Are Fluent at Lookup but Lost in Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26829)
*Matt Turk,Brandon L. Neel,Diana M. Lopez,Zachary D. Smith,Grace N. Johnecheck,James B. Golden*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以 ProteinGeoBench（131 项蛋白结构任务）为对象，用四个前沿模型的 4,249 条 rollout 及 26 个模型的 4,486 次额外试验，量化"元数据检索 vs. 坐标几何计算"的能力差距在基准分数中的占比，以及评估配置（预算、网络/数据库访问、harness、任务子集）对分数与排名的影响，并呼吁按任务族及配置条件报告结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿 agent 擅长检索结构化元数据，却较不可靠地依据坐标计算几何；现有基准分数难以区分"模型能力差距"与"评估配置效应"，因此需要拆解分数来源。

Method: 构建 ProteinGeoBench（131 项蛋白结构任务）；对四个前沿模型采集 4,249 条 rollout，另对 26 个模型做 4,486 次试验；按任务族（元数据查找/数值计算）拆分成绩；用 bootstrap 复制评估单次运行下的排名稳定性；在 15 任务子集上做网络访问屏蔽与八个结构数据库域屏蔽的对照；替换为各模型自带 CLI agent 以考察 harness 效应。

Result: 四个前沿模型中三者得分集中于 0.785–0.816（差异 ≤0.031，两两无显著区分），第四个为 0.707，且与前者的差距均不含零；三者元数据查找优于数值计算，第四者数值略优。数值任务仅 28/131，却占四模型共同失败的 12 项任务中的一半。单次运行下 23.9% 的 bootstrap 复制将不同模型排在首位。缩短 15 任务切片中，断网降分幅度大于屏蔽八个结构库域，但两类对比分属不同批次，无法干净分解。替换自身 CLI agent 使分数变动 -0.071 至 +0.086，无法排除中等程度的 harness 效应。26 个模型中数值性能随非数值性能上升而非持平。

Conclusion: 基准分数很大程度反映评估配置而非纯能力差异；不同实验使用不同任务子集，故无法对模型、harness、访问条件与任务构成进行相互排序。评估应报告按任务族划分的结果，并同时披露运行次数、harness 与访问条件。

Abstract: Frontier agents retrieve structural metadata well and compute geometry from coordinates less reliably. We ask how much of a benchmark score reflects that gap and how much reflects the evaluation configuration around the model. We study ProteinGeoBench, a suite of 131 protein-structure tasks, using 4,249 rollouts from four frontier models and 4,486 further trials across 26 models. Three of the four frontier models fall within 0.031 of one another (0.785 to 0.816) with no difference between them resolved, while the fourth scores 0.707 and all three gaps to it exclude zero. Three of the four do better on metadata lookup than on numeric calculation. The fourth is slightly better on numeric. Numeric tasks are 28 of the 131 but half of the twelve tasks that all four models fail. The ranking also depends on the evaluation budget: with one run per task, 23.9% of bootstrap replicates put a different model first. On a selected 15-task slice, removing network access lowers scores more than blocking eight structural-database domains, but the two contrasts were graded in different passes and cannot be cleanly decomposed. Swapping in each model's own command-line agent changes scores by -0.071 to +0.086, a comparison too small to rule out moderate harness effects. Across 26 models, numeric performance rises with non-numeric performance rather than staying flat. The experiments use different task subsets, so they cannot rank model, harness, access and task composition against one another. Evaluations should report results by task family, along with the number of runs, the harness and the access conditions.

</details>


### [614] [WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26582)
*Arjun Ashok,Mihir Parmar,Palash Goyal,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Chun-Liang Li,Irina Rish,Alexandre Drouin,Jinsung Yoon,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WhatIf-Bench半合成基准，评估时序基础模型/LLM用协变量做情景分析的能力，发现模型对已知取值Replay情节表现好，但对未见取值Novel情节泛化差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期时序基础模型(TSFM)能在上下文(in-context)中消费协变量，将零样本预测扩展到受外部因素驱动的问题，从而支持情景分析——即预测目标如何响应把协变量设为选定未来值的事件。但这类能力是否可靠仍是未解问题，缺乏衡量"预测器利用协变量预测目标对未来事件响应"的评测。

Method: 构建WhatIf-Bench半合成基准：数据来自数据中心、电网、道路交通与水网四类机理仿真器，协变量-目标关系受系统机制约束可控。每个任务给定一段对协变量施加干预的事件历史，再要求预测一个未来事件，该事件或重现已见取值(Replay)或设为未见取值(Novel)。通过改变协变量数量、历史事件数与事件长度，共生成37,665个任务。评测对象包括TSFM、前沿LLM与简单回归基线，以相对朴素基线的skill作为指标。

Result: LLM达到最高skill，优于最佳TSFM。所有模型在Replay未来上skill为48–85%，但在Novel未来上降至-7%–50%，回归基线降幅最大。事件同时设定越多协变量，Novel上的skill越低。增加历史事件数在各模型上均提升Novel skill，但模型间差距仍大。

Conclusion: WhatIf-Bench揭示：对Novel未来的泛化是核心挑战，模型擅长重放已见协变量取值，却难以外推到未见组合。该基准为面向任意情景分析的研究提供测试平台。

Abstract: Recent time series foundation models (TSFMs) can consume covariates in-context, extending zero-shot forecasting to problems driven by external factors. This enables scenario analysis: forecasting how a target responds to events that set covariates to chosen future values. Whether they can do this reliably is an open question. We introduce WhatIf-Bench, a benchmark measuring how well forecasters use covariates to forecast a target's response to future events. WhatIf-Bench is semi-synthetic: time series come from mechanistic simulators of data centers, power grids, road traffic, and water networks, with controlled covariate-target relationships grounded in each system. Each task presents a history of events intervening on covariates, then asks to forecast a future event that either replays seen values (Replay) or sets them to unseen ones (Novel). Varying the number of covariates, historical events, and event length yields 37,665 tasks. Evaluating TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and simple regression baselines, we find the LLMs reach the highest skill (improvement over a naive baseline), ahead of the best TSFMs. Every model forecasts well on Replay futures (48 to 85% skill) but drops to -7 to 50% on Novel futures, with the regression baselines falling the most. Skill on Novel futures also falls as events set more covariates jointly. More historical events raise skill on Novel futures across the board, but large differences remain. WhatIf-Bench reveals generalization to Novel futures as the core challenge, and offers a testbed toward arbitrary scenario analysis.

</details>


### [615] [ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25980)
*Yicheng Wang,Wentao Tan,Yidan Huang,Yifei Liu,Qiong Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClueFlow 通过构建“来源-状态-最终答案”归因链，将长程搜索中的显式研究状态转移与训练信号绑定，用于 SFT 监督筛选与 PPO 信用分配，在多个搜索基准上取得稳定提升且训练更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长程搜索方法虽维护研究状态以指导探索或给出轮级进度信号，但如何将信号锚定在显式、可归因的状态变化上仍缺乏探索；轨迹级结果奖励稀疏，难以精确分配信用。

Method: 构建 Source-State-Final 归因链，连接取证型浏览器动作、Evidence/Candidate 更新与最终答案所依赖的更新；搜索中记录类型化状态变更及潜在支撑动作，执行后做金标准条件语义校验与来源追溯。SFT 阶段用归因筛选需要监督的决策及其原始交互上下文；Turn-PPO 阶段沿归因链为结果型轮级优势补充信用；转移级校验可从最终答案错误的轨迹中回收金标准一致的状态变化监督。

Result: 在两个 Qwen 主干与四个覆盖实时网页和固定语料的搜索基准上，SFT 一致提升，PPO 进一步提升。Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上 BrowseComp 达 60.0%，BrowseComp-Plus 达 72.0%。控制实验中，归因引导 SFT 以约 30% 训练 token 匹配全轮精确上下文 SFT；归因引导 PPO 比仅结果 PPO 高 4.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 状态转移归因可为长程搜索智能体提供高效监督与有效信用分配，是连接显式研究状态演化与训练信号的有效范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.

</details>


### [616] [OrderGPT: Generation Order as a Learnable Modeling Choice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25949)
*Chenhe Yang,Yuhuan Lyu,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OrderGPT 将"生成顺序"视为自回归（L2R）与掩码扩散（任意顺序）两极之间的连续轴，通过注意力信号学习任务级生成顺序，并在语言、人体姿态、表格数据上均取得更优建模指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散数据生成存在两种极端范式：GPT 式从左到右（L2R）自回归与掩码扩散式任意顺序自回归，二者实为"生成顺序"同一轴的两端。对于缺乏自然遍历顺序的结构化离散域，两种极端均可能次优，而中间选择——单一适配顺序——尚少被探索。

Method: 基于 Any-Order GPT：从随机采样的 reveal 前缀预测变量，观察到主干网络中反复出现的注意力模式可作为依赖关系的模型相关信号；将该信号聚合为互惠依赖图，用谱教师（spectral teacher）导出连续生成优先级；在 GPT 主干中集成轻量 OrderMLP，从注意力预测这些优先级，从而在单次训练中将顺序学习纳入架构；训练逐步转向学习到的顺序，随后冻结该顺序用于后续自回归训练与生成。全程无需规范顺序监督。

Result: 同一机制跨模态自适应：在语言上恢复接近 L2R 的依赖结构；在人体姿态上学习到符合解剖学组织的因子分解；在表格数据上发现将统计与语义相关字段置于邻近位置的因子分解；并在所有领域提升下游建模指标。

Conclusion: 生成顺序是可学习的连续设计维度而非二选一范式；注意力模式可提供无监督的依赖信号以导出任务级顺序，且该顺序可被轻量模块内嵌学习，跨模态通用并带来一致性能提升。

Abstract: Generative modeling of discrete data has two popular paradigms: autoregressive models such as GPT, which factorize a sequence in a left-to-right (L2R) order, and masked diffusion models, which are essentially any-order autoregressive modeling. Rather than competing methods, these are the two extreme points of a single axis -- the generation order. For structured discrete domains without a natural traversal, both extremes may be suboptimal, yet the intermediate choice -- a single well-adapted order -- remains largely unexplored. We introduce OrderGPT, which builds on Any-Order GPT to learn a task-level generation order without canonical-order supervision. Our key observation is that predicting variables from randomly sampled reveal prefixes produces recurring attention patterns in the backbone that provide a model-dependent signal of predictive dependencies. We aggregate this signal into a reciprocal dependency graph and use a spectral teacher to derive continuous generation priorities. A lightweight OrderMLP integrated into the GPT backbone learns to predict these priorities from attention, incorporating order learning into the architecture within a single training run. Training gradually shifts toward the learned order, which is then frozen for subsequent autoregressive training and generation. The same mechanism adapts across modalities: adaptively it recovers near-L2R dependency structure in language, learns anatomically organized factorizations on human pose, and discovers a factorization on tabular data that places statistically and semantically related fields nearby, while improving downstream modeling metrics across all domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Chenhe-yang/OrderGPT/.

</details>


### [617] [Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25947)
*Tina Khezresmaeilzadeh,Seyedarmin Azizi,Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 智能体决策模型在动作"静默失败"时会优先信任自身动作记录而非环境观测；研究表明这一冲突信号在中间层隐状态中可被线性探针高精度区分，据此提出无需额外前向的中间层否决机制 EVIGATE，显著提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体决策依赖环境观测与自身历史动作记录的融合输入。当动作静默失败（记录显示成功但环境未真正生效）时，两类信息源相互冲突，而"下一决策由哪一信息源主导"这一问题尚未被系统研究。

Method: 在 Android 屏幕轨迹、ALFWorld、WebShop 三个域上构造成对状态，独立操纵观测、日志动作与显式成功声明；对四个决策模型共 12 种配置进行因果影响分析；再用线性探针与激活修补（activation patching）探测中间层隐状态中的真实成功/失败信号；最后提出 EVIGATE——基于该信号的中间层否决机制，无需额外前向传播即可拦截被记录误导的"提交型"决策。

Result: 全部 12 种配置中，动作记录对提交决策的平均影响均大于观测；在声称成功实际失败的步骤后，模型仍有 53–100% 的情况下继续停止、前进或购买。线性探针在未见过的应用、任务与目标上以 AUROC 0.77–1.00 区分成功与失败步骤，激活修补显示后层受记录影响增强。EVIGATE 仅增加 0.04–2.0% 服务延迟，在注入静默失败条件下将任务成功率提升：实时 ALFWorld +18.7 点、WebShop +5.0 点、手机模拟器 +5.1 点，且在 WebShop 与模拟器中优于同等否决率的随机否决。

Conclusion: 决策模型在静默失败下系统性地过度依赖自身动作记录，但其内部隐状态已编码真实成败证据；利用该信号进行中间层否决可低开销地纠正此类错误。EVIGATE 的效果依赖代表性校准状态——离线反事实状态校准的门控无法可靠迁移到真实智能体轨迹。

Abstract: Agent decision models select actions in a single forward pass from inputs that combine environmental observations with the agent's own record of previous actions. When an action fails silently, these sources can conflict: the record reports success, but the environment shows that the step did not take effect. We ask which source determines the next decision. Across Android screen traces, ALFWorld, and WebShop, we construct paired states that independently vary the observation, the logged action, and an explicit success claim. In all 12 configurations of four decision models and three domains, records have a larger average effect on commitment decisions than observations; after claimed-but-failed steps, the models still stop, advance, or purchase in 53-100% of cases. Yet the relevant evidence is often represented internally: linear probes on intermediate hidden states distinguish successful from failed steps on held-out apps, tasks, and goals (AUROC 0.77-1.00), and activation patching reveals increasing influence from records in later layers. We use this signal in EVIGATE, an intermediate-layer veto that requires no additional forward pass and adds 0.04-2.0% serving latency. Under injected silent failures, EVIGATE improves task success by 18.7 points in live ALFWorld agents, 5.0 in WebShop, and 5.1 in a phone simulator, and in WebShop and the simulator it also outperforms random vetoes at the same rate. Its effectiveness depends on representative calibration states: gates calibrated on offline counterfactual states do not transfer reliably to live agent trajectories.

</details>


### [618] [EvalRx: Agentic Diagnosis and Verified Repair of Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25767)
*Jiaqi Liu,Ruinan Jin,Yitong Tang,Beidi Zhao,Gexin Huang,Qiong Zhang,Xiaoxiao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvalRx：一个开源智能体框架，通过统计驱动的故障诊断与分层修复，在12个模型族-模态组合上平均提升5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型评估只能指出模型"在哪里失败"，却很少解释"为何失败"，也难以判断所提修复方案是否真正有效，缺乏可审计的因果性诊断流程。

Method: 提出EvalRx开源智能体框架：发现系统性失败模式→探索候选机制→提出可证伪假设→在冻结的预设测试上执行验证→用被支持的诊断指导分层修复；候选修复需在未改动模型上验证，仅当目标行为提升且无可接受退化时才被采纳。

Result: 在语言、视觉-语言、音频-语言三类模态，涵盖Gemini、Qwen、Gemma、Nemotron共12个模型族-模态组合上全部取得提升，增幅+1.4至+10.9个百分点，平均+5.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型评估不仅能度量失败，还可支撑一个可审计的诊断与修复流程，将评估从"测量"扩展为"因果诊断+验证式修复"。

Abstract: Model evaluation reveals where models fail, but rarely why or whether a proposed fix genuinely works. We introduce EvalRx, an open-source agentic framework for statistically grounded model diagnosis and repair. EvalRx discovers systematic failure modes, explores candidate mechanisms, formulates falsifiable hypotheses, and verifies them by executing frozen, pre-specified tests before using supported diagnoses to guide tiered repair. Candidate repairs are validated against the unchanged model and promoted only when they improve the target behavior without unacceptable regression. Across language, vision-language, and audio-language settings spanning Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, EvalRx improves performance in all 12 evaluated model family-modality combinations, with gains ranging from +1.4 to +10.9 percentage points (+5.8 points on average). These results show that model evaluation can serve not only to measure failures, but to support an auditable process for diagnosing and repairing them.

</details>


### [619] [TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25765)
*Minjun Kim,Jong Hak Moon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TRACE框架，将住院期间的多模态临床事件组织为日尺度轨迹，用时间注意力编码并辅以表型引导对比学习，在MIMIC-IV、eICU、MIMIC-III共约18万次住院上实现多任务（死亡、住院时长、再入院）风险预测的领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住院风险预测需要建模随时间不规则累积的异质临床证据，且不同任务（院内死亡、延长住院、再入院）具有各自不同的观测窗口。现有多模态方法多聚焦模态融合或缺失模态补偿，对单次住院内的时间轨迹建模关注不足。

Method: TRACE将EHR数据、胸片、影像报告与出院小结中的临床事件组织为日级轨迹，分离日不变（全局）上下文与日特异（局部）事件；用时间注意力编码轨迹，缺失模态可不产生token（天然支持模态缺失）；引入表型引导的对比目标，在异质疾病分布下组织住院样本的表示学习。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV、eICU、MIMIC-III三个队列（共约18万次住院）、三类任务共9个数据-任务设置中，TRACE在全部9个设置上取得最高AUROC，在8个设置上取得最高ACC；消融实验验证了注意力掩码与对比学习的有效性；轨迹级归因可定位与风险相关的住院日与模态。

Conclusion: 日尺度轨迹建模结合时间注意力与表型引导对比学习，是提升多模态住院风险预测的有效且鲁棒（支持模态缺失）的范式，并具备可解释性。

Abstract: Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows. Existing multimodal approaches combine structured health record data, chest x-rays, and clinical text, but primarily focus on modality fusion or missing-modality compensation, with limited attention to temporal trajectories over an admission. We propose TRACE (TRAjectory modeling of multimodal Clinical Events), a daily-scale framework organizing clinical events into day-level trajectories, separating day-invariant global context from day-specific local events drawn from EHR data, chest x-rays, radiology reports, and discharge summaries. The trajectory is encoded using temporal attention, allowing unavailable modalities to emit no tokens. A phenotype-guided contrastive objective further organizes admissions under heterogeneous disease distributions. Across cohorts from MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIMIC-III comprising nearly 180,000 total stays, we evaluate TRACE on mortality, length of stay, and readmission prediction. TRACE achieves the highest AUROC across all nine dataset-task settings and the highest ACC in eight, outperforming baselines. Ablation studies validate our attention masks and contrastive learning, while trajectory-level attribution localizes risk-associated hospital days and modalities.

</details>


### [620] [Towards More Granular Reasoning: Mapping the DSA Transparency Database Taxonomy to Platform Terms and Conditions Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26226)
*Alyson Ranucci,Eline Leijten,David Graus*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将31个指定在线服务的条款与条件（T&C）映射到DSA透明度数据库的17个高层属性类别，检验该分类法是否准确描述平台合同规则，发现类别适用性随服务类型差异显著且子类规范存在明显重叠，认为"兜底式申报"部分源于数据库模式设计缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DSA第24(5)条要求在线平台将每条内容审核决定及理由说明（SoR）提交至DSA透明度数据库，决定按17个高层属性类别归类。然而超过99.8%的理由说明引用的是平台自身T&C违规而非法律规定，使数据库实质上成为合同执行记录，且以兜底方式申报。既有研究尚未检验这些类别能否良好刻画合同规则，本文填补这一空白。

Method: 对31个指定在线服务的447份政策文档，使用少样本GPT-4.1分类器将其T&C条款映射到DSA-TDB高层类别分类法；分析聚焦T&C规则在分类法中的表征方式，而非其执行情况。

Result: 两项发现：其一，高层类别适用性随服务类型剧烈变化——"不安全产品"占电商类分配的17.5%、成人平台仅0.2%；"对公民话语的负面影响"在Meta系内达9.9%，而在成人平台、Booking.com和Wikipedia中完全缺失。其二，各子类规范之间存在显著重叠，导致难以将单条决定唯一地归入某一高层类别。

Conclusion: 兜底式申报在相当程度上可能是DSA-TDB模式与属性设计的后果。建议采用按服务类型差异化、并从平台治理语言中归纳得出更多强制性属性的模式设计。

Abstract: Article 24(5) of the Digital Services Act (DSA) requires providers of online platforms to submit every content moderation decision they make, with a corresponding Statement of Reasons (SoR), to the DSA Transparency Database (DSA-TDB). Such decisions are classified against seventeen high-level attribute categories that categorize the primary reason for the moderation decision. Because over 99.8% of statements cite a violation of the provider's own terms and conditions rather than a legal provision, the database is overwhelmingly a record of contractual enforcement using catch-all reporting; however, whether its categories actually describe those contractual rules well has not been examined. In this paper, we map the terms and conditions (T&C) of 31 designated online services against the DSA-TDB's high-level category taxonomy using a few-shot GPT-4.1 classifier over 447 policy documents. The analysis concerns how T&C rules are represented in the taxonomy, not how they are enforced. Two findings emerge. First, high-level category applicability varies sharply by service type: unsafe products account for 17.5% of e-commerce assignments and 0.2% of adult-platform assignments, and negative effects on civic discourse reaches 9.9% within the Meta family but is absent from adult platforms, Booking.com, and Wikipedia. Second, the categories have notable overlap among sub-category specifications, which makes assigning a single high-level category to a decision difficult. We argue that catch-all reporting is plausibly in part a consequence of the DSA-TDB's schema and attribute design, and recommend a schema that is differentiated by service type with more mandatory attributes derived inductively from platform governance language.

</details>


### [621] [Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26215)
*Ghulam Mudassir,Hameed Ullah Khan,Ahmad Sami Al-Shamayleh,Muhammad Faizan Khan,Muhammad Muqtasid,Moamin Abughazala,Adnan Akhunzada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇系统性文献综述，聚焦医疗疾病检测中AI偏见（算法偏见、人口统计偏见、模型偏见、部署偏见）的识别与缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在医疗检测中应用广泛，但医疗数据复杂性与诊断图像体量增长带来计算挑战；同时AI模型中的偏见问题影响诊断公平性，需要系统梳理现有识别与缓解偏见的研究现状。

Method: 系统综述方法：从7个数字图书馆检索64,389篇文献，时间范围为2015—2026年，筛选出23篇相关研究；按输入数据类型、模型架构与偏见类型（算法偏见、人口统计偏见、模型偏见、部署偏见）对解决方案进行分类比较。

Result: 归纳了23项入选研究的现状，揭示了AI医疗诊断偏见研究中的显著空白，并据此得出关于现有方法总体特征的结论。

Conclusion: 未来研究应优先关注可解释性、数据多样性、算法设计的公平性以及受影响患者群体的公平可及性，从而更有效利用医疗资源。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has several transformative effects on healthcare, like to facilitate clinicians in disease detection and to manage patient care with enhanced precision. Due to the increasing complexity of medical data and the growing volume of diagnostic images, the substantial computational power needed to process such information creates both opportunities and challenges. To accomplish this objective, numerous methodologies have been proposed to integrate AI into disease detection systems. All these methodologies consider different aspects of clinical diagnosis, considering key parameters such as the type of AI model employed, the nature of input data, and the population demographics being analysed. In this paper, we review different state-of-the-art techniques which have been proposed for various areas of disease detection, specifically focusing on bias identification and mitigation. The proposed solutions are distinguished based on the type of input data they utilize, the architecture of model, and type of bias (algorithmic bias, demographic bias, model bias, and deployment bias). The time frame chosen to filter out relevant studies is between 2015 and 2026. Eventually, we review 23 related articles out of 64,389 analyzed from seven different digital libraries. The obtained results guide us to reach a conclusion with respect to state-of-the-art selected studies. Furthermore, these results reveal significant research gaps that can assist researchers in addressing AI-related bias in medical diagnosis. By prioritizing explainability, data diversity, and fairness in algorithmic design, as well as equitable access for affected patient populations, they can utilize available healthcare resources more effectively.

</details>


### [622] [CARRS: A Constraint-Aware, Real-Time Routing System for Emergency Vehicles in Urban Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26346)
*Vincent Sello,Timothy Adeliyi,Ridewaan Hanslo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出约束感知实时路径系统CARRS，将A*、Dijkstra、双向A*与约束满足问题(CSP)方法融合，基于OSM城市路网和动态交通仿真评估，实现35秒内生成最优路径、20秒内增量重路由、车辆约束遵守率超90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 警车、消防车、救护车等应急车辆需在最短时间内抵达生命攸关事件现场，但城市交通的动态性导致严重延误；传统民用导航系统无法同时兼顾实时交通变化与车辆特定约束，导致路径方案不适配。

Method: 采用设计科学研究方法论(DSRM)，以原型迭代为开发过程；构建统一软件架构CARRS，将经典寻路算法(A*、Dijkstra、双向A*)与约束满足问题(CSP)方法融合；使用OpenStreetMap主要都市路网数据结合模拟动态交通场景进行实证评估，指标包括路径最优性、约束遵守率、重路由响应性和可扩展性潜力。

Result: 系统可在35秒内为运行相关的子图生成最优路径；增量重路由响应时间低于20秒；车辆特定约束遵守率超过90%，证明该架构可满足实时动态路径需求。

Conclusion: 研究提供了一个衔接AI驱动优化与软件工程运行合规的路径平台，是面向动态城市环境自适应应急车辆协调的务实变革性步骤。

Abstract: Emergency vehicles such as police vehicles, fire engines, and ambulances require a stable and efficient route optimization to reach life-critical events in the shortest times possible. However, the dynamic nature of urban traffic makes this ideal scenario much more challenging, causing critical life-threatening delays. Traditional civilian navigation systems cannot account for real-time traffic changes alongside vehicle-specific constraints, creating inadequate routing scenarios. This research presents the Constraint-Aware Real-Time Routing System (CARRS), a unified software architecture tailored for emergency coordination. The CARRS architecture is engineered to fuse together classical pathfinding algorithms such as A*, Dijkstra, and Bidirectional A*, with Constraint Satisfaction Problem methodologies. The Design Science Research Methodology is the research framework, and prototyping is the iterative process. The artifact was empirically evaluated using OpenStreetMap data for major metropolitan road networks, combined with simulated dynamic traffic scenarios. Performance metrics focused on route optimality, constraint adherence, rerouting responsiveness, and the potential for future system scalability. Findings revealed the system's capability to generate optimal routes for operationally relevant subgraphs in under 35 seconds, with incremental rerouting responsiveness below 20 seconds. Furthermore, the system achieved more than 90% adherence to vehicle-specific constraints, making the CARRS architecture viable for real-time dynamic routing requirements. This study delivers a routing platform that bridges artificial intelligence-driven optimization with software engineering operational compliance, presenting a practical transformative step toward adaptive emergency vehicle coordination in dynamic urban environments.

</details>


### [623] [Global probabilistic forecasting of air pollution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25941)
*Ammar Kheder,Michael Boy,Zhi-song Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Foehn——一个生成式PM2.5预报模型，从全球公里尺度PM2.5估计中学习并计算气团来源，在多数站点上超越业务预报，并能以公里尺度、校准良好的集合预报提前四天探测局地污染极端。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PM2.5短期暴露每年造成约百万人死亡，但现有业务预报网格达数十公里，掩盖了近两亿人每日所呼吸空气的污染水平；机器学习虽已革新天气预报，却仍抹平空气污染极值、且随气团输送距离增加而丧失预报技巧。

Method: 提出生成式模型Foehn，基于全球公里尺度PM2.5估计数据进行学习，并在建模中显式刻画气团来源（where the air comes from），以集合形式输出公里尺度预报。

Result: 在为期一年的回溯预报中，Foehn在四分之三（three in four）的站点上优于业务预报，并能预报隐藏暴露尺度上的污染；其集合预报经过校准，集合均值提前四天探测局地污染极值的效果可与业务预报提前一天相当。

Conclusion: 公里尺度污染预报可警示被粗分辨率地图遗漏的数百万人，前提是公里尺度数据能够实时可得。

Abstract: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) refers to particulate matter with an aerodynamic diameter of 2.5 micrometre or less. It comes from human activities, such as traffic and industry, and from wildfires, desert dust and gases emitted by vegetation. Short-term exposure to it accounts for about a million deaths a year. Operational forecasts run on grids tens of kilometres wide, which hide the pollution breathed by nearly two hundred million people a day. Machine learning has transformed weather forecasting, but data-driven forecasts of air pollution still blur extremes and lose skill as the air travels. Here we introduce Foehn, a generative model that learns from global kilometre-scale estimates of PM2.5 and computes where the air comes from. Over a year of retrospective forecasts, it outperforms the operational forecast at three stations in four and forecasts at the scale of this hidden exposure. Its ensembles are calibrated, and their mean detects local pollution extremes four days ahead as well as the operational forecast does one day ahead. Such forecasts could warn the millions whom coarse maps miss, once kilometre-scale data are available in real time.

</details>


### [624] [Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25858)
*Xiaoyin Chen,Yizheng Huang,Yinglun Xu,Ziyun Zhao,Emmett McQuinn,Julie Liu,Hope Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文研究非参数化自演化智能体（权重冻结，仅改写提示、记忆与技能）能否胜任持续学习，并在四个漂移任务流上评估 ReasoningBank、GEPA、Meta-Harness，发现自演化虽提升总体性能，但可塑性提升始终以稳定性为代价，现有自演化智能体尚不是完整的持续学习器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体部署环境中新知识、工具与工作流持续到来，要求其在不遗忘旧任务的前提下持续适配新任务，即持续学习；但传统梯度更新难以跟上这种节奏，因此需要考察非参数化自演化智能体是否是可用的替代方案。

Method: 构建四个随主题、工作流或领域漂移的任务流（基于 BIRD、BFCL、ScienceWorld），对三类代表性方法进行评测：基于经验检索的 ReasoningBank，以及基于自我修改的 GEPA 与 Meta-Harness；这些方法均冻结模型权重，仅通过任务反馈改写提示、记忆与技能等 harness。

Result: 在多数任务流上自演化提升了聚合性能，但可塑性提升一致地以牺牲稳定性为代价：自我修改方法对共享提示或工作区做全局编辑，干扰未见任务，并随任务流漂移覆盖早期知识；基于相似度的记忆检索能在远距离领域间实现局部化更新，但在未见任务上仍会检索到外来记忆，且在相似查询需要冲突工作流时出现检索碰撞。

Conclusion: 当前自演化智能体仍是不完整的持续学习器，可塑性与稳定性的权衡尚未解决。

Abstract: Large language model agents are often deployed in environments where new knowledge, tools, and workflows keep arriving. Such an agent is therefore expected to adapt continually, learning new tasks as they arrive without forgetting earlier ones. This resembles the continual learning problem, but at a pace that conventional gradient updates cannot sustain. Nonparametric self-evolving agents are a natural alternative: they adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen. We study whether such agents are effective continual learners across four drifting task streams that shift in topic, workflow, or domain (built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld). Evaluating three representative methods spanning experience retrieval and self-modification (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness), we find that although self-evolution improves aggregate performance on most streams, higher plasticity consistently comes at the cost of stability. Specifically, self-modifying methods apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts. Conversely, similarity-based memory retrieval localizes updates across distant domains, but still retrieves foreign memories on unseen tasks and suffers from retrieval collision when similar queries require conflicting workflows. These findings show that current self-evolving agents remain incomplete continual learners.

</details>


### [625] [SAR: Learning Global Item-Space Matching and Geometry-Aware Placement Ranking for Buffered Online 3D Bin Packing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25795)
*Xinpeng Lei,Jin Zhang,Yizhe Yang,Yihong Duan,Fucheng Wan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Spatial Affordance Retrieval (SAR)框架，将在线3D装箱中"物品选择"与"摆放评估"之间的空间推理分工显式解耦：体素-令牌空间编码器驱动的picker做全局物品-空间匹配，几何感知的loader对可行候选排序，两阶段在共享长时回报下联合优化。随机/JD/SF数据集上无缓冲(K=1)时利用率较最强在线基线提升0.96–4.20个百分点，K=5时最佳利用率分别达93.55%、91.04%、90.41%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线3D装箱在有界缓冲下需在未知未来到达的条件下做不可逆的选择与放置决策，仅保证可行性不足——不同可行动作会产生不同的剩余空间结构与后续装箱机会。核心架构问题是如何在"物品选择"与"摆放评估"之间分配空间推理能力。

Method: 1) 体素-令牌空间编码器表示3D容器占据状态，使picker无需物品特定的摆放提案即可将缓冲物品与残余空间匹配；2) 选定物品后，loader基于候选几何、局部几何特征(LGF)与候选间比较，对可行旋转-位置候选排序，且不直接访问全局空间令牌；3) 可行候选集作为两阶段的连接接口；4) 两阶段在共享长时装箱回报下联合优化。

Result: Random、JD、SF数据集上，最佳SAR变体在无缓冲(K=1)设置下利用率较最强在线基线提升0.96–4.20个百分点；有缓冲(K=5)时最佳利用率分别达93.55%、91.04%、90.41%。消融实验支持全局物品-空间匹配与几何感知摆放评估的互补作用；反事实分析表明学习到的物品选择偏向更高的未来装箱潜力；实验验证与多种候选生成器兼容。

Conclusion: 显式的空间推理分工——全局物品-空间匹配交由picker、细粒度几何评估交由loader——是有效的架构设计，两阶段通过可行候选集耦合并在共享回报下协同优化，可提升在线3D装箱的利用率与前瞻性，且对候选生成器具通用性。

Abstract: Online 3D bin packing with a bounded buffer requires irreversible item-selection and placement decisions under limited knowledge of future arrivals. Feasibility alone is insufficient, as feasible actions can produce different residual-space structures and subsequent packing opportunities. A central architectural question is how to allocate spatial reasoning between item selection and placement evaluation. We propose Spatial Affordance Retrieval (SAR), a novel learning-based framework that coordinates global item-space matching with geometry-aware placement ranking. A voxel-token spatial encoder represents 3D container occupancy, enabling a picker to match buffered items to the residual space without requiring item-specific placement proposals as inputs. After item selection, a loader ranks feasible rotation-position candidates using candidate geometry, local geometric features (LGF), and inter-candidate comparison, without directly accessing global spatial tokens. The feasible candidate set connects the two stages, which are jointly optimized under a shared long-horizon packing return. On the Random, JD, and SF datasets, the best SAR variants improve utilization over the strongest evaluated online baselines by 0.96-4.20 percentage points under the no-buffer setting (K=1). With a buffer (K=5), the best utilization rates across SAR variants reach 93.55%, 91.04%, and 90.41%, respectively. Ablations support the complementary roles of global item-space matching and geometry-aware placement evaluation, counterfactual analysis suggests that learned item selection favors greater future packing potential, and experiments demonstrate compatibility with multiple candidate generators.

</details>


### [626] [CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26071)
*Zhanhui Zhou,Weichen Zhang,Haoran Liu,Lingjie Chen,Tianneng Shi,Kevin Lin,Zhengyuan Yang,Lijuan Wang,Dawn Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CUA-Lite 是一个面向计算机使用智能体（CUA）的开放平台，通过统一环境接口、统一监督数据格式与跨评估/RL/SFT 共享的模型 harness 三大标准化抽象，整合 12 个基准、3 万余可验证任务与 14 个模型家族，解决资源分散与基础设施割裂问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 CUA 的开放资源（环境、数据集、模型）高度分散，缺乏统一标准导致难以集成与规模化；同时评估、强化学习与监督微调各自为政，无法共享同一套基础设施。

Method: 围绕三项标准化抽象构建平台：(1) 统一环境接口，整合桌面、浏览器、移动端共 12 个基准，并提供免虚拟机的轻量沙箱以低成本复现 OSWorld 桌面，累计超过 30,000 个可验证任务；(2) 统一监督数据格式，将主流公开 CUA 数据集（从 GUI grounding/理解到完整 rollout）及前沿 CUA 在新环境上的新采集轨迹统一转换；(3) 每个模型一套、覆盖 14 个模型家族的共享 harness，用于在环境中运行模型产出 rollout 供评估和 RL 使用，或将监督数据渲染为模型自身训练格式供 SFT。

Result: 发布了各整合基准的参考分数；实验表明，通过同一 harness 进行 RL 与 SFT 均能提升开放权重模型的表现。

Conclusion: 平台以标准化抽象统一了 CUA 的环境、数据与训练/评估流程，验证了评估—RL—SFT 共享基础设施的可行性；数据集、代码与模型均已开源，并开放社区贡献。

Abstract: Open resources for computer use agents (CUAs) -- environments, datasets, and models -- remain scattered: without a standard, these resources cannot be integrated and scaled; additionally, evaluation, RL, and SFT cannot share one infrastructure. We present CUA-Lite, an open platform for developing CUAs, built around three standardized abstractions: (1) Unified environment interface, under which we integrate 12 benchmarks across desktop, browser, and mobile, plus lightweight VM-free sandboxes that replicate OSWorld's desktop at much lower cost, providing over 30,000 verifiable tasks. (2) Unified supervised data format, into which we convert the major public CUA datasets, from GUI grounding and understanding to full rollouts, and record our fresh rollouts from frontier CUAs on these verifiable environments. (3) Model harnesses shared across evaluation, RL, and SFT, one per model and implemented for 14 model families. Each harness runs its model in these computer environments, producing the rollouts that evaluation and RL consume, or renders stored supervised data into the model's own training format for SFT. We release reference scores across the integrated benchmarks, and show that RL and SFT through the same harness improve open-weight models. We release our dataset, code, and models, and the platform is open to contributions.

</details>


### [627] [FinSafeGuard: A Quality-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Financial AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26066)
*Joseph Thomas Thacil,Reetu Raj Harsh,Krati Saxena,Bhaskarjit Sarmah,Stefano Pasquali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套四阶段合成数据生成流程，从63.2万条场景规格的结构化分类体系出发，经预生成参数研究、条件自动演化、两层语义去重与LLM评审质量过滤，将2640万原始样本压缩为1430万高质量训练样本，并在银行、保险、金融服务三领域验证了去重与批次多样性规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据稀缺领域训练专用AI系统时，大规模高质量合成数据集生成仍是基础性难题，核心痛点在于合成数据的质量、多样性与真实性难以兼顾，且缺乏可控、可复现的质量保障框架。

Method: 基于63.2万条场景规格构建结构化分类体系，设计四阶段流水线：(1) 预生成研究，通过收益递减分析确定最优生成参数；(2) 条件自动演化机制，在生成过程中修复低多样性的批次；(3) 两层语义去重架构，结合词法匹配与嵌入向量方法；(4) 以LLM-as-Judge进行质量评估，依据行为正确性与元组保真度筛选样本。同时开展批次规模优化，识别各生成模式下的多样性饱和阈值。

Result: 三个领域（银行、保险、金融服务）的去重率呈领域特异性，介于9.9%至40.6%，其中输出生成模式的冗余度最高。通过合并（降低20.9%）、语义去重（降低18.7%）与质量过滤（降低15.9%）三级处理，2640万原始样本最终得到1430万高置信度样本。批次规模优化揭示了模式特异的多样性饱和阈值，可支撑有原则的配额分配策略。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一套可复现、具备严格质量控制且面向特定领域的合成数据生成框架，将参数调优、多样性修复、语义去重与LLM质量评审系统化整合，为数据稀缺场景下的大规模合成数据构建提供了可操作范式。

Abstract: Generating high-quality synthetic datasets at scale remains a fundamental challenge for training specialized AI systems in data-scarce domains. We present a comprehensive methodology that produces 14.3 million quality-filtered synthetic training examples from a structured taxonomy of 632,000 scenario specifications. Our four-stage pipeline ad- dresses critical challenges in synthetic data quality, diversity, and realism through: (1) systematic pre-generation research establishing optimal generation parameters via diminishing returns analysis, (2) conditional auto evolution mechanisms that remediate low-diversity batches during generation, (3) a two-layer semantic deduplication architecture combining lexical and embedding-based methods, and (4) LLM-as-Judge quality evaluation filtering samples based on behavioral correctness and tuple fidelity. Empirical analysis across three domains (Banking, Insurance, Financial Services) demonstrates domain-specific deduplication patterns ranging from 9.9% to 40.6%, with output generation modes exhibiting highest redundancy. Our batch size optimization reveals mode-specific diversity saturation thresholds, enabling principled allocation strategies. The complete pipeline reduces 26.4M raw samples to 14.3M high-confidence examples through merge (20.9% reduction), semantic deduplication (18.7% reduction), and quality-based filtering (15.9% reduction), providing a reproducible framework for domain-specific synthetic data generation with rigorous quality control.

</details>


### [628] [Procedural Memory for Language Agents: A Neurosymbolic Perspective on Explicit Goal Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25996)
*Jonathan Leung,Zhiqi Shen,Deheng Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出大模型在长程任务上不可靠的关键原因是缺乏显式过程性记忆，主张用目标导向图（Goal-Oriented Graphs）作为可检查的符号化过程记忆表示，并讨论其构建、挑战及与神经推理融合的原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在需要过程性推理的长程任务中仍不可靠；作者归因于缺少显式过程性记忆，即关于"任务如何完成"的可访问、可修改的知识，并将其与语义记忆、情节记忆区分开。

Method: 概念性/立场性分析：以目标导向图（Goal-Oriented Graphs）作为过程性记忆表示，将目标及前置依赖编码为可检查的符号结构；考察其构建方式、带来的挑战，以及与神经推理集成的设计原则。

Result: 摘要未给出实验结果或定量评估，仅提出分析框架与设计主张。

Conclusion: 显式过程性记忆可能是提升长程任务可靠性的关键补充；目标导向图提供了一种可检验的符号化载体，但其构建方法与神经-符号融合仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Large language models remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks requiring procedural reasoning. We argue that a key cause is the absence of explicit procedural memory: accessible, modifiable knowledge of how tasks are accomplished, distinct from semantic and episodic memory. Goal-Oriented Graphs offer such a representation, encoding goals and prerequisite dependencies as inspectable symbolic structure. We examine their construction, the challenges they pose, and principles for integrating them with neural reasoning.

</details>


### [629] [Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25553)
*Carlos André Antunes,Aldry Albuquerque,Gabriel de Melo Schmith,Natã Batista,Pedro Oziel Escobar da Silva,Stefano Benko Rossi,Lingrid Dietrich Lorenz da Silva,Flávia Cristina da Costa,Thiago Bertotto,Luis Fernando Fausto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Narrow Decision Model (NDM)：与通用的System One模型相对，NDM面向单一组织的决策、可在自有基础设施上运行、架构开放可测试；将请求序列化为前缀树并用块注意力双向编码器，使答案对选项顺序不变且与其它问题独立，以Choice组合实现组织架构路由；通过对齐公开与虚构数据的验证，不变性、泛化路由与更优损失得到支持，真实法律文档上与生产LLM分类器一致率91%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One类模型（如Jev）以校准概率回答类型化问题（Choice/Score/Noul）而非生成文本，且通用、仅通过请求适配领域。作者希望研究设计空间的另一端：组织专用的窄域决策模型，规模小、可自托管、架构开放且性质可陈述与检验，并以法院通信路由为运行场景。

Method: 将请求序列化为前缀树（状态→每个问题→每个选项），在带逻辑位置的块注意力掩码下运行双向编码器，从而在构造上保证答案对选项顺序不变、且独立于其它问题。组织架构路由由带显式“none of these”选项的Choice决策复合而成。训练采用proper scoring rules与课程学习，并涉及校准与弃答、基于rubric的决策复合，以及在接受留出数据前对机制做接受/拒绝的协议。

Result: 在公开与虚构数据上的最小验证显示：训练后模型的不变性在舍入误差内成立；小规模实例在未见过的组织架构上路由显著优于词法检索；同等算力下块架构损失低于成对cross-encoder。基于真实法律文档训练的首个实例在留出文档上与生产LLM分类器一致率达91%。

Conclusion: NDM可行：以开放、可检验的块注意力架构与Choice复合，在小规模、自托管条件下实现校准的计算式决策，并在真实法律文书路由任务上接近生产LLM分类器性能。

Abstract: System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.

</details>


### [630] [Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26828)
*Zhaoyang Wang,Qianhui Wu,Haorui Wang,Simon Yu,Baolin Peng,Canwen Xu,Hao Cheng,Wenlin Yao,Boyi Liu,Yite Wang,Jianfeng Gao,Huaxiu Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 WildAWM 流水线，全开源模型合成同时支持 GUI、MCP 与 CLI 的可执行环境及长程任务，并用执行式质量门控保证可解性、难度与验证器可靠性；生成 341 个环境-任务对，训练出的 Qwen 模型在 8 个分布外基准上显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体学习范式正从“从人类数据学习”转向“在与世界交互中学习”，但在真实计算机系统中直接扩展此类学习困难且带来显著安全风险，因此需要可扩展、可控的合成环境与任务生成方案。

Method: 构建可执行环境，同时支持 GUI、模型上下文协议（MCP）服务与命令行界面（CLI），使智能体可灵活组合视觉交互、工具调用与代码执行；整个流水线完全由开源模型驱动。针对任务合成的三大难题（可解性、难度充分性、验证器可靠性），引入执行式质量门控：异构智能体轨迹采样（rollouts）、交叉评审一致性检查、以及对判断鲁棒性的反事实探测。

Result: 合成 341 个长程环境-任务对，部分任务需超过 100 步智能体操作，且对前沿模型仍有挑战（GPT-6-Astra 仅解出 60%）。仅在这些合成世界中训练两个不同规模的 Qwen 模型，均在覆盖 web、CLI（claw）与计算机使用智能体的 8 个分布外基准上取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 在 WildAWM 合成世界中的学习可广泛泛化到未见过的计算机使用任务；无需专有前沿模型即可生成高质量计算机使用环境；执行式质量门控可有效应对任务可解性、难度与验证可靠性问题。

Abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

</details>


### [631] [EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25931)
*Dastin Huang,Baran Nama,Salaheddin Alzubi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoSkill v2 是一个三智能体系统，通过改写智能体收到的指令（skills）而非改动模型与执行框架来提升性能；在 SpreadsheetBench v2 与 τ³-bench banking 上，其留出集通过率分别超过最优基线 7.7 与 5.4 个百分点，且单位提升成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能优化器主要有两种设计：SkillOpt 式的多次单模型调用序列，以及 SkillBoost 式的每轮重启智能体。二者均存在局限（如上下文不连续、易受噪声评分影响），作者希望验证一种全程保持状态、持续累积上下文的进化器设计能否带来更优的技能改写效果，并降低获得每单位性能提升的成本。

Method: 系统由三个智能体构成：(1) benchmark adaptor 将用户提供的基准描述与 grader 转为基准专用插件；(2) solver 尝试任务；(3) evolver 读取 solver 的训练 rollout 并在每轮 epoch 重写技能。evolver 被实现为单一有状态、全程持有 bash 工具的编码智能体。此外，方法上还测量 solver rollout 的跨尝试方差、为每个训练任务给 evolver 多次尝试机会，并接受每个 epoch 的技能而非基于噪声分数进行筛选。

Result: 在细粒度真值下，相对 SkillOpt 与 SkillBoost 中较强者，EvoSkill v2 训练的技能将留出集通过率在 SpreadsheetBench v2 上提升 7.7 个百分点、在 τ³-bench banking 上提升 5.4 个百分点；在两个基准、两种反馈设定下，其 evolver 获得每百分点留出集通过率的成本均低于两个基线的优化器。此外，较弱模型也能自我改进技能：由 Claude Haiku 5.5 同时充当 solver 与 evolver 的 τ³-bench banking 实验中，提升最高达 21.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: 保持状态、持续累积上下文的单一编码智能体式 evolver，配合多次尝试与无筛选的 epoch 技能接受策略，能在不改动模型与执行框架的前提下显著且低成本地提升智能体任务表现，并可让能力较弱的模型实现自我技能改进。

Abstract: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch. We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. With fine-grained ground truth, EvoSkill v2's skills raised the held-out pass rate above the stronger of SkillOpt and SkillBoost by 7.7 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and by 5.4 on $τ^3$-bench banking. In both benchmarks and both feedback settings, EvoSkill v2's evolver cost less per percentage point of held-out pass rate gained than either baseline's optimizer. EvoSkill v2 also enables a less capable model to improve its own skills, demonstrated by a gain of up to 21.5 percentage points in the $τ^3$-bench banking experiment where Claude Haiku 5.5 powers both solver and evolver.

</details>


### [632] [VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26342)
*Ruotian Peng,Yuanyi Ren,Shuaiqi Liu,Xin Guo,Fang Zhu,Yangyi Huang,Yue Wu,Zheng Wang,Yandong Wen,Zhihang Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VibeTraining-Bench基准，用于评估研究型智能体的"跨组件协同设计"能力，即联合优化训练数据、训练器与推理框架以实现递归自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体能诊断系统瓶颈并在训练与推理间协调改进，但缺乏衡量智能体联合优化数据、训练器、推理框架（cross-component co-design）能力的统一评测平台。

Method: 构建覆盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具使用、数学推理四类任务的基准。每个任务中研究型智能体在固定资源预算下从相同初始系统出发，依据验证反馈迭代改进数据、训练器和推理框架，再选择并提交最终系统在测试集上评测；采用测试数据隔离、研究与评分容器分离、研究智能体网络限制三项防作弊措施。

Result: 前沿研究型智能体可显著提升目标系统性能，如SWE-bench Verified上GPT-6-Astra将目标智能体从32.9%提升至53.7%，接近人工开发的 instruct 模型55.4%；但在跨组件协同设计与迭代精炼以实现累积增益方面仍有改进空间。

Conclusion: VibeTraining-Bench可作为推进RSI、深化智能体系统跨组件优化理解的统一平台，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.

</details>


### [633] [Whose Credential Is It? How Owner Attribution in Agent MemoryShapes Cross-User Account Misuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25707)
*Hau-Sing So,Daixian Liu,Carl Hou,Yuhaohang He,Mengzhu Wang,Hai-Tao Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出三阶段审计框架区分"暴露—行为—状态"三类事件，发现共享长期记忆的LLM智能体虽高频检索到他人凭证（84.7%），但实际滥用罕见；仅在记忆缺失本用户凭证的压力测试中出现80–94%滥用，而在线内标注凭证归属可将滥用从305对中的92次降至1次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享长期记忆使单用户智能体可能检索到其他用户的凭证，但"检索到"与"造成实际危害"之间的关系不明，现有评估可能混淆暴露与真实有害行为，缺乏对危害链条的分层刻画。

Method: 在AppWorld中构建含763条跨用户历史登录记录的混合记忆库，设计三阶段审计：①外来凭证进入提示（exposure）；②智能体据此行动（behavior）；③受害者账户状态改变（state）。并进行"记忆缺失本用户凭证、仅提供单一外来凭证作为该用户记录"的压力测试；随后对比在凭证行前或行内标注所有者、无名字用户名、所有者绑定笔记等干预，测量配对运行中的滥用率与任务成功率，并检验错误所有者标注、尾部标签与附加安全指令的效果。

Result: 常规混合记忆下，84.7%的必需应用会检索到他人凭证，但智能体极少据此行动。压力测试中七个智能体在80–94%的运行中使用外来凭证，最高43%的运行改变了受害者账户，部分甚至通过官方检查。标注所有者后，滥用由305对配对运行中的92次降至1次，无名字用户名同样有效；但所有者绑定笔记在干净记忆上使每个模型损失3–5个成功任务。错误标注所有者大体恢复了滥用；尾部标签与附加安全指令仅对部分模型有效。

Conclusion: 智能体记忆应一致地记录凭证归属，评估应度量行为而非仅度量暴露；暴露率高不等于危害高，归属标注是低成本高收益的缓解手段，但其鲁棒性与任务成功率的权衡需进一步解决。

Abstract: Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.

</details>


### [634] [When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25827)
*Guanqun Jiang,Pengfei Cao,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"程序性幻觉"（procedural hallucination）概念，并构建 SourceClash 匹配基准（10个程序性领域、1,271个bundle、6,355条prompt），系统揭示当检索上下文部分与技能规范冲突时，模型会采纳冲突线索而产出"有检索支持但违反技能"的答案；机制分析定位到残差流中 value 向量通路是主要修复来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地使用 skill 提供可复用的指令与执行程序。选定相关 skill 后，模型需要将 skill 的支配性程序与检索到的任务上下文结合。当检索上下文有用但含有违反 skill 的线索时，模型应保留兼容信息、拒绝冲突线索。作者关注现有研究未充分刻画的一类失效：模型采纳冲突线索，给出有检索依据却违反 skill 的答案。为隔离"技能规范 vs 检索上下文"这一变量，需要构建受控匹配的基准。

Method: 构建 SourceClash 匹配基准：覆盖10个程序性领域，共1,271个bundle、6,355条prompt。每个bundle固定任务、skill 规范与答案空间，仅变化 skill 与检索之间的关系（冲突型检索 vs 两种支持型检索），从而实现控制变量对比。在9个模型上评测 valid-answer rate；对开源权重模型做机制分析，包括：答案偏好差随生成位置的动态分析、残差替换（residual replacement）实验、注意力分解（attention decomposition）归因，以及在识别出的 value 通路上的干预验证。

Result: 9个模型上，冲突型检索下有效答案率平均仅 25.7%，而两种支持型检索下分别为 78.2% 与 72.8%，落差显著。机制分析显示：答案偏好差通常在生成开始后不久达到峰值；残差替换可将模型推向有效答案；注意力分解表明修复主要归因于 value 向量；对识别出的 value 通路进行干预亦能提升最终答案有效性。

Conclusion: 部分冲突的检索上下文会显著破坏 skill 引导的生成，导致程序性幻觉。该失效在生成早期即已形成于答案偏好层面，并可通过 value 通路的残差替换与注意力干预加以修复，说明该现象具有可定位、可干预的机制基础，为提升 skill 遵循的鲁棒性提供了方向。

Abstract: Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. After a relevant skill has been selected, the model may need to apply its governing procedure together with retrieved task context. When the retrieved context is useful but contains cues that violate the skill, the model must retain compatible information while rejecting the conflicting cues. We study failures in which the model adopts such cues and produces a retrieval-supported but skill-invalid answer, which we call procedural hallucination. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.

</details>


### [635] [When the harness decides success: state that cannot be re-observed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26632)
*Raimondas Lencevicius*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文研究"智能体框架"（agent harness）对上下文的不同处理方式（丢弃旧轮次、摘要、回放自身推理）是否不仅影响成本，还影响任务成功率。通过预注册合成探测、ARC-AGI-3 组件消融与已发表运行再分析，作者给出三条发现：可重新获取事实时截断上下文几乎无损，不可再观测时成功率跌至随机水平（相差 92.5 个百分点）；摘要在保留记笔记邀请时可恢复 63 分差距中的 86%；Adapter 优势随关卡加深而扩大，但该现象主要由运行停止位置造成，无法区分"增长优势"与"恒定优势"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往对上下文管理策略的评估主要关注成本（token 消耗），而未系统考察这些策略是否改变智能体能否成功完成任务。作者希望在"成功率"而非"成本"这一维度上，检验上下文窗口管理决策的因果影响，并厘清基准中不同 harness 性能差距的具体来源。

Method: (1) 预注册合成探测：考察低成本推理模型在"事实可重新查找"与"事实不可再观测"两种条件下截断上下文窗口的后果，并在第二家提供商的模型上做预注册复制。(2) ARC-AGI-3 组件消融：针对单一模型、四个游戏，将 Standard harness 与 Provider Adapter harness 的差距逐组件拆解，分别测试"摘要替代丢弃""记笔记邀请""原生推理回放"的贡献。(3) 对基准已发表运行及自有运行进行再分析，考察 Adapter 在已到达关卡的过关概率优势随关卡深度的变化。

Result: 第一，事实可重新查找时截断上下文对成功率无损失（模型转而重新查询），不可再观测时成功率降至随机水平，两种惩罚相差 92.5 个百分点（90% CI [89.5, 95.5]），第二家提供商的模型复制出相同对比，且事实丢失后选择不作答而非猜测。第二，在 ARC-AGI-3 上，"摘要替代丢弃 + 保留记笔记邀请"在不回放推理的情况下恢复 63 分差距的 86%；去掉记笔记邀请仅恢复 43%；再加入提供商原生推理回放则恢复剩余 57%。第三，Adapter 在已到达关卡上的过关概率优势在深层关卡大于早期关卡，但该现象在很大程度上只是重述了运行的停止位置，无法区分优势是随深度增长还是恒定。

Conclusion: 上下文管理策略是成功率的影响因素而非仅是成本因素，其效应取决于关键信息是否可再次观测；harness 性能差距可被分解为摘要、外部记笔记与推理回放等可分离组件，其中记笔记邀请与摘要具有可观的独立贡献；关于"优势随关卡加深而扩大"的观察目前受停止位置混杂，需更严格控制的设计才能识别真实的深度依赖。作者同时提示 ARC-AGI-3 结果为单次计数运行的仅有单点估计。

Abstract: Agent harnesses decide what a language model sees across turns: they drop old turns, summarize them, or replay the model's own earlier reasoning. We ask when these choices change whether an agent succeeds, not only what it costs, and report three findings. First, in a pre-registered synthetic probe, truncating the context window costs a low-cost reasoning model nothing in success when a needed fact can be looked up again (it looks the fact up instead), but drops its success to chance when the fact cannot be re-observed: the two penalties differ by 92.5 percentage points (90% CI [89.5, 95.5]). A pre-registered replication on one model from a second provider showed the same contrast. Once the fact was lost, that model chose no answer rather than guessing. Second, on ARC-AGI-3, where the benchmark's Standard harness trails its Provider Adapter harness by a wide margin, we decompose that gap one component at a time, for one model on four games. Summarizing old turns instead of dropping them, while keeping the Standard harness's invitation to take notes, recovers 86% of a 63-point gap without replaying the model's reasoning. The same harness without the invitation recovers 43%, and adding the provider's native replay of the model's reasoning recovers the remaining 57%. These are point estimates from one counted run per configuration and game, and the replay share depends on a single run. Third, in the benchmark's published runs and in ours, the Adapter's advantage in the probability of clearing a level it has reached is larger at deep levels than at early ones. This largely restates where runs stopped and does not separate a growing advantage from a constant one.

</details>
