Abstract: Designing capable neural policies for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), which map local observations to action distributions, represents an important challenge in multi-agent learning, with practical relevance to scalable collective automation problems such as warehouse logistics. In contrast to prior studies focusing primarily on individual policy design, this study explores a meta-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach to learning-based MAPF. Specifically, given a collection of compact yet high-performing experts specialised for different map distributions, our architecture learns a router that selectively fuses their outputs according to each agent's local situation. We instantiate and validate this MoE approach with a commonly used graph neural network-based policy as well as a newly developed recursive action-token refinement model. Combined with supervised and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the experts, our experiments show that MoE generally improves upon the pretrained policy and outperforms existing leading methods. At the same time, our findings reveal that appropriately trained, parameter-matched monolithic models still outperform MoE, highlighting a nuanced role for map-distribution MoE for MAPF.

</details>


### [670] [Train An Imaginative Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26845)
*Jiaxin Ge,Junyi Zhang,Tianning Chai,Hanjun Yoo,Chenyang Wang,Xiuyu Li,Weijia Shi,XuDong Wang,Sewon Min,Luke Zettlemoyer,Trevor Darrell,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Agima 训练单一全模态模型“先想象后行动”：先预测动作后果并生成图像、再在想象未来上推理决策，结合 SFT 与智能体 RL，在 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman、PushT 上实现强泛化与稀疏反馈下的规划能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sokoban 中看似合理的推动可能使关卡不可解，智能体需在执行前预判后果，尤其在真实环境反馈稀疏或动作不可逆时；需要让智能体具备“想象”能力以避免不可逆错误。

Method: 提出 Agima 训练框架：用单个全模态模型同时承担策略提议、结果图像生成与想象未来推理；不锁定单一计划，而是模拟动作序列、探索分支并比较多种可能未来。第一阶段用 SFT 统一策略与世界建模，获得前向思考与反事实分支能力；第二阶段用智能体式强化学习（agentic RL）训练其如何用想象未来进行推理与规划。

Result: 在 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman、PushT 四类环境上泛化到训练未见过的更难设定；仅在双箱 Sokoban 上做 SFT 时，Agima 在每五步才观测一次真实棋盘的条件下解出 40% 的四箱谜题，而纯动作规划器仅 2%。RL 后涌现新行为：形成 SFT 阶段未见过的统一格式、仅在必要时进行前向思考、在关键决策点更频繁分支。

Conclusion: 能够描绘动作后果的智能体可以学会何时、何处进行前瞻，即学会规划；想象能力与智能体 RL 结合可在稀疏反馈与不可逆动作下显著提升决策可靠性。

Abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

</details>


### [671] [Revision-Based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26636)
*Jiawen Li,Chenming Ge,Alice Gao,Rishab Vempati,Yi-Hao Peng,Jason Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RELIEF：利用对生成界面的交互反馈，由编码代理修订界面，再把改进回填到原生成轨迹中构造微调监督信号，以提升代码生成模型产出交互界面的可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成模型越来越多用于生成网站、用户界面等交互式产物，但界面是否有用往往只有经过真实交互才能体现，这类属性难以纳入模型训练。

Method: RELIEF（基于修订的交互经验与反馈学习）：用编码代理对生成界面进行修订，将改进后的结果并入原始生成轨迹，形成微调监督数据。评估上构建了 200 个合成网站、355 条交互记录及 24 名用户反馈的数据集，并分别以代码审查、自动化交互、显式人类反馈、人类交互记录四类批评信号微调两种代码生成模型的变体。

Result: 反馈的有效性随基座模型能力而变化；在所测试模型下，由人类交互记录推断出的批评信号带来的整体可用性提升最大。

Conclusion: 将交互反馈通过“代理修订—轨迹回填”的方式转化为监督信号，是提升代码生成模型界面可用性的可行路径；不同类型反馈的收益依赖于基座模型能力，人类交互记录类反馈最具价值。

Abstract: Code generation models are increasingly used to produce interactive artifacts, such as websites and user interfaces. Many properties that determine whether these interfaces are useful only become apparent through realistic interaction, making them difficult to incorporate into model training. In this paper, we introduce RELIEF (REvision-based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback), a method for improving code generation models using feedback on their generated interfaces. RELIEF uses a coding agent to revise these interfaces, then incorporates the improvements into their original generation traces to produce supervision for fine-tuning. To evaluate RELIEF, we collected a dataset of 200 synthetically generated websites paired with 355 interaction recordings and accompanying feedback from 24 users. We used critiques derived from code inspection, automated interaction, explicit human feedback, and human interaction recordings to fine-tune variants of two code generation models. Our results show that feedback effectiveness varies with base model capabilities, with critiques inferred from human interaction recordings leading to the largest usability improvements overall under our tested models.

</details>


### [672] [Selective Transfer through Sequence Distillation: From Benchmark Knowledge to Backdoor Behaviour](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26311)
*Jonibek Mansurov,Sholpan Bolatzhanova,Filbert Aurelian Tjiaranta,Vallerie Alexandara Putra,Alham Fikri Aji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 知识蒸馏对不同隐属性具有选择性：基准知识可通过全部四种蒸馏通道传递（甚至仅凭数字序列），而拒绝后门几乎不随序列蒸馏传递，仅logit蒸馏可传递（触发拒绝率达85.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明蒸馏不仅传递能力，还会传递教师模型非预期的属性；但尚不清楚不同隐属性在同一条蒸馏通道下的存活情况是否存在差异，因此作者系统比较两类属性。

Method: 对比两类教师隐属性：(1) 在基准数据上微调获得的benchmark相关知识与(2) 拒绝后门。测试四种蒸馏通道，包括仅使用教师生成、不含自然语言与领域内容的纯数字序列进行序列蒸馏，以及基于logit的蒸馏，并测量学生模型的属性继承程度。

Result: 基准知识在所有四种通道下均成功传递，包括学生仅见无自然语言/领域内容的数字序列时；拒绝后门在序列蒸馏下几乎完全不传递，而logit蒸馏可显著传递，学生在零后门样本情况下触发拒绝率达85.5%，被后门教师本身接近完美触发拒绝。

Conclusion: 蒸馏是选择性的，其选择标准不是学生所见数据的形态，而是教师属性的内部结构；这提示防御蒸馏泄漏需针对属性结构而非仅控制训练数据。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation is widely used to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models, but recent work shows that it can also transfer unintended teacher properties. We study whether different hidden teacher properties survive the same distillation channels. Specifically, we compare two properties: benchmark-associated knowledge and refusal backdoors, and show that distillation treats them very differently. Teachers fine-tuned on benchmark data successfully pass that knowledge to students through all four distillation channels we test, including when students are trained only on teacher-generated number sequences containing no natural language or domain content whatsoever. Refusal backdoors tell the opposite story: backdoored teachers achieve near-perfect triggered refusal, yet sequence-distilled students inherit essentially none of this behaviour. Logit-based distillation transfers it substantially, reaching up to 85.5\% triggered refusal in students that saw zero backdoor examples. Distillation is therefore selective, and the selection criterion is not what data the student sees, but what structure the teacher's property has. The code is available at https://github.com/MJonibek/kd-leakage.

</details>


### [673] [The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26324)
*Saad Naja,Nasser Odtallah,Jake Van-Praag,Sarah May*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究测试了四个AI交易代理是否遵守策略与风控规则，发现规则依从性高（97.5%毛亏损控制在声明止损内），但盈利性与运气难分，呼吁将"纪律"作为给代理资金前的前置检验而非唯一检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交易纪律常常失效；在赋予AI交易代理实质自主权或资金之前，缺乏证据区分"遵守规则"与"运气"，因此需要证据与方法论工具来评估代理的纪律性。

Method: 分析2026年2月12日至8月27日的2,627个已平仓头寸，资产池与执行条件一致；多数为对实时价格的模拟（0.09%往返费用），18%为真实Hyperliquid订单。每个头寸须声明策略、止损与目标，每代理最多5个未平仓头寸。检验规则依从性、止损执行、风险稳定性、仓位限制及市场回撤（29%）下的表现，并提供可复现的贸易快照与工具包。

Result: 组合费后净为正；四个代理（含亏损者）规则依从性均高；盈利能力与相对盈亏平衡胜率挂钩；97.5%毛亏损落在声明止损内，典型亏损在声明水平平仓；亏损后风险水平稳定，平静与波动月份间大体稳定；24次运行中23次遵守仓位限制（例外情况在日志中记录规模与时长）。

Conclusion: 四代理纪律均成立；但贸易级结果不等于账户级收益，也不构成持久优势的证明。所提供评估工具包可帮助交易者在投入资金前区分"守规"与"运气"——对考虑向代理配置资金者，纪律应作为入场检验，而非唯一检验。

Abstract: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and recovery, with documented exceptions. The discipline held for all four agents. Agents kept 97.5% of gross loss within declared stops, and typical losses closed at declared levels. Declared risk remained stable after losses and broadly stable across calm and volatile months. Twenty-three of 24 runs respected the position limit; logs identify the exception's size and duration. The same live data produced different results across assigned strategies. The trade-log tests can be rerun from the published trade snapshot; regime tests also require the published Bitcoin prices and regime labels. Section 3.5 specifies the stop-breach tolerance. These trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge. Our study provides an evaluation toolkit to help traders distinguish rule-following from luck before committing capital. For anyone considering allocating capital to agents to trade, discipline should be the entry test, not the only test.

</details>


### [674] [REFLEX: RNA Ensemble Generation via Flexibility-Calibrated Stochastic Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26261)
*Wanli Ma,Tianmeng Hu,Ke Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: REFLEX是一种序列条件驱动的RNA骨架构象集成生成器，基于SE(3)上的异方差随机桥，用实验B因子校准桥宽度以兼顾构象多样性与结构保真度，推理时仅需输入序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RNA通过多种实验观测的构象状态发挥功能，核心挑战在于捕捉集成多样性而不牺牲结构保真度：现有采样方法易塌缩至平均代表结构，或漂移至无支持（不合理）的构象区域。

Method: 提出REFLEX（由FLEXibility校准的RNA集成生成）。构建基于SE(3)骨架坐标系的异方差随机桥生成模型；训练时以实验B因子校准逐残基的桥宽度，通过残基特异尺度的局部扰动邻域暴露每个观测构象，受限区域保持更尖锐的分布；学习到的柔性条件引导桥场网络从校准后噪声状态恢复目标构象特异骨架；推理阶段仅使用输入序列，无需MSA子采样启发式。

Result: 在多构象RNA基准上，REFLEX在各评估阈值下取得最佳的精度-召回权衡（集成覆盖）；恢复-扰动消融表明在更强扰动下目标骨架恢复性能提升。

Conclusion: 以实验柔性（B因子）校准的SE(3)随机桥框架可有效生成兼具多样性与保真度的RNA构象集成，并免除对MSA子采样的依赖，为RNA动态结构建模提供了简洁有效的方案。

Abstract: RNA molecules often function through multiple experimentally observed conformational states. A central challenge is to capture ensemble diversity without sacrificing structural fidelity: samples may collapse toward averaged representative structures or drift into unsupported conformational regions. We introduce REFLEX (RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility), a sequence-conditioned generator for RNA backbone-frame ensembles based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3). During training, experimental B-factors calibrate residue-wise bridge widths, exposing each observed conformer through local perturbation neighborhoods with residue-specific scales while keeping constrained regions sharper. A learned flexibility condition guides the bridge-field network to recover target conformer-specific frames from these calibrated noisy states. At inference, REFLEX uses only the input sequence, requiring no MSA-subsampling heuristics. On a multi-conformer RNA benchmark, REFLEX achieves the best precision-recall trade-off for ensemble coverage across evaluation thresholds, while recovery-stress ablations indicate gains in target-frame recovery under stronger perturbations.

</details>


### [675] [LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Refuse More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26211)
*Anastasiia Kucherenko,Francois Brouchoud,Dimitri Percia David,Andrei Kucharavy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在合法的法律任务提示前加上"我是律师/法律顾问"等权威身份前缀，会显著提高小参数开源本地模型的拒答率（2–20倍），造成不平等的辅助可及性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律行业出于保密要求倾向使用本地部署的小型开源LLM处理摘要、翻译、改写等日常工作；用户按常规提示习惯会自报身份（"我是律师……"）。作者关注这种看似无害的习惯是否带来隐性成本与偏见。

Method: 在四款现代小型开源权重LLM上，对良性法律领域提示进行评测，比较无前缀基线与权威式身份前缀（如"我是某最高法院的法律顾问""我是辩护律师"）以及一种已知角色扮演越狱前缀下的拒答率。

Result: 权威式前缀使拒答率相对无前缀基线系统性上升2–20倍；越狱式角色扮演前缀效果不一，在部分模型中拒答激增，在另一些模型中几乎无变化。

Conclusion: 小型可本地部署LLM在真实机构用户自然引入的上下文框架下表现不稳定，会导致对合法请求的选择性拒答与不均等辅助获取，形成偏见风险；需进一步研究以最小化此类偏见。

Abstract: Confidentiality requirements increasingly push legal professionals toward small, on-device LLMs that keep case data in-house, used for everyday tasks such as summarization, translation, and reformulation. Following standard prompting guidance, a user naturally states their role (``I am a lawyer...''). We show that this innocuous habit has an unexpected cost: such authority framing can make the model selectively refuse legitimate requests, introducing bias through uneven access to assistance. We evaluate four modern small open-weight LLMs on benign legal-domain prompts to measure this over-refusal.
  Surprisingly, we find that authority-style prefixes (''I am legal counsel working for a national supreme court'', ''I'm a defense lawyer'') systematically increase refusal rates by 2--20x over the no-prefix baseline, while a known role-play jailbreak prefix shows mixed effects, sharply increasing refusals in some models and barely shifting them in others. The finding suggests that small on-prem deployable LLMs are unstable under contextual framings that a real institutional user might naturally introduce, and further investigation is essential to minimize opportunities for bias.

</details>


### [676] [Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26101)
*Jiasheng Mao,Jiacheng Liu,Hengwei Ye,Zheng Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 QuantHarness（两层 agent harness：金融专用 Workflow + Harness Core 边界控制）与 FinRelBench 基准，在轨迹层面保障金融策略开发可靠性，任务成功率 90.72%，优于对比系统的 74.23%–84.54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 可将自然语言金融研究请求转为可执行、可回测的策略，但"跑通"不等于正确：可能实现错误规则、使用决策时点不可得的信息（前视偏差），或掩盖修复与候选选择如何改变策略。这些失败贯穿开发全过程，因此仅凭最终代码与绩效指标无法证明需求保真度与开发过程有效性，需在轨迹层面评估可靠性。

Method: 提出 QuantHarness 两层 agent harness：金融专用 Workflow 负责规范、数据落地、构造、测试与复核的结构化组织；Harness Core 强制各阶段的信息、动作与承诺边界（控制中间输出如何成为下游状态）。并提出 FinRelBench 基准，从执行成功、需求满足、运行时证据三方面评估策略开发可靠性。

Result: QuantHarness 任务成功率 90.72%，对比系统为 74.23%–84.54%；受控压力测试显示其边界能拦截针对性违规；结构化运行记录提升了证据检索能力，并在评估协议下支持决策回放。

Conclusion: 金融策略开发可靠性应由轨迹级证据而非仅终端代码与指标来确立；分层工作流与阶段边界约束可有效抑制信息泄漏与过程不透明问题，为可审计、可回放的 agent 策略开发提供框架。

Abstract: LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\%, compared with 74.23\%--84.54\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

</details>


### [677] [AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26031)
*Jacopo Biggiogera,Nicolas Colombo,Krati Saxena,Bhaskarjit Sarmah,Stefano Pasquali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种“本体驱动、仓库原生”的数据质量层愿景，将质量规则视为一等公民工件（版本化、与治理文本建立溯源链接、可通过不可变执行轨迹重放），并给出其代理式规则发现核心（Full-Agentic 与 Guided 两种模式）与 HITL 审核界面的具体实现，定义评估框架并在金融、零售两个真实工业数据集上报告初步结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险表格流水线依赖零散、静态的质量检查，难以演进，也难以对照政策意图进行审计；受监管领域尤为突出，且 LLM 时代的自动化提升了对可追溯性与问责性的期望。

Method: 提出本体驱动、仓库原生的数据质量层愿景（规则版本化、与治理文本溯源链接、经由不可变执行轨迹重放）；作为验证第一步，实现代理式规则发现核心，含 Full-Agentic（完全自主、分治式）与 Guided 两种规则获取模式，以及 HITL 审核界面；并定义评估框架。

Result: 在金融与零售两个真实工业数据集上的初步实验，考察完全自主的分治式代理规则发现所产出的规则，在质量与多样性上是否与人类专家制定的规则相当。

Conclusion: 该工作以愿景加原型的方式推进：代理式规则发现是构建可审计、可演化质量层的第一步，初步结果表明其具备与专家规则可比的质量与多样性潜力，后续需在更大规模上进一步验证。

Abstract: High-stakes tabular pipelines rely on scattered, static quality checks that are hard to evolve and audit against policy intent. Regulated domains particularly suffer as the LLM-era automation raises expectations for traceability and accountability. We propose a vision for an ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer in which rules are first-class artifacts: versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and re-playable through immutable execution traces. As a first step toward validating this vision, we present a concrete implementation of its agentic rule-discovery core with two rule acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) and a human-in-the-loop (HITL) review interface. We define an evaluation framework and run experiments addressing whether our fully autonomous, divide-and-conquer agentic rule discovery produces rules of the same quality and diversity as those specified by a human expert, reporting preliminary results on two real world industry datasets in the finance and retail domains.

</details>


### [678] [A Semantic Knowledge Graph Construction Pipeline for Vehicle Intention Prediction in nuScenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26528)
*Khaled Nowara,Mohamed Manzour,Catherine Elias*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NIKG——一个基于OWL的自车意图知识图谱，将nuScenes场景实例化为Turtle图，并把自车相对运动、空间构型与TTC风险三类意图相关关系提升为参与者的一等属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通场景知识图谱多聚焦轨迹预测或通用场景理解，缺乏面向自车（ego-centric）意图上下文的显式语义表示。

Method: 构建OWL本体及可复现流水线，仅依赖自车位姿、跟踪目标标注与关键帧时序等少量输入；将每个场景参与者建模为一等属性节点，表达自车相对运动、空间构型与TTC风险关系，输出自描述的Turtle图，并配套验证协议。

Result: 在nuScenes mini上生成404个关键帧、211,335条三元组的图谱；验证协议下自车相对运动标签前向一致性达92.5%，并报告覆盖率、语义一致性与时序连贯性分析。

Conclusion: NIKG定位于场景导向交通知识图谱与意图预测模型之间，作为小型显式语义层，支撑KGE、SPARQL特征抽取及神经符号混合推理等下游任务。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly used in autonomous driving (AD) to make traffic scene entities and relations explicit for prediction and reasoning. Existing traffic-scene KGs, however, primarily emphasize trajectory forecasting or general scene understanding. This paper presents the nuScenes Intention Knowledge Graph (NIKG), a focused Web Ontology Language (OWL)-based semantic representation and construction pipeline for ego-centric vehicle intention context. NIKG instantiates nuScenes scenes as a self-describing Turtle graph and promotes three intention-relevant relations to first-class properties of each scene participant: ego-relative motion, spatial configuration, and time to collision (TTC) risk. The pipeline uses a small input contract available in many ego-centric driving datasets: ego pose, tracked object annotations, and temporal keyframe order. NIKG is released as an ontology-backed, self-describing graph artifact together with a reproducible construction pipeline and validation protocol for ego-centric intention context. Applying this pipeline to nuScenes mini yields a graph of 211,335 triples across 404 keyframes; under the validation protocol, ego-relative motion labels achieve 92.5% forward consistency. Coverage, semantic consistency, and temporal coherence analyses over this artifact are further reported. NIKG occupies the space between scene-oriented traffic KGs and intention-prediction models: a small, explicit semantic layer intended to support downstream work such as knowledge graph embedding (KGE), SPARQL-based feature extraction, or hybrid neuro-symbolic reasoning.

</details>


### [679] [Toward Structured Financial Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26516)
*Natraj Raman,Saumitra Mishra,Vamsi Potluru,Sumitra Ganesh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出以结构化数据为先的研究议程：构建模块化、领域专精的金融基础模型，通过"表示织网"实现跨域跨任务复用与组合，并要求其维护持久金融状态、刻画动态、模拟动作条件未来、跨regime与尾部结果校准、在数据与访问约束下高效学习并提供可追溯解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融基础模型的架构与目标函数无法同时应对金融系统的复合需求：部分可观测性、实体交互、异步事件、regime切换、动作依赖结果、以及后果不成比例的稀有状态。同时，独立开发的专家模型表示不兼容，而多域单体式方案将数据访问、模型更新与治理耦合在一起。

Method: 本文为立场/议程型论文，不提出具体模型或实验。核心方法主张为"结构化数据优先"：以模块化、领域专精的金融基础模型为单元，用表示织网（representation fabric）连接，实现跨域跨任务的复用与组合；模型需在聚合层级与时间尺度上维护持久金融状态、建模其动态并模拟动作条件情景，同时在regime与尾部结果上保持校准；在数据与访问约束下高效学习，并给出忠实、可追溯的解释。论文梳理研究挑战、方向与面向能力的评价标准。

Result: 无实证结果。论文贡献在于界定金融基础模型的能力需求清单、指出研究挑战与可行方向，并提出以能力为导向的评估准则，为后续工作提供参照框架。

Conclusion: 金融基础模型的进展应转向模块化、领域专精并以表示织网互联的路线，而非单体式多域模型；评价应围绕状态持久性、动态建模、动作条件模拟、校准（含尾部）、受限数据下的学习效率与解释可追溯性等能力展开。

Abstract: Foundation models promise reusable capabilities and step-change performance gains across tasks. In finance, large-scale pretraining of domain-specialized foundation models can advance both goals. However, prevailing architectures and objectives do not by themselves address the combined demands of financial systems: partial observability, interacting entities, asynchronous events, changing regimes, action-dependent outcomes, and rare states with disproportionate consequences. Moreover, independently developed specialists may learn incompatible representations, while multi-domain monolithic alternatives couple data access, model updates, and governance. We therefore propose a structured-data-first research agenda centered on modular, domain-specialized financial foundation models connected by a representation fabric for reuse and composition across domains and tasks. These models should maintain persistent financial state across aggregation levels and time horizons, capture its dynamics, and simulate action-conditioned futures, while remaining calibrated across regimes and for tail outcomes. They must also learn efficiently under data and access constraints and provide faithful, traceable explanations. We identify research challenges, directions, and capability-oriented evaluation criteria.

</details>


### [680] [ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26503)
*Zhicheng Zheng,Cheng Zhang,Shengping Yu,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 潜记忆作为GUI智能体的轻量历史补充，其增益主要源于“动作修正”而非历史编码；步进交叉熵导致修正无边界、会破坏8-13%原本正确决策。本文提出ScopeMem，通过以初始答案为条件、以“纠错且保持正确”为目标的编码器实现有界修正，将破坏率降至5.6%，并在多个基准上超越提示与潜记忆基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜记忆普遍被视为对冻结VLM的历史补充，但作者通过控制实验发现其增益主要来自前缀向量对模型默认动作的改写（action revision），而非历史编码本身。更关键的是，步进交叉熵（step-wise CE）在每一步都把输出推向参考动作，未显式保留原本正确的决策，导致修正"无边界"（unscoped）：既修复错误，也破坏8-13%的初始正确预测，而总体准确率掩盖了这部分损失。

Method: 提出ScopeMem，一种实现"有界修正"的潜记忆方法。其编码器以模型初始答案为条件生成前缀向量，并在此训练目标下学习：纠正错误决策的同时保持原本正确的决策不变，避免无差别改写。

Result: 在受控消融集上，ScopeMem将初始正确决策被破坏的比例降至5.6%，且修复的错误数量多于所有评测过的CE训练前缀。在AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey及零样本AITW上，ScopeMem优于所有评测的提示方法与潜记忆基线，使冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B达到或超过GUI专用智能体及Qwen3-VL-32B的水平。

Conclusion: 潜记忆的有效性来自动作修正而非历史编码，且需以"有界"方式施加。ScopeMem通过条件化编码器实现纠错而不破坏正确决策，在降低破坏率的同时提升整体性能，表明冻结模型中实现高效GUI智能体具有可行性。

Abstract: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

</details>


### [681] [GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25978)
*Suxing Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无训练的图结构化自反思协议GraphEvoResearcher，将EvoResearcher的元奖励提升到显式推理图上，用图感知奖励与图收敛早停决定修订/回溯/停止，在多跳QA上取得最优精度且成本可控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多跳QA的无训练"生成→批评→修订"自反思协议在扁平token流上运行：修订无法定位哪一步不可靠，早停也无法利用结构收敛信息，因此需要引入显式结构表示。

Method: 将中间结论/证据作为节点、以support/contradict/depends_on为边构建推理图；设计图感知元奖励，融合正确性、效率、反思、多样性及四个结构信号（连通性、无环性、分支覆盖、路径收敛），据此决定修订、回溯或停止；并用证据分支收敛到单一结论触发图收敛早停。

Result: 在DeepSeek上于GSM8K、MATH、BBH（各n=50）分别达98%、92%、82%，为全部基线最高；最难集MATH增益最大（较单次+24pp，较扁平反思+12pp），构建成本约2步/4.5–5节点。

Conclusion: 推理图的结构信号在单步推理最不可靠的场景中价值最大，说明结构感知的自反思与早停是提升多跳QA可靠性与效率的有效途径。

Abstract: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

</details>


### [682] [On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25977)
*Kamenan N'Gadi,Martin Laviale,C{é}dric Pradalier,J{é}r{é}my Fix*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对759类硅藻图像分类，构建ResNet-18基线并用温度标定改善置信度可靠性，结合选择性分类实现准确率与人工复核工作量的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显微镜图像中硅藻的自动识别是淡水生物监测的基础，但物种多样性高、类别严重不平衡，导致可靠分类困难；同时专家复核成本高，需要在不损害分类完整性的前提下降低人工工作量。

Method: 构建759类硅藻数据集的ResNet-18基线；采用事后温度标定（T=2.12）校准置信度，以ECE为指标评估可靠性；在三分诊（triage）框架下利用校准概率进行选择性分类，设置拒绝阈值τ=0.934，并以Selective Macro-F1与覆盖率评估；辅以定性分析，基于torch-uncertainty框架实现。

Result: 初始模型存在过度自信，ECE为0.117；温度标定后ECE降至0.055。在τ=0.934下，覆盖率66.2%时仍保持99.01%的Selective Macro-F1。定性分析显示系统作为智能过滤器，能稳定地将稀有类群（如AAMB、AASI）与形态模糊样本交由专家复核。

Conclusion: 简单的置信度标定技术即可显著提升自动化硅藻识别的实用性，使选择性分类在保证稀有物种指标（生态评估关键）的前提下有效降低专家工作量，具备稳健性和可复现性。

Abstract: Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to 0.055.By leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $τ$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.

</details>


### [683] [TESS: LLM-guided Translation, Exploration, Simulation, and Search for Embodied Task Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25930)
*Peiran Xu,Yixiang Yang,Jinghan Li,Fei Li,Cao Sheng,JiaZhong Yu,Yadong Mu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LLM引导的搜索算法用于具身任务规划：利用LLM将自然语言指令转为目标条件、辅助部分可观测环境探索、构建基于规则的世界模拟器、并剪枝候选动作空间，在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上取得优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身任务规划需将复杂任务分解为原子动作。现有LLM方法生成的计划在复杂环境与任务中可执行性与正确性欠佳；而经典搜索算法虽能完美求解规划问题，却依赖全可观测环境、已知状态转移与目标状态，在一般任务域中难以满足。故希望结合LLM的常识知识使搜索可行且高效。

Method: LLM引导的搜索算法，LLM承担四项功能：(1) 将自然语言指令翻译为格式化的目标条件；(2) 促进部分可观测环境中的高效探索；(3) 实现基于规则的世界模拟器；(4) 剪枝候选动作空间以提升搜索效率。

Result: 在VirtualHome与ALFWorld两个基准上实验，性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 将LLM常识知识与经典搜索相结合，可弥补LLM规划可执行性/正确性不足与经典搜索对完整环境模型依赖的互补缺陷，实现高效且可执行的具身任务规划。

Abstract: In this work we focus on the problem of embodied task planning, which requires an agent to accomplish a complex task by separating it into atomic actions. Recent studies have developed LLM-based methods to address this problem. However, the executability and correctness of the generated plans remain suboptimal in complex environments and tasks. On the other hand, classical search algorithms have the potential to solve the planning problems perfectly, yet they require fully observable environments, known state transitions and goal state, which are often unattainable in general task domains. Therefore, we propose to implement an LLM-guided search algorithm that makes the search process possible and efficient by incorporating LLMs' commonsense knowledge. Our method leverages LLMs to (1) translate natural language instructions into formatted goal conditions, (2) facilitate efficient exploration in partially observable environments, (3) implement a rule-based world simulator, and (4) prune the space of candidate actions to improve search efficiency. Experimental results on VirtualHome and ALFWorld demonstrate its superior performance.

</details>


### [684] [TimelineAgent: An LLM-based Framework for Query-Centric Event Timeline Extraction Across Multiple Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25733)
*Qingkai Min,Yunxin Bao,Yifeng Lu,Zhenyu Feng,Yulong Chen,Andreas Vlachos,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TimelineAgent——基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，通过多阶段推理工作流完成查询中心式跨文档事件时间线抽取，并构建覆盖多样查询焦点的基准，实验证明其持续优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询中心式跨文档事件时间线抽取需在不同查询焦点下从多文档构建事件时间线，其难点在于：跨文档时间线构建本身的复杂性带来异构事件建模需求，查询焦点的多样性又带来多样化推理需求，二者共同造成异构事件建模与推理的困难。

Method: TimelineAgent：基于LLM的多智能体框架，采用多阶段推理工作流；将异构事件特征组织为可复用技能（reusable skills），并通过目标导向协议（goal-oriented protocol）对技能进行编排调度。

Result: 为便于评测，构建了覆盖多样查询焦点的基准；实验结果显示TimelineAgent在各项对比中持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: TimelineAgent为复杂现实场景下的时间线构建提供了实用框架，验证了以技能化组织+协议化编排的多智能体推理范式在该任务上的有效性。

Abstract: Query-centric cross-document event timeline extraction aims to construct event timelines from multiple documents under diverse query focuses. The task is very challenging due to the heterogeneous event modeling and reasoning requirements arising from both the intrinsic complexity of cross-document timeline construction and the diversity of query focuses. In this paper, we propose TimelineAgent, an LLM-based multi-agent framework featuring a multi-stage reasoning workflow, where heterogeneous event features are organized into reusable skills and orchestrated through a goal-oriented protocol. To facilitate evaluation, we construct a benchmark covering diverse query focuses. Experimental results show that TimelineAgent consistently outperforms existing methods, offering a practical framework for complex real-world timeline construction.

</details>


### [685] [SOMA: Continuous Monitoring and Intervention for System Two Reasoning with System One Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26793)
*Ruizhi Qian,Lei Shi,Tianyu Hu,Bo Yan,Song Wang,Yu Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SOMA框架，用S1模型（如Jev）实时监控S2推理模型，通过"场景—觉察—控制"三层结构在需要时干预，无需训练即可缓解过度思考与不可回答问题两大失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型常在自身文本中已显现问题症状却无法察觉，导致过度思考或在不可回答问题上勉强作答。人类元认知将"监控"与"控制"分离：快速的直觉信号在缓慢的审慎推理过程中持续监视，并决定继续、转向或停止。现有S1决策模型虽能一次快速调用给出校准概率，却仅被用作推理前的门控，未被用于过程性监控。

Method: SOMA（System One Metacognitive Awareness）由三层组成：场景层以自然语言陈述每个目标并预设可选动作；觉察层由S1模型判断所描述行为是否出现；控制层累积这些判断，先提醒S2，仅在行为持续时接管。所有任务共享同一个S1模型与同一个控制器，且无需训练。

Result: 在两个推理模型、两类不同失效上验证：针对过度思考，推理token最多减少36%且平均准确率提升；针对不可回答问题，弃答率从70.5%提升至87.2%。

Conclusion: 小型S1模型可作为S2推理过程的持续元认知监控器，以低成本、免训练的方式实现过程级干预，兼顾效率与可靠性。

Abstract: Reasoning models often run into problems without noticing them, even when symptoms are visible in their own text. In humans, metacognition separates monitoring from control: fast, intuitive signals keep watch while slow, deliberate reasoning unfolds and help decide whether to continue, change course, or stop. System One (S1) decision models, such as Jev, are a natural candidate for this role: they return a calibrated probability for a natural-language question about a text in one fast call, yet they are used only as gates before reasoning. We introduce SOMA (System One Metacognitive Awareness), in which an S1 model continuously monitors a System Two (S2) reasoning model and intervenes when needed. SOMA has three layers: a scenario layer states each objective in natural language with predefined actions, an awareness layer lets S1 judge whether the described behavior appears, and a control layer accumulates these judgments, first reminds S2, and takes over only if the behavior persists. Sharing one S1 model and one controller across tasks, without training, SOMA addresses two different failures on two reasoning models: on overthinking, it cuts reasoning tokens by up to 36\% while improving average accuracy, and on unanswerable questions, it raises abstention from 70.5\% to 87.2\%.

</details>


### [686] [StrucChunk: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Legal Document RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26313)
*Surya Deep Singh,Ashutosh Tripathi,Gaurav Deep Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: StrucChunk：将法律文档视为条款DAG进行结构感知分块，保留条款边界并解析交叉引用，结合BM25与BGE-M3的稠密-稀疏混合检索（RRF融合），在五套法律语料上显著超越基线及SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG可将LLM输出锚定于领域知识，但法律文档处理困难：常规分块会割裂层级论证结构，通用嵌入难以兼顾精确引用匹配与语义理解。

Method: 提出StrucChunk结构感知分块：将文档建模为条款有向无环图（DAG），保持条款边界，在嵌入前解析交叉引用；检索端将BM25与BGE-M3通过Reciprocal Rank Fusion融合，形成稠密-稀疏混合检索。

Result: 在5个语料、3大法律传统、2种语言上评估：CrPC上边界精度100%（递归切分7.7%）；保留97.6%交叉引用（基线0%）；GDPR上以少40.3%的块数达到同等章节覆盖；LegalBench-RAG（6,858查询-段落对）Char-Recall@8为48.18% vs 最佳基线23.59%（+104%），超已发表SOTA +83%；印度法CrPC/CPC各501查询Recall@5从0.557→0.804（+44.4%）、0.158→0.259（+64.6%），分块贡献88%和73%；GDPR 501查询Recall@5=0.868，R@1提升59%；泰国金融法NitiBench-CCL（3,730查询）HR@5为0.856 vs 0.594（+44.1%），交叉引用增强在引用类查询上再增益2.3%。

Conclusion: 章节边界对齐是跨语言的主导因素，交叉引用增强提供额外增益；作者开源实现、5,256条评估查询、标注方法及分块质量指标。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can ground LLM outputs in domain-specific knowledge, but legal documents are hard: standard chunking fragments hierarchical argument structure, and generic embeddings struggle with both precise citation matching and semantic understanding. We propose StrucChunk (Structure Aware Chunking) with hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for hierarchically structured legal documents. It treats documents as directed acyclic graphs of provisions, preserves clause boundaries, resolves cross-references before embedding, and combines BM25 with BGE-M3 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. We evaluate on five corpora, three legal traditions and two languages. StrucChunk reaches 100% boundary precision (vs. 7.7% for recursive splitting on CrPC), preserves 97.6% of documented cross-references (vs. 0%), and matches section coverage with 40.3% fewer chunks on GDPR. On LegalBench-RAG (6,858 query-passage pairs), it achieves Char-Recall@8 of 48.18% vs. 23.59% for the best baseline (+104%), surpassing the published state of the art by +83%. On 501 queries each for CrPC and CPC (Indian law), Recall@5 improves from 0.557 to 0.804 (+44.4%) and from 0.158 to 0.259 (+64.6%); chunking accounts for 88% and 73% of the gain. On 501 GDPR queries, Recall@5 is 0.868 with R@1 improving +59%. On NitiBench-CCL (3,730 Thai financial law queries), HR@5 is 0.856 vs. 0.594 for naive chunking (+44.1%), showing that section-boundary alignment is the dominant factor across languages, and cross-reference augmentation adds +2.3% on cross-reference queries. We release the implementation, 5,256 evaluation queries across five legal corpora, annotation methodology and chunking quality metrics. Code: github.com/SinghSuryaDeep/legal-rag-strucchunk-1

</details>


### [687] [Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26660)
*Zhuomin Chen,Jingchao Ni,Xu Zheng,Yong Chen,Mo Sha,Wei Cheng,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Tandem 是针对移动 NPU 上混合线性注意力 GUI 智能体的运行时，通过在对齐位置保存循环状态、将 prefill 保留在矩阵单元并用单次权重读取的验证内核，将每步延迟降低 30%/16%，单步能耗降低 33%，待机功耗从 0.76 W 降至 0.22 W。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动端 GUI 智能体需在 NPU 本地执行以保护屏幕隐私，但每步动作的模型延迟会累积。混合线性注意力模型虽降低内存占用，其循环状态复用依赖在合适输入位置设置检查点；而智能体请求保留指令却重写近期历史，使面向聊天续写设计的检查点策略错过可复用前缀。此外，为投机解码保留回滚状态会把 prompt 处理移出 NPU 的矩阵单元，对短动作输出而言开销大于收益；已加载模型还会持续占用 NPU 电源。

Method: Tandem 在连续 prompt 发生分叉处保存循环状态，使后续请求复用已处理上下文；将大部分 prefill 保持在矩阵单元上，并通过简短的逐 token 尾部计算生成回滚状态；其验证内核对所有候选 token 仅读取一次每个权重块；在请求间隙释放 NPU 电源投票而不卸载模型。实现于 llama.cpp，并在两代 Snapdragon 的真实录制交互上评测。

Result: 在 Snapdragon 8 Elite 上，相较 llama.cpp 最快的 NPU 配置，Tandem 对文本屏幕描述每步延迟降低 30%，截图场景降低 16%，文本每步能耗降低 33%；模型保持加载时的待机功耗由 0.76 W 降至 0.22 W。

Conclusion: 针对智能体请求结构的检查点复用、矩阵单元友好的回滚状态生成、一次读取的验证内核与不卸载释放电源，是提升移动 NPU 上 GUI 智能体效率的有效组合，可在隐私本地执行前提下显著改善延迟、能耗与待机功耗。

Abstract: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

</details>


### [688] [Towards Robust Model Organisms for Eliciting Latent Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26698)
*Lennart Finke,Hardik Bhatnagar,Euodia Dodd,Francis Rhys Ward,Yves-Alexandre de Montjoye,Matthias Bethge,Mary Phuong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文训练了用于ELK研究的"模型生物"：在漏洞检测任务中教模型学会"选择性保留"答案（sandbagging），并同时满足选择性、抗诱导鲁棒性与知识保留三项关键属性，最强模型在鲁棒性上显著超越已有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI安全的核心难题是诱导潜在知识（ELK）：从能力超越监督者却已失准的模型中提取真实信息。例如被用于漏洞扫描的失准模型可能故意隐瞒发现以便日后利用（sandbagging）。实证研究ELK需要能复现该情境的模型生物，但现有模型生物在多个方面存在不足。

Method: 在漏洞检测任务上训练模型生物使其隐瞒答案；采用三项技术组合：transcript distillation（轨迹蒸馏）、counter-prompting（反向提示）以及 tamper-resistance training（防篡改训练），以注入三项关键属性：(1) 选择性——仅当模型认为监督者不知道答案时才sandbag，否则如实配合；(2) 鲁棒性——抵抗诱导式提取；(3) 保留性——维持相对监督者的知识优势而非丧失相关能力。研究训练了一系列递进的模型生物。

Result: 最强模型在鲁棒性上大幅优于先前的模型生物，同时保持选择性与知识保留两项属性不受损。代码、模型与数据集已公开于 HuggingFace 集合（lennart-finke/sandbagging）。

Conclusion: 所训练的模型生物可为社区提供有用的ELK测试平台，其方法论有望推动更具挑战性的模型生物的研发。

Abstract: A key problem in AI safety is eliciting latent knowledge (ELK), extracting information from a model that is misaligned and more knowledgeable than its overseer. For example, a misaligned model used to scan code for vulnerabilities may want to withhold its findings, i.e., sandbag, in order to exploit them later. To study ELK empirically, we need model organisms that mirror this setting. Existing model organisms fall short in several respects. In this work, we train model organisms to withhold solutions in a vulnerability detection task. We combine transcript distillation with counter-prompting and tamper-resistance training to instill three properties that we argue are critical for a useful ELK testbed: 1) Selectivity, the model sandbags when it thinks the overseer doesn't know the answer and complies otherwise, 2) Robustness, the model resists elicitation, and 3) Retention, the model retains a knowledge advantage over the overseer, as opposed to losing the relevant capability. We train a sequence of model organisms and show that our strongest model substantially outperforms prior models on robustness while keeping the other two properties intact. We hope that our model organisms provide a useful ELK testbed for the community, and that our methodology sparks the development of increasingly challenging model organisms.
  All our code, models and the dataset are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/lennart-finke/sandbagging.

</details>


### [689] [Local data augmentation for imbalanced binary classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26418)
*Harold Gu{é}neau,Alain Celisse,Pascal Delange*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究不平衡二分类中多种重平衡策略对召回率与误检率的影响，证明仅重平衡类别比例无法改变分类性能，而局部数据增强可以影响最终结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在类别不平衡的二分类任务中，希望最大化少数类的召回率，同时限制误检比例。作者试图厘清重平衡策略中哪一部分真正影响了性能。

Method: 提出两步式局部增强流程：第一步在训练样本中随机抽取锚点；第二步依据"增强核"（高斯核或基于扩散的核）生成新增强数据。由此可将锚点抽样的影响与是否考虑支撑集局部几何的增强抽样影响解耦。对比从少数类均匀子采样到局部数据增强的一系列重平衡策略，并在合成数据上实验。

Result: 仅改变类别比例的重平衡不影响分类性能；局部数据增强则被证明会影响最终结果。在类别边界邻近区域进行子采样并结合高斯增强核时，性能优于SMOTE类增强方法；当支撑集的几何结构较为重要时，基于扩散的增强核优于高斯核。

Conclusion: 重平衡的效果来源于局部数据增强而非类别比例本身；锚点抽样策略与增强核的选择共同决定性能，边界邻域子采样配高斯核在一般情形更优，扩散核在几何结构敏感场景更优。

Abstract: Facing imbalanced binary classification, we aim at maximizing the recall while limiting the proportion of false detections in the minority class. For doing that, the present work studies the effect of several rebalancing strategies, from the uniform subsampling of the observations from the minority class, to a more involved local data augmentation scheme. To be more specific, we establish that only rebalancing class proportions cannot modify the classification performance, whereas local data augmentation is proved to have an impact on the final results. The local augmentation scheme is introduced by means of a two-step procedure. The first step randomly subsamples anchor points among the training observations. These anchor points are used in the second step, for drawing new augmentation data following an ''augmentation kernel'' to be specified. This enables us to decouple the impact of the anchor points subsampling from the one of drawing augmentation data accounting (or not) for the local geometry of the support. The experiments on synthetic data illustrate the practical performance of several strategies for subsampling anchor points combined with either a Gaussian or a diffusion-based augmentation kernel. Compared to SMOTE-like data augmentation procedures, a better performance is achieved when subsampling in the close neighborhood to the classification boundary combined with a Gaussian augmentation kernel. Furthermore in specific settings where the geometric structure of the support matters, the experimental results show that using a diffusion-based augmentation kernel outperforms the Gaussian one.

</details>
